article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: l'INRB réalise un séquençage de 1 526 génomes du virus Bundibugyo - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: INRB conducts sequencing of 1,526 genomes of the Bundibugyo virus - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 9 November 2026, the National Biomedical Research Institute (INRB) in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo, sequenced 1,526 complete genomes of Bundibugyo virus in under six months as part of Ebola virus disease surveillance. By comparison, during the West Africa Ebola outbreak (2013–2016), about 1,610 Ebola virus genomes were sequenced over nearly 20 months. This milestone strengthens genomic surveillance, aiding understanding of the ongoing Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the DRC and enhancing response interventions. The work is supervised by Professors Tony Wawina B. and Placide Mbala K., with plans to expand sequencing to 2,500 Bundibugyo virus genomes to improve phylogenetic and transmission insights.}}

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Penularan Malaria Knowlesi, 150 Penambang Emas di Aceh Jaya Jalani Tes Darah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Knowlesi malaria transmission, 150 gold miners in Aceh Jaya undergo blood tests.
article.articleSummary: 150 gold miners in Krueng Sabee, Aceh Jaya Regency, Aceh Province, Indonesia, undergo a three-day Mass Blood Survey to detect Plasmodium knowlesi malaria and curb transmission. The testing targets miners in Block 12 and Gunung Ujeun, with participation from Dinas Kesehatan Aceh, Labkesmas Aceh, BKSDA Aceh, and Puskesmas Krueng Sabee, following rising knowlesi malaria cases in the area. Pre-program socialization with Muspika and Apdesi supported participation. The program includes human parasite testing, surveillance of long-tailed macaques (natural hosts), and vector surveillance for Anopheles mosquitoes to identify sources and risk factors. BKSDA Aceh assists with macaque assessments. Plans include distributing insecticide-treated nets to reduce mosquito bites. Findings will inform integrated control measures and help maintain malaria elimination status in Aceh Jaya.

article.articleHeadline: Fine Particulate Components Linked to Tuberculosis Hospitalizations and
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary tuberculosis admissions in Hainan, China, are linked to short-term exposure to PM2.5 and its chemical components. In a case-crossover study of 4,524 hospitalizations from 2016–2019, higher ambient PM2.5 and increased concentrations of sulfate, ammonium, black carbon, nitrate, and organic matter all correlated with elevated TB hospitalization risk. Total PM2.5 showed a 9.77% increase in risk per interquartile range (95% CI 2.60–17.44%), while sulfate drove 14.68% (7.25–22.64%), ammonium 10.81% (3.84–18.26%), black carbon 10.07% (3.17–17.44%), nitrate 8.53% (1.84–15.66%), and organic matter 6.82% (0.78–13.23%). Sulfate and black carbon accounted for 41.6% and 39.0% of the total component effects, together over 80%. Risks were higher among people aged 65 and older, residents of prefecture-level cities, and during warm seasons; greenness modified risks, being significant only in low-vegetation areas (NDVI <0.45). Implications point to reducing sulfate and black carbon emissions and expanding green space in low-vegetation areas.

article.articleHeadline: 浸大夥諾獎得主研全球首支丙肝疫苗　目標2030年完成效能測試推出 - 香港文匯報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nobel Prize-winning researchers at HKBU are researching the world's first hepatitis C vaccine, aiming to complete efficacy testing and launch by 2030 - Wen Wei Po
article.articleSummary: HKBU, with Nobel laureate Michael Houghton, is developing the world’s first hepatitis C vaccine, targeting Asia. The project focuses on neutralizing antibodies and cellular responses, aiming for efficacy testing and 2030 launch; phase I–II trials are planned from 2028 in Hong Kong, Shanghai, and Beijing, with multi-center design. Production talks are underway with Shenzhen and Shanghai manufacturers to tailor Asian virus strains, with potential licensing to mainland partners for mass production. Estimated cost around HK$1,600 per person to widen access and curb transmission. Hepatitis C causes acute or chronic hepatitis and can progress to cirrhosis and liver cancer. Global burden: about 47 million chronic infections, roughly 900,000 new cases per year, and 239,000 deaths in 2024; in Hong Kong, about 0.3% infected (17,000–22,000), with injection drug users disproportionately affected (>60%). Initial vaccine distribution planned for newborns, people with multiple sexual partners, healthcare workers and people who inject drugs.

article.articleHeadline: Systematic Review Identifies Leading Viral and Environmental Drivers of
article.articleSummary: South Asia's children under five with community-acquired pneumonia are more frequently infected with viral pathogens than bacteria, with respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) detected in a mean of 29.2% of cases across five countries—India, Bangladesh, Nepal, Pakistan, and Bhutan. The systematic review analyzed studies published 2000–2024 with an update through January 2026, selecting 16 high-quality investigations (eight on risk factors, eight on etiology) from 1,196 records after Crowe Critical Appraisal Tool ≥75% threshold. The work highlights young age (0–23 months), malnutrition (wasting/underweight), and incomplete immunization as consistent host determinants; environmental drivers include indoor air pollution, poor ventilation, and household crowding. Blood cultures showed low positivity (1.5%–31.3%), with Streptococcus pneumoniae and Staphylococcus aureus most common when positive. The authors call for integrated interventions addressing nutrition, immunization, indoor air pollution, and socioeconomic conditions to reduce the pneumonia burden in South Asia.

article.articleHeadline: Lymphatic Filariasis Risk Models Show High Bias and Limited External
article.articleSummary: Twenty-six lymphatic filariasis risk prediction studies (2000–2025) were systematically reviewed and all were judged as high or unclear risk of bias, with external validation and calibration notably absent. The work, conducted across Africa and India, sought models predicting infection status, transmission risk, and disease prevalence using spatially aggregated epidemiological and environmental data. Environmental predictors appeared in 76.9% of studies; climatic predictors in 73.1%, with socio-demographic, vector-related, and programmatic variables far less common (57.7%, 7.7%, 7.7%). Methodologies ranged from Bayesian spatial and ecological niche models to machine learning and hybrids; predictor selection tended to expert-driven with internal validation for Bayesian/spatial, and algorithm-based selection with cross-validation for ML/hybrids. External validation was reported in only 15.4% of studies. The authors call for stronger external validation, calibration assessments, greater methodological transparency, and improved reporting to support reliable models for elimination verification and post-elimination surveillance.

article.articleHeadline: कोरोना से खलबली, नया वेरिएंट PJ.2.1 क्या, कितना खतरनाक, कहां-कहां फैला, भारत में भी दस्तक
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Panic over coronavirus: What is the new PJ.2.1 variant, how dangerous is it, where has it spread, has it reached India.
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1 is a newly identified SARS-CoV-2 variant that has sparked concern. First detected in May 2026 in Ontario, Canada, it has spread to the United States, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, and parts of Asia. The variant carries a spike protein that may increase binding to ACE2. There is no conclusive evidence yet that PJ.2.1 causes more severe disease, higher hospitalisation, or more deaths. WHO notes COVID-19 symptoms resemble influenza and other respiratory infections, so diagnosis relies on testing. It is not yet confirmed whether the variant has reached India; INSACOG monitors SARS-CoV-2 lineages, and surveillance is needed. Vaccination remains protective; vaccine-induced antibodies have neutralised PJ.2.1 in studies. Cases have been more common among older adults, particularly 70+. Common symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, headache, and fatigue.

article.articleHeadline: Reuters: количество случаев заражения Эболой в ДР Конго превысило 11 тыс.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Reuters: The number of Ebola infection cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeded 11,000.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have exceeded 11,000, with deaths approaching 5,400, according to Reuters citing official state data. As of November 11, 2026, the outbreak, which began in May 2026, is the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the deadliest in the country’s history. Ongoing fighting in the eastern provinces and public distrust of authorities severely hinder access to medical care and the implementation of anti-epidemic measures, complicating response coordination across affected regions.

article.articleHeadline: Paraná confirma mais 118 casos de dengue em duas semanas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraná confirms 118 more dengue cases in two weeks.
article.articleSummary: Paraná, Brazil reports 6,380 lab-confirmed dengue cases in 2026, up 118 new confirmations in two weeks, through epidemiological week 44, per the state Health Secretariat (Sesa). The tally includes 72,455 notifications and 12,533 probable dengue cases; six deaths persist. There are 303 dengue cases with warning signs and 14 cases of severe dengue. Regional breakdown: Londrina Health Region leads with 1,700 cases (including dengue with warning signs and severe dengue), followed by Maringá with 675 and Paranavaí with 654. In total, 291 municipalities have confirmed cases; 5,324 locally acquired infections are autochthonous. For other arboviruses, chikungunya has 173 confirmed cases and 1,615 notifications (no deaths), while Zika remains with 84 notifications and no confirmed cases or deaths. Data are preliminary and can change; report covers year-to-date through week 44 of 2026.

article.articleHeadline: 儿童呼吸道传染病进入高发季 提醒：家长提前做好防护 _新闻频道_厦门网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pediatric Respiratory Infectious Diseases Enter Peak Season; Reminder: Parents Should Take Protective Measures in Advance
article.articleSummary: Xiamen authorities warn that widening day-night temperature gaps signal peak season for pediatric respiratory infections. In Xiamen, common pathogens include Mycoplasma pneumoniae, influenza virus, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), adenovirus, rhinovirus, and parainfluenza, transmitted by direct contact and droplets. Mycoplasma pneumoniae infections mainly affect children over 5 but can occur in younger kids; fever, cough, sometimes headache, runny nose or sore throat, with fever indicating severity. Influenza affects all ages, with infants and young children at higher risk; abrupt onset with fever 39–40°C, chills, headache, myalgia, fatigue, reduced appetite, plus cough and sore throat; infants may have non-typical symptoms or pneumonia. RSV mainly affects under 5, especially under 2; symptoms begin upper and may progress to severe lower respiratory infection with wheeze and feeding difficulties. Prevention emphasizes vaccination as the most effective, economical influenza protection; in winter, about 13°C with large diurnal variation, dress in layers, ventilate, and encourage outdoor activity.

article.articleHeadline: "ฝีดาษลิง" ติดต่อผ่านการดื่มน้ำได้? เปิดช่องทางแพร่เชื้อที่ต้องระวัง!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox: Can it be transmitted through drinking water? Transmission routes to watch out for!
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (Mpox) can be transmitted through sharing a drinking glass if the cup is contaminated with the virus, according to Thailand's Anti-Fake News Center, citing the Department of Disease Control, Ministry of Public Health. While close contact is the dominant route, including skin-to-skin contact and sexual activity, transmission via contaminated objects is possible when items such as plates, cups, utensils, clothing, or bedding are shared. Some reports indicate about 80% of infections relate to sexual activity, though this may vary by outbreak. Other routes include direct contact with lesions, close bodily contact, respiratory droplets in near proximity, and mother-to-child transmission. Preventive measures include avoiding close contact with suspected cases, not sharing personal items, practicing hand hygiene, and following infection-control guidance for caregivers. Guidance is current as of 11 November 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Muncul Varian Baru Covid-19 PJ.2.1, Sudah Menyebar Sampai Tetangga RI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New COVID-19 variant PJ.2.1 has emerged, already spread to Indonesia's neighboring countries.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 variant PJ.2.1, first identified in Ontario, Canada in May 2026, has spread to the United States, Israel, France, Spain, Australia, New Zealand, and across Asia, including Singapore and Indonesia’s neighboring region. The variant descends from MC.10.1.7 of the JN.1 lineage (circulating through May 2025). It features a spike protein with substantial mutations. Early studies in the Journal of Infection indicate PJ.2.1’s growth favors increased binding to the ACE2 receptor rather than substantial immune evasion. There is ongoing surveillance, but currently no evidence that PJ.2.1 causes more severe disease than prior variants. Common COVID-19 symptoms apply: fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, headache, muscle/joint pain, and fatigue, with possible shortness of breath, gastrointestinal symptoms, or anosmia in some cases.

article.articleHeadline: Abattoir Study in Ghana Identifies Caprine Pneumonia Patterns in
article.articleSummary: In a cross-sectional abattoir study in Ghana (Kumasi and Tamale) from June 2020 to February 2021, 2,246 goats were examined; 163 (7.3%) had pneumonic lung lesions. Kumasi accounted for 63/1,695 (3.7%), Tamale for 100/551 (18.1%). Overall prevalence 95% CI 6.3–8.4%. Seasonal comparison showed rainy season 8.0% vs dry season 6.7% (p=0.230; not significant). Consolidation scores were higher at Tamale (p=0.042). Distinct gross patterns by site: Tamale primarily bronchopneumonia; Kumasi more broncho-interstitial pneumonia; histology identified broncho-interstitial pneumonia, suppurative bronchopneumonia, fibrinous bronchopneumonia, and interstitial pneumonia. Breed effects were significant (Kruskal-Wallis p<0.001) but uneven breed distribution limits interpretation. Methodology included ante-mortem and post-mortem lung examination and histopathology; analyses used Chi-square, Mann-Whitney U, and Kruskal-Wallis tests. Authors caution against attributing differences to geography alone and call for ongoing abattoir-based surveillance and pathogen-focused etiologic studies.

article.articleHeadline: Antallet af ebolatilfælde i DR Congo passerer 11.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in DR Congo passes 11,000.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 11,000 cases, with 5,387 deaths reported. Government data show 11,042 confirmed Ebola cases in the country, making it the largest and most deadly outbreak in DR Congo's history. Eight of the country's 26 provinces have been affected, and many deaths have occurred outside treatment centers, underscoring access and care challenges. By comparison, the West Africa outbreak of 2014–2016 remains the largest on record with about 28,600 cases and over 11,000 deaths. The ongoing outbreak in DR Congo is attributed to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant. There is currently no approved vaccine or specific treatment for this variant, highlighting the need for enhanced surveillance, containment, and supportive care.

article.articleHeadline: O leite comprado diretamente do produtor pode parecer mais natural, mas especialistas alertam que a ausência de pasteurização aumenta o risco de doenças transmitidas por alimentos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Milk purchased directly from the producer may seem more natural, but experts warn that the lack of pasteurization increases the risk of foodborne diseases.
article.articleSummary: As of November 11, 2026, the article warns that raw milk purchased directly from producers poses clear foodborne risks. Without pasteurization, dangerous bacteria can contaminate milk via contact with feces or milking equipment, enabling growth while the product looks and tastes normal. Key pathogens linked to raw milk include Salmonella, Campylobacter, Listeria monocytogenes, and pathogenic Escherichia coli, causing severe abdominal cramps, vomiting, persistent diarrhea, dehydration, high fever, and potential kidney or neurological complications. Pasteurization—controlled heating—destroys harmful microorganisms while preserving nutrients; regulators such as Brazil’s Anvisa and the Ministry of Agriculture, and the U.S. CDC, recommend only pasteurized products for daily consumption. Vulnerable groups—young children, pregnant people, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals—face higher risks, underscoring the recommendation to choose certified pasteurized milk.

article.articleHeadline: Ghanaian Pediatric Study Finds Low Coinfection of Malaria and Enteric
article.articleSummary: In Northern Ghana's Kumbungu District, a hospital-based cross-sectional study at King's Medical Center (March–December 2024) assessed 239 children ≤12 years presenting with fever, diarrhea, or abdominal pain. Plasmodium falciparum malaria and enteric pathogens were detected individually, but concurrent infection occurred in only one child (0.4%). Malaria was confirmed via thick and thin blood films, with P. falciparum as the sole malaria species. Stool culture, following enrichment in selenite F broth and selective plating on MacConkey and XLD agar, plus Gram and biochemical confirmation, identified enteric pathogens. Fisher's exact tests showed no significant association between GI pathogens and malaria parasitemia. A significant link was found between household waste disposal methods and enteric pathogen positivity, underscoring sanitation as a driver of infections. Demographics: 63.6% male; median age 1.67 years (IQR 1.0–3.0); rural dwellers 72.8%. Sampling was consecutive; exclusions included prior antimicrobial/antimalarial therapy within two weeks.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナの小児研究、マラリアと腸管病原体の同時感染率は低いことが判明
triage.triage_reason: 単発の学術研究報告であり、アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を示すものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究の結果報告であり、マラリアと腸管感染症の同時感染率が低いことを示す疫学研究。アウトブレイクの報告ではないため対象国にも含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Over 11.000 smittet av ebola i Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 11,000 infected with Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Over 11,000 people have been confirmed infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with 5,387 deaths, according to authorities as of 11 November 2026. A total of 11,042 cases have been registered since the outbreak began in May. This outbreak ranks as the second-largest and second-deadliest on record, surpassed only by West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic, which infected over 28,600 and killed about 11,000. The transmission is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. Delayed detection, armed conflict, and a strained health system have facilitated faster spread than in prior outbreaks. Ebola has now been detected across East, Central, and West Africa, marking the widest geographic spread recorded on the African continent.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者が11,000人を超える

article.articleHeadline: [OPINION] Beyond the clinic: The fight against TB begins in the village
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary TB in the Philippines is framed as more than an infection; a rural barangay case shows economic hardship—a father unable to work, a child missing school, and relatives bearing costs. TB is shaped by social determinants such as education, living conditions, and access to services, influencing exposure, timely diagnosis, and completion of treatment. Despite expanding the Directly Observed Treatment Short-course strategy (TB-DOTS) since the 1990s and achieving high treatment success among those in care, the country remains a high-burden nation with limited population-level impact. Gaps include delayed diagnosis, under-detection, geographic isolation, stigma, and treatment interruptions, alongside health-system weaknesses: inconsistent implementation, shortages of first-line medicines, fragmented financing, and data gaps. The Local Government Code (1991) decentralizes responsibilities between DOH and local governments, complicating coordination. Proposed directions include institutionalized TB screening across services (e.g., YAKAP), stronger active case finding, community-based treatment support, better training, and multisectoral accountability to monitor progress.

triage.headline_ja: [オピニオン] クリニックの先へ：結核との闘いは村から始まる
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はフィリピンの結核対策に関する社会的・構造的課題を論じるオピニオン記事であり、新規の異常な感染拡大や急性の公衆衛生事象を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Число заразившихся Эболой в ДР Конго превысило 11 тысяч
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, Ebola has been confirmed in more than 11,000 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 11,042 laboratory-confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths. The report notes that roughly 60% of Ebola fatalities occur outside healthcare facilities, complicating containment and timely treatment. Authorities cited by Reuters indicate the ongoing transmission persists amid limited access to care and surveillance challenges. In a cross-border public health move, Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor has provided Ebola diagnostic test systems to all neighboring countries of the Democratic Republic of the Congo to support regional detection and response. The figures underscore the severe mortality burden and the need for intensified case finding, isolation, and community engagement to curb spread.

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго выявили более 11 тысяч случаев Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 11,000 Ebola cases identified in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 11,042 confirmed cases, with 5,387 deaths, according to Congolese authorities cited by Reuters. The latest figures signal ongoing transmission within the country. On 29 October, at the Russia–Africa Summit, DRC Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba Mulamba stated the Ebola outbreak situation was under control. Separately, Russian consumer safety agency head Anna Popova warned that the rise of Ebola presents a major global problem, noting that neighboring Uganda has localized the outbreak and is taking measures to prevent cross-border reintroductions. The report also references a prior epidemiologist who allowed the import of Ebola into Russia, highlighting international cross-border considerations surrounding the outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: Giant Panda Respiratory Virome Analysis Identifies Novel Densovirus and
article.articleSummary: 130 nasopharyngeal swabs from captive giant pandas at the Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding, Sichuan, China, collected in 2018, 2020, and 2021, were subjected to retrospective metagenomic sequencing to define the upper-respiratory virome. Illumina NovaSeq data yielded 6,048,716 reads, with 6,549 viral reads (~0.108%) after host read removal. Sixteen complete or near-complete viral genomes were assembled, belonging to Papillomaviridae, Genomoviridae, Parvoviridae, Inoviridae, Microviridae, plus one unclassified genome; broader analysis detected twenty-six viral families (18 dsDNA, 6 ssDNA, 2 ssRNA). A previously unrecognized densovirus lineage within Parvoviridae was identified. Although overall viral richness remained stable over time, the taxonomic composition of the respiratory virome showed significant temporal shifts across the three collection years. This study provides a baseline for wildlife health monitoring and highlights panda exposure to diverse viral agents, alongside documented pathogens such as canine distemper virus, pathogenic coronaviruses, H1N1 influenza, canine parvovirus, and feline panleukopenia virus.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeds 11,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths as of November 11, 2026. The mid-May outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, with no approved treatments or vaccines for this lineage. It ranks as the second-largest and most deadly Ebola epidemic on record, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak which surpassed 28,600 cases and >11,000 deaths. The disease has spread across eight of DRC’s 26 provinces, with numerous fatalities occurring outside care centers, underscoring access barriers. Delayed detection, ongoing armed conflict, and security disruptions hinder containment. Health systems are strained by resource shortages, complicating response efforts. The outbreak has expanded across East, Central, and West Africa, raising concerns about spillover to neighboring countries without stronger surveillance and rapid interventions. International and local efforts continue to try to curb transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Microwave-Synthesized Zinc Carbon Nanozyme Destroys Bacteria at Neutral pH
article.articleSummary: Zinc-doped carbon nanozyme from The Fourth Hospital of Changsha acts as a neutral-pH peroxidase, converting low-dose hydrogen peroxide into bactericidal reactive oxygen species to kill bacteria. The two-minute microwave-assisted synthesis uses 0.50 g 3,5-diamino-1,2,4-triazole and 0.10 g Zn(NO3)2·6H2O in 10 mL ethylene glycol at 90°C and 700 W, yielding a flake-like, nitrogen-rich carbon matrix with uniform zinc dispersion. Elemental analysis shows C ~41%, N ~54.5%, O ~3.5%, Zn ~1.2%; XPS confirms divalent zinc coordinated with N and O. The catalyst exhibits pronounced peroxidase-like activity at physiological pH and, with low-dose H2O2, demonstrates potent antibacterial efficacy against both Gram-negative Escherichia coli and Gram-positive Staphylococcus aureus, addressing the prior acidity constraint of carbon-based nanozymes.

article.articleHeadline: Metagenomic Sequencing Identifies Pathogens in 40.6 Percent of Suspected
article.articleSummary: In a prospective, single-centre study at a tertiary-care centre in Central India, 197 adults with suspected central nervous system (CNS) infection underwent cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) alongside routine diagnostics from Jan 2023 to Jan 2024. A reportable microbial finding was identified in 80 patients (40.6%; 95% CI 34.0–47.6). Detected pathogens included 52 bacterial, 25 Mycobacterium tuberculosis–associated, 2 viral, and 1 fungal findings; 117 patients (59.4%) had no reportable findings by sequencing. Clinical follow-up, available for 160 patients, showed 63 improved, 70 on active treatment, and 27 deaths. The study notes discordance between initial clinical diagnoses and sequencing results and emphasizes that mNGS should be considered a complementary diagnostic tool, not a definitive reference standard. Concludes CSF mNGS provides valuable insights, particularly for bacterial and tuberculous etiologies, without establishing superior diagnostic accuracy, therapeutic benefit, or survival advantage.

article.articleHeadline: Casos e mortes por Covid-19 sofrem queda de 68,8% em 2026 - Sim Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases and deaths from COVID-19 fall by 68.8% in 2026 - Sim Notícias.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Brazil declined 68.8% in 2026 vs 2025. The Health Ministry reported 118,851 COVID-19–related influenza-like illness cases and 3,400 severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS) cases, down 63% from 9,200 in 2025. Deaths fell from about 1,400 to 437 (69%). However, 18 states reported increases in mild cases, including Alagoas, Bahia, Ceará, Distrito Federal, Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Mato Grosso, Paraíba, Pernambuco, Piauí, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Rondônia, Roraima, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina, and São Paulo, all still classified as low risk; Mato Grosso, Distrito Federal, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, and Santa Catarina also noted a mild rise in SARS related to COVID-19. Vaccination remains the primary prevention; since 2024, the COVID-19 vaccine is in the National Immunization Schedule for children 6 months–5 years, pregnant women, and adults 60+ with comorbidities or immunocompromised. In 2026, over 20.3 million doses distributed, 7.4 million administered.

article.articleHeadline: Number of Ebola cases in DR Congo tops 11,000 -- Reuters
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has exceeded 11,000 confirmed cases, with fatalities nearing 5,400, as of 11 November 2026, according to Reuters citing official data. The emergency began May 15 in the DR Congo’s eastern region and Uganda, becoming the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the deadliest there; it is the second deadliest Ebola outbreak recorded in Africa. Ongoing hostilities in eastern provinces and deep-seated public mistrust of healthcare hinder delivery of medical aid and anti-epidemic measures, complicating surveillance, case management, and vaccination campaigns. The figures highlight the risk of regional spread and the sustained challenges of outbreak response in conflict-affected settings.

article.articleHeadline: Chennai: Case filed against vet after stray dog dies post ABC surgery; autopsy confirms rabies
article.articleSummary: Rabies (dumb rabies) infection confirmed in a stray dog that died after ABC surgery at Chennai's Kannamapet Animal Birth Control centre, prompting a police case against Dr. Yazhini. The procedure took place on November 4; the dog, due for release on Monday, became aggressive, tore its sutures, and exposed internal organs. Staff re-sutured around 7:30 am, but the dog died. Post-mortem results confirmed dumb rabies. Police inspected the Kannamapet ABC centre. Activists allege inadequate post-operative care and restricted volunteer access; they note a prior collaboration that achieved zero post-surgery deaths. Over six months, about 30,000 ABC surgeries occurred; Madras Veterinary College post-mortems reportedly showed that more than 25 dogs dying after surgery were infected with dumb rabies, highlighting ongoing concerns about ABC procedures in Chennai.

article.articleHeadline: Musim Hujan Tiba, Dinkes Cirebon Minta Warga Waspadai DBD dan Penyakit Menular
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The rainy season has arrived; the Cirebon Health Office asks residents to beware of dengue fever and other infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: Cirebon Regency in West Java is bracing for dengue fever (DBD) as the rainy season and the dry-to-wet transition raise infectious-disease risk. The district health office has issued a circular on Oct 19, 2026 to bolster vigilance. As of week 41 of 2026, 527 DBD cases and 1 death have been recorded in Cirebon; the 2026 figures remain below 2025’s total of 1,169 cases and 2 deaths (May and August). In 2025 monthly totals ranged from 53–161 cases, while 2026 through October shows 537 cases with 1 death (April). Authorities rely on the Early Warning System (SKD) monitoring real-time reports from all public health facilities. The campaign also promotes 'One House One Jumantik' (G1R1J) and '3M Plus' vector-control: draining and covering water containers, waste recycling, installing screens, repellents, larviciding, and mosquito-repellent plants.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季到来、チルボン保健局が住民にデング熱など感染症への警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 西ジャワ州チルボン県における季節性のデング熱警戒喚起であり、2026年の症例数は2025年を下回っており、異常性や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアにおいて毎年雨季に発生する風土病であり、本記事は保健当局による定例的な予防啓発活動の報告。症例数は前年を下回っており、重大な公衆衛生上の懸念は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴのエボラ感染者1.1万人超え、死者5387人　過去2番目の流行規模
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 11,000, with 5,387 deaths; the second-largest outbreak on record.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 11,000 infections with 5,387 deaths, according to government data released November 10, 2026. The current outbreak, driven by the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain, was declared mid-May and has no approved therapies or vaccines. The DRC has reported infections across eight of its 26 provinces, with many fatalities occurring outside health facilities. Delayed detection, ongoing conflict, and strained health systems have accelerated spread compared with past outbreaks. So far, infections have appeared across East, Central, and West Africa, making this Africa's most geographically widespread Ebola outbreak on record. This event follows, but is separate from, the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak, which involved more than 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者1.1万人超え、死者5387人　過去2番目の流行規模
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が1.1万人感染・5387人死亡に達し、治療薬・ワクチン未承認かつ複数州に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にモザンビーク・アンゴラが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（8州）での流行および『東・中央・西アフリカにまたがる地理的拡大』はDRC国内地域区分を指す可能性が高く、他国への越境拡大は明記されていないためDRCのみを検証済み地域とした。

article.articleHeadline: عاجل.. إيبولا يضرب الكونغو بقوة.. 11 ألف إصابة و5387 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking: Ebola strikes the Democratic Republic of the Congo hard — 11,000 cases and 5,387 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths, driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain. Began mid-May and stands as the second-largest, most deadly Ebola outbreak on record after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (over 28,600 cases, >11,000 deaths). The DRC outbreak has spread across eight of its 26 provinces, with many fatalities outside treatment centers, complicating containment. Factors include delayed detection, ongoing armed conflict, and a strained health system. Cases have also been reported in eastern, central, and western Africa, marking the widest geographic spread of Ebola on the continent to date. There are no vaccines or approved treatments for this Bundibugyo strain at present.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で猛威、感染者11,000人・死者5,387人
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が大規模に拡大し、複数州・複数国に広がっており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）を複数満たすため、フルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事ではアンゴラは発生地域として明示されていないため除外。致死率の高いBundibugyo株による大規模流行で、武力紛争や医療体制の脆弱さが対応を困難にしている。ワクチン・承認された治療法が存在しない点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh giác biến chứng cúm A ở trẻ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be vigilant for influenza A complications in children.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases at Yen Lac Regional Medical Center in Phu Tho have surged over the past two weeks, with 20–25 children admitted daily, mostly elementary school age. Symptoms include fever, cough, runny nose, sore throat, and fatigue, but influenza A can progress to pneumonia and respiratory failure, posing serious risks for young children, those with weaker immunity, or underlying conditions. Parents should closely monitor children's health and seek urgent care for warning signs such as rapid or labored breathing, lethargy, difficulty waking, inability to drink, or signs of dehydration. Preventive measures emphasize annual flu vaccination, regular handwashing with soap, covering mouth and nose when coughing or sneezing, and maintaining well-ventilated, clean living and classroom environments while limiting contact with the ill. If symptoms appear, children should stay home and avoid self-medicating with antibiotics or antivirals without physician guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 小児のA型インフルエンザ合併症に注意
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの流行報告であり、重症例の急増や異常な病原性は示されておらず、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも見られない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAの地域的な患者増加報告。予防啓発記事の色合いが強く、重症度や異常性の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: عدد مصابي "إيبولا" في الكونغو يتجاوز 11 ألفا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeds 11,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 11,042 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 5,387 deaths. The outbreak, caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, began in mid-May and currently has no approved treatment or vaccine for this strain. It is the second-largest and most lethal Ebola outbreak on record, after the West Africa epidemic of 2014–2016, which exceeded 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths. Eight of DR Congo’s 26 provinces are affected, with numerous fatalities occurring outside treatment centers. Delays in detection, ongoing conflict, and stretched health services have allowed faster spread. The outbreak has now spread across East, Central, and West Africa, making it the most geographically widespread Ebola outbreak in Africa to date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が11,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が11,000例超・致死率約49%と史上2番目の規模で拡大し、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認、8州に拡大し国際的拡散のリスクも高いためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域にMozambique、Angolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRC国内の発生状況（8州）に焦点を当てており、他国への越境拡大の具体的記述はないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 39歲明星經紀人感染新冠 一個月後成白肺去世 | 感染新冠去世 | 郝泊言去世 | 中國疫情升溫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 39-year-old celebrity agent infected with COVID-19 dies a month later after developing white lung | Died after contracting COVID-19 | Hao Boyan dies | China's COVID-19 outbreak heats up
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 infection killed 39-year-old Chinese celebrity agent Hao Boyan (also known as Hao Jing’an) in Beijing on November 9, 2026, after a late-September infection. He developed severe lung injury described as “white lung” and underwent a tracheostomy the day after hospital admission; cremation occurred the same day and his ashes returned to Shandong. Tributes came from colleagues including singer He Jing and actor Gu Xiaoxiao. The piece also notes the November 1 Beijing death of director Jiang Xiaoyu, 56, reportedly from a stroke, with his mother having died a month earlier. China’s COVID-19 situation is described as heating up, with multiple outbreaks and rising severe/fatal cases; authorities reportedly conducted emergency drills and disinfection in crowded venues while restricting pandemic news. No lab-confirmed infection details or infection source are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 39歳の芸能人マネージャーが新型コロナウイルスに感染、1ヶ月後に「白肺」で死去 | 郝泊言死去 | 中国で感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19自体は既知の疾患で特段の異常性はないが、個別の著名人死亡事例を通じて中国国内での重症化・死亡例増加や「疫情升温（流行拡大）」が示唆されており、公式統計や感染源情報が不足しているため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は反体制系メディア（NTDTV）による個人死亡事例中心の報道で、具体的な感染統計や公式発表、検査確定情報が欠如している。「中国当局が緊急演習・消毒を実施し疫情報道を制限」との記述があり、社会的・政治的関心は示唆されるが、公式データによる裏付けが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lawan HIV, TBC, dan Malaria di Sumba Timur Bukan Lagi Tugas Dinas Kesehatan Saja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fighting HIV, TB, and malaria in East Sumba is no longer the sole responsibility of the Department of Health.
article.articleSummary: East Sumba Regency, Indonesia, hosts the RSSH ATM ADINKES 2026 launch, reinforcing that HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis (TB), and malaria are development issues requiring involvement beyond the Health Department. The event runs through 13 November 2026 and covers three agendas: integrated budgeted action planning (RAD 2026–2030) with Desa/Kelurahan funds, partnerships with BAZNAS and CSR, and a data-vs-budget analysis workshop for ATM programs. As of Q3 2026, HIV: 5,010 tested of 8,409 target (59.6%); People living with HIV on antiretroviral therapy 46 of 72 (63.9%), with 26 not yet on ARV. TB: suspects 3,187/3,558 (89.6%); new cases found 302/732 (41.3%); TB treatment success 365/446 (81.8%), below the national 90% target; ~430 undetected. Malaria: API 0.84 per 1,000, under 1, but surveillance must stay strong to reach elimination. The data reflect impacts on families and call for stronger village engagement, case finding, treatment adherence, bed nets, vector control, stigma reduction, and Desa funding support.

triage.headline_ja: 東スンバにおけるHIV、結核、マラリアとの闘いはもはや保健局だけの課題ではない
triage.triage_reason: 既知の地域流行病（HIV/結核/マラリア）に関する行政プログラムの進捗報告であり、新規性・異常性・緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体プログラム（RSSH ATM ADINKES 2026）の進捗報告記事。既存の慢性感染症対策に関する行政的取り組みであり、公衆衛生上の新規シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Över 11 000 fall av ebola i Kongo-Kinshasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 11,000 Ebola cases in Congo-Kinshasa
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Congo-Kinshasa) is the worst in the country's history. Began in May, and as of November 11, 2026, authorities report 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths. Eight of the DRC's 26 provinces have been affected, with many fatalities occurring outside health facilities, underscoring gaps in access to care and ongoing community transmission. The current outbreak surpasses previous domestic episodes in scale, though it trails the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic in total deaths. The situation highlights sustained transmission across multiple regions and ongoing public health challenges, as authorities maintain surveillance, case management, and risk communication to curb spread and reduce mortality.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ（キンシャサ）でエボラ出血熱患者が11,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで同国史上最大規模のエボラ流行が発生し、確定症例11,042人、死亡5,387人、26州中8州に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき案件。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC国内の流行状況のみが述べられており、Angolaでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases surpass 11,000 as death toll exceeds 5,300 in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) driven by the Bundibugyo strain has surpassed 11,000 cases with over 5,300 deaths. As of November 8, 2026, the CDC counts 11,021 confirmed cases and 5,358 deaths across affected countries; the DRC alone reports 10,990 cases and 5,354 deaths. Ituri province remains the epicenter (7,654 cases, 3,613 deaths), followed by North Kivu (2,720 cases, 1,488 deaths), with transmission in 67 of 178 health zones. Between November 7–8, the DRC added 70 cases and 31 deaths. Community transmission contributes to deaths outside treatment centers, and only 86% of contacts are followed daily (below the 95% target). There is no licensed vaccine specifically for Bundibugyo; WHO has recommended including Oxford’s ChAdOx1 and Moderna’s mRNA-1469 in the TUMAINI trial, subject to approvals. Declared in May 2026, this is the largest Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the second-largest globally, exacerbated by insecurity and weak health systems, calling for coordinated cross-border action.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者が11,000人を超え、死者数は5,300人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（11,000例超、死者5,300人超）が継続しており、致死率が高く国境を越えた拡大懸念があるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行。ワクチン未承認で接触者追跡率も目標未達のため、感染拡大継続のリスクが高い。治安不安と医療体制の脆弱性が対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Puskesmas Karyamekar Gelar Rontgen Gratis, 100 Warga Cariu Jadi Sasaran Deteksi TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Karyamekar Community Health Center Holds Free X-Ray Screening, 100 Cariu Residents Become Targets for TB Detection
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) screening conducted at Karyamekar Community Health Center in Bogor Regency, Indonesia, with free chest X-ray examinations for residents of Bantarkuning Village, Cariu District, on November 11, 2026. Approximately 100 residents are targeted, prioritizing individuals with close contact to TB patients, such as co-residing family members. The initiative supports government efforts for early TB detection and is part of the Free Health Check (Cek Kesehatan Gratis, CKG) program. The screening includes imaging and establishes a follow-up mechanism for anyone with TB indications; participants’ identities and phone numbers are recorded to enable outreach. Treatment will be provided at Puskesmas Karyamekar according to diagnostic results. TB transmission is airborne, emphasizing screening among household contacts to interrupt spread.

triage.headline_ja: カリヤメカール保健センター、無料レントゲン検査を実施 - カリウ住民100人がTB検出対象に
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核早期発見プログラムの一環としてのスクリーニング活動であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 通常の政府主導の結核検診プログラム（CKGプログラム）の実施報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Quảng Ninh tăng cường phòng, chống dịch bệnh động vật cuối năm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quang Ninh strengthens prevention and control of animal diseases at year-end.
article.articleSummary: Quảng Ninh authorities require completion of the second livestock vaccination round by 15 December 2026 and strengthen surveillance, reporting, and outbreak response. Local leaders must designate responsible officials, maintain the VAHIS vaccination/disease database, and rapidly sample, quarantine, trace, and control movements when diseases are detected; violations such as concealing outbreaks or illicitly selling or slaughtering diseased animals will be sanctioned. Measures emphasize farm biosecurity, feed and water controls, sanitation and vector control, with vaccination oversight by the Department of Agriculture and Environment, coordinating with the Finance Department for funding. Border controls and import/export checks will be intensified by Trade, Public Security, Border Guard, and customs, with enforcement against illicit activity. For 2027, plans for terrestrial and aquatic disease control must be submitted by 20 November 2026 (DoA&E) and 10 December 2026 (city). Hanoi CDC warns rabies is spreading in animals, with six dog outbreaks in Soc Son district since 2024, with ongoing vigilance for avian influenza and zoonoses.

triage.headline_ja: クアンニン省、年末に向けた家畜防疫対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な人への感染事例や異常な流行拡大は報告されておらず、行政による通常の年末防疫対策・ワクチン接種強化の案内が主題。ただしハノイCDCが狂犬病の動物感染拡大（2024年以降ソクソン郡で6件の犬の発生）に言及しており、鳥インフルエンザ・人獣共通感染症への警戒も示唆されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は主に行政的な家畜防疫強化策に関するもので、具体的な人の感染症例数やアウトブレイク規模の詳細は記載されていない。狂犬病の動物間流行（ソクソン郡）と鳥インフルエンザへの警戒言及があるため、続報の有無を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Casos graves de covid-19 aumentam 23% em Mato Grosso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe COVID-19 cases rise 23% in Mato Grosso.
article.articleSummary: Mato Grosso, Brazil, reports 90 COVID-19–associated Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) cases and seven COVID-19 deaths in 2026 through epidemiological week 44 (ending Nov 7), a 23% rise in SARS over the past four weeks (Oct 12–Nov 7) vs the prior four weeks. Fiocruz flags Mato Grosso and Mato Grosso do Sul as states with rising severe respiratory infections; MT’s increase is mainly driven by coronavirus, while MS’s rise is linked to rhinovirus. Signals of SARS growth also appear in the Distrito Federal and in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Santa Catarina. None of the seven COVID-19 deaths this year had up-to-date vaccination; officials urge updating vaccines, with boosters every six months for elderly and immunocompromised, vaccination for pregnant individuals, and completing schedules for children 6 months–<5 years, plus influenza vaccine. Child vaccination coverage in Cuiabá and Várzea Grande is below targets (e.g., second-dose varicella 58% in Cuiabá; yellow fever 68%; polio 77%), prompting the Imuniza Mais MT program.

triage.headline_ja: マトグロッソ州で新型コロナウイルス感染症の重症例が23%増加
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19関連の重症呼吸器感染症（SARS）が季節的に増加しているが、国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限等の深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められず、通常の季節的変動の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内の複数州（マトグロッソ、サンパウロ、リオデジャネイロ、サンタカタリーナ）でCOVID-19関連の重症呼吸器感染症が季節的に増加。ワクチン接種率の低さが課題として指摘されているが、国際的な拡大や渡航制限の懸念は記事からは読み取れない。

article.articleHeadline: อุทาหรณ์! ช่วยนกเขาตกจากต้นไม้ ก่อนติดเชื้อรุนแรง เสียชีวิตใน 48 ชั่วโมง
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning! A magpie that fell from a tree was helped before it developed a severe infection and died within 48 hours.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, a single fatal human case linked to Chlamydia psittaci, the bird-borne bacterium causing psittacosis, is reported. A man assisted a magpie that had fallen from a tree, kept it for 3 days, then released it. Within 48 hours he developed severe sepsis with hypotension, reduced pulse, hypoglycemia, and thrombocytopenia, and died despite hospital care. Laboratory testing confirmed Chlamydia psittaci as the cause; this bacterium resides in birds including magpies, pigeons, and sparrows, in feathers, secretions, and droppings. Transmission can occur when handling birds with bare hands, touching food, rubbing the eyes, or inhaling dust. Precautions: never handle wild birds bare-handed; wear a mask and gloves; dampen droppings before cleaning; seek medical care promptly if fever, cough, or breathing difficulty after bird exposure, and tell doctors about contact with birds.

triage.headline_ja: 警告！木から落ちたキジバトを助けた男性が重症感染症を発症し、48時間以内に死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一の致死的なオウム病（Chlamydia psittaci）症例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はなく散発的な人獣共通感染症事例と考えられるが、重症度が高いため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 単一症例であり、鳥類（キジバト）との接触による感染と推定される。ヒト-ヒト感染の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の広範な影響は現時点で不明。続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: حالات الإصابة بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية تتجاوز 11 ألفًا - بوابة الأهرام
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infection cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 11,000 - Al-Ahram Gate
article.articleSummary: Over 11,042 confirmed Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, government data cited by Reuters show, as the outbreak widens across eight provinces. The largest burden is in Ituri with 7,654 cases and 3,613 deaths, followed by North Kivu with 2,720 cases and 1,488 deaths. The eight provinces also include South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, Ubangi North and Ubangi South, with ongoing community transmission. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control’s update dated 10 November reported 10,990 cases and 5,354 deaths (data up to 8 November), 966 patients in hospital isolation, and 2,951 recoveries. Cross-border spread is noted with Kenya reporting 9 confirmed cases (2 deaths) and Nigeria identifying a case later transferred to Switzerland. The outbreak is caused by Ebola virus Bundibugyo; there is no licensed vaccine or approved targeted treatment for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が11,000人を超える - アル・アハラム・ゲート
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1万1000人を超えるエボラ感染（致死率約50%）が8州に拡大し、ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: ケニア（9例・2死亡）、ナイジェリア→スイスへの症例移送が報告されており国際拡大が確認されているが、ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン未承認・治療薬未承認のBundibugyo株による流行である点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: Drug-Resistant Tuberculosis Determinants Shift Across Shanghai Towns Over
article.articleSummary: Drug-resistant tuberculosis (DR-TB) in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, exhibits marked spatiotemporal heterogeneity from 2019–2023. Using town-level surveillance data and six determinant domains—socioeconomic development, population characteristics, healthcare resources, TB prevention and control, air pollution, and meteorological conditions—the study applied principal component analysis to generate composite indices and a geographically and temporally weighted regression (GTWR) model to link determinants with DR-TB incidence. Temporal coefficients showed increasing association over time for population characteristics (+0.203) and meteorological factors (+0.325), while air pollution (-3.395), TB prevention and control (-1.641), healthcare resources (-0.438), and socioeconomic factors (-0.012) declined. Spatial patterns: economic, healthcare resources, air pollution, and meteorological factors had higher effects in northwestern urban areas; population characteristics and TB prevention and control were higher in other areas. Conclusion: associations vary by place and time; tailored, town-specific public health strategies are warranted.

article.articleSummary: Thailand’s end-2026 prophecy by Mor Plai warns of three disasters: a New Year’s Eve countdown fireworks/explosion risk across major and secondary cities; thrifty foreign tourists and nightlife crowds potentially causing fights and injuries due to intoxication or drug effects; and political upheaval in Thailand with scrutiny over funding sources for blue- and orange-labeled groups. article.articleHeadline: Carros fumacê vão circular em 12 bairros de Feira de Santana com ação de prevenção ao mosquito da dengue - Folha do Estado da Bahia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fogging trucks will circulate in 12 neighborhoods of Feira de Santana as part of a dengue prevention campaign.
article.articleSummary: Feira de Santana, Bahia, Brazil launches fumacê insecticide spraying to fight Aedes aegypti, the vector of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya, in 12 high-transmission neighborhoods. The districts are Centro, Queimadinha, Ponto Central, Lagoa Grande, Tomba, Muchila, Pedra do Descanso, Campo Limpo, Conceição, Mangabeira, Gabriela, and Rua Nova. Spraying begins Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. and will proceed in morning and afternoon passes from 6:30 a.m., with five cycles across 15 days. The Centro Municipal de Combate às Endemias notes the areas were chosen based on technical and epidemiological criteria, and expansion to additional areas may occur after surveillance. Residents should keep doors and windows open during fumacê to allow insecticide droplets inside. The measure aims to reduce adult mosquitoes and interrupt transmission, and is supplementary to preventive actions such as removing containers that collect standing water.

article.articleHeadline: Review Identifies Four Checkpoints Governing Frequent Viral Spillover in
article.articleSummary: Four checkpoints govern aquatic cross-species viral spillover, per a systematic review in The Innovation Water by Qi-Ya Zhang, Fei Ke, and Jian-Fang Gui (Chinese Academy of Sciences). The study argues water-based systems—especially high-density aquaculture—facilitate frequent multi-host transmission, challenging the notion that spillover is primarily terrestrial (e.g., avian influenza, Ebola, SARS-CoV-2). It catalogs rhabdoviruses, herpesviruses, aquatic reoviruses, and iridoviruses, with tilapia lake virus and white spot syndrome virus as notable examples. Ranavirus is highlighted as central, confirmed in more than 170 aquatic species across fish, amphibians, and reptiles, and linked to wild frog population declines. Ranavirus is a notifiable pathogen per the World Organisation for Animal Health, and China lists it in its official aquatic disease monitoring. The four barriers are: (1) viral amplification/mutation in the reservoir; (2) entry via compatible receptors (e.g., heparan sulfate); (3) overcoming host defenses; (4) reaching a population-level epidemic threshold. The authors suggest modeling spillover with radial maps and pursuing targeted surveillance and mitigation.

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria's sanitation compliance below 36% as cholera kills over 3,000 globally | Daily Champion | Voice of the Nation, Champion of the Truth.
article.articleSummary: Cholera has killed more than 3,000 people worldwide in 2026 (first nine months), with nearly 7,900 deaths in 2025—the deadliest year since 1999, per WHO. About 90% of 2026 deaths have occurred in Africa, with seven countries—Angola, Bangladesh, DR Congo, Nigeria, South Sudan, Sudan and Yemen—accounting for the vast majority of cases. WHO warns El Niño could worsen outbreaks; vaccination and water/sanitation improvements are central, with the ICG approving 71 million doses last year funded by Gavi. In Nigeria, safe sanitation access remains below 36% (NDHS), and open defecation persists in markets, motor parks, schools and communities, fueling cholera and related diseases. On World Toilet Day, the Federal Government described interventions: capacity building for environmental health officers, faecal sludge management, climate-adaptation sanitation, the Clean and Green Programme, Community-Based Waste Management/Open Defecation Control, and public-private sanitation partnerships.

article.articleSummary: North Sumatra Regional Office of the Ministry of Law and Human Rights (Kanwil Kemenkum Sumut) facilitates the harmonization of Binjai City’s draft Mayor Regulation on the Regional Action Plan (RAD) for Tuberculosis Control 2026–2029. Led by senior regulation drafter Eka N.A.M. The RAD Penanggulangan Tuberkulosis is framed as a crucial instrument for structured and sustainable TB health interventions in Binjai. The collaboration is intended to finalize a Mayor Regulation that provides protection and health benefits to Binjai residents, aligning with national policies. Published date: 2026-11-11.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DR Congo pass 11,000, with 5,387 deaths
article.articleSummary: 11,042 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,387 deaths reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 2026-11-11, marking the country’s largest and deadliest outbreak. The pathogen is the Bundibugyo strain, which kills about half of those it infects, and it has spread across eight of 26 provinces, with many fatalities occurring outside treatment centers. The outbreak is the second-largest and second-deadliest Ebola emergency on record, after the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic (more than 28,600 cases and over 11,000 deaths). Delayed detection, ongoing conflict and strained health services have accelerated transmission. There is no vaccine or treatment specifically for Bundibugyo. Earlier this month, the World Health Organization approved clinical trials of two newer Ebola vaccines, with results anticipated in early 2027. Cases have appeared in East, Central and West Africa, representing the continent’s widest geographic spread to date.

article.articleHeadline: Потвърдените случаи на ебола в ДР Конго надхвърлиха 11 000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeded 11,000.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceeds 11,000 cases, with 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths reported as of 2 November 2026, per government data cited by Reuters. The epidemic is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which no approved treatments or vaccines exist. It ranks as the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history, after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths). Eight of Congo’s 26 provinces have reported cases, with many deaths occurring outside health facilities. Contributing factors include delayed case detection, ongoing armed conflict, and an overburdened health system, all accelerating spread compared with prior outbreaks. The outbreak has now reached Eastern, Central, and Western Africa, making it the widest Ebola outbreak on the African continent to date. The accompanying photo shows health workers at an Ebola treatment center in Beni, North Kivu.

article.articleHeadline: Trẻ co giật, nói sảng khi mắc cúm A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Children experience seizures and delirium when infected with influenza A.
article.articleSummary: Two pediatric influenza A cases in Vietnam featured seizures and delirium with pneumonia and neuropsychiatric symptoms. A 6-year-old boy from Quy Nhơn Ward, Gia Lai, presented with fever >39°C, cough, sore throat and headache; after five days fever subsided and influenza A testing was negative, but he subsequently developed high fever, seizures, delirium and sleep disturbances. Chest X-ray showed pneumonia; diagnosed with pneumonia following influenza and hospitalized. He later showed fatigue and night terrors; neurology evaluation suggested panic disorder. A 4-year-old boy, Tấn Phát, in Ninh Bình, contracted influenza A at end-August, then developed bronchitis, high fever, seizures, delirium and startle episodes; diagnosed with post-influenza neurological disorder and monitored in hospital. Clinicians stress that convulsions or altered consciousness during/after flu warrant medical assessment to exclude encephalitis. Vaccination and infection control are advised; Vietnam offers vaccines from multiple countries, including UK nasal spray for 2–18 years and annual WHO-recommended boosters.

article.articleHeadline: Fórum Paulista de Febre Aftosa debate vigilância sanitária em Avaré
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paulista Forum on Foot-and-Mouth Disease Discusses Sanitary Surveillance in Avaré.
article.articleSummary: On November 13, 2026, from 10:00 to 12:00, the V Paulista Forum on Foot-and-Mouth Disease will be held in Avaré, São Paulo, at the Dr. Fernando Cruz Pimentel Exposition Park, as part of Faesp Show (Nov 12–14). It discusses sanitary-surveillance changes after the suspension of vaccination against foot-and-mouth disease (FMD). Attendees include Breno Welter, head of the State FMD Surveillance Program; Erika Ramos Mello, director of Defesa Agropecuária; and Cyro Ferreira Penna Júnior, vice-president of Faesp, addressing risk-based surveillance, clinical-signal identification, and immediate notification of suspected cases, with a public-roundtable. The forum explains Fundesa-PEC, funded by mandatory contributions from cattle and buffalo owners; in 2026, the rate is R$ 1,076 per declared animal, collected during the May and November herd updates, funding indemnities for FMD-related emergencies. Attendance is free with registration. Brazil achieved World Organisation for Animal Health recognition in 2025 as FMD-free without vaccination, underscoring ongoing vigilance.

Figures come from government data cited by Reuters. Persistent violence and population mistrust complicate outbreak response. No specific infection source, transmission routes, or imported/exported case details are provided. article.articleHeadline: Число заболевших Эболой в Конго превысило 11 тысяч человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports 11,042 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 5,387 deaths, according to Reuters citing local authorities. Despite the scale, on October 29 the DRC Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba Mulamba told delegates at the Russia–Africa summit that the outbreak is under control. Russia’s consumer watchdog head Anna Popova described the rise in Ebola as a serious international problem, noting that neighboring Uganda has localized transmission and is taking measures to prevent new importations. The figures indicate a protracted epidemic with ongoing containment challenges, while official statements reveal a tension between domestic assurances of control and international concern about cross-border spread.

article.articleHeadline: Antallet af ebolatilfælde i DR Congo passerer 11.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in DR Congo surpasses 11,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DR Congo) reports 5,387 Ebola-related deaths and more than 11,000 confirmed cases, according to government data cited by Reuters. The dataset indicates that this Ebola outbreak is the deadliest in DR Congo’s history, underscoring the extent of transmission within the Central African nation. The excerpt notes the official figures without providing additional details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. The figures reflect ongoing, high-level transmission and an urgent public health challenge for DR Congo, with authorities releasing updated counts to reflect the evolving situation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ症例数が11,000人を突破

article.articleHeadline: The never-ending fight against the Ebola virus
article.articleSummary: Ebola resurges in Africa with about 10,000 cases and 5,000 deaths in Sub-Saharan Africa as of October, the second-largest outbreak on record. The 2013 West Africa outbreak began with 2-year-old Emile Ouamouno and spread from Dandou Pombo to Guinea, Sierra Leone and Liberia. Ebola is caused by Orthoebolavirus, with four disease variants: Ebola virus disease, Sudan virus disease, Taï Forest virus disease and Bundibugyo virus disease. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms are flu-like, progressing to severe inflammation, hemorrhage, diarrhea, and death. Average fatality ~50% (80–90% for certain mutations). Transmission via bodily fluids, not airborne. KDCA in Korea monitors risk; no cases by November, but flags Congo, Uganda and Kenya as Strict Quarantine Inspection Areas, with 21-day travel monitoring and a Sept drill by 14 agencies. Bundibugyo is the current zoonotic spillover; a nurse in Congo Bunia was infected. Ervebo exists for Zaire ebolavirus; Korea collaborates on Bundibugyo vaccine development with SK Bioscience, IAVI, Hilleman Labs; BARDA funding up to $99 million. Korea aids international response and vaccine development.

triage.headline_ja: 終わりなきエボラウイルスとの闘い
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（ブニア）でブンディブギョ型エボラの新たなスピルオーバーが発生し、医療従事者への感染も確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・渡航制限）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は主にエボラウイルス全般の解説記事だが、コンゴ（ブニア）での現行のブンディブギョ型スピルオーバーと看護師感染が言及されており、これが現在進行中の実際のイベントと判断。その他の国（韓国、スーダン、シエラレオネ、ケニア、リベリア、ウガンダ、ギニア）は歴史的事例または監視対象地域としての言及であり、現行発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis Detection Campaign: ಕ್ಷಯರೋಗದ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳಿದ್ದವರು ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷ್ಯ ಮಾಡದೆ ತಕ್ಷಣ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ: ಡಾ.ವೈ. ನವೀನ್ ಭಟ್
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis Detection Campaign: Those with tuberculosis symptoms should not ignore them and should get tested immediately: Dr. V. Naveen Bhatt.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis detection campaign in Chikkaballapur district, Karnataka, under National TB Elimination Programme, from Oct 27 to Nov 4 screened 182,425 people. Among them, 1,688 with cough were tested by sputum smear; 4 TB cases confirmed by sputum tests and 1 by chest X-ray among 432 examined, total 5 cases. All started treatment. Health workers visited households and offered NAAT for symptomatic individuals; high-risk persons over 60, diabetics, HIV, and malnourished are screened with chest X-ray. TB is airborne; an untreated patient can transmit to around 10 people per year. DOTS treatment provided; contacts receive TB preventive therapy (IPT). Totals: 2023—1,612; 2024—1,774; 2025—1,573; cumulative 4,959. Treatment success rose from 86% to 91%; mortality fell from 8% to 6%. Higher cases in Bagepalli, Chikkaballapura, Chintamani, Gowribidanur taluks. Symptoms include cough >2 weeks, fever, weight loss, loss of appetite, blood in sputum, chest pain, shortness of breath, night sweats, fatigue, and neck swelling.

triage.headline_ja: 結核検出キャンペーン：結核の症状がある人は放置せず、直ちに検査を受けるべき：Y・ナビーン・バット医師
triage.triage_reason: 通常の国家結核撲滅プログラムに基づくスクリーニング活動の報告であり、異常な増加や新規アウトブレイクではなく、既存の対策プログラムが順調に機能している内容のため。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の地方病性かつ既知の感染症に関する定期的な公衆衛生啓発・スクリーニング活動の報告であり、治療成功率の向上や死亡率の低下など、プログラムの改善を示す内容。新規性・異常性はなく、対象国リストに含まれるインドではあるが、イベントとしての新規シグナル性は低いためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Xpert Assays Show High Diagnostic Accuracy for Spinal Tuberculosis in
article.articleSummary: Spinal tuberculosis, a severe extrapulmonary TB manifestation, was evaluated for Xpert-based molecular assays (Xpert MTB/RIF and Xpert MTB/RIF Ultra) in a global systematic review and diagnostic-accuracy meta-analysis including twelve studies up to June 2026. As of 11 November 2026, pooled data against composite/clinical reference standards show high specificity (1.00; 0.99–1.00) and moderate sensitivity (0.77; 0.66–0.86) for Xpert-based assays, with a positive likelihood ratio of 43.86 and a negative likelihood ratio of 0.24; diagnostic odds ratio 213.28. The accuracy is highly influenced by the reference standard; when culture alone is used, specificity drops to 0.62 (0.44–0.78). Only one study evaluated Xpert MTB/RIF Ultra, preventing definitive Ultra-versus-RIF comparisons. Authors emphasize that negative results do not exclude spinal TB and must be interpreted with clinical, radiological, microbiological, and histopathological data. Publication: Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology (Clinical Infectious Diseases), accepted 16 Oct 2026; co-author Xiaojun Chen (Fujian Minbei Orthopedics Research Institute).

triage.headline_ja: 脊椎結核に対するXpertアッセイの診断精度が高いことをメタ分析が示す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は診断検査の精度に関する学術的メタ分析であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は診断法の精度評価に関する研究論文であり、特定地域でのアウトブレイク発生を報告するものではないため、地域検証の対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo supera la barrera de los 11.000 casos de ébola, incluidos 5.387 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses the 11,000 Ebola cases mark, including 5,387 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, with confirmed cases surpassing the 11,000 mark. As of November 9, 2026, the National Institute of Public Health (INSP) reports 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths, for a case-fatality rate of 48.8%. The epidemic, declared on May 15 in the DRC, remains ongoing, reflecting sustained transmission across affected areas and the substantial lethality. The figures underscore the gravity of the situation and the need for continued surveillance, case management, and public health interventions by Congolese authorities and partners. The report provides data up to the cited date, illustrating the evolving landscape of this Ebola outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の症例数が11,000人の大台を突破、死者5,387人を含む
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.8%の大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクを有するため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に宣言されたエボラ流行が継続中で、11月9日時点で11,042症例、5,387死亡（致死率48.8%）。既存の大規模流行であり継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Тысячи человек умерли от лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thousands of people died of Ebola fever in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 11,000 laboratory-confirmed infections (11,042) with 5,387 deaths. The outbreak, officially declared in mid-May 2026, has spread to eight of 26 provinces and is driven by a rare Bundibugyo virus strain with about 50% case fatality. This outbreak is the second-largest and deadliest in modern history, surpassed only by the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths). There are currently no licensed vaccines or therapies proven effective against this strain. In early November 2026, WHO approved two experimental vaccine trials, with results expected in early 2027. The outbreak has crossed regional borders, with imported cases confirmed in Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. The IOM warns of severe funding shortfalls for cross-border surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ熱により数千人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが11,000例以上・致死率約50%に達し、複数国へ越境拡大しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し緊急のフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、アンゴラへの越境症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが主要発生国として記載されているため含める。稀なBundibugyo株によるアウトブレイクで、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点が重大な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: จุฬาฯ เคลียร์ชัด 3 โรคร้ายจาก นกเขา ทำติดเชื้อจนเสียชีวิตภายใน 48 ชั่วโมง จริงหรือไม่
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chulalongkorn University clarifies three deadly diseases from cockatoos that can cause infection and death within 48 hours — is this true?
article.articleSummary: Psittacosis (parrot fever) from cockatoos is highlighted by Chulalongkorn University in Bangkok, Thailand as a risk that can cause fever, cough and severe pneumonia. Cryptococcosis, a fungal infection from bird droppings, can affect lungs or the nervous system, especially in immunocompromised individuals. Wound infections from bird bites or scratches may lead to skin infection and progression to sepsis. The university cautions there is no universal 48-hour death rule; outcomes depend on the pathogen type, route of infection, patient health, and prompt treatment. The clarification was issued by the Faculty of Veterinary Science on Nov 11, 2026, following a Nov 6, 2026 social-media post about cockatoo-related illness. They provide awareness and prevention guidance, but the article does not report confirmed cases or ongoing outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: チュラロンコン大学が解説：インコからの3つの危険な病気は48時間以内に死亡させるというのは本当か?
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症例や流行は報告されておらず、大学による一般的な注意喚起・啓発情報にとどまるため。
triage.notes: SNS投稿をきっかけにした大学による注意喚起記事であり、確認された感染例やアウトブレイクの報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: UN agency says 95pc of Ebola cases detected along informal routes
article.articleSummary: 71 confirmed Ebola cases identified along population mobility corridors in the DRC since the outbreak began, with 95% detected at informal routes, underscoring border-surveillance gaps. IOM reports 258 deceased persons intercepted along informal routes and control points. To curb spread, IOM uses mobility mapping at markets, bus stations, displacement sites and transport corridors; since onset, 55 million health screenings across the DRC and neighbouring countries. The effort includes 67 internally displaced sites in the DRC, 50 of them in Ebola-affected health zones. Funding shortfall: $59.8 million against a $110 million plan. Kenya and Uganda strengthen border surveillance at Busia, Malaba and Lwakhakha with support from ECSA-HC and World Bank; port-health inspections and a seven-point readiness package covering assessments, SOPs, surveillance, IPC and lab readiness. Kenya reports nine Ebola cases and two deaths in one cluster, with 211 people in isolation; 97% of contacts of the index patient have been traced.

triage.headline_ja: 国連機関、エボラ症例の95%が非公式ルートで検出されたと発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が継続しており、ケニアへの越境感染（9例・死亡2例）が確認されるなど国際的拡大が現実化しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の多数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行（71例確認）とケニア・ウガンダへの越境拡大リスクを中心に報じている。ケニアでの9例・死亡2例は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず、主発生国であるDRCのみを計上した。資金不足（計画110百万ドルに対し調達59.8百万ドル）も国際支援の必要性を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus DBD di Klaten Kian Menurun, Warga Diminta Tetap Waspada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever cases in Klaten are on the decline; residents urged to remain vigilant.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in Klaten Regency, Central Java, Indonesia have declined through week 43 of 2026 to 147 cases and 1 death, down from 475 cases and 3 deaths in the same period in 2025. Health officials credit the reduction to heightened community engagement in vector-control activities, including mosquito breeding-site elimination (PSN), and the work of larval monitors (jumantik) in limiting Aedes aegypti spread. Preventive efforts continue with public education on dengue risks and campaigns to keep environments clean. Despite the drop, authorities urge ongoing vigilance and rapid medical response to potential cases. The report provides no details on laboratory confirmation. The situation highlights the importance of PSN, jumantik, and local public-health outreach in controlling Dengue transmission in Klaten as of 2026.

triage.headline_ja: クラテン県のデング熱症例は減少傾向、住民には引き続き警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例は前年比で大幅に減少しており、地方当局による通常の予防活動の継続報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱は同地域の季節性・地方流行性疾患であり、症例数・死亡数とも前年より減少。通常の公衆衛生活動の範囲内の報告。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu : 2 826 cas confirmés et 152 soignants infectés, la riposte confrontée au manque de moyens
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: 2,826 confirmed cases and 152 healthcare workers infected, the response hampered by a lack of resources.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, as of Tuesday, November 10, 2026: 716 active cases and 442 recoveries, with North Kivu now the province reporting the highest number of cases. Health workers bear a heavy burden: 152 infections among healthcare professionals, including nine doctors; four doctors have died (three in Beni health zone and one in Katwa). Response efforts are hampered by shortages of materials, particularly personal protective equipment. In the education sector, 44 schools are affected; nearly 50 children tested positive, with 31 deaths and eight recoveries among them. Vaccine stocks are in rupture; a vaccine order has been placed, but a replenishment date is not provided. Surveillance teams are tracking more than 14,000 contacts. Priorities to contain the outbreak include enhanced protection for responders, vaccine availability, and sustained case finding and follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州でのエボラ出血熱:確認症例2,826例、医療従事者152人感染、対応は資源不足に直面
triage.triage_reason: 確認症例2,826例・医療従事者感染152人・死亡例を含む大規模アウトブレイクであり、ワクチン不足や学校における感染拡大も報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ワクチン供給途絶、PPE不足、医療従事者・子供の死亡例、14,000人以上の接触者追跡など、対応能力を超えた深刻な状況が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Vakcíny proti ebole jsou na obzoru. Evropu však ohrožuje jiný virus, varovala šéfka ECDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccines against Ebola are on the horizon. Europe is threatened by another virus, the head of the ECDC warned.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak continues: 10,920 cases and 5,323 deaths across eight provinces; Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths, with WHO declaring its end in August. Recent linked cases in Kenya and Nigeria involve relatives and health workers. Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment; surveillance and contact tracing remain challenging, creating uncertainty about spread. EU risk for Ebola remains very low; virus is not easily transmitted aerogenically, and secondary EU transmission is unlikely if detection and isolation are timely. EU actions include vigilance, exit screening at airports in affected countries, and EU Health Task Force deployment to source locations. West Nile virus is endemic in Europe, with a record year: 2,029 cases and 148 deaths; Italy, Greece, Romania most affected, driven by climate-related mosquito dynamics. Vaccine development progressing: Moderna and Oxford candidates in phase 2/3; regulatory approval pending; vaccination timing uncertain but hoped soon.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチンは目前に。しかし欧州は別のウイルスの脅威に直面している、とECDC長官が警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株、死亡者5,323人）がケニア・ナイジェリアへ関連症例拡大しており、IHR基準の深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクの2つに該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRCのエボラ流行継続（ウガンダは既に終息宣言）とケニア・ナイジェリアへの関連症例拡大、および欧州の西ナイルウイルス記録的流行を扱う。西ナイルウイルスの発生地域（イタリア、ギリシャ、ルーマニア）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアも対象国リスト外のため除外し、DRCのみ採用。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak tops 11,000 cases as disease keeps spreading
article.articleSummary: Congo's Ebola outbreak has topped 11,000 cases as of 2026-11-11. The article’s body focuses on U.S. influence in Latin America—immigration policy, deportations, and midterm election outcomes—without outbreak-specific details. There is no information in the text on laboratory confirmation, symptoms, transmission sources, or any imported or exported cases. Consequently, aside from the headline figure of 11,000+ cases in Congo, the piece provides no actionable epidemiological data, dates beyond the publication date, or public health measures related to the Ebola outbreak. The article lacks corroborating details about the ongoing outbreak beyond the headline.
