article.articleHeadline: Bahia registra cinco casos de mpox em 2026; veja sintomas e como se proteger da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bahia reports five mpox cases in 2026; see the symptoms and how to protect yourself from the disease.
article.articleSummary: Bahia confirmed five mpox cases in 2026 after 225 notifications, per Sesab. Brazil logged 665 cases in the same period, with 10,821 in 2022. Of Bahia’s five cases, two were likely locally acquired (Salvador and Mata de São João) and three likely imported (one in Osasco, São Paulo, and two in Maceió, Alagoas). The circulating virus belongs to mpox clade II, subclade IIb. Transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with skin lesions, mucosal secretions, or contaminated objects; intimate and prolonged close contact raises risk, including potential respiratory secretions. Common symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, lymphadenopathy, and skin or mucosal lesions, which may be genital or anal. Diagnosis is via PCR on lesion material. No specific antiviral exists; management is supportive with isolation. SUS vaccination targets prioritized groups, including people with HIV/AIDS, lab workers, and close contacts after risk evaluation. Surveillance emphasizes early detection, compulsory notification, and PPE.

triage.headline_ja: バイーア州、2026年にmpox感染者5例を報告；症状と予防法について
triage.triage_reason: mpoxクレードIIbの散発例報告であり、重症度・異常性は低いが、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があり継続的なサーベイランス対象として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・バイーア州における2026年のmpoxクレードIIb症例（5例、うち国内感染2例・輸入3例）の定例報告。症状は軽症〜中等症で、支援的治療と隔離で管理可能。ワクチン接種はHIV陽性者等のハイリスク群に優先実施。重大な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えないが、継続的なヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。エルサルバドルは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola izmiče kontroli u Kongu: Više od 11.000 zaraženih i 5.387 mrtvih
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spiraling out of control in the Congo: More than 11,000 infected and 5,387 dead.
article.articleSummary: As of November 11, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths, per the Ministry of Health, making it the deadliest Ebola episode in the country. The outbreak, declared in mid-May, is spreading across eight of 26 provinces, with Ituri and North Kivu as renewed hotspots. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus is causing the epidemic; there is no known vaccine or approved treatment for this strain. Attacks on health facilities and workers amid distrust and misinformation hinder response, exacerbating the crisis. The outbreak has extended to neighboring countries, including Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. Experts urge intensified efforts to slow transmission, improve access to care, and protect health workers to contain further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が制御不能に拡大：感染者1万1000人超、死者5,387人
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模のエボラ流行が拡大し、周辺国への越境感染も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの拡大が言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・治療法未確立のブンディブギョ株による流行であり、致死率が極めて高い点にも注意。

article.articleHeadline: KDR: Ebolou sa už nakazilo viac ako 11.000 ľudí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: KDR: More than 11,000 people have already contracted Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of November 11, 2026, more than 11,000 people have contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with nearly half of the infected dying, per the DRC Ministry of Health. The outbreak, declared May 15, centers in the northern and eastern provinces and is driven by weak health infrastructure, community hesitancy to cooperate, and country instability with armed groups. The current epidemic is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccine or therapy exists. The disease has spread to Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. It ranks as the second-largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in history after the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, which saw over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ感染者が既に1万1000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%、感染者1万1000人超、ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株によるアウトブレイクで、既に複数国（ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア）へ拡大しており、史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行としてIHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの感染拡大が報告されているが、いずれも本トリアージの対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療法が未承認のブンディブギョ株であり、武装勢力による不安定な治安状況が対応を困難にしている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia di ebola in Congo, record di contagi: oltre 11 mila casi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, record number of infections: over 11,000 cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000 infections, with 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths (roughly half). The Bundibugyo Ebola virus is responsible, spreading to eight of the country's 26 provinces. There is no approved vaccine or cure. The World Health Organization warned in May that the outbreak risk was raised from high to very high due to rapid spread, with cases moving from dozens to thousands in months. This is the deadliest epidemic ever recorded in the DRC. Data released by the Ministry of Health on Wednesday confirm the record severity of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が流行、感染者数が過去最多を記録：1万1千人超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが8州に拡大し、WHOがリスクを「非常に高い」と評価しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬が未承認とされており（従来のエボラワクチンとの関係は記事内で明記されず）、WHOは5月時点でリスクをhighからvery highに引き上げ。DRC史上最悪の流行とされ、国際的支援の必要性が高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: U Kongu registrovano više od 11.000 slučajeva ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Congo, more than 11,000 cases of Ebola have been registered.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths, according to the Ministry of Health. Declared mid-May, the current epidemic is the deadliest on record for the DRC and has extended to Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. Containment has been hindered by armed conflict in affected regions, a fragile health system, and poor transport infrastructure. For the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, there is no vaccine, and it has spread across eight of the DRC’s 26 provinces. Health facilities and workers have faced skepticism about the virus. The report highlights ongoing cross-border transmission and continued domestic spread, with limited vaccination options for the circulating strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の症例が11,000件を超えて登録
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が11,042症例・5,387死亡と過去最悪規模に達し、国境を越えてウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへ拡大。武装紛争とワクチン不在により封じ込めが困難であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境伝播が報じられているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株にはワクチンが存在せず、武装紛争・脆弱な医療体制・住民の不信感が対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria Scare In Rayagada Sevashram: Class 5 Girl Dies, Brother Critical
article.articleSummary: Malaria confirmed as cause of death in Rayagada, Odisha, after a Class V girl, Khusi Kilaka, at Badaraising Ashram School in Jemadeipentha Panchayat, Rayagada Sadar block, developed fever and tested malaria positive. She returned to the hostel after a 10-day leave, was treated with anti-malaria drugs following a blood test, but her condition deteriorated on 10 November 2026 and she died during treatment at the District Headquarters Hospital. Her younger brother also tested positive for malaria and is undergoing treatment at a hospital. The incident underscores ongoing malaria concerns in the Rayagada area; no source of infection nor outbreak details are provided beyond the two affected siblings.

triage.headline_ja: ラヤガダのセヴァシュラムでマラリアの脅威：5年生の少女が死亡、弟も重体
triage.triage_reason: オリッサ州ラヤガダで学生1名がマラリア感染により死亡、弟も陽性で治療中だが、現時点では家族内の個別症例に留まり、集団発生や感染源の情報は不足している。
triage.notes: マラリアはオリッサ州ラヤガダ地域で既知の流行病であり、本件は寮生活をする兄妹の個別症例。地域全体での集団感染や感染源（蚊媒介経路など）についての詳細情報がなく、続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola tops 11,000 cases in Congo's deadliest outbreak
article.articleSummary: Congo's Ebola outbreak has topped 11,000 cases, with 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths, according to the health ministry. Declared in mid-May, the Bundibugyo virus has no known vaccine or treatment and has spread to eight of the DRC's 26 provinces, including major hotspots in Ituri and North Kivu. Ongoing violence, armed conflict, a fragile health system, poor roads, and community mistrust and misinformation have hampered containment, with health facilities and workers repeatedly targeted. The outbreak has spilled into neighboring countries, including Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria. The current outbreak already ranks second and has had at least three times the number of cases and deaths in the time since it was declared, compared with the West Africa 2014–2016 outbreak, which saw about 28,000 infections and more than 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ史上最悪のエボラ流行、感染者数が1万1000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で感染者1万1000人超・死者5000人超という大規模なエボラ流行が続いており、近隣国への拡大も報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの波及も言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文での言及はなく除外。

article.articleHeadline: কঙ্গোতে প্রাদুর্ভাব ছড়াচ্ছে ইবোলা, আক্রান্ত ছাড়ালো ১১ হাজার
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading in Congo; over 11,000 infected.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-11, Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000 infections, with 11,042 cases and 5,387 deaths. Since mid-May, the outbreak has spread to 8 of 26 provinces, with Ituri and North Kivu as hotspots, where violence hampers health service delivery. Armed conflict, fragile health systems, poor road access, and misinformation have led to attacks on health workers, prompting urgent calls for a ceasefire to enable safe operations. The epidemic has crossed borders into Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria, among others in Africa, triggering international calls for swift, intensified containment measures to curb transmission and protect frontline staff.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の流行拡大、感染者数が1万1千人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で11,000人超の感染・5,387人の死亡という深刻な公衆衛生被害が発生し、複数国への越境拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへの越境拡大が報じられているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。武力紛争により保健活動が阻害されている点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DRC exceed 11,000
article.articleSummary: By 11 November 2026, Democratic Republic of Congo reported 11,042 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,387 deaths in an outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo species. Declared in mid-May, it is the second-largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak on record, behind the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak (more than 28,600 cases and over 11,000 deaths). Eight of DR Congo's 26 provinces are affected, with many deaths occurring outside treatment centres. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatments or vaccines. Delayed detection, conflict, and strained health services have facilitated faster spread. The disease has been reported in East, Central and West Africa, marking the widest geographic spread of any Ebola outbreak on the continent to date, underscoring ongoing transmission as of 11 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱症例数が11,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 史上2番目に大きい規模のエボラ流行で、死亡者5,387人、治療薬・ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株による広範な地理的拡大が確認されており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にモザンビーク・アンゴラが含まれるが、記事サマリーでは具体的に言及されておらず、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。DRCが唯一の主題国として確認された。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Cases Pass 11,000, Deaths 5,387
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak has reached 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths, according to government data reported on 10–11 November 2026, about six months after the mid‑May declaration. Infections are caused by the Bundibugyo species, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists, with transmission via contact with body fluids of sick or dead individuals. Eight of Congo’s 26 provinces have reported cases, with the hotspot now in North Kivu and ongoing activity in Ituri. The outbreak ranks as the second-largest on record and second-deadliest, behind 2014–2016 West Africa. WHO tallies as of 7 September show 6,757 cases and 3,267 deaths, illustrating differences between sources. For travelers, the U.S. CDC bans entry of non-citizens who were in Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past 21 days (renewed through 10 November 2026). Ghana reports airport screening with no confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ出血熱の感染者数が11,000人を突破、死者5,387人に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例11,042人・死者5,387人に達し、史上2番目の規模・致死数のエボラ流行となっている。国際的な渡航制限（米CDC入国禁止）も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ガーナは空港スクリーニングを実施しているが確認症例なしのため除外。ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO集計値とコンゴ政府発表値に差異がある点は要注意（情報源間の不一致）。

article.articleHeadline: شمار مبتلایان به ابولا در کنگو از ۱۱ هزار تن گذشت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola in Congo surpassed 11,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 11,042 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and at least 5,387 deaths in the current outbreak. Eight of 26 provinces are affected, with ongoing transmission hampered by late case identification, armed conflict, and strain on health services. The outbreak centers on the Bundibugyo ebolavirus species, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment, contributing to high mortality. The World Health Organization, earlier this month, approved clinical trials of two new Ebola vaccines, with results expected in early 2027. The persistence of transmission in this region marks it as the second-largest and second-deadliest Ebola outbreak on record, underscoring the need for strengthened surveillance, vaccination strategies, and protection of healthcare workers and communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ感染者数が1万1000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ（ブンディブギョ種）がDRCの8州に拡大し、死者5,387人・感染11,042人と記録史上2番目の規模に達しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ種エボラで、武力紛争により保健サービスが圧迫され症例特定が遅延。WHOが新規ワクチン治験を承認したが結果は2027年初頭予定。史上2番目の規模・致死数の流行。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta por un brote de viruela del mono en Brasil y hay más casos en Argentina de la cepa con mayor riesgo de contagio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert over a monkeypox outbreak in Brazil, and there are more cases in Argentina of the strain with the highest risk of transmission.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (mpox) outbreak alert in Brazil with 832 total cases, concentrated in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Ceará, and Brasília. In São Paulo, 64 cases were recorded in the past month; Rio de Janeiro reports 74 new infections in the last two months, a sharp rise versus 2025. Argentina has 23 cases so far this year, including at least four in the Ib clade (Córdoba, San Juan and two in Buenos Aires Province), the most transmissible lineage. Brazil has secured 25,000 additional vaccine doses targeted to high-risk groups; mass vaccination is not advised. mpox spreads mainly by direct skin-to-skin contact, intimate or sexual contact, and contact with contaminated objects; incubation 6–20 days, starting with fever and myalgias followed by widespread skin lesions. Early antivirals and vaccination within four days of exposure may prevent severe disease; authorities emphasize testing and isolation. Not a global emergency.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでサル痘（mpox）の流行警戒、アルゼンチンでも感染リスクの高い系統の症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで832例という大規模な流行があり、より伝播性の高いIbクレードがアルゼンチンでも検出されるなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルとアルゼンチンの流行を扱っているが、アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。アルゼンチンでIbクレード（より伝播性の高い系統）の症例が確認されている点は国際的拡大リスクの根拠として評価に反映した。記事は『世界的な緊急事態ではない』と明記している。

article.articleHeadline: La crisis del ébola alcanza los 11.000 casos en RDC con una letalidad que ya roza el 49%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola crisis has reached 11,000 cases in the DRC, with a case fatality rate hovering around 49%.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports over 11,000 diagnosed cases and about 5,387 deaths, a case fatality rate around 48.8%. The latest tally shows 11,042 cases, with 52 new infections and 33 deaths in the last 24 hours. The spread covers eight provinces and 67 of 178 health zones (37.6%), with Ituri as the epicenter (69.6% of total cases; 57.7% of daily infections, 30 new). Kivu del Norte adds 17 cases (local CFR ~55%), driven by Beni, while Haut-Uélé reports 5 cases. Community transmission accounts for 19 of 33 daily deaths; 14 deaths occurred in Ebola Treatment Centers. Active contact tracing reaches 27,012 of 33,900 exposed (79.7%), below the 95% target. Bundibugyo virus positivity is 9.3% (557 samples), signaling persistent community transmission and one of the deadliest outbreaks in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ危機が1万1000症例に到達、致死率は49%に迫る
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、11,000例超、8州に拡大し地域社会内感染が継続するなど深刻な公衆衛生イベントであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 接触者追跡率が目標の95%に届かず（79.7%）、地域内感染継続（33死亡中19件がコミュニティ内）など、感染拡大継続のリスクが高い。既に大規模流行であり継続的なモニタリングとフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: 小甘密新村至少5宗骨痛热症病例 村委会拟大扫除清理荒废空屋 - 地方 - 花城大小事
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Xiao Ganmi New Village Has At Least Five Dengue Fever Cases; Village Committee Plans a Large-Scale Cleanup to Clear Abandoned Vacant Houses - Local - Guangzhou Local Affairs
article.articleSummary: Five dengue fever cases have been reported in Xiao Ganmi New Village in Guangzhou’s Furong area, with infections mainly clustered around the Hakka Village belt. Although spraying by the Health Bureau helped reduce mosquitoes, officials warn that eliminating breeding sources is essential to prevent a rebound. The village committee plans a large-scale cleanup targeting long-abandoned vacant houses and water-accumulation hotspots to curb Aedes mosquitoes. Focus areas include plant pot bases, idle containers, rear corners, and drainage ditches; public spaces will be cleaned as well. Cross-agency coordination is under way with Furong City Hall, the SWM Company, a state solid-waste management agency, and the Community Mosquito-Borne Disease Elimination Team (COMBI) to coordinate garbage clearance, canal hygiene, and vacant-property management. Residents are urged to tidy their homes and surroundings before the operation to sustain prevention beyond this event and reduce dengue transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 小甘密新村で少なくとも5件のデング熱症例、村委員会が廃屋の大掃除を計画
triage.triage_reason: 単一村落での小規模なデング熱クラスター（5例）であり、地元当局（村委員会・保健局・COMBI）が既に防除対応を進めている。公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際拡大のリスクは認められないが、蚊媒介感染症として継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedotは発生地域を中国・広州としているが、ソースURL（sembilan.sinchew.com.my）および記事中の組織名（Furong City Hall, SWM Company, COMBI＝Community Mosquito-Borne Disease Elimination Team）はマレーシア・ヌグリ・スンビラン州の行政用語であり、実際の発生地はマレーシアと推定される。マレーシアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient, beginning countdown to Ebola-free declaration
article.articleSummary: Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient on 2026-11-11, beginning a 42-day countdown to an Ebola-free status if no new infections occur by Dec. 23. The Bundibugyo-strain outbreak remains severe regionally, with Congo reporting 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths; Uganda and Nigeria have reported cases linked to travelers from Congo. In Kenya, nine Ebola cases were recorded in October after the initial patient traveled from Congo via Uganda, transmitting to four family members and four healthcare workers. The index patient and his mother died; the other seven recovered. Kenya identified 135 contacts connected to the first case, with authorities saying all confirmed infections tie to that contact list, indicating no community transmission. Border measures include a designated airport gate for arrivals from 10 affected countries, thermal screening, and health declarations; Saudi Arabia suspended visas indefinitely affecting Kenyan workers. The outbreak remains one of the worst on record.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最後のエボラ患者を退院させ、エボラ終息宣言へのカウントダウン開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で11,042例・5,387死亡という史上最悪級のエボラ流行が継続中で、ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・ケニアへの越境伝播が確認され、サウジアラビアのビザ停止等渡航制限も発生しているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの終息動向だが、根本的な感染源・大規模流行はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）であり対象国リストに該当。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・サウジアラビアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nova variante da Covid-19 circula no Brasil; saiba identificar os sinais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new COVID-19 variant is circulating in Brazil; learn how to identify the symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports circulation of SARS-CoV-2 variant XFG, also known as Stratus, a descendant of Omicron. Detected in 18 states plus the Federal District, with a six-week rise in mild COVID-19 cases through 31 October, though overall risk remains low. WHO is monitoring XFG; current data do not indicate greater severity than other circulating variants. Symptoms resemble other COVID-19 illnesses and include sore throat, hoarseness, fever, cough, nasal congestion or runny nose, fatigue, headache, muscle pains, altered smell or taste, and nausea or diarrhea; none are diagnostic for XFG without testing. Diagnosis relies on rapid antigen or RT-PCR tests; variant identification requires genomic sequencing. In 2026, Brazil recorded 118,851 COVID-19–related influenza-like illness, about 3,400 severe acute respiratory infection cases, and 437 deaths, all down from 2025. Vaccination remains key; antivirals are available for high-risk groups when started within five days. By 11 November 2026, over 20.3 million doses distributed, 7.4 million administered; reinforce hand hygiene, ventilation, and masking in high-risk settings.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新変異株がブラジルで流行中、症状の見分け方を学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株XFG(Stratus)の流行が報告されているが、WHOも重症度増加の根拠はないとしており、全体リスクは低いとされているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: WHOが監視中の変異株であり、現時点で重症度増加の証拠はない。死亡者数・重症例数は2025年比で減少傾向。

article.articleHeadline: Fetal Inflammation Predicts Neonatal Blood Infections
article.articleSummary: In China, a retrospective 1:2 propensity-matched case-control study at Women's Hospital, Zhejiang University, links fetal inflammatory response (FIR) and maternal prenatal pathogenic infection as independent predictors of positive neonatal umbilical cord blood cultures (UCBC). Neonates with positive UCBC (n=81) were matched to UCBC-negative controls (n=162) from births between January 2021 and December 2024, with placental pathology re-reviewed per Amsterdam 2016 criteria. FIR showed a strong independent risk (odds ratio 6.253, 95% CI 2.704–14.458, P<0.001); maternal prenatal pathogenic infection also independently increased risk (OR 5.904, 95% CI 2.819–12.368, P<0.001). Pathogen analysis yielded 86 strains from 81 positive UCBCs (5 polymicrobial); Gram-positive 59.3% (Enterococcus faecalis 14%, Group B Streptococcus 7%, Streptococcus mitis 7%), Gram-negative 40.7% (Escherichia coli 29.1%). Moderate/severe histological chorioamnionitis (HCA) occurred in 55.6% of positive cases, with FIR present in most E. coli–related HCA. Listeria monocytogenes and polymicrobial infections were associated with concurrent FIR and moderate/severe HCA, underscoring severe intrauterine inflammation requiring vigilance. Limitations include retrospective design and potential biases.

triage.headline_ja: 胎児の炎症反応が新生児血流感染を予測する
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設の後方視的臨床研究であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態やアウトブレイクを示すものではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は新生児の血流感染と胎児炎症反応の関連を調べた単一病院の症例対照研究であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態に関する情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Temukan 2.800 Kasus TBC di Kota Padang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department Finds 2,800 TB Cases in Padang City
article.articleSummary: 2,800 tuberculosis (TB) cases were found in Padang City, West Sumatra, via contact tracing across 104 kelurahan (districts) to strengthen early detection and management. Findings announced during National Health Day (HKN) 62nd on 11 November 2026 at Gedung Bagindo Aziz Chan Youth Center Padang, with tracing covering 204 loci to identify cases promptly and curb transmission. Positive patients receive treatment; authorities also provide support to individuals suspected of TB and educate communities on transmission prevention. Officials emphasize environmental health, including reducing smoking and household tobacco smoke exposure, as critical risk-reduction factors. The program advocates regular health screenings to detect TB early and prevent organ damage, and engages community organizations (PKK, Dharma Wanita) and local groups to support families and nutrition initiatives addressing stunting and pregnant women.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局、パダン市で結核2,800症例を発見
triage.triage_reason: 結核はインドネシアにおいて既知の流行疾患であり、本記事は通常の接触者追跡・早期発見活動の報告であって、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 国家保健デー(HKN)に合わせた地域保健局の定例的な結核対策報告であり、通常の公衆衛生活動の一環と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : en RDC, principal foyer de l'épidémie, plus de 11 000 cas recensés, pami lesquels 5 300 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: In the DRC, the main epicenter of the outbreak, more than 11,000 cases recorded, including 5,300 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains centered in the outbreak's main epicenter, with 11,042 registered cases and 5,387 deaths, according to the National Public Health Institute of the Congo (INSP) figures released on 11 November 2026. The same update records approximately 2,990 recoveries, indicating a substantial disease burden and a protracted outbreak. The numbers underscore the severity of the situation in the DRC, where the outbreak continues to unfold within the country, without details on other provinces or cross-border transmission in the report. All figures cited originate from INSP's latest public tally dated 11 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国、流行の主要震源地で1万1000人以上の症例、うち5300人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、1万人超の症例・5000人超の死者を記録する大規模かつ継続中のエボラ流行であり、公衆衛生上深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事は国内の主要震源地における累計症例・死者数の更新情報であり、他州や国境を越えた伝播についての言及はない。致死率が非常に高く、継続的な監視と国際支援の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يفتك بأكثر من 5 آلاف شخص في الكونغو وسط اتساع رقعة التفشي - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola claims more than 5,000 lives in Congo as the outbreak widens.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000 confirmed infections and 5,387 deaths, according to government data released on 2026-11-11. The outbreak, which began in mid-May, is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain for which no approved vaccines or treatments are available, complicating containment. With 11,042 confirmed cases across eight of the country’s 26 provinces, this is the second-largest Ebola outbreak by case load and the deadliest since West Africa's 2014-2016 epidemic (over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths). Notably, many fatalities have occurred outside treatment centers, highlighting access and security challenges in conflict-affected areas. The spread has extended to eastern, central, and western Africa, making this the widest geographic dispersion of Ebola in Africa to date, driven by delayed detection, armed conflict, and overburdened health services.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が5000人以上の死者、流行はさらに拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で11,000例超・死亡5,387人に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続し、稀な亜種（ブンディブギョ株）でワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、複数州・複数地域へ拡大しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC国内の流行拡大のみが述べられており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria Scare at Rayagada Ashram School: Class 5 Student Dies
article.articleSummary: Malaria death at Badaraising Ashram School, Jemadeipentha Panchayat, Rayagada district, Odisha: Class 5 student Khusi Kilaka died after malaria was confirmed by blood test and she received anti-malarial treatment; she died while hospitalized at District Headquarters Hospital, Rayagada. Her younger brother, also a resident student at the same school, tested positive for malaria and is in critical condition, admitted to hospital. The siblings had returned after a 10-day vacation. The incident underscores concerns about malaria transmission among students in residential tribal institutions and highlights the need for timely diagnosis, adequate healthcare facilities, and preventive measures in such settings. Laboratory confirmation by blood test supports the diagnosis, intensifying calls for preventive and diagnostic measures in tribal residential schools.

triage.headline_ja: ラヤガダ・アシュラム学校でマラリア騒動：5年生の生徒が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一校内での死亡1名・重症1名の局地的事例であり、マラリアはインド・オリッサ州の風土病であるため国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、部族寄宿学校での感染拡大の可能性があり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: マラリアはオリッサ州の部族地域で流行性のある風土病。単一施設内での発生であり、広域的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態とは言えないが、寄宿学校での予防・診断体制の不備が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو تتجاوز 11 ألف حالة في أسوأ تفش للمرض في تاريخها
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Congo exceed 11,000 in the worst outbreak of the disease in its history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000 cases, with 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths reported by the Ministry of Health as of November 11, 2026. This outbreak is the most deadly in the DRC’s history and remains a major global threat. Health authorities call for intensified efforts to slow transmission and contain spread, noting the virus has entered several neighboring countries, including Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. The West Africa 2014–2016 outbreak remains the benchmark for scale, with about 28,000 infections and 11,000 deaths; the current outbreak is ranked second in severity, and since declaration, total cases and deaths have reached roughly three times the figures of the West Africa episode.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者が11,000人を超え、同国史上最悪の流行に
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の過去最悪規模の流行で、致死率が高く、周辺国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）への拡大も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生イベントである。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの流行を主題としており、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの拡大は言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。アンゴラも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Numri i rasteve të konfirmuara të ebolës në Kongo tejkaloi 11 mijë
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in Congo exceeded 11,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the rare Bundibugyo variant, has reached 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths as of 11 November 2026, according to government data released the previous day. The outbreak, declared in mid-May, has no proven therapy or vaccine for Bundibugyo Ebola. It is the second-largest Ebola epidemic in history, after the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, which infected more than 28,600 people and killed over 11,000. The disease has spread across East, Central, and West Africa, representing the widest geographic reach of Ebola on the continent to date. Health authorities continue to monitor transmission and coordinate cross-border response across affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ確定症例数が11,000人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の確定症例が11,042人、死者5,387人に達し、史上2番目の規模の流行かつアフリカ大陸で最も広範な地理的拡大を示しており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大シグナル。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にはモザンビーク・アンゴラも含まれるが、記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国での流行のみが具体的に記述されており、他国での確定症例は言及されていないため除外した。ブンディブギョ株は治療法・ワクチンが未確立であり、史上2番目の規模（11,042例、5,387死亡）という点で極めて重大な公衆衛生イベント。

article.articleHeadline: Especialistas alertam para risco de dengue grave em segunda infecção e reforçam importância da vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts warn of the risk of severe dengue upon reinfection and emphasize the importance of vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Dengue experts warn that prior infection increases the risk of severe dengue upon reinfection with a different serotype due to Antibody-Dependent Enhancement (ADE). With Dengue Day approaching on November 21 and summer boosting Aedes aegypti activity, the threat grows. There are four dengue serotypes (DENV-1–DENV-4); immunity protects only against the same serotype, so infection with another type can enhance viral entry into cells and trigger a stronger inflammatory response. In Brazil, DENV-3 is expanding, rising from 14% to 30% of tested samples, heightening vulnerability in São Paulo; 374,000+ cases and 371 deaths were recorded January–October 2026. Prevention centers on the Qdenga vaccine (two doses 3 months apart), available 4–60 years in networks and prioritized by SUS for 10–14-year-olds; contraindicated in pregnancy, lactation, and immunosuppression. The critical phase (days 3–7 after fever onset) features severe abdominal pain, vomiting, bleeding, dizziness, and reduced urine; IV hydration and avoiding aspirin/NSAIDs are advised.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家、二次感染による重症デング熱のリスクを警告し、ワクチン接種の重要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州でDENV-3型の急拡大（14%→30%）により重症デング熱（ADE）リスクが高まっており、374,000件超の症例と371人の死亡が報告されている。公衆衛生当局（SUS）によるワクチン接種対応も進行中で、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はサンパウロ州における血清型シフト（DENV-3増加）に伴う重症デング熱リスクの啓発記事であり、新規アウトブレイクの発生報告ではないが、症例数・死亡者数の規模とSUSによるワクチン接種対応の動きから経過観察・評価対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Nghệ An: Trâu, bò chết hàng loạt do bệnh tụ huyết trùng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nghệ An: Mass die-off of buffalo and cattle due to anthrax.
article.articleSummary: On 11 November 2026, Nghệ An Province authorities confirmed that dozens of buffalo and cattle in the mountainous commune of Hữu Kiệm died from anthrax, with lab confirmation by the Central Veterinary Diagnostic and Testing Center I. Since 3–7 November, nearly 30 head died presenting neck swelling, foaming at the mouth, difficulty breathing, and bloating. In response, the provincial Department of Livestock and Veterinary Medicine and the Hữu Kiệm People’s Committee have implemented containment, surveillance, and treatment around the outbreak site. Prophylactic treatment has been given to nearly 200 cattle in the affected villages and surrounding areas; from 9–11 November, more than 60 animals have been treated. Vaccination campaigns against anthrax are underway across the commune to build immunity and curb spread. Neighboring Chiêu Lưu commune is also taking preventive measures; farmers are urged to restrict free-grazing and report abnormal signs promptly.

triage.headline_ja: ゲアン省：出血性敗血症（原題表記）により水牛・牛が大量死（Bluedotは炭疽と分類）
triage.triage_reason: 家畜（水牛・牛）の集団死亡事例であり、ヒトへの感染や重篤な公衆衛生影響は記載がない。地域内対応（隔離・ワクチン接種）が進行中で、国際的拡大の兆候は見られないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 原文ベトナム語の病名『bệnh tụ huyết trùng』は本来『出血性敗血症（Pasteurellosis、Hemorrhagic Septicemia）』を指す用語であり、Bluedotが付与した疾患名『Anthrax（炭疽）』とは異なる可能性が高い。ヒトへの感染報告はなく、家畜のみの事例として報告されている。続報でヒト感染や診断確定情報が出た場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: plus de 11 000 cas d'Ebola recensés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: More than 11,000 Ebola cases recorded.
article.articleSummary: As of November 11, 2026, more than 11,000 Ebola cases have been recorded in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). 11,042 people are infected, 5,387 have died, and about 2,990 have recovered, for a case-fatality rate of 48.8%. The outbreak began in Ituri province and has spread to seven other provinces; Ituri and Nord-Kivu house the majority of cases. The Bundibugyo strain is driving the outbreak; there is no vaccine specific to Bundibugyo. MSF calls for rapid expansion of access to Ervebo, licensed for the Zaïre strain, to protect at-risk groups. On Oct 24, WHO launched a trial in DRC to test cross-protection against Bundibugyo. Cross-border transmission has reached Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. Security clashes and violence against health teams in Ituri have led to a health center fire in Lolwa and suspension of response activities in Fataki; ADF attacks continue in Ituri, Haut-Uele, and Nord-Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ症例が11,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%の大規模エボラ流行がDRC国内8州に拡大し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境伝播も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境伝播が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。Bundibugyo株に対する有効ワクチンが未確立で、治安悪化により対応活動が妨げられている点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola no Congo ultrapassa 11 mil casos e deixa mais de 5,3 mil mortos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo surpasses 11,000 cases and leaves more than 5,300 deaths.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths, according to the Ministry of Health on 11 November 2026. The case fatality rate is about 49% among confirmed cases, making it the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC to date. First identified in mid-May, the outbreak has spread to eight of the country’s 26 provinces. The surge occurs amid armed conflict and a strained health system, hindering containment and patient care. The outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus species; there is no vaccine or specific treatment approved for this variant, complicating response. Government efforts to curb transmission continue, but regional instability and weak hospital infrastructure challenge the public health response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、感染者1万1千人超、死者5,300人以上に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49％、感染者1万人超・8州に拡大し、ワクチン未承認の変異種かつ紛争下で対応が困難なため、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する深刻な公衆衛生事象。
triage.notes: DRC史上最悪規模のエボラ流行とされ、ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo種であること、武力紛争下での医療体制脆弱性が懸念材料。フルRRAへの移行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يواصل الانتشار في الكونغو الديمقراطية والإصابات تتجاوز 11 ألفاً
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with cases exceeding 11,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths reported as of 11 November 2026, according to the health ministry cited by AP. Deaths nearly comprise half of total cases, marking the largest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history. Declared in mid-May, the outbreak has proven hard to contain due to armed conflict, a weakened health system, poor roads, and violence fueled by distrust and misinformation. The World Health Organization warns of accelerated transmission of the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, noting that there is no vaccine or approved treatment for this strain. Experts urge intensified control measures, as linked cases have appeared in other African countries, including Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. Ebola spreads through direct contact with blood or body fluids of the infected or deceased.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大続く、感染者数は1万1000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が継続し、死亡率約50%、ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブギョ株による感染拡大、周辺国への波及も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアでの関連症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCが主要な発生地域であり、史上最大のエボラ流行として社会的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya begins 42-day countdown to Ebola-free status
article.articleSummary: Kenya begins a 42-day countdown (Nov 12–Dec 23, 2026) to being declared Ebola-free after nine confirmed cases and two deaths linked to the initial imported infection. Incubation for Bundibugyo virus disease ranges two to 21 days; the countdown doubles that period to allow detection of any secondary transmission. The World Health Organization notes symptoms can appear within this window. The last case was reported Oct 20; as of Nov 10 the outbreak remains active in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths. Kenya will maintain heightened surveillance, rapid response teams in all counties, active facility and community surveillance, and entry-screening at points of entry. An advisory for returning Kenyans will require health declaration via a chatbot, on-arrival screening, and 21 days of quarantine with follow-up; no quarantine centers or border-free certification will be issued. Fever or related symptoms after travel should seek care via toll-free 719.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ出血熱終息宣言に向けた42日間のカウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（11,042症例、5,387死亡）が継続中であり、ケニアへの輸入症例も発生、国際的拡大と渡航制限措置が確認されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクとそこから輸入されたケニアの症例について述べている。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCの死亡者数・症例数が非常に多く、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cudurka Ebola oo oo Dilay in ka Badan 5,300 oo Qof
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 11,042 cases and more than 5,387 deaths as of 2026-11-11, making it the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak ever recorded in the country. The outbreak has affected eight of the DRC's 26 provinces, with authorities warning that many fatalities occurred outside designated treatment facilities. The Bundibugyo strain is associated with a high fatality rate, with about half of those infected dying; there is no vaccine or specific treatment for this strain. Delays in case detection, armed conflict, and weak health services have driven the spread. Earlier this month the WHO approved trials of two new Ebola vaccines. The disease has been reported in East, Central, and West Africa, underscoring one of the broadest Ebola spreads on record. Historically, this outbreak is second only to the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (over 28,600 cases and over 11,000 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病、5,300人以上の死者を出す
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが11,042症例、5,387人以上の死亡という同国史上最大規模に拡大しており、重症度・国際拡大リスク・管理困難性のいずれも極めて高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda、Mozambique、Angolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRC国内の拡大（8州）についてのみ言及しており、他国への越境拡大は明記されていないため除外した。致死率約50%、ワクチン・特効薬なしという極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient, beginning countdown to Ebola-free declaration
article.articleSummary: Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient on 11 November 2026, beginning a 42‑day countdown to an Ebola‑free declaration, contingent on no new infections through 23 December. Kenya recorded nine Ebola cases in October, tracing to the first patient who traveled from Congo via Uganda; transmission occurred to four family members and four healthcare workers. The first patient and his mother died; the other seven patients recovered, with 135 contacts identified. Globally, Congo remains the outbreak epicenter with 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths, while Uganda and Nigeria report cases linked to Congo travelers. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain and is described as among the worst on record. Kenya emphasizes no community transmission and that all confirmed cases are linked to the initial contact list. Border restrictions include airport screening via a designated gate and Saudi Arabia’s visa suspension since Oct 30.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最後のエボラ患者を退院させ、エボラ終息宣言へのカウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国を震源地とする大規模エボラ流行（感染者11,042人、死者5,387人）が、ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアへ越境拡大し、サウジアラビアのビザ停止など渡航制限も発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの感染終息に焦点を当てているが、震源地であり主要発生国はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・サウジアラビアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya releases last Ebola patient, starts 42-day countdown to disease-free status
article.articleSummary: Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient on Nov 11, initiating a 42-day countdown to disease-free status. Nine Ebola cases have been reported in Kenya since early October, all linked to an index patient—a Kenyan man who tested positive after arriving from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak began in May. Of the nine cases, one died and seven recovered; the remaining 11 contacts were released from quarantine. No new infections have been recorded since Oct 19, and Kenya will require travelers arriving from the DRC to undergo a 21-day quarantine. Ebola has affected four countries across eastern, central and western Africa, with the DRC outbreak the second-largest on record, more than 11,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最後のエボラ患者を退院させ、疾病フリー状態までの42日間のカウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生した大規模エボラアウトブレイク（11,000例超）が国境を越えてケニアに拡大し、渡航制限措置も導入されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの収束報告だが、感染源であるDRCのアウトブレイクは5月以降継続し11,000例超・第2位の規模。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、DRCのみをverified_locationsとした。

article.articleHeadline: Κένυα: Σε 42 μέρες θα μπορέσει να κηρυχθεί απαλλαγμένη από Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya: In 42 days it will be possible to declare it Ebola-free.
article.articleSummary: Kenya is entering a 42-day countdown to Ebola-free status after discharging the last patient on Wednesday. Since early October, Kenya has recorded nine Ebola virus disease cases, all linked to a traveler who arrived from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where a large outbreak was declared in May. The initial patient died; one additional death occurred, and seven patients recovered. No new cases have been reported since October 19, and the last 11 contacts exposed to confirmed cases were released from quarantine on the publication date. Going forward, Kenya will require arrivals from the Democratic Republic of Congo to quarantine for 21 days. Ebola has been detected in four countries across East, Central, and West Africa, marking the widest geographic spread of the disease on the continent to date. The DRC outbreak is the second-largest ever, with more than 11,000 confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア：42日後にエボラ終息宣言が可能に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,000例超の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが継続中であり、東・中央・西アフリカの4カ国に拡大するなど過去最大規模の地理的広がりを見せている点で、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの感染終息宣言に向けた動きだが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、感染源であり11,000例超の過去2番目に大きい規模のアウトブレイクが継続中のDRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。モザンビーク、アンゴラは記事本文で具体的言及がなく除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - RDC: plus de 11.000 cas d'Ebola recensés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola - DRC: more than 11,000 Ebola cases recorded.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, more than 11,000 Ebola cases have been recorded in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the worst outbreak the country has ever seen, with armed conflict significantly hindering the public health response, according to Congolese authorities cited by AFP. The outbreak was officially declared in mid-May, after several months’ delay. Ebola transmits via contact with bodily fluids and causes a severe hemorrhagic fever. Across Africa, Ebola has caused more than 15,000 deaths in the past 50 years. The previous worst DRC outbreak, from 2018 to 2020, killed about 2,300 people from roughly 3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 - コンゴ民主共和国: 11,000人以上の感染者を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（1万1千例超）が発生し、武力紛争により公衆衛生対応が著しく妨げられているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 過去最悪規模のDRCエボラアウトブレイク。武力紛争による対応遅延が懸念材料。致死率や国際的な封じ込め支援の詳細は本文からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: ▷ Brote de viruela del mono en aumento en Brasil y casos de cepa más contagiosa se incrementan en Argentina | Actualizado noviembre 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ▷ Rising monkeypox outbreak in Brazil and cases of the more contagious strain are increasing in Argentina | Updated November 2026
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (mpox) outbreaks are rising in Brazil, with notable activity in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. In the most recent weeks, São Paulo reported 64 mpox cases, while Rio de Janeiro confirmed 74 infections over a span of a couple of months. The numbers indicate a substantial increase compared with the same periods in prior years. The article provides no details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, transmission sources, or fatalities, and does not mention imported or exported cases. The focus is on urban centers amid the ongoing Brazil mpox trend as of November 11, 2026. No further countrywide data or regional comparisons are given in the body. The report highlights monitoring in two major cities, suggesting heightened public health attention to mpox transmission in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: ▷ ブラジルでサル痘（Mpox）の発生が増加、アルゼンチンではより感染力の高い株の症例が増加 | 2026年11月更新
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内（サンパウロ・リオデジャネイロ）でMpox症例数が前年同期比で大幅に増加しており、より感染力の高い株（Clade I）がアルゼンチンでも増加との言及があり、異常性と国際拡大の可能性の2基準が該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（サンパウロ・リオデジャネイロ）の症例増加が主題。アルゼンチンへの言及はあるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。症例の重症度・死亡・感染経路・検査確定情報が本文に記載されておらず、続報での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Duale Fires Warning to U.S., Other Countries Over Ebola
article.articleSummary: Kenya declares Ebola-free as of 2026-11-11 following the Bundibugyo virus outbreak, which yielded nine confirmed Ebola cases and two deaths (first case reported Oct 3). Seven patients recovered; the last patient was discharged and the final batch of 11 quarantined contacts completed monitoring. Kenya will not act as a quarantine centre for any country or host travelers to meet foreign entry requirements, a stance reiterated by Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale. The United States had sought to quarantine its citizens from the Democratic Republic of Congo in Laikipia, but public opposition and court orders blocked the facility. With the last patient cleared, Kenya marks a milestone toward being Ebola-free. Public can report Ebola-related emergencies via toll-free 719, or dial *719#, or WhatsApp 0700 719 719.

triage.headline_ja: デュアレ氏、米国などに対しエボラ対応で警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）のアウトブレイクに伴い死亡例が発生し、国際的な渡航・検疫措置を巡る政治的対立が生じているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアのエボラ終息宣言だが、米国がコンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者をケニアで検疫しようとした問題が中心的対立点であり、コンゴの状況が間接的に関与しているためDRCを検証済み地域として記載。ケニア・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Број заражених вирусом еболе премашио 11.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with the Ebola virus has surpassed 11,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 11,000 cases, with 11,042 confirmed infections and 5,387 deaths. The Bundibugyo virus is responsible for the outbreak, which has spread to eight of the Democratic Republic of the Congo's 26 provinces. The epidemic was declared in mid-May, and authorities struggle to contain it amid armed conflict, a strained health system, poor roads, and violence fueled by distrust and misinformation. There is no known vaccine or treatment for this Bundibugyo-based outbreak according to the report. Healthcare facilities and workers have been attacked as skepticism grows in affected communities. Renewed violence in the Ituri and North Kivu provinces has raised concerns and prompted health officials to call for a ceasefire or safe access to patients so staff can reach those in need.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染者数が11,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ species）流行が11,000例・5,387人死亡に達し、8州に拡大、治療法・ワクチンもなく、武力紛争で対応が困難という深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際的拡大・支援の必要性も高い。
triage.notes: 致死率は約49%と高く、武力紛争・医療従事者への攻撃・ワクチン未承認など複合的リスクが存在。ブンディブギョ種のエボラはスーダン型やザイール型と異なり既存ワクチンの効果が不明なため、早急なリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient, beginning countdown to Ebola-free declaration
article.articleSummary: Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient on 11 November 2026, initiating a 42-day countdown to an Ebola-free declaration, contingent on no new infections. Kenya reported nine Ebola cases in October after the index patient travelled from Congo through Uganda, transmitting the virus to four family members and four healthcare workers. The index patient and his mother died; the remaining seven cases have recovered. Kenya identified 135 contacts linked to the first patient. The 42-day period ends on 23 December, though Kenya will maintain prevention measures. Despite Kenya’s progress, the regional outbreak continues to widen: Congo remains the epicentre with 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths reported to authorities as of 11 November 2026. The outbreak has also crossed borders to Uganda and Nigeria via travellers from Congo. Health Minister Aden Duale noted the countdown equals twice the longest incubation period.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最後のエボラ患者を退院させ、エボラ終息宣言へのカウントダウン開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCを震源とするエボラ大規模流行（感染11,042例、死亡5,387例）が複数国に越境拡大しており、IHR4基準すべてに該当する重大な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの封じ込め成功を報じているが、震源地であるDRCでの大規模流行（11,042例・5,387死亡）が主題の核心であり、ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・ケニアへの越境伝播も発生している。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: PJ.2.1: दुनिया भर में फैल रहा कोविड-19 का नया वेरिएंट कितना है खतरनाक, क्या भारत में मिले मामले? जानें- लक्षण, बचाव और इलाज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PJ.2.1: How dangerous is the new variant of COVID-19 spreading worldwide, have there been cases in India? Learn - symptoms, prevention and treatment.
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1 is a SARS-CoV-2 lineage with numerous spike protein mutations, potentially increasing ACE2 receptor binding and entry into human cells. First identified May 2, 2026 in Ontario, Canada, the variant has since been detected across the United States (first U.S. case in New York City, June 30, 2026) and in Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, Israel, France, and Spain, with Spain reporting sustained local transmission. Public Health Ontario data (Sept 20–Oct 17) show PJ.2.1 accounting for 25.2% of sequenced SARS-CoV-2 samples, up 16.9% from the previous four weeks. Symptoms resemble other COVID-19 and influenza illnesses; no definitive evidence yet of more severe disease or higher mortality. Diagnostic testing is needed to confirm SARS-CoV-2 infection. It is unclear whether PJ.2.1 has been detected in India; INSACOG monitors genomic changes. Some researchers label it a 'saltation variant,' but current data do not indicate major immune escape from vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: PJ.2.1：世界中に広がる新型コロナウイルスの新変異株はどれほど危険か？インドでも感染例はあるのか？症状・予防・治療法を解説
triage.triage_reason: 新規SARS-CoV-2変異株PJ.2.1が複数国（カナダ、米国、シンガポール、豪州、NZ、イスラエル、仏、西）で確認され、スペインでは持続的な市中伝播が報告されており、国際的拡大のリスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事はインドでのPJ.2.1検出有無について『不明』と明記しており（INSACOGが監視中）、確定的な検出報告はないため対象国リストに該当する検証済み発生国はなし。実際に検出が確認されているのはカナダ、米国、シンガポール、豪州、NZ、イスラエル、仏、西であり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Число зараженных Эболой в ДР Конго превысило 11 тысяч человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola in DR Congo has surpassed 11,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 11,000 infections, with 11,042 confirmed cases reported as of November 10, 2026. About 5,400 deaths have occurred, and the disease has affected eight of the country’s 26 provinces. By early November, the case fatality rate reached 51.6%. The outbreak is the second-largest and most deadly in Ebola history, behind the West Africa 2014–2016 epidemic, which infected more than 28,600 people and caused over 11,000 deaths. The spread across East, Central, and West Africa makes it the widest geographically on the continent. Reuters cited government data for these figures.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ感染者数が1万1000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率51.6%、感染者11,042人・死者約5,400人という大規模流行で、複数州・複数地域に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: モザンビーク・アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが記事主題はDRコンゴの流行であり、対象国リストにも該当しないため除外。史上2番目に大きい・致死率の高いエボラ流行として報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia da de alta al último paciente de ébola e inicia cuenta atrás para declararse libre de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya discharges the last Ebola patient and begins the countdown to being declared Ebola-free.
article.articleSummary: Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient, starting a 42-day countdown to be declared Ebola-free by December 23, 2026, provided no new infections occur. Kenya reported nine Ebola cases in October after the first patient traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo through Uganda, transmitting to four relatives and four health workers; the index patient and his mother died, while seven others recovered. Authorities identified 135 contacts linked to the initial case. The regional outbreak centers in Congo, with 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths, have also spread to Uganda and Nigeria via travelers from Congo. Health Minister Aden Duale said the 42-day window is twice the maximum incubation period, and prevention measures will stay. All Kenyan cases were linked to the initial contact list, indicating no community transmission. Kenya tightened border controls, designating a dedicated airport gate for travelers from 10 affected or neighboring countries; the outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and is described as among the worst.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最後のエボラ患者を退院させ、エボラ終息宣言へのカウントダウン開始
triage.triage_reason: DRC発の地域的エボラアウトブレイク（感染11,042例、死亡5,387例）がウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアに拡大しており、IHR基準に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでのエボラ終息に向けた動きを報じているが、主要な発生源はDRCであり、同国で大規模な流行（11,042感染・5,387死亡）が継続中。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株による史上最悪級の流行と記述されている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Lâm Đồng ghi nhận hơn 19.600 ca bệnh truyền nhiễm, 4 người tử vong trong 10 tháng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lam Dong records more than 19,600 infectious disease cases, 4 deaths in 10 months.
article.articleSummary: Lam Dong reported 19,623 infectious disease cases across 44 diseases in the first 10 months of 2026, with 4 deaths. Dengue fever accounted for 7,193 cases (+501 vs 2025) and caused 1 death in the Đắk R'lấp area; 330 dengue outbreaks were detected and managed. Hand-foot-mouth disease rose to 5,817 cases (+2.4x from 2025) and 2 deaths occurred in Ta Nang, Đức Trọng. Measles recorded 125 cases, no deaths, a substantial reduction (−3,756) from 2025 though suspected cases persist. Rabies: 1 death and 1 suspected case, down 3 from the prior year. Malaria: 5 cases, no deaths, mainly among forest workers sleeping in high-risk rural areas. Overall, the situation is stable, but dengue and HFMD require continued vigilance in communities and schools, with ongoing surveillance and outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: ラムドン省、過去10ヶ月間で19,600件以上の感染症症例、4人死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病の症例数が前年比2.4倍に増加し継続監視が必要とされているが、全体として記事は定期的な疾病サーベイランス報告であり、新規の異常事態や国際的拡大の兆候は確認されない。
triage.notes: ベトナム・ラムドン省における年次（10ヶ月間）の複数感染症サーベイランス報告。デング熱・手足口病は増加傾向にあり地域内での継続的な監視対象だが、麻疹は大幅減少、狂犬病・マラリアは少数例。全体として「安定」と評価されており、緊急のリスク評価には至らないが、手足口病の増加率（2.4倍）は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Taipeh meldet importierte Dengue-Fieber-Fälle: Taiwan verzeichnet Infektionen nach Vietnam-Reise
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taipei Reports Imported Dengue Fever Cases: Taiwan Records Infections After Vietnam Trip.
article.articleSummary: Two imported dengue fever cases linked to a Phu Quoc, Vietnam trip were confirmed in Taiwan, alongside a new local case in Xinzhuang District, New Taipei City. The imported cases involve a man and a woman from Taichung, aged 40–60, who traveled in late October for eight days; after returning they developed fever, headaches, and muscle pain and were diagnosed by physicians. The local case is a woman in her 40s, with the infection source under investigation. Health authorities mapped exposure and residence for a 13-person travel group; eight others live in Taichung, two in Nantou, and one in New Taipei City. Monitoring extends through December 6, with vector control and breeding-site removal at residences. Taiwan has 245 confirmed cases this year, including 18 local transmissions and 227 imported, with exposures mainly in Southeast and South Asia (notably Vietnam and Bangladesh). Travelers should use protective clothing and insect repellent; seek care for fever or rash after return and report travel history; residents should remove standing water.

triage.headline_ja: 台北市が輸入デング熱症例を報告：ベトナム旅行後に台湾で感染確認
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における輸入デング熱症例および小規模な地域内感染であり、今年の累計245例という既知の季節性流行の範囲内で、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれず、ベトナムは旅行先・曝露地として言及されているのみでベトナム国内での流行拡大について具体的記述がないため、verified_locationsには含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Bayi Sering Batuk Pilek Kenali Bahaya RSV dan Cara Mencegahnya sejak dalam Kandungan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infants Who Often Cough and Have Colds: Recognize the Dangers of RSV and How to Prevent It During Pregnancy
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, ahead of World Pneumonia Day, the Indonesian Obstetrics and Gynecology Association (POGI) warns that Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) infection is a leading cause of hospitalization for infants under six months worldwide, and in Indonesia accounts for about 20% of pediatric lower respiratory tract infections. About 90% of children are infected with RSV by age two, while 50% of RSV hospitalizations occur in the first three months of life due to narrow airways and immature immunity. To reduce severe outcomes, POGI promotes maternal vaccination during pregnancy in weeks 32–36 to maximize antibody transfer through the placenta, conferring early protection after birth. Global clinical trials report that vaccination during pregnancy can cut the risk of severe infant hospitalization by more than 80%. Expectant mothers are urged to consult their obstetricians for RSV protection.

triage.headline_ja: 赤ちゃんの頻繁な咳と鼻水：RSVの危険性と妊娠中からの予防法を知る
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではなく、妊婦へのワクチン接種推奨に関する教育的内容のため。
triage.notes: RSVはインドネシアで小児の既知の疾患として言及されているが、アウトブレイクや異常増加の報告ではなく、世界肺炎デーに合わせた予防啓発記事のため対象国として計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola dépasse les 11 000 cas et fait plus de 5300 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola outbreak surpasses 11,000 cases and has killed more than 5,300 people.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 11,000 infections and 5,387 deaths as of 10 November 2026, with 11,042 confirmed cases since mid-May. Eight of 26 provinces are affected, led by Ituri and North Kivu; ongoing conflict, poor transport networks, and fragile health systems hinder response, and many patients die before reaching treatment centers, while mistrust complicates contact tracing. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or approved specific treatment; WHO is backing experimental vaccine trials in Bunia since October. The outbreak is the second-deadliest in the DRC, after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (over 28,600 cases, more than 11,000 deaths). Cases have appeared in Kenya and Nigeria, prompting calls for strengthened cross-border surveillance, rapid case identification, and unhindered access for medical teams.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ出血熱の流行が11,000症例を超え、5,300人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが11,000症例・5,300人以上の死亡に達し、国境を越えた拡大（ケニア・ナイジェリア）も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ケニアでの症例報告があるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。致死率・規模から2014-2016年西アフリカ流行に次ぐ深刻度とされる。

article.articleHeadline: 逾1900間學校完成流感疫苗外展接種　流感活躍程度仍高於基線
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,900 schools have completed influenza vaccination outreach; influenza activity remains above baseline.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, Hong Kong Health Secretary visits a Tseung Kwan O kindergarten to oversee the seasonal influenza vaccine school outreach, urging schools and parents to vaccinate children early to reduce the risk of severe illness or death. In just over a month since the program began, more than 1,900 schools have completed outreach vaccination; remaining schools are expected to finish by mid next month. To boost uptake, the government’s eHealth mobile app has introduced a new electronic consent form to simplify data entry and reduce administrative burdens for schools and vaccination teams; the Centre for Health Protection will continue to review and optimize services. Influenza activity remains above baseline but showing signs of decline. This season has recorded 29 severe pediatric influenza cases, including 2 deaths, 3 in critical condition, 22 recovered/discharged, and 2 stable.

triage.headline_ja: 逾1900校がインフルエンザワクチン学校訪問接種を完了　インフルエンザ活動度は依然基準値を上回る
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの流行状況報告であり、重症小児例や死亡例が存在するが、現時点では例年の季節性流行の範囲内とみられ、異常性や国際的拡大リスクの明確な根拠は乏しい。
triage.notes: 香港における季節性インフルエンザのワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する定例報告。重症小児例29件・死亡2件が報告されているが、季節性流行として想定内の範囲であり、IHR基準には該当しない。継続的なモニタリング対象として経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Nhiều người mắc sốt xuất huyết nặng phải nhập viện
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many people with severe dengue fever require hospitalization.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-11-11, Hanoi's National Hospital for Tropical Diseases reports 16 patients with severe dengue in intensive care. A 23-year-old woman from Hanoi presented with high fever and vomiting, developing severe dengue with profound thrombocytopenia (platelets 21 G/L) and marked liver injury (AST 1,907 U/L; ALT 883 U/L); ultrasound revealed ascites and bilateral pleural effusions, indicating plasma leakage. A second case involves a 53-year-old woman from Hai Phong, with five days of fever and myalgia, whose platelets fell from 38 to 21 G/L and had elevated liver enzymes, diagnosed with severe dengue with liver injury and coagulopathy. Dr. Phạm Văn Phúc emphasizes that thrombocytopenia alone does not determine severity; prognosis relies on clinical status and multiple indices (bleeding, blood pressure, urine output, hematocrit, organ involvement). Plasma leakage risk rises around defervescence (days 3–7). November is dengue peak season in Vietnam; promotes vector control and vaccination as prevention, but vaccination does not replace mosquito control; seek medical care if dengue is suspected.

triage.headline_ja: 多くの人が重症デング熱を発症し入院
triage.triage_reason: ハノイの熱帯病病院で重症デング熱患者（ICU入室含む）が報告されているが、11月はベトナムのデング流行期であり季節性の流行の範囲内と考えられる。異常性や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性デング熱の重症例報告であり、ハノイの一病院における臨床事例（血小板減少・肝機能障害等）を中心に記述。全国的な急増やアウトブレイク宣言は確認されていないため、通常のサーベイランス情報として経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : en RDC, principal foyer de l'épidémie, plus de 11 000 cas recensés, pami lesquels 5 300 morts - Le guide du Maroc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: in the DRC, the main epicenter of the outbreak, more than 11,000 cases recorded, among whom 5,300 deaths - The Morocco Guide
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains concentrated in Ituri and North Kivu, after being declared mid-May. As of November 11, 2026, the INSP reports 11,042 Ebola cases, 5,387 deaths, and about 2,990 recoveries, a 48.8% case fatality rate. The epidemic has spread to seven other provinces, with Ituri and North Kivu bearing most cases; cross-border transmission has occurred in Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria. There is no vaccine specific to the Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak. MSF has urged expanding access to Ervebo, licensed against the Zaïre strain, to protect at-risk people. On Oct 24, WHO announced a DRC trial to assess cross-protection by Ervebo against Bundibugyo. Security crises impede response: a health center in Lolwa was burned, and fighting in Fataki temporarily suspended response activities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:コンゴ民主共和国で流行の主要拠点、11,000人以上の症例を記録、うち5,300人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%の大規模エボラ流行がDRC複数州に拡大し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境伝播も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境伝播が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。治安問題（医療施設焼失、戦闘による対応中断）がさらなる拡大リスクを高めている。Bundibugyo株に特異的なワクチンが存在せず、Ervebo（Zaïre株用）の交差防御効果を検証する臨床試験が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Zabójcza ebola poza kontrolą. Służby podały nowy bilans
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly Ebola Out of Control. Authorities Report a New Toll.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Bundibugyo (BVD) strain of Ebola has caused more than 11,000 infections and 5,387 deaths since the epidemic began in May, with eight of 26 provinces affected. WHO and CDC assessments indicate ongoing high transmission. The natural reservoir is most likely fruit bats; initial human infection occurs after close contact with blood or secretions of infected wildlife, including bats and primates, with subsequent human-to-human spread via blood, secretions and other body fluids. Risk is highest in healthcare settings lacking adequate protections and during funeral rites. The incubation period is 2–21 days; early symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle and throat pain, complicating rapid diagnosis, which requires laboratory confirmation. No vaccine exists for this Bundibugyo variant yet. Containment relies on rapid case finding, isolation, care, contact tracing, safe burials, and community education. At end-Oct, WHO began testing two vaccines; results expected early next year.

triage.headline_ja: 致死性エボラ、制御不能に。当局が新たな被害状況を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が11,000人以上感染、5,387人死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、ワクチン未承認・制御不能との報道でIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHOとCDCが高い伝播継続を評価しており、26州中8州に拡大。ワクチン2種の試験が開始されたが結果は来年初め予定。致死率は約49%と高い。

article.articleHeadline: Casos graves de Covid-19 aumentam até 23% em Mato Grosso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe COVID-19 cases rise by as much as 23% in Mato Grosso.
article.articleSummary: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) cases linked to COVID-19 rose 23% in Mato Grosso in Oct 12–Nov 7, 2026, vs the prior four weeks, per SES-MT from SIVEP-Gripe. From the start of 2026 through week 44 (Nov 7), Mato Grosso recorded 90 SARS cases with SARS-CoV-2 identified and seven COVID-19 deaths. Fiocruz notes Mato Grosso and Mato Grosso do Sul show rising severe respiratory infections; in MS the increase is mainly due to rhinovirus, while signals also appear in the Federal District and in SP, RJ and SC. All seven COVID-19 deaths this year occurred in unvaccinated individuals. Authorities urge up-to-date vaccination, especially for elderly and immunocompromised (every six months), pregnant women per pregnancy, and children 6 months to under 5, plus influenza vaccination. Low vaccination coverage persists in Cuiabá (varicella 58%, yellow fever 68%, polio 77%) and Várzea Grande; Imuniza Mais MT aims to raise coverage.

triage.headline_ja: マットグロッソ州で新型コロナウイルスの重症例が最大23%増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の季節的なCOVID-19重症例増加であり、既知の病原体・限定地域での通常範囲の変動と考えられ、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも低い。
triage.notes: 低ワクチン接種率（水痘・黄熱・ポリオ）への言及があるが、これは既存の公衆衛生課題であり新規の異常事態ではない。地域の保健当局がワクチン接種推進キャンペーンを実施中。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak exceeds 11,000 cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) exceeds 11,000 confirmed cases, with 11,042 infected and 5,387 deaths and about 2,990 recoveries, as of 11 November 2026. The 17th DRC outbreak began in Ituri province and has spread to seven other provinces, mainly Ituri and North Kivu, with additional cases in Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria. Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids, causing severe hemorrhagic fever. No approved vaccines or treatments exist for the Bundibugyo species driving this outbreak; Ervebo (Zaire strain) is undergoing a full human trial in the DRC to assess cross-protection. Security challenges in eastern DRC hinder response, including a burned health centre in Lolwa and suspended operations in Fataki amid clashes; Islamic State–affiliated ADF attacks reported in Ituri, Haut-Uele and North Kivu. The outbreak was officially declared in May.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、感染者数が11,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで感染者11,000人超・死者5,387人の大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが拡大し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアにも波及、承認ワクチン・治療法が無く治安悪化で対応困難なためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当数が高く、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの感染拡大が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。承認ワクチンが無いブンディブギョ株による致死率約49%の大規模流行であり、治安悪化（ADF攻撃、医療施設焼失）が対応を妨げている点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak tops 11,000 cases as disease keeps spreading
article.articleSummary: Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus with no vaccine or treatment, has infected 11,042 people and killed 5,387, according to health ministry data. Declared in mid-May, the outbreak has spread to eight of Congo's 26 provinces, with Ituri and North Kivu as major hotspots. Attacks on health workers and community mistrust and violence have hampered response, and health facilities have been targeted. The outbreak has also crossed borders to Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria. It ranks as Congo's deadliest outbreak, with nearly half of infections in this surge, and is the second-largest Ebola outbreak after West Africa's 2014–2016 epidemic, which recorded about 28,000 infections and more than 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、感染者数が11,000人を超え拡大継続
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン・治療法のないBundibugyoウイルス型エボラが1万人超感染・5千人超死亡し、複数国に越境拡大しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当し緊急のフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ(DRC)のエボラ流行を主題としており、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・アンゴラへの越境は言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。ワクチン・治療法がない点、医療従事者への攻撃・地域住民の不信感による対応困難も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Περισσότερα από 11.000 κρούσματα στο Κονγκό - Εξιτήριο πήρε ο τελευταίος ασθενής στην Κένυα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 11,000 cases in Congo — the last patient in Kenya has been discharged.
article.articleSummary: 11,042 Ebola infections and 5,387 deaths reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo (INSP), with about 2,990 recoveries and a case fatality rate of 48.8%. The 17th outbreak began in Ituri (northeast) in May and spread to seven other provinces, with Ituri and North Kivu bearing most cases; cross-border transmissions reported to Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. Vaccine options remain limited for Bundibugyo strain; MSF calls for expanded access to Ervebo (Zaïre/Zaire strain), while WHO started late-Oct a trial to assess protection against Bundibugyo. Violence and health facility attacks impede response, including a burned center in Lolua, Ituri, and halted operations in Fataki. In Kenya, the last Ebola patient was discharged, initiating a 42-day countdown; nine cases since October, one death, seven recoveries; last 11 contacts released; Kenya imposes 21-day quarantine for arrivals from DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴで11,000人以上の感染例 — ケニアで最後の患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（11,000例超、死亡5,387人、致死率48.8%）が継続中であり、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境伝播が報告され、渡航制限（ケニアの検疫措置）も発生しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ流行（第17次流行、Bundibugyo株）を主題とし、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境伝播も報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCの暴力・施設攻撃が対応を妨げている点も重要な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: Ξεπέρασαν τα 11.000 τα κρούσματα - 5.387 θάνατοι
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Over 11,000 cases — 5,387 deaths.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak: 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths, ~2,990 recoveries; CFR 48.8% (INSP). Began mid-May in Ituri (northeast) and has spread to seven other provinces, with Ituri and North Kivu most affected. The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no vaccine specific to this strain. Cross-border cases reported in Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria. MSF calls for expanded access to Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) to cover Bundibugyo; WHO started a clinical trial on Oct 24 to test vaccine protection against Bundibugyo. Ituri remains epicenter amid security and healthcare disruptions, including attacks on a health center in Lolwa and clashes in Fataki with ADF attacks in Ituri, Upper Uele, and North Kivu. In Kenya, the last Ebola patient was discharged, starting a 42-day countdown; nine cases since October, one death, seven recoveries; no new infections since Oct 19; 21-day quarantine for arrivals from DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：感染者数が11,000人を超える - 死者5,387人
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48.8%の大規模なエボラ流行がDRC複数州に拡大し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境感染も報告されており、IHR基準の複数に該当する深刻な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境感染が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株であり既存ワクチン(Ervebo)の有効性が未確立。治安悪化（ADFによる攻撃）が対応を阻害している点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемията от ебола в ДР Конго: Близо 5400 загинали и над 11 000 заразени
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the DRC: nearly 5,400 dead and over 11,000 infected.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo faces an Ebola virus disease outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain. The outbreak has reached 11,042 cases and 5,387 deaths since its mid-May onset, marking it the second deadliest in history. It spans eight of the DRC's 26 provinces, with major transmission in Ituri and North Kivu, where ongoing violence, a fragile health system, poor road infrastructure, and community distrust hinder containment. Health facilities and workers have been attacked, further obstructing response efforts. There is currently no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. Cross-border spread is reported, with cases in Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria, underscoring the need for safer access and coordinated regional public health action.

triage.headline_ja: DRCにおけるエボラ流行:死者約5,400人、感染者11,000人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行は死者5,387人・感染者11,042人に達し、周辺国への越境拡大も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない（ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国外）ため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。ワクチン・治療法未承認、治安悪化・医療従事者への攻撃などが封じ込めを困難にしている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Πάνω από 11.000 κρούσματα στο Κονγκό - Αντίστροφη μέτρηση για το τέλος της ασθένειας στην Κένυα

Majority of cases occur in Ituri and eastern regions; cross-border transmissions have been recorded in Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. The case fatality rate is 48.8%, with about 2,990 recoveries. There is no vaccine for Bundibugyo; MSF has urged expanding Ervebo access (licensed for Zaire ebolavirus). WHO began Oct 24 a clinical trial in DRC to assess protection against Bundibugyo. Violence and health-facility attacks hinder response, including a clinic fire in Loluwa and ADF assaults in Ituri, Fataki, and North Kivu. In Kenya, the last Ebola patient was discharged, initiating a 42-day countdown to declaring end; nine Oct cases (one death, seven recoveries) and no new infections since Oct 19, with a 21-day quarantine for travelers from DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴで1万1000人以上の症例 - ケニアではエボラ終息へのカウントダウン
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（11,000超症例、致死率48.8%）でウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境感染が確認されており、ワクチン未承認・治安悪化により対応が困難。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
