The 42-day period, doubling Ebola's longest incubation, will allow ongoing surveillance; authorities say all confirmed cases linked to the first patient's contacts, indicating no community transmission. Kenya has entry screening, including an arrival gate at its airport for travelers from 10 high-risk countries or neighboring areas with active cases, plus thermal screening and a health declaration form. An Ebola hotline and five isolation-bed facilities (241 beds) were established. In the Congo, 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths were reported as of November 11; the outbreak began in May and spread to Uganda and Nigeria via travelers. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain has no vaccine or treatment; health workers treat based on symptoms.

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde confirma que surto de ebola no Congo ultrapassa 11 mil casos e 5,3 mil mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health confirms that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000 cases and 5,300 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports the Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak with 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths as of November 11, 2026, making it the deadliest Ebola epidemic in the country’s history. The Bundibugyo virus lacks a vaccine or any effective treatment. Transmission has reached eight of 26 provinces. The outbreak began in mid-May and persists amid armed conflict and a severe health-system crisis, hindering containment efforts. Mortality is near 49% among confirmed cases. There are no laboratory-confirmed therapeutic options, and the absence of vaccines and therapeutics compounds containment challenges. Health authorities warn of ongoing geographic spread risk, with expansion across provinces underscoring the urgent need for strengthened public health response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが1万1000症例・5300人死亡を超えたと確認
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ型エボラが8/26州に拡大し、致死率約49%、11,000例超・5,300人超の死亡で同国史上最悪の流行となっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 武力紛争と医療システム崩壊が封じ込めを妨げており、ワクチン・治療薬の不在が懸念される。国際的な支援の緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 26歲男子感染猴痘　潛伏期曾透過社交平台結識男子有高風險接觸
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 26-year-old man infected with monkeypox; during the incubation period, he had high-risk contact with a man he met on a social media platform.
article.articleSummary: Twenty-six-year-old man diagnosed with monkeypox in Hong Kong after high‑risk contact with a man met via a social media platform during the incubation period. He developed a rash on November 1 and fever, was admitted to Tseung Kwan O Hospital for isolation, and laboratory tests confirmed mpox infection. The Centre for Health Protection is conducting an epidemiological investigation and will report the case to the WHO. Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 119 mpox cases, 94 locally transmitted, all male. From August to November, 26 cases were identified; all patients reported high‑risk sexual activity during incubation, including sex with casual male partners or multiple partners without condoms; most had not received mpox vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: 26歳男性が猴痘(エムポックス)に感染　潜伏期間中にSNSで知り合った男性と高リスク接触
triage.triage_reason: 香港では2022年以降119例のエムポックス症例（うち94例が地域内感染）が継続して報告されており、本件もその延長線上の個別症例。新規異常事象ではないが、性的接触によるMSMコミュニティ内での継続的な感染拡大が懸念されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 香港は中国の特別行政区であるため、対象国China(1814991)に分類。本症例は2022年以降続く香港国内のMSMコミュニティにおけるエムポックス地域内感染（計119例、うち94例が現地感染）の一部であり、新規の異常事象とは言えない。衛生署(CHP)が疫学調査を実施しWHOへ報告予定。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemie de Ebola fără precedent în Republica Democrată Congo. Peste 5.300 de morți și 11.000 de infectări
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unprecedented Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Over 5,300 deaths and 11,000 infections.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the country’s worst, with 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths as of 11 November 2026, a case fatality near 49%. The epidemic is caused by Bundibugyo and has no approved vaccines or specific antivirals. Declared in May 2026, it is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC and has surpassed all previous ones in infections and deaths. Community transmission persists in eight of 26 provinces, most severely in Ituri and North Kivu in the east. Barriers to case-finding and contact tracing include poor road networks, vast distances, ongoing conflict, strikes, unpaid healthcare salaries, and public mistrust. The WHO is supporting phase trials of two experimental vaccines—Oxford/Serum Institute and Moderna—coordinated by INRB in the DRC. EU risk remains very low per ECDC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で前例のないエボラ流行、死者5,300人以上、感染者11,000人以上
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行で致死率約49%、複数州でコミュニティ内感染が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・抗ウイルス薬はなく、WHO支援下で治験ワクチン（Oxford/Serum Institute、Moderna）が実施中。紛争・インフラ問題により症例把握が困難。EUへのリスクはECDC評価で非常に低いとされる。

article.articleHeadline: Segunda escola de Vespasiano, na Grande BH, suspende aulas após casos de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second school in Vespasiano, in the Greater Belo Horizonte area, suspends classes after cases of human scabies.
article.articleSummary: Two-day suspension at Escola Estadual Maria da Piedade Fonseca in Morro Alto, Vespasiano, in the Belo Horizonte metropolitan area, starting 11 November 2026 after a teacher was diagnosed with scabies (Sarcoptes scabiei). The school will undergo cleaning, disinfection, pest control, and water-tank sanitization; students and staff received prevention guidance, and classes will be rescheduled. This is the second scabies-related closure in Vespasiano that week, following 9 November suspensions at Escola Municipal de Ensino Especial Vovó Mariquita in Caieiras after a student was diagnosed. Transmission is mainly via prolonged close contact and shared textiles. SES-MG reports no municipal outbreak and notes scabies is not on national/state notifiable lists; 11 outbreaks have been reported this year across multiple municipalities, including Lagoa Santa, which logged 50 confirmations in 24 hours last month and a total of 241 cases notified there.

triage.headline_ja: ベロオリゾンテ都市圏ヴェスパシアーノの2校目の学校が疥癬（ヒゼンダニ）症例発生後に休校
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は軽症で致死性のない一般的な皮膚感染症であり、当局も自治体レベルのアウトブレイクではないとしている。国際的拡大・渡航貿易制限のリスクもなく、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。
triage.notes: 疥癬は国/州の届出対象疾患ではなく、州保健当局（SES-MG）は自治体レベルのアウトブレイクを否定。学校閉鎖は予防的措置であり、重大な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: क्या सर्दियों में भी हो सकता है जानवरों को लंपी स्किन डिजीज? साफ दिखते हैं ये लक्षण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can animals get Lumpy Skin Disease in winter as well? These symptoms are clearly visible.
article.articleSummary: Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD), caused by Capripoxvirus, is a contagious viral infection primarily affecting cattle and other bovines in Sultanpur, India. Infected animals can spread the disease through direct contact and blood-feeding insects such as mosquitoes and flies; damp, dirty conditions and insect vectors in winter also raise transmission risk. Principal signs include nodular swellings on the body, fever, weight loss, tearing from the eyes, drooling, and reduced milk yield. Early recognition is crucial, and infected animals should be isolated from healthy stock. Prevention focuses on maintaining clean, dry stables, reducing insects with appropriate sprays, and vaccinating with goatpox vaccine under veterinary guidance. If symptoms appear, veterinary consultation is advised. The article underscores that winter does not eliminate LSD risk and calls for continued vigilance among livestock farmers in Sultanpur.

triage.headline_ja: 冬でも動物はランピースキン病にかかる可能性があるのか？はっきりと見られるこれらの症状
triage.triage_reason: 動物（牛）の疾患に関する一般向け啓発記事であり、人への健康影響やヒト-ヒト感染のリスクはなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は家畜(牛)のランピースキン病に関する予防啓発記事であり、人獣共通感染症ではないため公衆衛生リスクは低い。地域限定の家畜衛生情報として続報の必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde prevê expansão de casos de Covid-19 e reforça importância da vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health anticipates an increase in COVID-19 cases and reinforces the importance of vaccination.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases rise in 18 Brazilian states over the last six weeks, though the overall risk remains low. The Ministry of Health, in an interview with CBN News, says end-of-year increases are expected and follow a pattern seen in previous years. Hospitalizations show sustained increases in the Southeast and Central-West regions, and in Paraná, with São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Distrito Federal, and Mato Grosso highlighted. Officials warn the spread may expand nationwide and stress vaccination, noting more than 20 million doses distributed this year, but coverage among priority groups remains well below targets. Vaccination is recommended for children 6 months to under 5 years, pregnant people, adults 60+, and those with high-risk conditions including immunosuppression and other comorbidities. Vaccine supply is currently normal and stocks are sufficient; if a municipality lacks doses, residents should prompt local officials to coordinate with the state to resolve shortages.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、ブラジル全土でのCOVID-19症例増加を予測、ワクチン接種の重要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: 季節的なCOVID-19症例増加であり、当局は全体リスクは低いとしているが、入院の持続的増加と全国拡大の可能性が指摘されているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性の増加パターンとして当局も既知の現象と説明しており、全体リスクは低いとされている。ワクチン在庫は正常、優先接種対象者のカバレッジが目標を下回っている点が課題。

article.articleHeadline: Super El Niño pode agravar doenças e elevar mortes; médica faz alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Super El Niño could worsen diseases and increase deaths; a doctor warns.
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces a climate-health emergency as extreme heat and the Super El Niño correlate with rising mortality and infectious disease risk. Fiocruz data link more than 120,000 reported deaths in the past two decades to climate change. International models project up to 450,000 deaths worldwide by February 2027 due to extreme weather events. Pulmonologist Dr. Celia Rocha warns that patients with comorbidities—respiratory disease, rheumatic disease, heart failure, chronic kidney disease, diabetes, systemic lupus erythematosus, pulmonary fibrosis, multiple sclerosis, and scleroderma—are especially vulnerable. The climate also influences reproduction and viral circulation, with higher preterm births, pregnancy complications, and surges of viral illnesses including COVID-19 and tuberculosis. She calls for Brazil’s SUS leadership and COP legacy to drive prevention, education, and management at home, addressing comorbidities, food insecurity, and misinformation to mitigate impacts of the Super El Niño.

triage.headline_ja: スーパーエルニーニョが病気を悪化させ死亡者数を増加させる可能性；医師が警告
triage.triage_reason: 気候変動と健康影響に関する一般的な警告記事であり、特定の感染症アウトブレイクや急性公衆衛生イベントを報告するものではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は気候変動（スーパーエルニーニョ）が慢性疾患・感染症リスクに及ぼす一般的な影響についての医療専門家の警告であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常な感染症事象の報告ではない。COVID-19・結核への言及はあるが、具体的な症例数・発生状況の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola supera los 11.000 casos y las 5.000 muertes en la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak surpasses 11,000 cases and 5,000 deaths in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 11,042 cases and 5,387 deaths as of November 11, 2026, per the Congolese Ministry of Health via Associated Press. Declared in mid-May, it constitutes the largest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history. Transmission persists amid armed conflict, a strained health system, poor road networks, and violence fueled by mistrust and misinformation. The World Health Organization warns of rapid spread of the Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak, noting there is no vaccine or approved treatment. Authorities report related cases in other African countries, including Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. Ebola causes a severe hemorrhagic fever and spreads through direct contact with the blood or other bodily fluids of an infected or deceased person.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、DRCで症例数が11,000例、死者数が5,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が継続し、致死率高く複数国への拡大兆候もあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアでの関連症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・承認された治療法がない点、武力紛争による対応困難も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito-palha acende alerta em Corguinho - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sand fly raises alarm in Corguinho - Boca do Povo News
article.articleSummary: Sand fly–borne leishmaniasis concerns rise in Corguinho, with 22 of 38 samples testing positive (not all lab-confirmed) across Furnas da Boa Sorte, Assentamento Vista Alegre, and Zigurats. Six patients have started treatment; two await medication. Fogging (fumacê) was considered but rejected by the state due to ecological risks, including harm to bees, sustaining transmission near forested areas. Prevention focuses on personal protection and vector control: on November 19, 500 repellents will be distributed in the Quilombola Furnas da Boa Sorte community; residents are advised to clear land, install screens, and wear protective clothing for arms and legs. The investigation is ongoing, with 22 positives and 16 negatives from 38 collections, signaling a localized transmission concern.

triage.headline_ja: コルギーニョでスナバエが警戒を喚起 - Boca do Povo News
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの小規模自治体でサシチョウバエ媒介リーシュマニア症の陽性例が増加しているが、重症例・死亡は報告されておらず、州レベルで対応中であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・マトグロッソドスル州コルギーニョ市の局地的なサシチョウバエ由来リーシュマニア症警戒に関するもの。38検体中22件陽性（未全て検査確定）、6名治療開始、2名待機中。州はエコロジカルリスクを理由に燻蒸（fumacê）を見送り、個人防護と駆除対策を推奨。国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限の兆候はなし。続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya's Ebola outbreak: Last patient discharged as countdown begins to be being declared free of the virus
article.articleSummary: Kenya marks an Ebola milestone as it discharges its last patient on 2026-11-11, beginning a 42‑day countdown to being declared Ebola‑free after seven recoveries and 135 contacts completing 21‑day follow‑ups. The outbreak began with a Kenyan businessman who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and died after arriving in Nairobi; his mother also died. No new confirmed Kenyan cases since 2026-10-20, and all cases are linked to the traveler with no evidence of wider community transmission; four of the recoveries were healthcare workers. Ebola spreads via infected bodily fluids, with a 2–21 day incubation. WHO guidelines require 42 days after the last negative test or discharge. Kenya will maintain enhanced surveillance at borders and health facilities; travelers from affected areas undergo electronic declarations and 21‑day supervised quarantine. The DR Congo outbreak involves Bundibugyo Ebola; no approved vaccine or treatment, though trials are underway.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアのエボラ流行：最後の患者が退院、ウイルス撲滅宣言までのカウントダウン開始
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでのエボラ流行は終息に向かっており新規の脅威ではないが、感染源であるDRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクは依然継続中であり、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの流行終息（渡航者由来の限定的事例、コミュニティ拡大なし）だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であり現在も流行が続くDRCのみverified_locationsに含めた。エボラという疾患特性上、DRCでの継続状況については引き続き監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Govt sets December 23 for Kenya's Ebola-free declaration after last patient's discharge
article.articleSummary: Kenya aims to declare Ebola-free on December 23, 2026 after the last patient's discharge and monitoring of 135 contacts. Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale announced a 42-day countdown starting November 12, 2026, to determine whether the outbreak ends with no new infections. Since the first imported case on October 6, 2026, nine confirmed Ebola cases have been recorded, all within a single cluster with no community transmission. The 11 contacts completed a 21-day monitoring period, and 135 contacts linked to the index case were traced. Progress is attributed to coordinated national and county response and a strengthened legal framework—the designation of Ebola as a formidable epidemic and the Public Health (Ebola Disease) Rules—with support from WHO, Africa CDC, IGAD, the US and India. Surveillance and entry screening continue; Kenya remains open to travel, with no quarantine centers or Ebola-free travel certificates unless required by IHR. Countdown remains conditional on no new cases.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア政府、最後の患者退院後の12月23日をエボラ終息宣言日に設定
triage.triage_reason: 既知のエボラアウトブレイクが収束局面にあり、地域感染やヒト-ヒト感染の拡大はなく、対象国リストにも該当国が含まれないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアにおけるエボラアウトブレイクの終息プロセスを報じるフォローアップ記事。発生国ケニアは対象国リストに含まれず、インドや米国は支援国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: لماذا نمرض أكثر في الشتاء؟ أسباب انتشار الفيروسات وطرق الوقاية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why do we get sick more in winter? Causes of virus spread and prevention methods.
article.articleSummary: Winter brings a seasonal surge in respiratory infections, including the common cold and influenza, with more respiratory complaints, according to Times Now. Dr. Randeep Guleria, former director of the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) in Delhi, notes that colder temperatures and longer indoor stays create conditions that boost viral spread and transmission. Lower temperatures help some viruses persist longer and may make person-to-person transmission easier. The viruses can remain airborne longer in chilly air, and certain viruses retain infectivity for extended periods. These factors are described as the main drivers of winter spikes in viral respiratory illnesses. The report does not cite specific case counts or outbreak data, but highlights indoor crowding and environmental stability as key mechanisms behind seasonal increases in wintertime infections in India and elsewhere.

triage.headline_ja: なぜ冬はより病気になりやすいのか？ウイルス拡散の原因と予防方法
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクや症例数の報告ではなく、季節性の呼吸器感染症に関する一般的な解説記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や懸念を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザ・風邪の一般的な予防啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの報告はない。インドの地名が付与されているが、特定の発生事例ではなく一般論のため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: لماذا نمرض أكثر في الشتاء؟.. أسباب انتشار الفيروسات وطرق الوقاية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why Do We Get Sick More in Winter? Causes of Viral Spread and Preventive Measures.
article.articleSummary: Winter drives higher incidence of viral respiratory infections, notably the common cold and influenza, with broader wintertime viral activity described in India. Dr. Randip Guleriya, former director of the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in Delhi, explains that lower temperatures help some viruses survive longer in the air and outside the body, while cold weather keeps people indoors in close contact, boosting transmission. The article emphasizes seasonal risk across respiratory infections as temperatures drop. Six preventive measures are recommended: 1) receive the influenza vaccine early; 2) avoid outdoor activity when air quality is poor or pollution is high; 3) reduce indoor pollution, including avoiding incense burning; 4) wear masks to cut inhalation of pollutants and viruses; 5) continue prescribed medications for chronic conditions like cough or asthma; 6) consult a doctor for persistent cough, shortness of breath, or wheeze. Following these steps may reduce winter health risks in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: なぜ冬はより多く病気になるのか？ウイルス蔓延の原因と予防策
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な季節性インフルエンザに関する健康啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため、シグナルとして取り扱う必要はない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性ウイルス感染症に関する一般的な健康情報・予防啓発記事であり、インド・デリーで特定の異常なアウトブレイクが発生していることを示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Beijos e Compartilhamento de Copos Podem Transmitir Infecções e Provocar Feridas nos Lábios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisses and Sharing Cups Can Transmit Infections and Cause Lip Lesions.
article.articleSummary: Kissing and sharing cups or utensils can transmit infections that cause lip and mouth lesions. The article highlights herpes labialis (HSV-1), syphilis (Treponema pallidum), impetigo, and infectious mononucleosis (Epstein-Barr virus). HSV-1 spreads by direct contact with skin, saliva, or active lesions and can persist in nerves with reactivation under stress, sleep loss, sun exposure, or immune changes. Early signs include tingling, burning, or itching on the lips, followed by grouped blisters that rupture and crust; recovery commonly occurs in 1–2 weeks. Syphilis may cause a mouth ulcer (hard chancre) transmitted mainly via sexual contact including oral sex. Impetigo causes honey-colored crusted lesions around the mouth. Mono presents with fever, sore throat, swollen neck glands, fatigue, and sometimes white patches on tonsils. Seek care at a Basic Health Unit for evaluation and testing; avoid self-medication and home remedies. Prevention: avoid kissing and sharing saliva-containing objects when infection or lesions are suspected. Not all mouth lesions are herpes.

triage.headline_ja: キスやコップの共有が感染症を媒介し、唇の病変を引き起こす可能性
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定の発生イベントやアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、性感染症や接触感染に関する一般的な健康教育記事であり、ブラジルにおける具体的な発生事例の記述もない。

article.articleHeadline: Duale to Kenyans in DR Congo: Come home, but don't bring Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak persists in the Democratic Republic of Congo, prompting Kenya to prepare a travel advisory for Kenyans returning home for the festive season, urging safe travel to avoid importation. Kenyans in DR Congo are welcome home but must ensure they do not bring Ebola with them. In Kenya, the Bundibugyo strain outbreak is at a turning point: the last patient under treatment has been discharged and the final 11 contacts completed monitoring. Kenya now enters a 42-day countdown to declaring Ebola free; if no new case is recorded, the country will be officially Ebola-free on December 23. Surveillance continues in all health facilities and port screening remains in effect. Kenya criticizes foreign travel restrictions, notably Saudi Arabia, and will not serve as a quarantine centre or issue Ebola-free certificates for travel. WHO AFRO praised transparency and urged continued vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥアレ氏、コンゴ民主共和国在住ケニア人へ：帰国は歓迎するが、エボラは持ち帰らないように
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ流行が継続中であり、国際的な人の移動を通じた越境拡大リスクおよび渡航制限（サウジアラビア）が実際に発生しているため、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア国内のBundibugyo株流行終息（42日カウントダウン）と、DRCでの流行継続に伴う帰国者への注意喚起が主題。ケニア・サウジアラビアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの流行継続が国際的懸念の核心。

article.articleHeadline: 本港再錄猴痘個案，26歲男子確診｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong records another monkeypox case; 26-year-old man diagnosed.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong records another monkeypox case: a 26-year-old man developed genital, hand and facial rashes from Nov 1 and fever; he presented to Tseung Kwan O Hospital on Nov 8 and remains stable. Public Health Laboratory Service confirmed monkeypox infection, and the center is tracing high-risk contacts and will report the case to WHO. Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 119 monkeypox cases (94 local, 25 imported), all male. Among 26 cases since August, all patients reported high-risk sexual activity during incubation, with most unvaccinated. Some patients could not contact new casual partners, hindering tracing; authorities are boosting social media outreach and coordinating vaccine pushes via dating apps. Monkeypox vaccine can prevent infection and severe disease. Since late September, extra vaccination centers, including at the Centre for Health Protection, operate with NGO outreach; hotline 2125 2373 (9:00–18:00). Seek medical care for rash, fever, lymphadenopathy and avoid contact.

triage.headline_ja: 香港で再び猴痘（Mpox）症例、26歳男性が確診
triage.triage_reason: 単発の安定した症例で2022年以降続く性的接触ネットワーク内の継続的な流行パターンであり、特段の異常事態ではないが、ヒト-ヒト感染が続いている点は注視が必要。
triage.notes: 2022年以降、香港で119例（うち94例は地域内感染）が報告されており、今回はその延長線上の単発症例。患者は安定しており、重症度は低い。性的接触によるハイリスク行動が共通する感染経路であり、接触者追跡とワクチン接種の推進が続けられている。WHOへの報告は定例的なものと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak hits 11,042 cases, death toll rises to 5,387
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak has 11,042 confirmed infections and 5,387 deaths, with about 2,990 recoveries, as of 11 November 2026 per National Institute of Public Health figures. Declared in May 2026, it is the 17th outbreak in DR Congo and the deadliest, surpassing 2018–2020’s ~3,500 cases and ~2,300 deaths. Originating in Ituri, it has spread to seven other provinces, with Ituri and North Kivu bearing the heaviest burden; cases have reached Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. Insecurity hampers containment: a treatment centre in Lolwa, Ituri, was set on fire; clashes in Fataki paused health activities; ISIS-affiliated ADF rebels operate in Ituri, Haut-Uele, and North Kivu. No approved vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo Ebola; WHO plans human trials to test Ervebo for potential protection against Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、感染者11,042人、死者5,387人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DR Congoで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が継続し、複数国への越境拡大、致死率の高さ、治安悪化による対応困難が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの症例拡大に言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン未承認（Bundibugyo株）、治安悪化による対応困難、史上最大規模の流行である点は重大リスク要因。

locations.name: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Περισσότερα από 11.000 κρούσματα έχουν καταγραφεί στη ΛΔ του Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 11,000 cases have been recorded in the DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: 11,042 people infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 5,387 deaths and about 2,990 recoveries (case fatality 48.8%, INSP). The 17th outbreak began in Ituri province (northeast) and has spread to seven other provinces, with the majority in Ituri and North Kivu. Cross-border transmission has been recorded with Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. No vaccine exists for the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain; MSF urged expanding Ervebo access, licensed for the Zaïre strain only. WHO began a 24 October clinical trial in DRC to test protection against Bundibugyo. Violence hampers response: a health center burned in Loluwa, Ituri; clashes in Fataki; ADF attacks in Ituri, Haut-Uele, and North Kivu. In Kenya, the last Ebola patient was discharged, starting a 42-day countdown; nine cases since October (one death, seven recoveries); 11 contacts cleared; Kenya imposes 21-day quarantine for arrivals from DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で11,000人以上の感染者が記録される
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.8%の深刻なエボラ流行が複数州・複数国に拡大しており、ワクチン未承認株への対応や暴力による対応阻害など、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSri Lanka、Kenya、Uganda、Nigeriaが含まれているが、記事の主題はDRCでのアウトブレイクであり、ケニア等は越境症例・対応措置の文脈で言及されているのみ。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo giảm tiểu cầu sâu, tổn thương gan nặng do sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning of severe thrombocytopenia and severe liver injury due to dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: 16 dengue fever patients treated at the Central Tropical Disease Hospital in Vietnam, with two women aged 53 (Hai Phong) and 23 (Hanoi) presenting with severe thrombocytopenia, markedly elevated liver enzymes (ALT/AST near 2,000 U/L), coagulation disorders, and organ injury. Ultrasound showed abdominal fluid and bilateral pleural effusions, indicating plasma leakage and risk of hypovolemia, shock, and multiorgan failure if not promptly managed. The report notes dengue can worsen even after fever abates, typically between days 3 and 7, underscoring critical monitoring for signs of bleeding, circulatory failure, and organ damage. Experts urge urgent care for warning signs (severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, lethargy, mucosal bleeding), and caution against self-medication or NSAIDs. Preventive guidance includes eliminating standing water, larval control, minimizing mosquito bites, hygiene, and dengue vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 重度の血小板減少・肝障害を伴うデング熱に関する警告
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はベトナムで流行している既知の風土病であり、本記事は重症化症例に関する臨床的注意喚起にとどまり、異常な発生増加やアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の重症化（血小板減少、肝障害、血漿漏出）に関する医療機関からの臨床警告であり、症例数の急増やアウトブレイクの兆候は記載されていない。デング熱はベトナムで季節的に流行する既知の疾患であるため、特段のシグナルとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: कई देशों में फैला कोरोना का नया वेरिएंट PJ.2.1, क्या भारत को भी सतर्क रहने की जरूरत?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new coronavirus variant PJ.2.1 spreading in many countries; does India also need to stay vigilant?
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1 is a newly identified SARS-CoV-2 variant detected first in Ontario, Canada on May 2, 2026, with cases later reported across Canada, multiple US states, and in Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, Israel, France, and Spain. Described as a saltation variant linked to the JN.1 lineage (MC.10.1.7), it carries several spike protein mutations that may enhance binding to the ACE2 receptor, potentially improving cell entry in laboratory tests. There is no solid evidence yet that PJ.2.1 causes more severe disease or higher hospitalisation or mortality than existing variants. Vaccines against prior variants appear to recognise PJ.2.1 antibodies in labs, though real-world effectiveness remains uncertain. Symptoms are non-specific and similar to COVID-19 and influenza, complicating clinical diagnosis; testing is advised when symptoms occur. High-risk groups should maintain precautions, including masks in crowded places, ventilation, and vaccination/boosters. India’s status is unconfirmed; WHO’s 2026-07-27 variant list did not include PJ.2.1.

triage.headline_ja: 多くの国に広がる新型コロナウイルス変異株PJ.2.1、インドも警戒が必要か？
triage.triage_reason: 新規SARS-CoV-2変異株PJ.2.1が複数国（カナダ・米国・シンガポール・豪州・NZ・イスラエル・仏・スペイン）に拡大しており、スパイク変異によるACE2結合性向上の懸念があるため、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大）が2つ以上該当しPICKUPと判定。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのメディアによる報道で、インドへの警戒喚起が主題だが、インド国内での発生は『未確認（unconfirmed）』と明記されており、確認済み発生国（カナダ・米国・シンガポール・豪州・NZ・イスラエル・仏・スペイン）はいずれも対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。重症度増加のエビデンスはまだないが、スパイク蛋白変異によるACE2結合性向上の可能性があり、WHO変異株リストにも未掲載であるため今後の動向を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya to begin Ebola-free countdown as last patient discharged
article.articleSummary: Kenya has discharged all seven Ebola survivors and released 11 identified contacts after 21 symptom-free days, marking the end of active monitoring. There is no patient under treatment and no contacts in quarantine, enabling a 42-day countdown toward an Ebola-free declaration, expected around Dec. 23 if no new cases arise. The milestone comes 37 days after Kenya confirmed its first imported Bundibugyo Virus Disease case on Oct. 6, a Kenyan traveler who journeyed from the DRC through Uganda before testing positive and dying. All nine confirmed cases, including two deaths, were contained within a single transmission cluster with no community transmission. During the countdown, Kenya will maintain heightened surveillance, rapid response capacity, and port screening; about 760,000 travelers have been screened at 26 entry points. The DRC outbreak remains active, and the risk of importation persists; toll-free 719 for assistance.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最後の患者退院によりエボラ終息へのカウントダウン開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という高致死性疾患の国境を越えた伝播事例であり、DRCでの流行が継続中でケニアへの再流入リスクも残るためIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる主題はケニアでの輸入症例終息だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。DRCでの流行は依然継続中であり、越境リスクの観点から対象国として記録。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Ebola na República Democrática do Congo ultrapassam 11 mil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpass 11,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000 confirmed cases, with 5,387 deaths reported. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, was declared in mid-May and currently has no approved treatments or vaccines for this strain. As of 11 November 2026, 11,042 confirmed infections and 5,387 deaths have been recorded, with an estimated case-fatality rate of about 51.6% per INRB. Eight of the 26 provinces are affected, and many deaths occur outside treatment centers. Delayed detection, ongoing conflict, and health-system overload have accelerated spread. This outbreak is the second-largest and most lethal on record, surpassed only by the West Africa epidemic of 2014–2016 (over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths). Cases have reached East, Central, and West Africa, marking the widest geographic spread of Ebola in the continent to date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例数が11,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約51.6%、死者5,387人に達する大規模アウトブレイクであり、ワクチン・治療法が未承認、複数州・複数地域に拡大しておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内の流行拡大を主題としており、Mozambique・Angolaは発生地域として付与されているが記事本文では言及なし。史上2番目に致死的な流行であり、ブンディブギョ株に対する承認済み治療薬・ワクチンがない点が重大。

article.articleHeadline: พบผู้ป่วยสงสัยโรคคอตีบ 61 คน เสียชีวิต 8 คน สธ.เร่งเฝ้าระวังทั่วประเทศ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 61 suspected diphtheria cases, 8 deaths; Ministry of Public Health steps up nationwide surveillance.
article.articleSummary: As of November 9, 2026, Thailand reports 61 suspected diphtheria cases with 8 deaths (case fatality ~13%), ages 8 months–82 years (median 18), and a male-to-female ratio of 1.14:1. Cases are nationwide but concentrated in three southern border provinces and four districts of Songkhla; Narathiwat has the most cases (10), Songkhla 21 cases with 5 deaths (3 lab-confirmed). No evidence of a nationwide outbreak yet; authorities are maintaining nationwide surveillance and elevating measures in high-risk areas. Diphtheria transmits via droplets or contact with infected secretions; core symptoms include fever, sore throat, and a gray-white throat membrane, with potential airway obstruction and cardiac or neurologic complications in severe cases. Public health actions include rapid case finding, contact tracing, preparation of diphtheria antitoxin, and catch-up vaccination campaigns, especially in the south. Vaccination guidance: DTaP by 2,4,6 months with boosters at 18 months and 4 years; adults should receive a dT booster.

triage.headline_ja: ジフテリア疑い患者61人、死亡8人確認 保健省が全国的な監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約13%（8/61）と高く、ジフテリアという通常はワクチンで制御されるべき疾患での集団発生は異常事態。IHR基準で2項目以上該当するためフルRRAへ移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 南部国境県（ソンクラー、ナラティワート）に集中しており、ワクチン接種率の低い地域や国境を越えた人の移動がある地域での感染拡大リスクに注意が必要。現時点で全国的な大規模流行の証拠はないとされているが、致死率の高さと症例の年齢分布の広さ（生後8ヶ月〜82歳）から、免疫ギャップの存在が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Segunda infecção por dengue pode ser mais grave que a primeira
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A second dengue infection may be more severe than the first.
article.articleSummary: Secondary dengue infection with a different serotype may be more severe due to antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). Dengue virus has four serotypes (DENV-1–4); prior infection confers long-lasting protection against the same serotype but not others. In Brazil, ITpS reports more than 374,000 dengue cases and 371 deaths from January–October 2026. Serotype 3, once rare, is resurging, now responsible for about 30% of cases in 2026, up from about 14% in 2025. Vaccination with Qdenga is approved in Brazil for ages 4–60, two doses three months apart, available in private networks and the SUS; contraindicated in pregnant or lactating individuals and those with compromised immunity. Severe dengue can cause hemorrhages, plasma leakage, hypotension, and organ damage. In 2025, Brazil recorded 35,749 cases of severe dengue or with warning signs. Deterioration often begins as fever subsides, days 3–7 after onset. Management is supportive; IV fluids; avoid aspirin/NSAIDs; paracetamol or dipirona under medical guidance.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の二次感染は一次感染より重症化する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで継続するデング熱流行とセロタイプ3の再興を背景にした医学解説記事であり、新規の異常事態の報告ではないが、重症デング熱の増加や血清型シフトという経過観察すべき情報を含む。
triage.notes: 記事は二次感染による重症化メカニズム(ADE)の医学解説が中心で、新規発生の報告ではない。ただしセロタイプ3の割合が14%→30%に増加している点や、2025年の重症デング熱35,749件という数値は流行動向として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de mpox voltam a subir, antiviral falha em testes e Brasil compra 25 mil doses da vacina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of mpox rise again, antiviral fails in tests, and Brazil buys 25,000 doses of the vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (MPXV) cases rise in Brazil, with Rio de Janeiro reporting 74 cases in the last two months and São Paulo 67 since Oct 4, alongside 832 cases and 1 death nationwide as of Nov 6. Typical mpox symptoms include skin lesions (often on skin, mouth, genitals or anal region), fever, swollen lymph nodes, headaches, myalgias, chills and weakness. The surge is driven by clade Ib, now predominant, distinct from the 2022 clade IIb; clade Ib originated in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (2023) and reached Brazil via travelers, with community transmission detected in early 2026 in Rio. INI/Fiocruz reports 43 of 62 samples Sept–Oct were clade Ib; 19 were clade IIb; October had 130 suspected cases, 89 confirmed. The Health Ministry bought 25,000 doses of the MVA-BN vaccine (Jynneos) for intradermal use to expand reach, given no proven antiviral efficacy. Tecovirimat failed in PALM007 (clade Ib) and STOMP (clade II).

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでMpox症例が再び増加、抗ウイルス薬の治験失敗、ワクチン2万5千回分を購入
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のクレードIbがブラジルで市中感染を伴い拡大しており、国際的拡大と異常性の観点からIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）はクレードIbの起源地として言及されているが、現在の症例増加・市中感染の主体はブラジルであるため、verified_locationsはブラジルのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Кенија отпустила из болнице последњег пацијента оболелог од еболе
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya discharged the last patient ill with Ebola from the hospital
article.articleSummary: Kenya discharged the last patient ill with Ebola, raising recoveries to seven and ending active hospitalizations in Nairobi. As of 11 November 2026, there have been no new Ebola cases since 20 October, and all 135 identified contacts completed the 21-day isolation. The first case was a Kenyan businessman who died soon after arriving in Nairobi from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where the Bundibugyo strain has caused thousands of deaths since May. Four health workers among the cases were linked to the index patient; no evidence of community transmission has emerged. Kenyan health authorities will maintain heightened surveillance at borders, airports, and clinics for 42 days after the last negative test before declaring the outbreak officially over, per WHO guidance. Returning travelers must complete electronic health declarations and 21 days of medical supervision.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ患者の最後の1人を退院させる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで数千人の死者を出しているエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)がケニアへ越境伝播し、医療従事者感染も発生した事例であり、IHR4基準すべてに該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの患者退院だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。発生源であるDRCでの継続的な大規模流行（数千人死亡）がケニアへの越境伝播の背景として明記されているためDRCを検証済み地域とした。

article.articleHeadline: The encephalitis blind spot of neglected orthoflaviviruses circulating in Brazil and mimicry of autoimmune CNS disorders - npj Viruses
article.articleSummary: Encephalitis blind spot of neglected orthoflaviviruses circulating in Brazil and mimicry of autoimmune CNS disorders highlights a surveillance gap for orthoflaviviruses in Brazil. The study discusses neglected orthoflaviviruses circulating in Brazil that can cause encephalitis and present with symptoms overlapping autoimmune CNS conditions, complicating accurate diagnosis. It underscores that autoimmunity may obscure infections, potentially delaying appropriate treatment. The Brazilian sites and the University of Texas Medical Branch are involved, with funding from NIH/NIAID Award U01AI151807 and FAPESP grants (2013/21719-3, 2022/03645-1, 2022/09229-0) and INCT grants. The work is open access under CC BY 4.0 and corresponds to authors including Marielena V. Saivish, Cassia F. Estofolete, Mauricio L. Nogueira, and Nikos Vasilakis. Published 2026-11-11 in npj Viruses; the article invites heightened awareness of orthoflavivirus infections in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで流行する見過ごされてきたオルソフラビウイルスによる脳炎の盲点と自己免疫性CNS疾患との類似性 - npj Viruses
triage.triage_reason: 急性の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、学術研究論文によるサーベイランスギャップの指摘であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や新規事例報告は確認できない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究論文（npj Viruses掲載）であり、既存のオルソフラビウイルス（脳炎を引き起こす既知・未知のウイルス群）に対するブラジルでの診断・サーベイランス体制の課題を論じたもの。具体的な発生事例や患者数の報告ではないため、トリアージ対象としては見送り判定とする。Texasは米国の研究機関（University of Texas Medical Branch）の共同研究拠点としての言及であり、発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya's last Ebola patient goes home as 42-day countdown begins
article.articleSummary: Kenya declares Ebola-related milestones as the last Bundibugyo virus disease patient is discharged on 11 November 2026, triggering a 42-day countdown from 12 November toward a potential Ebola-free status on 23 December 2026 if no new cases occur. The outbreak began with a Kenyan case on 6 October 2026, linked to travel from the Democratic Republic of the Congo via Uganda. Authorities traced 135 close contacts; eight infections emerged while in quarantine (four family members, four health workers), preventing community spread. The last case was confirmed 19 October 2026; five discharges by 3 November and a sixth by 6 November left seven recoveries and two deaths. Ongoing Ebola transmission persists in the DRC, with nearly 11,000 cases and over 5,000 deaths. WHO advises no travel restrictions; Kenya will maintain surveillance, post-recovery follow-up, and rapid-response readiness.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで最後のエボラ患者が退院、42日間のカウントダウンが始まる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国由来のエボラ出血熱がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境し、隔離下とはいえ家族・医療従事者に二次感染が発生したため、国際的拡大とIHR基準の複数該当が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの感染終息だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは進行中の大規模流行（約11,000例、5,000人超死亡）の発生源として記事内で実質的に言及されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient, begins 42-day countdown to end outbreak
article.articleSummary: Kenya discharged its last Bundibugyo virus disease (Ebola) patient and released the final 11 contacts from quarantine, marking a milestone in outbreak containment. The World Health Organization said Kenya has no patients in treatment and no contacts under quarantine 37 days after confirming its first case on Oct 6, 2026, involving a traveler from the Democratic Republic of the Congo via Uganda. A total of 135 close contacts were identified; eight additional cases emerged (four family members, four health workers) with seven recoveries and two deaths. The last case was confirmed on Oct 19. Kenya will begin a 42-day countdown on 12 November 2026; if no new cases occur, the country could be declared free of Bundibugyo virus disease on 23 December 2026. Rapid response teams remain on alert; no travel or trade restrictions are advised, and Kenya remains open to travel.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最後のエボラ患者を退院させ、アウトブレイク終息に向けた42日間のカウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス病）の国境を越えた感染拡大事例であり、重症度・異常性・国際拡大の観点からIHR基準に複数該当するため、状況確認のためフルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのアウトブレイク終息報告であり、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは感染者の出身国として言及されているが、DRC国内でのアウトブレイク発生自体への直接的言及はなく、参考情報として記載するにとどめる。すでに収束に向かっており新規感染者はゼロだが、致死的疾患かつ越境伝播歴があるため、経過確認を含めフルRRAでの再評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: CHP investigates confirmed Mpox case
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) confirmed in Hong Kong. A 26-year-old man developed a genital, hand, and facial rash since November 1, with fever; admitted November 8 for isolation. CHP Public Health Laboratory Services Branch confirmed Monkeypox. The patient reported high-risk sexual contact with men met via social media during incubation; epidemiological investigation ongoing; case to be reported to the WHO. Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 119 Mpox cases (94 local, 25 imported), all male. Of 26 cases since August, all involved high-risk sexual activity; most were not vaccinated. Transmission linked to dating apps; contact tracing hampered when partners could not be reached. CHP expanded vaccination outreach with an additional centre at the CHP Building; 973 high-risk individuals vaccinated since Sept 28. Two-dose Mpox vaccine reduces infection risk by 82% and lowers transmission. Mpox is not transmitted via respiratory droplets; avoid close contact with suspected cases. Hotline 2125 2373, 9am–6pm.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生防護中心（CHP)、確定Mpox症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: 香港で継続している既知のMpoxクラスター（2022年以降119例）の一例であり、重篤性や異常性は低いが、性的接触を介したヒト-ヒト感染が続いている点は注視を要する。
triage.notes: 香港では2022年以降119例（うち局所94例）が確認されており、本症例は既存の継続的流行の一部。高リスク性行為とワクチン未接種者における感染拡大が懸念されるが、CHPによる接触者追跡・ワクチン接種体制は機能しており、外部支援の必要性は低いと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Mesmo sem registrar casos de dengue, Itaquiraí mantém ações de prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Even without reporting dengue cases, Itaquiraí maintains preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: Itaquiraí reports no active dengue cases despite the rainy season, as stated by the Municipal Health Secretariat. The vector control team continues prevention measures to curb Aedes aegypti proliferation, including insecticide spraying and community orientation and monitoring across different city areas. Officials stress that vigilance must persist even without current cases: residents should eliminate standing water and keep yards clean. The mayor, Thalles Tomazelli, emphasizes the commitment to maintaining a dengue-free Itaquiraí and protecting residents, while the health secretary Fran highlights the importance of ongoing prevention and neighborhood engagement. The ongoing rainy conditions heighten the breeding risk, so sustained vector-control activities remain in place.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の症例登録がない中でも、イタキライ市は予防対策を継続
triage.triage_reason: 記事は症例がない中での予防活動の継続を報じているのみで、実際の感染事例や公衆衛生上の異常事態は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の症例発生ではなく、予防的な蚊媒介対策の継続を報じる内容。ブラジルは対象国だが、症例がない旨が明記されているため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Fãs da banda BTS testam positivo para Covid-19 após show no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fans of the band BTS test positive for COVID-19 after the show in Brazil
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising in Brazil, with a new wave of severe illness across Mato Grosso, the Federal District, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Santa Catarina, according to Fundação Oswaldo Cruz. Mass gatherings at events and concerts may fuel transmission, as shown after the BTS concert in São Paulo where fans reported symptoms days later; one attendee, Mariá, tested positive three days after onset of symptoms. InfoGripe notes rising metapneumovirus activity among children in the South and Southeast, but the signal for COVID-19 remains a primary concern. In recent surveillance of severe respiratory infections with confirmed viral identification, 24% of deaths tested positive for SARS-CoV-2. Experts say the situation is not yet alarming, but stress maintaining up-to-date vaccinations, especially for older adults and immunocompromised individuals. Clinicians urge symptomatic individuals to seek care promptly and unvaccinated people to complete vaccination to prevent worse outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: BTSのファン、ブラジル公演後にCOVID-19陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でCOVID-19の新たな流行波とメタニューモウイルスの増加が報告されているが、専門家は『まだ警戒レベルではない』としており、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は見られないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: COVID-19とメタニューモウイルスの同時流行が複数州（サンパウロ、リオデジャネイロ、サンタカタリーナ等）で報告。季節性の流行波とみられ、専門家は深刻視していないが、重症例・死亡例の一定割合が確認されているため継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية: 11042 إصابة و5387 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 11,042 cases and 5,387 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) totals 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths as of November 10, per the national health ministry. Eight of 26 provinces are affected, with many deaths occurring outside treatment centers. The World Health Organization Africa regional office warns the outbreak remains out of control despite a slight nationwide decline, as transmission shifts toward international borders and expands across East, Central, and West Africa, marking the most geographically widespread Ebola outbreak in Africa to date. Officially declared on May 15, the outbreak mainly affected Ituri Province in eastern DRC and is described as the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history and the second-largest globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. Factors driving spread include delays in detection, conflict, and strained health services.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が流行：感染者11,042人、死者5,387人
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで史上最大規模に拡大し、国境を越えた伝播や複数州への拡大がWHOにより「制御不能」と警告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき事案。
triage.notes: モザンビーク・アンゴラはBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが記事本文では言及なし（対象国リストにも非該当）。DRC国内8州に拡大し、国境を越えた伝播が懸念されている点が特に重大。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Garut: Wisatawan mengalami diare belum dipastikan akibat makanan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Garut Health Office: Tourists experience diarrhea not yet confirmed to be caused by food
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, the Garut Health Office (Dinas Kesehatan Garut) reports tourists returning from Garut, West Java, are experiencing diarrhea and vomiting, but investigators have not confirmed a food-related cause. Field teams have gathered statements from visitors, yet no definitive source has emerged. Onset occurred up to four days before reporting, and investigators faced difficulties examining consumed foods and leftovers. Food samples could not be obtained because restaurant samples are typically discarded within 24 hours, leaving no material for laboratory confirmation. It remains unclear whether the illness stems from food consumed in Garut or from other factors, including possible bacterial or viral infections. The case notes will inform stronger food-safety surveillance at tourist sites, restaurants, and hotels in the area. Social media reports earlier drew public and regional attention.

triage.headline_ja: ガルット保健局:観光客の下痢症状、食品由来かは未確認
triage.triage_reason: 観光客の下痢・嘔吐事例が報告されているが、原因（食中毒か感染症か）が未特定であり、規模・重症度も不明なため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 原因不明の下痢・嘔吐症例。食品サンプルが確保できず原因究明が困難な状況。細菌/ウイルス感染の可能性も排除されていないため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Maior surto de ebola na história do Congo ultrapassa 11 mil casos e deixa 5,3 mil mortos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Largest Ebola outbreak in Congo's history surpasses 11,000 cases and leaves 5,300 dead.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports 11,042 Ebola cases and 5,387 deaths, the largest and most lethal outbreak in the country, affecting eight of 26 provinces. Declared May 15, the outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a rare, genetically distinct strain; there is no approved vaccine or proven treatment. WHO notes it is Africa's second-largest Ebola outbreak, after 2014–2016 West Africa, with over 28,000 infections and about 11,000 deaths. Two vaccine candidates received WHO support; one from Oxford University and the Serum Institute of India. Trials will be led by the National Biomedical Research Institute of the Congo with international partners. Control is hampered by instability in eastern regions near South Sudan, Uganda, and Rwanda, and by communities beyond health workers’ reach. Transmission occurs via bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces; symptoms include fever, headache, vomiting, diarrhea, and organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ史上最大のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、1万1千件超の症例と5300人の死者
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラ流行（1万1千例超、死者5300人超）が発生し、ワクチン未承認・治療法未確立で国際的拡大リスクも高く、IHR基準に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: インドは治験ワクチン提供元（Serum Institute of India）として言及されているのみで、インド国内での発生事例ではないため verified_locationsから除外。南スーダン、アンゴラ、ルワンダ、ウガンダは国境近接の不安定要因として言及されているのみで、感染発生国としての記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Tưởng qua cơn sốt, hai nữ bệnh nhân đối mặt biến chứng nguy hiểm sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever thought to have subsided, two female patients face dangerous dengue fever complications.
article.articleSummary: Two female dengue patients in Vietnam face severe complications. As of November 11, 2026, at the National Hospital for Tropical Diseases in Hanoi, 16 dengue patients are under treatment, including a 53-year-old from Hai Phong and a 23-year-old from Hanoi with Dengue hemorrhagic fever features: platelet counts severely depressed (53-year-old: 38→21 G/L; 23-year-old: 21 G/L), markedly elevated liver enzymes (AST/ALT: 1,939/804 U/L for the 53-year-old; 1,907/883 U/L for the 23-year-old) and coagulation abnormalities. The Hanoi patient’s ultrasound showed intra-abdominal fluid and bilateral pleural effusions, signaling plasma leakage. Both cases are severe dengue with liver injury, requiring close monitoring to prevent bleeding, hemodynamic instability, or shock. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes. Warning signs include persistent fever followed by abdominal pain, vomiting, bleeding, reduced urine, or altered consciousness; fever reduction does not indicate recovery. Home monitoring should be accompanied by medical guidance and avoidance of NSAIDs unless advised.

triage.headline_ja: 熱が引いたと思いきや、2人の女性患者がデング出血熱の危険な合併症に直面
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで季節的に発生するデング熱の個別重症症例報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで毎年流行する風土病であり、本記事は個別患者の重症化事例を扱った医療啓発的な内容。アウトブレイクの規模や拡大傾向についての言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Bác sĩ cảnh báo cái bẫy hạ sốt ở người mắc sốt xuất huyết Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors warn about the fever-reducing trap for patients with dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Two dengue fever cases in Vietnam progressed to severe dengue with profound thrombocytopenia and marked hepatic injury. At the National Institute of Infectious and Tropical Diseases Hospital, a 53-year-old woman from Hai Phong and a 23-year-old woman from Hanoi showed platelets of 21–23 G/L, AST around 1,907–1,939 U/L and ALT 804–883 U/L, with coagulation disorders and organ involvement; one had ascites and pleural effusions indicating plasma leakage. As of 2026-11-11, the hospital is treating 16 dengue patients, including severe cases needing close monitoring. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, and deterioration can occur during days 3–7 even as fever subsides. Warning signs prompting urgent care include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, drowsiness, bleeding, or very low urine output. For home care, rest and adequate fluids are advised, avoid self-medicating with fever reducers or NSAIDs, and seek follow-up testing and monitoring; vaccination and mosquito control are recommended per medical guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 医師がデング熱患者の解熱剤使用の落とし穴について警告
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで重症デング熱症例（血小板減少・肝障害・血漿漏出）が報告されているが、デング熱は同地域で流行性があり、本記事は医療啓発目的の内容であり、大規模流行やIHR基準に該当する異常性は確認できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の重症化事例を示す医療啓発記事であり、病院は16名のデング患者を治療中とのことだが、流行規模や拡大状況についての情報はない。SFTSウイルスへの言及は見当たらず、疾患名リストとの整合性が取れていない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 avança em 18 estados no Brasil; veja quem deve se vacinar e quando fazer o teste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 is spreading across 18 states in Brazil; see who should get vaccinated and when to get tested.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 is spreading across 18 Brazilian states as of November 4, 2026, with 118,851 COVID-19–related respiratory syndrome cases reported in 2026. Test positivity rose to 16.66% last week, the highest since March 2025, though the Health Ministry continues to consider infections low risk. Through mid-October, 2026 cases totalled 115,626 versus 367,640 in the same period in 2025, indicating a milder year-to-date trajectory. Increases are observed in Alagoas, Bahia, Ceará, Distrito Federal, Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Mato Grosso, Paraíba, Pernambuco, Piauí, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Rondônia, Roraima, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina, and São Paulo; InfoGripe notes upticks in Mato Grosso, DF, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro and Santa Catarina, with hospitalizations remaining very low except in Mato Grosso. Vaccination targets children 6 months–<5 years (two Moderna or three Pfizer doses); ages 5–59 with no prior vaccination should receive one dose. Priority groups include 60+, pregnant, Indigenous, healthcare workers, and others with schedules varying (e.g., every 6 months for 60+). Transmission is via respiratory droplets; antigen tests early, RT-PCR from day 1; a negative result does not rule out infection.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル18州でCOVID-19が拡大中：誰がワクチン接種すべきか、いつ検査すべきかを解説
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19はブラジル全土で季節的な増加を示しているが、保健省は低リスクと評価し入院数も概ね低水準であり、前年同期より軽度の推移である。新規性や重症度の面で特段の異常はなく、ルーティンの疫学情報に留まる。
triage.notes: 既知の病原体(COVID-19)による季節的な感染増加であり、保健当局自身が低リスクと評価。入院率も低く、前年より感染者数が少ない。特段の異常性・重篤性は認められず、フルリスク評価の必要性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تبدأ العد التنازلي لإعلان خلوها من فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya begins the countdown to declaring itself Ebola-free.
article.articleSummary: Kenya announced a milestone in its Ebola response as Health Minister confirmed last patient was discharged from hospital. Kenya enters a 42-day surveillance window to detect any new infections; if none occur, the country will be declared Ebola-free under international health standards. Since early October, nine confirmed Ebola cases were recorded in Kenya, all linked to an initial infection imported by a Kenyan who arrived from the Democratic Republic of Congo, with two deaths and seven recoveries. No new cases have been reported since October 19. On Wednesday, 11 close contacts were released from quarantine after remaining symptom-free during the monitoring period. To bolster prevention, Kenya imposed a 21-day mandatory quarantine for arrivals from DRC. The outbreak has spread across four East, Central, and West African nations, with DRC reporting over 11,000 confirmed cases—the region’s largest and second-largest. Nairobi authorities stress border surveillance and adherence to protocols during the 42-day window.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラウイルスからの脱却宣言へ向けたカウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準に複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事象であり、DRCでは11,000例超の大規模流行が継続、周辺国への国際的拡大と渡航制限（検疫措置）も確認されているためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおけるエボラ終息プロセスだが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、DRCは流行の起点かつ11,000例超の最大規模流行地として具体的に言及されているため、verified_locationsに含めた。地域全体（東・中央・西アフリカ4カ国）での感染拡大が継続している点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Cases Surpass 11,000 as Conflict Complicates Response
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has reached 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths, with about 2,990 recoveries, since it was officially declared in May. Originating in Ituri province, the outbreak has spread to seven provinces, with most cases in Ituri and neighbouring North Kivu; exported/imported cases have been reported in Uganda, Kenya and Nigeria. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no approved vaccine or treatment. WHO plans a full human trial of the Ervebo vaccine (Zaire strain) in the DRC to assess potential cross-protection against Bundibugyo. The response is hindered by insecurity in eastern Congo: a treatment centre in Lolwa, Ituri, was set ablaze, and Fataki response activities were suspended amid clashes. ISIS-linked ADF rebels have attacked Ituri, Haut-Uele and North Kivu, intensifying risks to health workers. Control will require expanded medical interventions and improved security.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染者数が11,000人を超える中、紛争が対応を複雑化
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が7州に拡大し、周辺国への越境例も確認されている上、紛争により対応が阻害されておりIHR基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの輸出例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州・北キブ州。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo supera los 11.000 casos de ébola, incluidos 5.387 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 11,000 Ebola cases, including 5,387 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak declared May 15 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 11,000 infections with 5,387 deaths as of Nov 9, 2026 (11,042 infections; 48.8% case fatality). Recoveries total 2,990; 651 are hospitalized or in isolation; contact tracing coverage is 79.7%. Ituri (epicenter) and North Kivu account for most new cases (57.7% and 32.7%). The outbreak affects 67 health zones across eight provinces, including Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, South Kivu, and Ubangi north/south. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain drives transmission; no specific treatments exist, but two vaccines are in Phase 1 trials, and Ervebo has been deployed in the DRC since August with positive animal signals against Bundibugyo. Uganda reports 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and 2 deaths; Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths) and Nigeria (1) are linked. France reports a linked case; four evacuees reach the Netherlands (1), Germany (2), and the United Kingdom (1). Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhagic manifestations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ症例が11,000人を超え、死者5,387人に達する
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで症例数・死亡者数が甚大かつ複数州に拡大、さらに周辺国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）や欧州（フランス、オランダ、ドイツ、英国）へ国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランス、オランダ、ドイツ、英国での輸入症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないかDRCからの輸出例であるため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。症例死亡率48.8%と非常に高く、致死率・規模ともに深刻な公衆衛生上の緊急事態。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - L'aéroport de N'djili réceptionne 4,5 tonnes de kits de prévention
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola - N'Djili International Airport receives 4.5 metric tons of prevention kits.
article.articleSummary: On 10 November, N'djili International Airport in Kinshasa received 4.5 metric tonnes of Ebola prevention kits donated by Foundation Angels to bolster surveillance and hygiene measures. The kits, including hydroalcoholic gels and soaps, will be deployed at the airport to protect passengers, visitors, and airport staff, reinforcing the airport as a strategic health surveillance point. Dr. Francisca Takombe of Foundation Angels stressed the need to take Ebola seriously and implement prevention at major entry points, noting that Ebola had not yet arrived in Kinshasa. The airport commander’s representative expressed gratitude and confirmed the kits would be used to reduce transmission risk. The distribution campaign continues on 11 November at the Government Hotel, the General Police Headquarters, and Cinquantenaire Hospital, with a plan to total seven tonnes of hygiene materials across high-traffic sites to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ対策 - ンジリ国際空港が4.5トンの予防キットを受領
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱に関する予防物資配布のオペレーション記事であり、新規症例や感染拡大の報告はない。キンシャサには未到達と明記されているため、現時点では流行監視の継続事項として注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はキンシャサの空港や主要施設へのエボラ予防物資（消毒ジェル・石鹸等）配布に関するもので、具体的な新規感染確認情報は含まれていない。エボラは既知の重大感染症であるため、DRC国内の流行状況に関する続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus respiratórios apresentam alta em Teresina e FMS reforça importância da vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Respiratory viruses are on the rise in Teresina, and FMS reinforces the importance of vaccination.
article.articleSummary: In Teresina, Brazil, January–October 2026, rhinovirus detections rose 173% (63 to 172) and influenza increased 51.8% (112 to 170), while RSV detections fell 70.9% (213 to 62). COVID-19 positives declined 94.6% (853 to 46) by rapid antigen tests, but authorities warn SARS-CoV-2 continues to circulate and vaccination remains essential. Data from the Fundação Municipal de Saúde (FMS) Epidemiological Surveillance guide ongoing public-health actions and vaccination messaging. The COVID-19 vaccine remains available via the SUS and is included in the National Vaccination Schedule. Routine targets include children 6 months–<5 years, adults ≥60, and pregnant women; several special groups are eligible for vaccination with varying dosing frequency, typically every six months for elderly/immunocompromised and annual for others. Preventive measures—hand hygiene, well-ventilated spaces, and avoiding close contact when symptomatic—are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: テレジーナで呼吸器系ウイルスが増加、FMSがワクチン接種の重要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: 季節性呼吸器感染症（インフルエンザ、ライノウイルス）の通常の流行動向を伝える内容で、COVID-19やRSVはむしろ減少しており、異常性・深刻性・国際的拡大リスクはいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 地域の公衆衛生当局（FMS）によるワクチン接種推奨の通常広報であり、異常な流行やアウトブレイクの兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Kenya: Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient on 2026-11-11, triggering a 42-day countdown to declare Ebola-free. The outbreak originated with a Kenyan man who traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Kenya's first-ever Ebola case on October 6. The DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak since May has produced over 11,000 cases and 5,000 deaths. In Kenya, nine confirmed cases and two deaths occurred, all linked to the index patient within a single transmission cluster; no community transmission. The last patient released, along with 11 contacts kept in quarantine for 21 days, were cleared. 135 contacts linked to the index case were traced and monitored. Surveillance and screening at health facilities and entry points remain active; Kenya would be declared Ebola-free on December 23 if no new cases arise.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最後のエボラ患者を退院させる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,000例以上・5,000人以上の死者を伴う大規模アウトブレイクが続いており、越境感染によりケニアで同国初のエボラ症例が発生した。公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事象であり、国際的拡大の実例がある。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCの第17次エボラアウトブレイク（2026年5月以降、11,000例以上・5,000人以上死亡）が主たる発生地であり、ケニアへの越境感染例は収束に向かっている（コミュニティ内伝播なし、9症例・2死亡）。DRC国内の継続的な大規模流行が深刻なリスク要因である。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola supera los 11 mil casos en el brote más mortífero del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola surpasses 11,000 cases in the Congo's deadliest outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus drives the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s deadliest Ebola outbreak, with 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths as of 11 November 2026. Declared in mid-May, the outbreak has spread to eight of the DRC’s 26 provinces, reaching Bunia, the capital of Ituri, where the majority of cases are centered. Ituri accounts for about 70% of all infections, while North Kivu has emerged as the main site of new transmission. The Bundibugyo virus lacks a vaccine or approved treatment. Health facilities and personnel face attacks and community skepticism amid armed conflict, weak health systems, poor roads, and misinformation. The outbreak has reached Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. By comparison, the West Africa outbreak of 2014–2016 caused about 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths; the current outbreak is the second-largest on record.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ史上最も死者数の多い流行で感染者数が1万1000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行が感染者11,042人・死者5,387人に達し、ワクチン・承認治療法がなく、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大も報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（特にIturi州・Bunia）を中心とする流行を主題としている。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの拡大が言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。Angolaは発生地域リストにあるが記事本文では言及されておらず除外。

article.articleHeadline: 26歲男染猴痘　潛伏期內與男子有高風險性接觸
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 26-year-old man contracts monkeypox after high-risk sexual contact with a man during the incubation period.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox case in Hong Kong: A 26-year-old man developed genital and facial rashes with fever starting November 1 and was admitted to Tseung Kwan O Hospital on November 8 for isolation; laboratory confirmation by the Centre for Public Health Laboratory Service. He had risky sexual contact during the incubation period with a man he met via social media in Hong Kong. Since 2022, Hong Kong has logged 119 monkeypox cases, including 94 local and 25 imported, all male. Since August, 26 local cases report risky sexual activity during incubation, including sex with unfamiliar men or multiple partners without condoms; most had not received the monkeypox vaccine. Some patients could not contact new partners after diagnosis, hindering tracing. Authorities urge exposed individuals to vaccinate promptly and avoid risky sexual contact. Monkeypox typically does not spread by air, droplets, or casual contact; seek medical care for rash, fever, lymphadenopathy, fatigue, myalgia, or headache.

triage.headline_ja: 26歳男性がサル痘に感染、潜伏期間中に男性とハイリスクな性的接触
triage.triage_reason: 香港における単発のサル痘症例報告であり、2022年以降119例の継続的な性的接触によるヒト-ヒト感染が続いている状況。新規性・異常性は低いが、流行しやすい集団での感染拡大リスクが継続しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 2022年以降香港で119例（うち94例が局所感染）確認されており、本件は継続的な性的接触によるサル痘感染の一事例。重症度は低く、公衆衛生当局が既に接触者追跡とワクチン接種を推奨する体制を取っている。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch sốt xuất huyết cao điểm, nhiều bệnh nhân giảm tiểu cầu nặng, nguy kịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever outbreak at its peak, many patients with severe thrombocytopenia in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever peaks in Vietnam, with 16 dengue patients under treatment at Hanoi's National Hospital for Tropical Diseases as of 11 November 2026, including two severe cases. B.H., a 53-year-old from Hải Phòng, and P.L., a 23-year-old from Hà Nội, presented with high fever (39–40°C), body pains, nausea, vomiting, and abdominal pain. Laboratory tests showed rapid thrombocytopenia (platelets down to 21–23 x10^9/L), markedly elevated liver enzymes and coagulopathy; P.L. also had ascites and bilateral pleural effusions signaling plasma leakage and risk of shock. Both were transferred for intensive care; the hospital is treating 16 dengue patients, many with severe disease. Dengue is transmitted mainly by Aedes mosquitoes. Experts warn that severe dengue can occur during defervescence (days 3–7) and that platelet counts alone do not determine severity. Prevention emphasizes eliminating standing water, larval control, mosquito bite avoidance, hydration, vaccination guidance, and timely follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱流行がピークに、多くの患者が重度の血小板減少で危篤状態
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで季節性デング熱が流行し重症例（血小板減少・血漿漏出）が報告されているが、異常な拡大や社会的関心の急上昇を示す情報はなく、毎年の流行範囲内と判断されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疾患名にSFTS Virusが含まれているが、記事本文はデング熱のみを扱っており、SFTSへの言及はない。病院単位（ハノイの熱帯病国立病院）の症例報告であり、全国的な流行状況や死亡者数など詳細情報は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle provoca prejuízo de R$ 7 milhões em SC após restrições sanitárias e comerciais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease causes a loss of R$ 7 million in Santa Catarina after sanitary and trade restrictions.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, Newcastle disease in Oeste Santa Catarina, Brazil, triggers severe economic disruption as Nova Erechim-based hatchery Avícola Oeste and meat processor Frigorífico Nova Friaves face sanitary restrictions within a 10-km radius. Directly affecting at least 186 jobs, measures have produced losses exceeding R$7 million in under a month. Avícola Oeste employs about 26 staff and incubates roughly 3 million eggs monthly; it had shipped chicks mainly to Paraná and Mato Grosso do Sul, but must discard all chicks and fertile eggs on hand and suspend operations indefinitely. Frigorífico Nova Friaves, with 160 employees, previously slaughtering around 30,000 birds daily and aiming to expand to 40,000 by December, now exports are suspended; domestic slaughter represents about 5% of prior capacity. The municipality urges sanitary control alongside state and federal support to cushion workers, producers, and suppliers across the regional poultry sector.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病の影響で、サンタカタリーナ州で衛生・貿易制限後に700万レアルの損失が発生
triage.triage_reason: 家きんのニューカッスル病発生により衛生・貿易制限が課され、地元自治体が州・連邦政府に支援を要請しているため、経済・行政的関心の高まりを示すシグナルとして識別。ただし人への健康影響情報はない。
triage.notes: 本事例は家きん（ニューカッスル病）への影響に限定されており、人への感染・健康被害の報告はない。経済的損失と貿易制限が主な論点であり、公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは低いが、地域経済・行政対応の観点から継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: MSF urges global health officials to widen Ebola vaccine access
article.articleSummary: On 11 November 2026, Doctors Without Borders (MSF) urged widening access to Merck’s Ervebo Ebola vaccine in DR Congo as the Bundibugyo strain drives the country’s largest-ever outbreak, with more than 5,300 deaths. DR Congo requested 500,000 doses, but only 70,000 were released from the global stockpile. WHO guidance recommends restricting Ervebo’s use against Bundibugyo to research settings since protection against this strain remains unproven. MSF argues broader vaccination is justified by early observations of fewer infections and deaths among previously vaccinated individuals and calls for including young children. A larger stockpile release hinges on backing from WHO vaccine advisers, who meet next week, to approve expanded use. The article centers on vaccine access amid the ongoing Bundibugyo outbreak in DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団、エボラワクチンへのアクセス拡大を世界の保健当局に要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが継続しており、死者5,300人超と公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、ワクチン供給を巡る国際的対応も求められているためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 本記事はワクチン供給・アクセス政策に焦点を当てているが、背景にある過去最大級のエボラアウトブレイク（死者5,300人超）が継続しているため、既存のRRA更新または新規評価が必要。WHOワクチン諮問会議の決定にも注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ডেঙ্গু দমনে বাংলার কৌশলেই আস্থা কেন্দ্রের, অন্য রাজ্যকে অনুসরণের পরামর্শ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Centre puts faith in Bengal's dengue-control strategy, urging other states to follow suit.
article.articleSummary: West Bengal’s dengue-control strategy earned central praise, with the Union government citing four criteria: dengue surveillance, analysis of cases and deaths, health-worker training, and regular high-level administrative reviews. National Centre for Vector Borne Diseases Control (NCVBDCP) officials said Bengal’s integrated approach should be emulated by other dengue-prone states. Health Minister Dr. Sharadwata Mukhopadhyay attributed success to coordinated efforts across the health department, municipalities, district councils, panchayats, and district offices under the Chief Minister’s leadership, with ongoing oversight. For 2025, Bengal recorded 17,032 dengue cases as of November 1, down from 14,634 by October 31, a roughly 14.1% year-on-year decrease. In a November 6 central review, Bengal’s State Programme Officer (Vector-Borne Diseases), OSO, and Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme Data Manager highlighted the dengue reporting portal, rapid case documentation, and centralized data consolidation. The meeting also praised epidemiological and entomological reviews of deaths, the Special Anti-Dengue Month, routine monitoring, and steady supply of testing kits.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策、中央政府が西ベンガル州の戦略に信頼を寄せ、他州にも追随を助言
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数は前年比減少傾向にあり、本記事は西ベンガル州の対策成功事例を評価する行政的な内容であり、新規性・異常性・緊急の公衆衛生リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱は毎年流行する季節性感染症で、本記事は症例数減少と対策成功を報じる内容。緊急性・異常性は見られないためDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: Com alerta em SP e MT, Campo Grande registra queda de 80% nos casos de Covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With alerts in SP and MT, Campo Grande records an 80% drop in COVID-19 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reports an 80% drop in COVID-19 infections in 2026 with 20 confirmed cases and six deaths (Sesau). The city logged eight COVID-19 cases in January, eight from February–March, and single cases in June, July, and August; the date for the 20th case is unspecified. In 2025 there were 99 cases through epidemiological week 45, ending the year with 103. In 2026, 2,279 Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases in Campo Grande include 736 with unspecified etiologies, potentially linked to COVID-19. Among specified causes: Rhinovirus 491, RSV 452, Influenza A 131, Influenza B 130, Adenovirus 80, Metapneumovirus 79, Bocavirus 27, Parainfluenza 3 23; 78 undetermined; 32 due to other agents. Nationally, SRAG activity rose Sep–Oct 2026; Rhinovirus led positives (50.1%), followed by RSV, Influenza A/B, and COVID-19 (8.5%). Aquidauana recorded a COVID-19 death. MS totals: 1,326 SRAG notifications and 11 deaths in 2026; cumulative: 755,506 cases and 11,388 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州とマットグロッソ州への警戒の中、カンポグランデでCOVID-19症例が80%減少
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19症例は前年比で大幅減少しており、異常な増加や新規変異株の兆候はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内の季節性呼吸器感染症（COVID-19減少、RSV・インフルエンザ等のSRAG動向）に関する定期統計報告であり、ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient, as it aims to end outbreak
article.articleSummary: Kenya on 11 November 2026 discharged its last Ebola patient, with no patients or contacts in quarantine as it begins a 42-day countdown to being declared free of Ebola Virus Disease (EVD). The final patient recovered; 11 contacts completed monitoring. Countdown begins 12 November 2026; if no new infections are detected, end-of-outbreak is set for 23 December 2026. Ongoing surveillance, screening at entry points, community monitoring, and rapid response continue. DR Congo’s ongoing outbreak keeps Kenya at risk of imported cases across borders; a safe return advisory will guide travelers, with arrival screening and follow-up. Public urged to seek care for Ebola-like symptoms after travel; toll-free 719. Kenya rejects blanket travel restrictions and will not issue Ebola-free travel certificates. US has committed about $14.5 million; WHO calls the discharge a milestone and urges vigilance; Dr Amoth underscores contact listing, quarantines, and follow-up as key lessons.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ出血熱の最後の患者を退院させ、アウトブレイク終息を目指す
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが国境を越えてケニアへの輸入リスクを生んでおり、IHR基準のうち深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクの複数が該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおけるアウトブレイク終息に向けた進展だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは『継続中のアウトブレイク』が明記されており、越境リスクの根拠として対象国に含めた。米国の資金支援（約1450万ドル）やWHOの監視継続要請も記載あり、既知のDRCエボラ流行の継続状況として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya da de alta a su último paciente de ébola en un hito importante
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya Discharges Its Last Ebola Patient in a Major Milestone.
article.articleSummary: Kenya marks a major Ebola milestone by discharging its last patient, bringing total recoveries to seven and initiating a 42‑day countdown to being declared Ebola‑free after no new confirmed cases since Oct 20, 2026. The first case involved a Kenyan businessman who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and died after arriving in Nairobi; his mother also died. Africa CDC calls it a regional milestone, noting all Kenyan cases were linked to the DRC traveler with no broader community transmission; four of the seven recoveries were healthcare workers. Discharges progressed: five on Nov 3, a sixth on Nov 6, and the seventh on Nov 11. WHO criteria require 42 days after the last patient tests negative or safe burial. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids, with a 2–21 day incubation. Kenya will maintain heightened surveillance at borders, airports, health facilities, and communities; travelers from affected areas will be screened and undergo 21‑day quarantine; e‑health declarations are required, and Kenya does not intend to become a regional quarantine hub.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最後のエボラ患者を退院させ重要な節目に到達
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来の輸入エボラ症例がケニアで発生し国境を越えた伝播が確認されたこと、エボラはIHR Annex2で自動通知対象疾患であることからIHR基準複数該当、フルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの回復・退院（ケニアは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外）。ただし感染源であるDRCでのエボラ発生が背景にあるため、DRCを記録。ケニア国内の症例は輸入例に限定され、地域内二次感染は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 肯尼亚释放最后一位埃博拉患者，标志着该国迈向无病毒状态的重大里程碑。Australia ChinaTown News 中文华人新闻 - NEWS.CHINA.COM.AU 这里是生活在墨尔本咱自家人的地盘！把客场当主场，视异乡为故园。澳洲唐人街 - 中华澳网 China Town News澳洲唐人街;澳大利亚华人社区和主流新闻媒体
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya discharges the last Ebola patient, marking a major milestone in the country’s move toward an Ebola-free status.
article.articleSummary: Kenya discharged the last Ebola patient on November 11, 2026, the seventh recovered, marking progress toward an Ebola-free status. The first Kenyan case appeared in early October after a businessman who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo died on arrival in Nairobi; the DRC outbreak has persisted since May with over 5,000 deaths. Kenya had not reported confirmed cases since Oct 20. All Kenyan cases were traced to a single man who traveled from the DRC via Uganda, with no evidence of wider community transmission. Five patients were discharged on November 3, the sixth on November 6, and final patient on November 11. WHO guidance requires 42 days after the last patient tests negative or is buried before declaring an end. Kenya will maintain heightened border and airport surveillance; travelers from affected regions face electronic health declarations, screening, and 21‑day quarantines. Africa CDC called the milestone important.
