triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最後のエボラ患者を退院させ、同国のエボラ撲滅に向けた重要な節目に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5月以降継続するエボラ流行は死者5,000人超と深刻であり、ケニアへの越境感染事例も発生している。記事自体はケニアの収束ニュースだが、背景にあるDRC流行は国際的拡大リスクを示す重要な継続シグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの収束だが、ケニアとウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは流行の発生源かつ継続中の深刻な流行地域として含めた。DRC国内の流行状況（5000人超死亡、5月から継続）について続報の精査が必要。

article.articleHeadline: El peor brote de ébola de la historia de Congo supera los 11.000 casos confirmados y 5.300 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The worst Ebola outbreak in Congo's history surpasses 11,000 confirmed cases and 5,300 deaths.
article.articleSummary: The worst Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has surpassed 11,000 confirmed cases and 5,300 deaths amid armed conflict hampering the response. National Public Health Institute data show 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths, with about 2,990 recoveries. The outbreak began in Ituri province in the northeast and has spread to seven provinces; Ituri accounts for 7,485 cases and 3,532 deaths, while North Kivu has 2,593 cases and 1,422 deaths (North Kivu’s provincial fatality rate at 54.8%). WHO data through Nov 3 report 1,463 new cases in 21 days. Cases have been detected in Uganda, Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths), and Nigeria (imported case). There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo; the Tumaini trial in Bunia began Oct 23 to test cross-protection from Zaire vaccines, with two Bundibugyo-specific candidates from Oxford and Moderna to be added after approvals. Violence disrupts response, including attacks on a Lolwa health center and suspended operations in Fataki.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ史上最悪のエボラ出血熱流行、確認症例が1万1000人、死者5300人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続し、複数州・周辺国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）へ拡大、治療薬・ワクチン未承認かつ武力紛争で対応が妨げられており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアでの症例確認が記載されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。主体はDRCの流行。

article.articleHeadline: Путин призвал страны ОДКБ объединиться для борьбы с угрозой эпидемий
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Putin urged CSTO member countries to unite in the fight against the threat of epidemics.
article.articleSummary: At an expanded meeting of the CSTO's Collective Security Council in Moscow, President Vladimir Putin urged permanent information exchange on infectious threats among CSTO members, arguing that the introduction of a dangerous pathogen in one country endangers others. He said the epidemiological situation worldwide remains complex and that tight cooperation is required to timely detect potential disease spread. The briefing notes that Russia has previously supplied Ebola detection test systems to neighboring countries bordering the Democratic Republic of Congo during an Ebola outbreak, and Rospotrebnadzor head Anna Popova stated that these states received diagnostic tools. Russia also expressed willingness to share its developments for the rapid identification of epidemiological threats. The emphasis is on coordinated, timely surveillance to mitigate cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: プーチン大統領、CSTO加盟国に対し感染症の脅威との闘いで団結を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、政治的な協力呼びかけに関する記事であり、過去のエボラ対応への言及のみで現在進行中の公衆衛生事案ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はCSTO首脳会議における感染症対策協力に関する政治的声明が主題。DRCのエボラ流行への言及は過去の支援実績の文脈であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクを報告するものではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 5,387 Dead in Outbreak; Cheese Recall Expands; Breast Cancer Chemo May Speed Aging
article.articleSummary: Record Ebola outbreak in Congo reported 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths. In the United States, genetic data suggest measles has re-emerged as endemic, with about 5,100 cases this year; the CDC says elimination status could be reconsidered, but response will remain unchanged, while the measles outbreak is estimated to have roughly $83 million in economic costs. Food safety: Family Farmstead Dairy expanded its cheddar cheese recall due to potential Listeria contamination. In breast cancer care, chemotherapy may accelerate biological aging and increase mortality risk, per a JAMA Network Open modeling study. ASAM released its first clinical guidance for managing medetomidine intoxication and withdrawal.

triage.headline_ja: 感染拡大で5,387人死亡；チーズ製品のリコール拡大；乳がん化学療法が老化を加速させる可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で「記録的規模」のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが発生し、確定症例11,042件、死亡5,387人と甚大な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクも高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事は複数トピックの要約記事であり、主見出しはコンゴのエボラ死者数に言及している。米国の麻疹再流行・チーズリコールは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DR Congo cross 11,000 with 5,387... | UNI India
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak has reached 11,042 confirmed cases and at least 5,387 deaths as of 11 November 2026, according to government figures. The outbreak, caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, is the largest and deadliest Ebola event in the DRC’s history and ranks as the second-largest and second-deadliest on record, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (more than 28,600 cases and over 11,000 deaths). Eight of the DRC’s 26 provinces are affected, with many deaths occurring outside treatment centres. Delayed detection, ongoing conflict, and an overstretched health system are cited as factors complicating control of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、感染者数が1万1000人を超え、死者5,387人に
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は同国史上最大規模（確定症例11,042、死者5,387）で、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（26州中8州）の流行についてのみ言及されており、Angolaへの波及は明記されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Caucaia, no Ceará, registra quase 15 mil casos de dengue, zika e chikungunya desde 2016
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Caucaia, in Ceará, records nearly 15,000 cases of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya since 2016.
article.articleSummary: In Caucaia, Ceará, Brazil, 2016–2025 saw 14,842 confirmed arboviruses (dengue, Zika, chikungunya) and 31,456 notifications. The year 2017 recorded the highest confirmations, driven largely by chikungunya, which also coincided with the greatest concentration of deaths in 2016–2017; no deaths from Zika were recorded over the decade. The findings come from a study by UniAteneu in partnership with the Municipal Health Secretariat, analyzing epidemiological data and employing spatial analysis to map disease distribution across the municipality. Women and adults aged 20–29 accounted for the largest share of cases, informing targeted prevention. Results can guide health surveillance and Aedes aegypti control. Recommended measures include eliminating standing water, keeping reservoirs covered, and facilitating inspections by health workers. Data were drawn from the Portal Web Epidemiológico.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州カウカイアで2016年以降、デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱が合計約1万5千件確認
triage.triage_reason: 過去10年間（2016-2025年）の累積統計データに関する学術研究報告であり、現在進行中の急性アウトブレイクではないため、即時のシグナルとしての対応は不要。
triage.notes: 記事は過去10年間の疫学データ分析・研究報告であり、現在の急性感染拡大を示す速報ではない。デング熱等のアルボウイルスはブラジルで流行性が高いため監視継続の価値はあるが、本記事単体でのピックアップは不要。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 volta a preocupar em BH após índice atingir maior nível de 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 worries again in Belo Horizonte after index reaches its highest level in 2026.
article.articleSummary: 7% COVID-19 positivity in Belo Horizonte public health network during the epidemiological week Oct 25-31, 2026 marks the highest rate in 2026. The municipality reported 27,885 suspected cases, 449 laboratory-confirmed infections, and 9 deaths (8 aged 60+). Health Secretary Miguel Duarte noted rising positives but no strain on health services; vaccination, integrated into Brazil's National Vaccination Calendar, remains the primary protection. COVID-19 vaccines stock is adequate. Vaccination eligibility in Belo Horizonte includes adults 60+, children 6 months to under 5 years, pregnant people, other priority groups and health professionals; full vaccination details and required documentation are available on the city portal. The outbreak underscores the importance of maintaining immunization to prevent severe disease, hospitalizations, and mortality.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19、2026年の最高値を記録しベロオリゾンテで再び懸念
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19陽性率上昇だが医療逼迫なし、通常の季節的変動範囲内であり既知の疾患かつワクチン体制も整っているためシグナルとしての該当基準は低い。
triage.notes: 既知の疾患(COVID-19)の季節的な陽性率上昇であり、医療体制への負荷なし・ワクチン供給も十分と報告されている。地域ローカルニュースであり国際的拡大懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果伊波拉確診逾1.1萬例　肯亞啟動42天疫情解除倒數
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 11,000 Ebola cases confirmed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; Kenya launches a 42-day countdown to end the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, with cumulative confirmed infections surpassing 11,000 (11,042) and 5,387 deaths as of November 11, 2026. The latest wave began in Ituri Province in northeastern DRC and has spread to seven other provinces, with most cases centered in Ituri and North Kivu. Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria have also reported cases. Kenya’s health ministry says the last Ebola patient has recovered and been discharged, triggering a 42-day countdown to declare the outbreak over if conditions are met; Kenya has recorded 9 confirmed cases since early October. The report notes ongoing surveillance and cross-border concerns, but does not specify the infection source or clinical symptoms beyond the designation of confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴでエボラ出血熱確認例が1.1万例超　ケニアは42天の疫情解除カウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（1.1万例超、死者5,387人）が複数国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアも症例報告があるが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ケニアは最終患者の回復により42日間の終息カウントダウンを開始している点が特記事項。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak tops 11,000 cases -- RT Africa
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in DR Congo surpasses 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths (CFR 48.8%), across eight provinces and 67 health zones, with Ituri as the epicenter and North Kivu reporting a 55% fatality rate. Insecurity impedes contact tracing, notably in Tshopo. The outbreak began in May; DR Congo's Health Ministry declared the 17th outbreak on May 15 and says this is the deadliest since 2018-2020 (2,299 killed). The virus has crossed borders with cases in Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. Uganda's outbreak was controlled in August; Kenya discharged its last patient, beginning a 42-day countdown; nine infections and two deaths in Kenya. Nigeria reports one imported case with no secondary transmission. A British doctor treating patients in DR Congo was evacuated to the UK; risk to the public remains low. Russia provided diagnostic test kits; over 7,500 tests delivered to DR Congo, Republic of the Congo, and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、感染者数が11,000人を超える -- RTアフリカ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が11,000例超・致死率48.8%に達し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへ越境伝播するなど国際的拡大と重大な公衆衛生影響が認められるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。英国人医師の退避やロシアからの検査キット支援など国際的関与も確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Governo envia alerta sobre sarampo e recomenda conferir vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The government issues an alert about Measles and recommends checking vaccination status.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks across the Americas trigger Brazil’s government to issue a WhatsApp alert urging people to check vaccination status and update doses at a Basic Health Unit (UBS). PAHO data show the Americas accounted for more than 95% of confirmed measles notifications in 2026, with United States, Guatemala, Mexico, Peru, and Canada hotspots. In Brazil, 52 imported cases were recorded through October 5: 41 in São Paulo, 10 in Amazonas, and 1 in Rio de Janeiro. Vaccination is the primary prevention; the measles-mumps-rubella vaccine is provided free by SUS. People should review their vaccination card and seek age-appropriate doses at health units. The United States reported the largest annual measles burden in over 35 years (as of Oct 6, updated Oct 28), with >90% of infections in unvaccinated or vaccination-status-unknown individuals, mainly under 19. Public health teams conduct investigations and vaccination campaigns; verify alert authenticity via GOV.BR inbox.

triage.headline_ja: 政府が麻疹に関するアラートを発信し、ワクチン接種状況の確認を推奨
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」の2つが該当し、米州全体での麻疹流行とブラジルへの輸入症例増加が確認されているためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 米国・グアテマラ・メキシコ・ペルー・カナダ・スペインは記事中で言及されるが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジルは輸入症例52例（サンパウロ41、アマゾナス10、リオデジャネイロ1）が主題として扱われているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Hohe Fallzahlen in Asien und Amerika: So schützen sich Reisende vor Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High Case Numbers in Asia and the Americas: How Travelers Protect Themselves from Dengue
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases surge in Asia and the Americas, with Bangladesh reporting about 136,930 cases and 427 deaths this year, and end-Oct hospitalizations reaching nearly 2,000 in a single day. Vietnam records ~131,205 cases, ~37% higher than last year, concentrated in the southern Ho Chi Minh City metro area (~42,500). In Latin America, Honduras exceeds 12,000 cases by end-Oct; Mexico, Bolivia, Peru, and Colombia show up to 53% increases over the prior four weeks; the Dominican Republic has 415 cases by week 40, notably in La Altagracia, La Romana and Puerto Plata. Dengue is transmitted by daytime-biting Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus in urban settings; incubation is 4–10 days. Re-infection with a different serotype raises risk of severe disease. Prevention emphasizes long clothing, effective repellents, and bed nets. Vaccination: Stiko caps use behind prior lab-confirmed infection; BCRT/CRM advocate Qdenga even without prior infection; EU-approved for ages 4+ with two doses at least three months apart.

triage.headline_ja: アジアと米州で感染者数増加：旅行者のデング熱予防法
triage.triage_reason: 複数国でデング熱症例が季節的に増加しているが、対象国の中ではベトナムのみが該当し、既知の風土病の季節変動の範囲内とみられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は旅行者向けの一般的な健康情報記事であり、ベトナムでは前年比約37%増加、特にホーチミン市に集中している点が注目される。他の言及国（バングラデシュ、ホンジュラス、メキシコ、ボリビア、ペルー、コロンビア、ドミニカ共和国、スペイン領カナリア諸島）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: عدّ تنازلي لإعلان كينيا خالية من إيبولا المتمدّد في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Countdown to Kenya's declaration of Ebola-free status amid the outbreak spreading in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: EBOLA VIRUS DISEASE remains active in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with 11,042 cases and 5,387 deaths across Ituri and North Kivu—the second-largest global outbreak to date and spreading across eight provinces. The Bundibugyo strain lacks an approved treatment or vaccine; ongoing violence and health-system weaknesses impede response, and health facilities have been attacked. Uganda has declared Ebola-free after containing cross-border infections (20 confirmed cases, 2 deaths). Kenya, reporting its first imported case on Oct 6, discharged the last patient and began a 42-day countdown on Nov 12, 2026, toward a possible Ebola-free declaration around Dec 23, 2026, provided no new cases arise. Nine confirmed Kenyan cases all belong to a single transmission chain; 135 contacts were traced, with 11 remaining in quarantine as of Nov 11. Kenya imposes a 21-day quarantine for entrants from DRC; Nigeria has also reported Ebola infections in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行の中、ケニアのエボラ終息宣言へのカウントダウン
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,042症例・5,387死亡という史上2番目の規模の流行が継続し、既にウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの継続的なエボラ流行を主題とし、ウガンダは終息宣言済み、ケニアは終息宣言へカウントダウン中、ナイジェリアでも感染確認と言及されているが、これら3カ国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Pato Branco faz mutirão contra a dengue em três bairros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pato Branco Launches a Dengue Cleanup Campaign in Three Neighborhoods.
article.articleSummary: Three Pato Branco neighborhoods—Alto da Glória, Vila São Pedro, and São João—will start a dengue-prevention cleanup mutirão on Monday, November 16, led by the Municipal Secretariats of Environment and Health. Trucks will remove water-collecting objects from sidewalks to reduce Aedes aegypti, the vector for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Residents must place items on the curb before the route arrives; after finishing a street, crews do not return. Past mutirões in Alvorada (Sept 28–Oct 15) yielded 103 loads (515 tons) and in Menino Deus (Nov 9–11) 12 loads (60 tons), totaling 115 loads and 575 tons. The Department of Health Surveillance urges homeowners to inspect yards during truck passes and discard unused containers that could collect water, reinforcing efforts to curb mosquito-borne disease transmission.

triage.headline_ja: パト・ブランコ、3地区でデング熱対策の一斉清掃活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の自治体によるデング熱予防清掃キャンペーンの告知であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・パラナ州パト・ブランコ市における蚊媒介性疾患（デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱）予防のための日常的な清掃活動を報じたもので、具体的な症例数や流行拡大の情報は含まれていない。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、記事内容が通常の予防活動であるためDISMISSと判断。

article.articleHeadline: UVZ orienta moradores de Araucária sobre zoonoses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UVZ guides residents of Araucária on zoonoses.
article.articleSummary: UVZ in Araucária guided residents of Jardim Israelense and Arco-Íris on zoonoses, focusing on feline sporotrichosis and leptospirosis. Feline sporotrichosis is a fungal infection affecting cats and can be transmitted to humans via scratches or bites; in cats it causes non-healing skin lesions and respiratory signs, while in people it can produce skin lesions that heal slowly. Prevention centers on keeping cats indoors; suspected feline cases should contact the Health Ombudsman at 0800-643-7744 or (41) 3614-7723 (WhatsApp) to schedule exams with Vigilância Ambiental. If confirmed, the Municipal Health Department provides medication and guidance. Leptospirosis is caused by Leptospira bacteria shed in the urine of infected animals, especially rats, and can be transmitted through floodwater, mud, and contaminated soil. Early symptoms include fever and malaise; severe cases may cause jaundice. Workers exposed to waste or animals should take precautions. Seek prompt medical care if symptoms appear after floodwater exposure; early diagnosis improves outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: UVZがアラウカリア市住民に人獣共通感染症について啓発
triage.triage_reason: 地方自治体による日常的な予防啓発活動の案内であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・パラナ州アラウカリア市の保健部門による猫の胞子性菌症とレプトスピラ症に関する一般的な予防啓発情報であり、具体的な発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため対象国としても計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Berantas Kasus TBC dengan Program ACF, Pemkab Jepara Menuju Eliminasi Tuberkulosis 2030
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eradicate TB Cases with the Active Case Finding (ACF) Program, Jepara Regency Government Aims for Tuberculosis Elimination by 2030.
article.articleSummary: Jepara Regency aims to eliminate tuberculosis by 2030 through Active Case Finding (ACF), focusing on tracing close and household contacts. The program targets 161 lokus (locations), with 100 residents per lokus. So far, ACF has been conducted at 132 lokus, reaching 13,200 people; 29 lokus remain to be completed in November, involving about 2,800 people. TB detections in 2024–2026 show fluctuations: 2024 had 2,407 cases (75% of estimates); 2025 had 2,398 cases (74.69%); January–October 2026 found 2,148 new cases (70% of an estimated 3,059), with numbers still dynamic. Reported cure rate among new cases is 86.91%, underscoring treatment efficacy. Screening uses portable X-ray and sputum tests, with Sukodono residents in Tahunan District specifically included in the outreach. The initiative reinforces the national elimination goal by 2030 and targets reaching about 90% of estimated cases.

triage.headline_ja: ACF（積極的症例発見）プログラムでTBC症例を撲滅、ジェパラ県政府は2030年結核排除を目指す
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核対策プログラム（積極的症例発見）の進捗報告であり、異常な流行や緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による既存の結核排除プログラム（ACF）の定例的な進捗報告記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: VIDEO Speciaal team begraaft ebolaslachtoffers in Congo, dodelijke epidemie blijft uitbreiden
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: VIDEO Special team buries Ebola victims in Congo, deadly Ebola outbreak continues to spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, with more than 11,000 people infected and 5,387 deaths among the sick as of November 11, 2026. Transmission persists, partly due to funeral practices that involve touching bodies, enabling further spread. A specialized team is depicted collecting and burying Ebola victims safely to curb transmission. VRT NWS Africa analyst Stijn Vercruysse accompanies the team, illustrating how safe and dignified burials can interrupt infection chains. The report underscores the critical public health role of proper funeral procedures in an active Ebola outbreak in Congo, while highlighting the ongoing challenge of reducing fatalities amid cultural practices and fear.

triage.headline_ja: 特別チームがコンゴでエボラ犠牲者を埋葬、致死的なエボラ流行は拡大を続ける
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で11,000人超の感染、5,387人の死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が継続・拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く(約49%)、埋葬慣習による感染継続が指摘されている。大規模かつ進行中のアウトブレイクであり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Кения на пути к статусу свободной от Эболы -- выписан последний пациент
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya on the road to Ebola-free status — the last patient has been discharged.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, Kenya is moving toward Ebola-free status after discharging the last patient; seven recovered in the country and 135 contacts completed 21 days of isolation, starting a 42-day countdown to an official declaration. The first case was a Kenyan businessman who died after arriving in Nairobi; he contracted the virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak has killed more than 5,000 people since it began in May. The man’s mother also died. Kenya has reported no new confirmed cases since Oct 20. Four of the recovered were healthcare workers. Uganda had already ended its outbreak by Aug 27. The DR Congo outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, which currently has no approved vaccine or treatment, though trials continue. Africa CDC called it a milestone and urged continued vigilance until the outbreak is officially declared over.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ出血熱の終息に向け前進 ― 最後の患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5月以降5,000人以上が死亡したエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株、承認済みワクチン・治療法なし）がケニア・ウガンダにも越境した事例であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの終息動向だが、根源となるアウトブレイクはDRC（5月発生、5,000人超死亡、ブンディブギョ株）であり、対象国リストに含まれるDRCを verified_locations とした。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Covid-19 aumentam em 18 estados; saiba quem deve se vacinar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases rise in 18 states; find out who should get vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases rose in 18 Brazilian states, but overall risk remains low with declines in deaths and severe illness versus 2025. Health Ministry data through Oct 31 show a rise in mild cases across Alagoas, Bahia, Ceará, Distrito Federal, Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Mato Grosso, Paraíba, Pernambuco, Piauí, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Rondônia, Roraima, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina and São Paulo. Mato Grosso, DF, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo and Santa Catarina report growing COVID-19–associated severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG), though at low levels. In 2026, about 3,400 SRAG cases vs 9,200 in 2025; deaths 437 vs 1,400; influenza-like syndrome linked to COVID-19 total 118,851, down 68.8%. Vaccination remains free via SUS for 60+ every six months; gestation one dose per pregnancy; children 6 months–<5 years (timing varies); immunocompromised and other groups. Testing: rapid tests 3–5 days after symptoms; RT-PCR from onset. Advice emphasizes vaccination, masking in risk settings, antivirals for high-risk, and seeking early care.

triage.headline_ja: 18州でCOVID-19症例が増加、ワクチン接種対象者について
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19軽症例の増加が報告されているが、重症例・死亡は前年より減少しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。通常の季節的変動として扱われ、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: ブラジル保健省の定期データに基づく軽症例増加の報道。重症・死亡例は2025年比で減少しており、既存の監視・ワクチン接種体制内で管理可能。新規性・異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: عدّ تنازلي لإعلان كينيا خالية من إيبولا المتمدّد في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Countdown to Kenya declaring itself Ebola-free from the outbreak spreading in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease persists in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with 11,042 cases and 5,387 deaths, making it the second-largest global outbreak to date, concentrated in Ituri and North Kivu and spanning eight provinces amid ongoing conflict and weak health systems. The Bundibugyo lineage has no approved treatment or vaccine. Across East and Central Africa, Kenya and Uganda report progress: Kenya’s first imported case on Oct 6 led to 9 confirmed cases all from a single transmission chain; the last contact (11 individuals) exited quarantine as Kenya begins a 42-day countdown on Nov 12 to declare Ebola-free around Dec 23 if no new infections, with a 21-day border quarantine for arrivals from DRC. Uganda has declared Ebola-free after containing cross-border transmission from DRC, having recorded 20 cases and 2 deaths. Nigeria also reported infections. WHO stresses that preventing community transmission depends on no new cases during the countdown days.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで拡大するエボラ流行からケニアが『エボラフリー』宣言までのカウントダウン
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,042症例・5,387死亡の大規模アウトブレイクが継続し、ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアへの越境感染も発生。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRC（Ituri州、North Kivu州など8州に拡大）での継続的なエボラ流行を扱っている。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・モザンビークは発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダは既にエボラフリー宣言済み、ケニアもカウントダウン中であり、越境感染が制御されつつある点は留意事項。

article.articleHeadline: Кенія на шляху до статусу вільної від Еболи - виписала останнього пацієнта
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya on the road to Ebola-free status discharged the last patient.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, Kenya has discharged its last Ebola patient, with seven recovered and 135 contacts completing 21 days of isolation, initiating a 42-day countdown to an official Ebola-free declaration. The initial case was confirmed in early October: a Kenyan businessman who died after arriving in Nairobi; he contracted the virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak has caused over 5,000 deaths since May. The 135 identified contacts completed 21 days of monitoring; no new confirmed cases since 20 October. All Kenyan cases were linked to the traveler from DRC via Uganda, with no evidence of wider community transmission. Four of the recovered patients were healthcare workers. Uganda had already declared its outbreak over on 27 August. The ongoing DRC outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a relatively rare strain with no approved vaccine or treatment yet, though trials are ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ出血熱からの回復に向けて最後の患者を退院させる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5,000人以上の死者を出しているエボラアウトブレイクが継続中であり、国境を越えてケニアへ伝播した事例が確認されている。重篤な公衆衛生イベントであり国際的拡大リスクもあるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事本文はケニアでの終息プロセスに焦点を当てているが、感染源であるDRCでは2026年5月以降5,000人以上の死者を出す大規模なエボラアウトブレイクが継続中であり、Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株（承認済みワクチン・治療法なし）による深刻な状況。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Afrique : sortie d'hôpital du dernier patient atteint au Kenya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Africa: the last patient infected in Kenya has been discharged from hospital.
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s last Ebola patient has been discharged from hospital, initiating a 42-day countdown beginning November 12, 2026, to determine potential end of transmission in the country. Kenya confirmed its first Bundibugyo ebolavirus case on October 6, 2026, in a Kenyan traveler returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda. The final positive case was confirmed October 19, 2026, and no new cases have been recorded since; only two deaths have occurred in Kenya. The World Health Organization cautions that this is a cautiously celebratory milestone, and vigilance must continue. The Ebola outbreak remains active in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with nearly 11,000 laboratory-confirmed cases and over 5,000 deaths, highlighting ongoing transmission there while Kenya approaches the end-of-outbreak counting period.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ：ケニアで最後の患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: DRCで約11,000例・5,000人超の死亡が継続する大規模エボラアウトブレイクが進行中であり、ケニア・ウガンダへの越境伝播歴もあることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの終息（42日カウントダウン開始）だが、ケニアとウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。DRCでの継続的な大規模アウトブレイクが明記されているためDRCを含めた。ケニアの症例はDRC由来の越境感染であり、国際拡大リスクの実例として考慮した。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola en el Congo supera los 11.000 casos y más de 5.300 muertos en el segundo brote más letal de la historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo surpasses 11,000 cases and more than 5,300 deaths in the second deadliest outbreak in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000 confirmed infections and 5,387 deaths since it was declared on May 15, 2026. Updated figures through November 9, 2026 from the National Institute of Public Health (INSP) report 11,042 infections and a case-fatality rate of 48.8%, making this the second deadliest Ebola outbreak in history, after 2014–2016 West Africa. The outbreak has spread to eight of the DRC’s 26 provinces and crossed borders into three African regions (Eastern, Central, Western), representing the widest geographic spread of Ebola on the continent. Many deaths occur outside treatment centers, hindering contact tracing and containment. Late detection, strained health services, and armed groups hindering response have accelerated transmission. Ebola spreads via direct contact with blood, bodily fluids, or tissues of infected humans or animals.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、感染者11,000人超・死者5,300人超に、史上2番目に致死的な流行に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.8%・11,000人超の感染・史上2番目に致死的なエボラ流行で、国境を越えた拡大も報告されておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としている。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは『アフリカの東・中央・西地域に拡大』『DRC国内26州中8州に拡大』との記述のみで、アンゴラでの発生を具体的に示す記述はないため除外した。武装勢力による対応妨害、医療機関外での死亡多数による接触者追跡困難など、管理の困難さが示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Casos e mortes por covid-19 no país caem em relação ao ano passado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases and deaths in the country fall compared with last year.
article.articleSummary: From January to October 2026, Brazil recorded 1,400 COVID-19 deaths, a 69% drop from January–October 2025. Influenza-like illness (ILI) cases totaled about 119,000, also down 69% year over year. Confirmed severe COVID-19 cases (Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome) reached around 3,400, a 63% decrease versus 2025. Despite declines, the Health Ministry notes an uptick in 18 states, typical for this season. Vaccination remains the main preventive measure: 20.3 million doses distributed to health units, with about 7 million administered this year. Vaccination is provided free by the SUS; continued precautions include hand hygiene and well-ventilated environments. COVID-19 is an acute respiratory infection; mild cases present as influenza-like illness with fever, cough, sore throat, and runny nose, while severe cases involve shortness of breath and hypoxemia requiring hospitalization.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19の症例数と死亡者数、昨年と比べて減少
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19・ILIともに前年比で大幅減少傾向にあり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は見られない。一部州での増加も季節的なものとされている。
triage.notes: 記事は年次統計報告であり、感染症の急激な増加や新たな異常事態を示すものではない。18州での増加は季節性のものと説明されている。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en el Congo suma miles de muertos y nuevos contagios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo has killed thousands and caused new infections.
article.articleSummary: EBOLA virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have surpassed 11,000 cases, with 5,387 deaths among 11,042 infections reported by the Ministry of Health as of 11 November 2026. Declared mid-May, the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has spread to eight of the country’s 26 provinces, with Ituri accounting for about 70% of cases and North Kivu now the principal site of new transmission. The outbreak remains without approved vaccine or therapy. Ongoing violence, a weakened health system, damaged transport routes, and community distrust hinder control efforts, and health facilities and workers have been attacked. It has spilled over into neighboring countries, including Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. The outbreak is the second largest on record, with the current case/death totals far exceeding those seen in the prior West Africa epidemic (2014–2016).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ(DRC)でのエボラ出血熱流行、死者数千人・新たな感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際的拡大）があり、死者5,387人・感染11,042人規模で周辺国への越境拡大も確認されているためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへの越境症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、暴力・医療体制の脆弱性・コミュニティの不信感が対応を妨げている点は重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Congo, l'Ebola supera gli 11.000 contagi con 5.387 morti: Medici Senza Frontiere chiede di usare l'unico vaccino disponibile
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo, Ebola surpasses 11,000 cases with 5,387 deaths: Doctors Without Borders calls for the use of the only vaccine available.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo strain) reaches 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths, the country’s deadliest on record and second-largest globally after 2014–16 West Africa. Declared mid-May, the outbreak has spread to eight of 26 provinces, including Ituri (north‑east epicenter) and the Kivu and Ubangi regions; many patients die before reaching treatment due to late diagnosis, conflict, and overwhelmed health services. The Bundibugyo strain has about 50% case fatality and currently lacks a tailored vaccine. MSF urges WHO and Merck to broaden access to Ervebo, the vaccine active against Zaire strain, beyond frontline use and trial protocols. Five countries have reported cases: Congo, Uganda, Kenya (imported in Oct with secondary transmission), Nigeria, and France. Trials include Tumaini; OMS recommends two candidate vaccines against Bundibugyo (ChAdOx1 and mRNA-1469) with efficacy readouts expected in early 2027; MBP134 and remdesivir are in therapy trials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染者11,000人超・死者5,387人:国境なき医師団、唯一利用可能なワクチンの使用を要請
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)がDRCで大規模流行し、複数国への国際的拡大が確認されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・フランスへの波及例があるが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず。DRCが主発生国として明確。

article.articleHeadline: Imparable, el brote de ébola en el Congo; hay más 5 mil muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Relentless, the Ebola outbreak in the Congo; more than 5,000 dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared May 15 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has grown to 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths (case fatality 48.8%) as of November 9, 2026, with 2,990 recoveries and 651 hospitalized or in isolation; contact tracing is 79.7% complete. Ituri (epicenter) and North Kivu account for the majority of new cases (57.7% and 32.7%), across eight provinces. The Bundibugyo strain has no specific treatment; WHO is testing two vaccines in Phase 1, while Ervebo has been used in the DRC since August, with early signals against Bundibugyo in animals. The outbreak spread to Uganda (20 cases, 2 deaths; Aug 26 end), Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths), Nigeria (1), and France (imported). Four evacuees were sent to the Netherlands, Germany, and UK. Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhaging. This is DRC’s seventeenth Ebola outbreak and the second deadliest globally.

triage.headline_ja: 止まらないエボラ出血熱の流行、コンゴで死者5000人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ大規模流行（1万人超感染、致死率48.8%）が複数国に拡大しており、IHR基準の深刻性・国際拡大の両方に該当するため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランス、オランダ、ドイツ、英国への拡大が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが主要な発生地であり唯一の対象国。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño health emergency: WHO issues warning as India worst affected
article.articleSummary: WHO has for the first time declared El Niño’s health impacts a public health emergency, with India among the worst affected. The climate phenomenon acts as a risk multiplier for heat-related illness and mortality, wildfire smoke and degraded air quality, malnutrition and injuries, and shifting risks of water- and vector-borne diseases such as cholera, malaria and dengue. The COP31 State of the Climate in 2026 and WMO updates tie record heat to ongoing extremes, noting January–September 2026 global mean temperatures about 1.47°C above pre-industrial levels and likely to be the highest on record by year end. In India, an April 2026 heatwave exposed an estimated 146.5 million people to severe heat stress; post-monsoon drought is declared across five states. Nepal’s late August glacier collapse killed over 1,300, and Europe reports more than 30,000 excess deaths linked to heat, drought and wildfires across multiple countries.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョによる健康危機：WHOが警告を発令、インドが最も深刻な影響を受ける
triage.triage_reason: WHOが初めてエルニーニョの健康影響を公衆衛生上の緊急事態と宣言し、インドが最も深刻な影響を受けていると報じられており、IHR基準の『深刻な公衆衛生影響』『異常性』の2項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOによるエルニーニョ関連の気候・健康危機宣言を主題としており、コレラ・マラリア・デング熱は気候変動によるリスク増大要因として言及されているが、インド国内での具体的な感染症アウトブレイクの発生は明示されていない。ネパールの氷河崩壊は感染症と無関係の災害であるため対象国から除外した。続報で具体的な感染症発生状況が報告されるか注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Pernambuco promove oficina para fortalecer diagnóstico, tratamento e vigilância da malária no estado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pernambuco hosts workshop to strengthen malaria diagnosis, treatment, and surveillance in the state.
article.articleSummary: Pernambuco, Brazil, hosts a workshop to strengthen malaria diagnosis, treatment, and surveillance. The Pernambuco State Health Secretariat (SES-PE), in partnership with Hospital Universitário Oswaldo Cruz, the state's malaria treatment reference center, held the Clinic Management, Surveillance and Notification of Malaria workshop on 11 November 2026 at the Marante Executive Hotel in Boa Viagem, Recife. Health professionals from all 12 regional health areas—physicians, nurses, Hospital Epidemiology nuclei, Hospital Epidemiological Surveillance, regional health management, and primary care staff—plus residents in Infectious Diseases, Internal Medicine, and Family and Community Medicine, gathered to share experiences and align procedures for care, investigation, and follow-up of suspected and confirmed malaria cases. The program covers laboratory diagnosis, clinical management, surveillance, and notification. Malaria, caused by Plasmodium parasites transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes, is an acute febrile illness; timely diagnosis and treatment prevent complications and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ペルナンブコ州、マラリアの診断・治療・サーベイランス強化のためワークショップを開催
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は医療従事者向け研修ワークショップの開催報告であり、具体的な症例急増やアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。通常の能力強化活動であり、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア対策能力強化のための研修会の告知であり、具体的な発生状況データ（症例数・死亡数等）は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 314 ODHIV di Sumba Timur Sudah Dapat Pengobatan, Ini Sebaran per Kecamatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 314 PLHIV in East Sumba Have Already Received Treatment, This Is the Distribution by Sub-districts.
article.articleSummary: East Sumba District, Indonesia, reports 314 people living with HIV (PLHIV) who have begun treatment from 2023 to September 2026. HIV infections have risen since 2014, with a notable increase in 2021 (107 new cases). All 314 individuals are currently on regular antiretroviral therapy. Sub-district distribution shows Kambera with the highest number (61), followed by Waingapu City (51), Umalulu (23), and Pandawai (22). Smaller counts include Kahaungu Eti (7), Kambata Mapambuhang (5), Rindi (9), Pahunga Lodu (2), Wula Waijelu (8), Matawai La Pawu (3), Paberiwai (12), Mahu (3), Karera (1), Pinu Pahar (2), Tabundung (12), Katala Hamu Lingu (4), Lewa Tidahu (7), Lewa (20), Nggaha Ori Angu (3), and Kanatang (12). The figures reflect localized burden and ongoing ART access in Sumba Timur.

triage.headline_ja: 東スンバの314人のHIV陽性者が治療を受ける、郡別分布はこちら
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性感染症の通常報告であり、新規性・異常性・急性公衆衛生リスクは認められない。ARTによる管理下にあり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクもない。
triage.notes: HIVは対象疾患としての緊急性は低く、ルーティンの保健統計報告に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला के मामले 11,000 के पार, 5,387 ल... | UNI Varta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo exceed 11,000, 5,387 people...
article.articleSummary: Dateline Kinshasa, 11 November 2026 — Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has climbed to 11,042 confirmed cases with at least 5,387 deaths. The outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain, making it the largest and deadliest Ebola episode in the country’s history. It stands as the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which infected over 28,600 and killed more than 11,000. Government data indicate the tally spans all 26 provinces. The article underscores the scale relative to past outbreaks and the ongoing national burden, highlighting that despite global attention, the Bundibugyo-driven outbreak remains the dominant public health crisis in the DRC as of 11 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者が11,000人を超え、5,387人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ（Bundibugyo株）が11,042例・死亡5,387人に達し、同国史上最大規模かつ史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行であり、全26州に拡大していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRC国内（全26州）の流行拡大のみを記述しており、Angolaへの越境感染の記述はないため除外した。致死率は約49%と極めて高く、希少なBundibugyo株による過去最大規模の流行である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Congo supera los 11.000 casos de ébola y más de 5 mil muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo surpasses 11,000 Ebola cases and more than 5,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 11,042 cases and 5,387 deaths, according to the Health Ministry, making it the deadliest outbreak on record in the country. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain is responsible; there is no vaccine or proven treatment. Declared in mid-May, the outbreak has spread to eight of the 26 provinces, with main transmission hotspots in Ituri and North Kivu. Containment is impeded by armed conflict, a strained health system, poor roads, and violence fueled by distrust and misinformation. Authorities urge ceasefires to allow medical teams to access patients. The report relies on official ministry counts; it does not detail laboratory confirmation or any imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ感染者1万1000人、死者5000人超に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（1万1000例以上、死者5000例超）が発生し、武力紛争により封じ込めが困難な状況であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州は国内の行政区分（ADM1）であり、DRC国内の発生地として集約。ワクチン・治療法未確立かつ武装紛争による対応阻害が深刻度を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de sarna humana provoca suspensão de aulas em creche municipal de Dourados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak of human scabies leads to suspension of classes at the municipal daycare center in Dourados.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of human scabies in Dourados, Brazil, prompted an indefinite suspension of classes at Ceim Recanto Raízes in Jardim Água Boa after 24 children and 16 staff were infected (40 cases at the center). At Recanto Raízes, 18 have recovered and 22 remain under treatment; six reinfections and five new cases were reported in recent days. Additional cases were identified at Ceim Beatriz de Barros Bumlai in BNH 4º Plano—four staff and two children—leading to decontamination measures and medical leave. Authorities cite incomplete home treatment and environmental contamination as drivers of the outbreak, and have implemented family advisories, prompt medical evaluation with certificates, entry screening, targeted class suspensions, and intersectoral coordination with social services and the Council Tutelar, alongside staff withdrawals. The center will undergo terminal cleaning, linen washing, furniture disinfection, and mattress containment. Scabies is a highly contagious skin infestation transmitted by close contact; control requires treating all close contacts promptly and environmental decontamination.

triage.headline_ja: 疥癬の集団発生によりドウラードス市立保育園で授業停止
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は局地的な保育施設内での集団発生であり、重症度・国際的拡大リスクともに低く、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 疥癬は重症度が低く致死性もない皮膚寄生虫症であり、地域の保育施設内での管理可能な集団発生に留まる。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威としての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo, oltre 11mila contagi per ebola durante guerra e proteste, gli esperti tranquillizzano: "Rischio molto basso per l'Ue"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo, more than 11,000 Ebola infections during war and protests, experts reassure: 'Very low risk for the EU.'
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with >11,000 infections and 5,387 deaths across eight provinces, amid ongoing war and protests that hinder response. Bundibugyo virus (BVD), an orthoebolavirus, is zoonotic; initial animal-to-human transmission, then human-to-human spread via contact with blood. Incubation 2–21 days; early symptoms include fatigue, fever, muscle pains, and headache, potentially quickly progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, organ damage, and hemorrhage. No authorized vaccines/ therapies yet;  targeted supportive care and safe burials remain core, but health services suffer from pay arrears and strikes, disrupting surveillance, decontamination, and data reporting. Europe is assessed as very low risk; several imported cases have been treated in isolation in Germany, France, the Netherlands, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom since May. On 4 November, WHO announced clinical trials for two vaccine candidates with results expected early 2027. Continuous emphasis on early diagnosis, isolation, contact tracing, and safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、戦争と抗議活動の中でエボラ感染者1万1000人超、専門家は『EUへのリスクは非常に低い』と説明
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行は11,000人超の感染・5,387人の死亡という深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、紛争下での対応困難、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、国際的な症例報告（欧州複数国での輸入例）が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 欧州各国（スイス・オランダ・フランス・ドイツ・英国）は輸入症例の治療国であり、発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Comunidade do 'pai do ET Bilu', Zigurats está entre áreas com casos de leishmaniose humana em MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The 'Father of ET Bilu' community, Zigurats, is among areas with human leishmaniasis cases in Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reports 22 suspected human leishmaniasis cases across Corguinho, including the Zigurats community, Furnas da Boa Sorte quilombola, the Vista Alegre Settlement, and other rural areas. The Municipal Health Department has collected 38 diagnostic samples; 22 yielded positive results and 16 negative, though positives are not necessarily laboratory-confirmed, with several patients presenting clinically suggestive skin lesions. First cases appeared late last year and rose with rains and higher temperatures. Dogs from the communities tested twice were negative. Clinically, 15 patients were referred for specialist evaluation, six are in treatment, and two have not yet started follow-up. A fumacê aerosol campaign was proposed but not authorized by the state due to concerns about human occupancy in sandfly habitat and potential impacts on bees. Zigurats is about 99 km from Campo Grande.

triage.headline_ja: 『ETビルの父』ことジグラッツ地区、マトグロッソ・ド・スル州でヒトのリーシュマニア症症例が確認された地域の一つに
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一地域（コルギーニョ）における風土病（リーシュマニア症）の局所的な発生であり、季節性（雨季・気温上昇）に伴う既知のパターンで、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大の懸念はない。
triage.notes: リーシュマニア症はサシチョウバエ媒介の風土病で、ブラジルでは既知の流行パターン。州は防虫剤散布（フマセ）を環境・ハチへの影響懸念から未承認とし、局所的な公衆衛生対応が継続中。国際的な懸念事項には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: PAHO malaria plan puts Guyana's elimination drive under spotlight
article.articleSummary: PAHO's Action Plan for Malaria Elimination in the Americas 2026–2030 targets a 50% reduction in regional malaria incidence by 2030 (vs 2024) and a 70% drop in Plasmodium falciparum, achieved through stronger surveillance, expanded rapid diagnostic testing, and timely treatment. It calls for targeted interventions in gold-mining communities, Indigenous settlements and hard-to-reach hinterland areas, especially in the Amazon Basin. In 2025 the region reported about 458,000 malaria cases (86% in South America; Brazil, Colombia and Venezuela accounted for 74%). Guyana’s malaria burden is linked to interior mining activity; 2024 cases totaled 27,169 (Regions One, Seven, Eight and Nine highest). The 2024 Guyana profile lists 28,776 presumed/confirmed cases, including 28,533 confirmed Indigenous cases, and about 90,200 people in high-transmission areas. Region Nine reduced cases 53% (2023–2024) with 31 microscopists trained; it’s a potential first elimination region. An August 2026 Paramaribo PAHO meeting stressed cross-border strategies with Suriname, malaria-free since 2025.

triage.headline_ja: PAHOのマラリア撲滅計画がガイアナの排除への取り組みに注目
triage.triage_reason: PAHOによる米州マラリア撲滅行動計画（2026-2030）に関する政策・統計報告であり、新規の異常な発生や急性アウトブレイクを示すものではない。対象国（ブラジル等）は地域統計の一部として言及されるのみで、記事の主題はガイアナの排除事業である。
triage.notes: 記事はガイアナの鉱山地域・先住民コミュニティでのマラリア排除の進捗と、PAHOの地域計画（ブラジル・コロンビア・ベネズエラを含む統計）を扱う政策報告。対象国リストのうちブラジルは統計上の言及のみで主題ではないため除外。ガイアナ・スリナム・コロンビア・ベネズエラは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia wijst rol als quarantainehub voor met ebola besmette reizigers af
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya rejects role as quarantine hub for Ebola-infected travelers.
article.articleSummary: Kenya will not host a quarantine facility for travelers exposed to Ebola virus disease (EVD) amid the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. The Ministry of Health stated that travelers will not be detained to meet foreign entry rules, and it will not issue quarantine exemptions or certificates of being virus-free, noting such measures are not supported by international health guidelines. This marks a reversal of plans to build a 50-bed isolation and treatment center at a military airbase about 200 km north of Nairobi, funded by the United States to monitor and care for its personnel or citizens in contact with the Congo outbreak. Local protests highlighted fears of importing a highly contagious disease. In Kenya, nine Ebola infections have been confirmed, all linked to the first patient who arrived from Congo last month, with two deaths. The last patient was discharged, initiating a 42-day observation period to declare Kenya virus-free. In Congo, the outbreak has grown to nearly 11,000 confirmed cases and over 5,300 deaths as of 7 November.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ感染渡航者の検疫拠点となる役割を拒否
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が拡大（約11,000例、5,300人超の死亡）し、既に越境感染（ケニアで9例・2死亡）が発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: ケニアでの越境感染事例（9例・2死亡）が報告されているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主要な発生国であるDRCのアウトブレイク状況（約11,000例、5,300人超死亡）が記事の中心的内容であり、国際的拡大・渡航制限議論が活発化している。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Πάνω από 11.000 κρούσματα και 5.387 θάνατοι στη ΛΔ Κονγκό - Εξιτήριο πήρε ο τελευταίος ασθενής στην Κένυα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Over 11,000 cases and 5,387 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo — the last patient in Kenya was discharged.
article.articleSummary: 11,042 Ebola infections and 5,387 deaths reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with about 3,000 recoveries and a 48.8% case-fatality rate, marking the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is responsible, centered in Ituri with spread to seven eastern provinces, and cross-border cases in Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. No vaccine is licensed specifically for Bundibugyo; MSF urges broader use of Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine) to protect vulnerable groups. WHO began a clinical trial in DRC on Oct 24 to test protection against Bundibugyo. Ongoing armed conflict in Ituri and Fataki hampers response, including attacks on health facilities. In Kenya, the last patient was discharged, initiating a 42-day countdown to end the outbreak; nine Kenyan cases since October (one death, eight recoveries), no new infections since Oct 19, with 11 contacts completing a 21-day quarantine; arrivals from DRC face 21 days of quarantine.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で11,000人以上の感染者と5,387人の死者 — ケニアで最後の患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（11,000例超、死亡5,387人、CFR48.8%）が国境を越えてウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアに波及しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（Ituri州、Fataki地区中心）での第17次エボラ流行を主題とし、Bundibugyo株による感染拡大、武力紛争による対応妨害、ワクチン未承認の課題、ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアへの越境症例が報告されている。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果爆发创历来最严重伊波拉疫情 逾1.1万人感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak has become the most severe Ebola epidemic in history; over 11,000 people infected.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces the most severe Ebola outbreak on record, with 11,042 confirmed infections and 5,387 deaths (case fatality ~50%). The outbreak has spread to seven additional provinces and to neighboring Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. In Kenya, the last Ebola patient has recovered and a 42-day observation period has begun; if no new cases occur, Kenya could declare the outbreak over on 23 December. Kenya’s first confirmed case was on 6 October in a man who had traveled from the DRC; nine confirmed Kenyan cases have been reported, including two deaths, all linked to the initial patient, with no evidence of sustained community transmission, and all cases belong to a single transmission cluster. The virus involved is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is currently no approved vaccine or specific treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪のエボラ出血熱流行、感染者1万1000人超
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際的拡大）に該当し、近隣国への越境拡大も確認されているためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの拡大が報じられているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ケニアでは最後の患者が回復し観察期間に入っているが、DRC本国の流行は史上最悪規模で継続中。ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスに対する承認済みワクチン・特異的治療法がない点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Campos confirma primeiro caso de mpox neste ano e alerta para aumento de casos no estado -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campos confirms the first mpox case this year and warns of an increase in cases in the state.
article.articleSummary: Campos dos Goytacazes, Brazil, confirms its first mpox case of the year. The 45-year-old patient was hospitalized November 1–3 and is now stable at home under Epidemiology surveillance. Exposure was likely in Rio de Janeiro city; diagnosis occurred in Campos. In response to rising statewide mpox activity, authorities reinforced guidance on transmission and care. Mpox spreads mainly via close, especially skin-to-skin contact; major symptoms include vesiculopustular skin lesions, fever, lymphadenopathy, muscle aches, and headache. A mpox vaccine exists but is restricted to frontline health workers and some people living with HIV under medical care. Suspected Campos cases should seek the public health network; strongly suspected cases are referred to the Centro de Doenças Infecto-Parasitárias (CDIP), the reference unit. SES-RJ data show 269 mpox cases through Nov 3, 2026, with no deaths; 2025 had 92, a ~192% increase. Campos records: 2025 (1), 2024 (1), 2023 (3); 2022 (6, with 1 death).

triage.headline_ja: カンポスで今年初のmpox症例確認、州内での症例増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・リオデジャネイロ州でmpox症例が増加傾向（2026年269例、死亡なし）にあるが、重症度は低く、既知の疾患で管理体制も確立されているため、フルRRAには至らないが継続的な動向監視が必要。
triage.notes: 死亡例なく重症度は低いが、州全体で前年比約192%の症例増加が報告されており、地域の疫学サーベイランス状況を継続的に注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue ultrapassa 4 mil casos prováveis e mata criança de 11 anos em Mato Grosso do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue surpasses 4,000 probable cases and kills an 11-year-old child in Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, surpassed 4,000 probable cases in 2026, with 2,327 laboratory-confirmed infections and one death (11-year-old boy) in Bonito, ~297 km from Campo Grande; another death under investigation. The figures appear in the SES epidemiological bulletin for week 43 of 2026 and are provisional, not a final balance. Relative to 2025, incidence has fallen (84.4 vs 306.9 cases per 100,000). In 2025 there were 8,461 confirmed cases and 20 deaths. Corumbá records the most probable dengue cases (869), followed by Sidrolândia (208), Costa Rica (205), Jardim (169), Santa Rita do Pardo (146), and Ladário (144). Aedes aegypti surveillance via ovitraps is being used to map risk zones, guiding control efforts. Preventive measures include removing standing water, cleaning gutters and yards, sealing water tanks, and proper disposal of breeding materials. Symptoms include fever, body aches, headache, nausea, and a rash; warning signs require immediate care.

triage.headline_ja: マトグロッソ・ド・スル州でデング熱が4,000件の疑い例を超え、11歳の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はブラジルで季節性かつ地方風土病的に発生しており、2025年と比較して罹患率は低下している。子どもの死亡例はあるが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、ルーティンの疫学報告の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 州保健局（SES）の週次疫学速報に基づく記事で、症例数は暫定値。2025年比で罹患率は低下しており、季節性のデング流行としてルーティンな範囲内と考えられるが、死亡例の推移は今後も監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 000 κρούσματα και 5.387 θάνατοι από Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό, ιάθηκε ο τελευταίος ασθενής στην Κένυα - dete.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 000 cases and 5,387 deaths from Ebola in the DR Congo, the last patient in Kenya has recovered - dete.gr.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak—the most severe on record—has 11,042 confirmed infections and 5,387 deaths, with about 3,000 recoveries and a 48.8% case-fatality rate. This is the 17th outbreak in the country, beginning in Ituri (north-east) and spreading to seven provinces, with Ituri and North Kivu as hotspots; the virus has reached Uganda, Nigeria, and Kenya. There is no vaccine specifically for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, though MSF urges broader use of Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine), and WHO began Oct 24 clinical trials in DRC to test Ervebo against Bundibugyo. Security problems hamper response: attacks on health workers, a health center burned in Lolua, UN suspended Fataki operations; ADF/ISIS-linked attacks affect Ituri, North Kivu, and Upper Uele. In Kenya, the last Ebola patient was discharged, initiating a 42-day countdown to end; nine cases since Oct, one death, no new cases since Oct 19; arrivals from DRC face 21-day quarantine; seven recovered.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱11,042例・死者5,387人、ケニアでは最後の患者が回復
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ出血熱が発生し、致死率約49%、複数州に拡大しウガンダ・ナイジェリア・ケニアにも波及。治安悪化により対応が困難化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC（イトゥリ州・北キブ州が中心）。ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・ケニアへの拡大にも言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。治安悪化（ADF/ISIS関連攻撃、医療従事者への攻撃）が対応の大きな障害となっている点にも注意。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: risco de reinfecção acende alerta entre especialistas; saiba por quê
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Risk of Reinfection Raises Alarm Among Experts; Learn Why.
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces renewed dengue risk as Antibody-Dependent Enhancement (ADE) raises reinfection severity when a different dengue serotype infects a person previously exposed. With the National Day for Dengue Control approaching on November 21 and summer’s warmth boosting Aedes aegypti, experts warn that infections by serotype DENV-3 are rising. Dengue antibodies from prior infections may recognize but not neutralize a new serotype, potentially aiding viral entry and accelerating disease. In Brazil, January–October 2026 saw about 374,000 dengue cases and 371 deaths, while 2025 recorded 1,841 dengue deaths and 2024 had 6,270. DENV-3’s share climbed from at least 14% in 2025 to about 30% in 2026. Vaccination with Qdenga is approved for ages 4–60, two doses 3 months apart, available in private networks and SUS (prioritized for 10–14 years). Severe dengue includes hemorrhage, shock, and organ injury; early diagnosis and IV fluids are essential; avoid self-medication.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：専門家の間で再感染リスクへの警戒が高まる、その理由とは
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでデング熱死亡者数が高水準で推移し、DENV-3血清型比率上昇による重症化（ADE）リスクが専門家から指摘されており、WPRO基準の重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさに該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 毎年繰り返される季節性デング熱流行の専門家解説記事だが、DENV-3血清型比率上昇とADEによる再感染重症化リスクが強調されており、死亡者数も多いため経過観察・リスク評価の価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : le bourgmestre de Makiso appelle au respect des mesures barrières contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: the mayor of Makiso calls for compliance with barrier measures against Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Kisangani, Democratic Republic of Congo's Tshopo Province prompts a push for strict barrier measures. In Makiso commune, Kisangani, on 11 November 2026, mayor Simon Lowawa urged residents to scrupulously observe protective barriers to break the transmission chain, stressing that Ebola is real and has already claimed victims. He called on the population to follow health authorities' guidelines to curb spread within Kisangani and across Tshopo. During the administrative tour, the mayor acknowledged support from Delly Likunde and highlighted the crucial role of neighborhood leaders and avenue chiefs due to their proximity to residents. The Nyumba Kumi program was cited to strengthen community vigilance. An exercise on local data management—covering area size, demographic stats, births, deaths, number of avenues, and school and health facilities—was praised as essential for accurate local reporting and improved outbreak monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州：マキソ区長がエボラ対策の防疫措置遵守を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国チョポ州キサンガニでエボラ出血熱の死者が既に発生しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性、地域内感染拡大のリスクがありIHR基準を満たすため。
triage.notes: 記事は地元行政官による防疫措置呼びかけであり、死者発生が既に確認されていることからエボラ流行が進行中とみられる。詳細な症例数・致死率等の情報は本文に記載がなく、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola atinge 11 mil casos na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola reaches 11,000 cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000 cases, making it one of the deadliest in the country’s recent history. The surge places pressure on already weakened health systems. Authorities are intensifying containment with mass vaccination campaigns and the establishment of specialized treatment units, though efforts are hampered by political and social instability in the region. Ebola, a viral hemorrhagic fever, typically presents with fever and internal bleeding and has a high case-fatality rate. The rapid spread has drawn international concern, with support from the World Health Organization and Doctors Without Borders. Coordinated international-local health responses and clear community communication are essential to prevent further escalation. Logistical challenges, misinformation, and fear complicate control measures, and the outbreak is impacting the economy and social stability in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が11,000例に到達
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が11,000例を超え、高い致死率と国際的懸念を伴う大規模アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOおよび国境なき医師団が支援に関与しており、政治的・社会的不安定も対応を複雑化させている。致死率や感染経路の詳細は記事本文に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Sinh viên thú y tham gia phòng, chống bệnh dại từ cộng đồng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Veterinary students participate in community-based rabies prevention and control.
article.articleSummary: Approximately 500 veterinary students and faculty from the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine, Vietnam National University of Agriculture, joined a Hanoi event to form a network of student ambassadors for rabies prevention and community behavior change. Organized by SBCC Vietnam and Soi Dog Foundation with the Faculty, the program pilots a model to prevent rabies, promote sustainable livelihoods, and gradually transform the dog and cat meat trade in 14 Hanoi wards. Approved July 24, 2025 by Hanoi’s People’s Committee, the project is led by Hanoi Department of Agriculture and Environment; Soi Dog Foundation is the international partner, with SBCC Vietnam providing technical and communications support. The One Health approach links human, animal, and environmental health, training businesses to shift to safer livelihoods via vocational training and market access. Rabies is almost universally fatal after symptoms but preventable; Vietnam targets zero deaths by 2030 per WHO. CDC Hanoi outlined local risk analyses; students will become ambassadors disseminating knowledge to households and communities, continuing the “Student accompanies” series including December 2025 at the Vietnam Academy of Youth.

triage.headline_ja: 獣医学生、狂犬病の地域予防対策に参加
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病予防啓発活動に関する平時の広報・教育プログラムの報道であり、具体的な発生拡大や異常事態は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の発生事例ではなく、ハノイにおける予防啓発・教育プロジェクトの紹介記事である。

article.articleHeadline: Más de 11.000 casos de ébola reporta la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports more than 11,000 Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000 confirmed cases as of November 9, 2026, with 5,387 deaths (case fatality ~48.8%) and 2,990 recoveries. About 651 patients remain hospitalized or in isolation, and contact tracing covers 79.7% of exposed individuals. The outbreak began May 15 and remains concentrated in the eastern provinces of Ituri (the main hotspot) and North Kivu, which account for about 57.7% and 32.7% of cases, respectively. The health emergency spans 67 health zones across eight of the DRC’s 26 provinces, including Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, South Kivu, and Ubangi provinces (South and North). With detections across multiple African regions, this is the most geographically widespread Ebola outbreak ever recorded in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の症例が11,000件を超えたと報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が11,000例超・致死率約48.8%に達し、8州67保健区域に拡大、史上最も地理的に広範なアフリカでのエボラ流行とされており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域に記載されたTshopo、Nord Ubangi、South Kivu、Équateur、IturiはいずれもDRC国内の州・県であり、独立した対象国ではないためDRCのみを計上。致死率約48.8%・2990例回復・接触者追跡79.7%など詳細データあり、史上最大規模の地理的拡大を示すエボラ流行として極めて重大な公衆衛生イベント。

article.articleHeadline: Segunda escola de Vespasiano suspende aulas após casos de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second school in Vespasiano suspends classes after cases of human scabies.
article.articleSummary: Second school in Vespasiano suspends classes after human scabies cases. Escola Estadual Maria da Piedade Fonseca, in Morro Alto, halted activities on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, for cleaning and disinfection; the temporary suspension did not specify case counts. Minas Gerais SEE, in alignment with Municipal Sanitation Surveillance, issued guidance to students, families and staff on transmission prevention, with the school administration monitoring the situation. No return date is yet set; classes will resume after sanitization and days will be made up to meet the academic calendar. This follows an earlier suspension at another Vespasiano school, Escola Municipal de Ensino Especial Vovó Mariquita, after a confirmed scabies case, with activities paused through 11 November and expected to restart on 12 November. In the region, Lagoa Santa reported 178 confirmed scabies cases in September, with 75 under investigation (253 notifications total) and 12 new cases in the prior 24 hours. Scabies spreads mainly via prolonged skin contact; treatment may involve close contacts.

triage.headline_ja: ヴェスパシアーノ市の2校目が疥癬（ヒト）症例確認後に休校
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上重大なリスクを持つ疾患ではなく、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限の懸念もない。地域内の学校単位での衛生対応にとどまる。
triage.notes: 疥癬は皮膚接触で感染する慢性的な皮膚疾患で、重篤な公衆衛生リスクではない。地域保健当局が通常の対応（消毒・経過観察）を行っており、WATCHほどの継続監視価値も低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola tops 11,000 cases in Congo's deadliest outbreak
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), caused by Bundibugyo virus. By Nov 11, 2026, health ministry data show 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths, in what government says is Congo's deadliest outbreak. Began mid-May; spread to eight of 26 provinces, with Ituri province accounting for about 70% of cases and North Kivu as the main site of new transmission. Bundibugyo virus has no known vaccine or treatment. Containment hampered by armed conflict, a fragile health system, poor roads, and mistrust/violence; health facilities and workers facing attacks. The outbreak has reached neighboring countries, with reported cases linked to Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. Attacks in communities and school impacts noted in Ituri; schools affected and teachers infected. Urgent calls for cessation of fighting to allow access and faster containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが11,000例を超え、同国史上最悪の流行に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）がDRCで11,000例超・死者5,387人に達し、武力紛争により封じ込めが困難な上、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョウイルス株による流行で、武力紛争・医療施設への攻撃が封じ込めを阻害。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの関連症例報告があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Smrtonosni virus hara Afrikom, više od 5.300 ljudi izgubilo život: Epidemija ebole izmiče kontroli, zaražene hiljade - strahuje se od još gore katastrofe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly virus ravages Africa, more than 5,300 people have died: The Ebola epidemic is getting out of control, thousands of people infected—fears of an even greater catastrophe.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has reached 11,042 cases and 5,387 deaths, the deadliest outbreak in the country and the second-largest globally. As of November 3, eight of Congo's 26 provinces are affected, with Ituri in the northeast accounting for about 70% of cases and North Kivu a new hotspot; transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated objects, with infectivity after symptom onset. The outbreak has spilled into Kenya and Nigeria; Uganda and France outbreaks were controlled. A health worker was evacuated to the United Kingdom for specialized care; another patient went to Switzerland. Trials of experimental vaccines (Tumaini) began Oct 23, with candidates from Oxford and Moderna. WHO notes no licensed vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo virus, and stresses isolation and care. Global risk remains low; travel restrictions are not advised.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカで致死的ウイルスが猛威を振るう、5,300人以上が死亡：エボラ出血熱の流行は制御不能に、数千人が感染—さらなる大惨事への懸念
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がコンゴ史上最悪の流行となり、1万人以上の感染・5千人超の死亡、複数国への拡大・医療従事者の国際搬送が発生しておりIHR基準・WPRO基準を多数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアへの飛び火、スイス・英国への患者/医療従事者搬送、フランスでの小規模流行が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リスト外（DRC以外）。WHOはグローバルリスクを低いと評価し、渡航制限は推奨していない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Outbreak Surpasses 11,000 Cases and 5,300 Deaths as Deadliest Epidemic in Nation's History Spreads - [your]NEWS
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus has expanded to eight provinces, led by Ituri (≈70% of cases) and North Kivu, with Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, South Kivu, North Ubangi and South Ubangi also affected. As of Nov 11, 2026, the Health Ministry reports 11,042 confirmed infections and 5,387 deaths (roughly 49% fatality). No approved vaccine or targeted therapy exists for Bundibugyo; containment relies on early detection, isolation, contact tracing and supportive care. The epidemic, declared mid‑May, is the deadliest in DRC history and the world’s second-largest Ebola outbreak. Attacks on medical workers and insecure conditions hinder response; Cantine-Aloya attack killed 66 civilians, including three health workers, with three facilities looted. WHO warns insecurity as a major obstacle; nearly 3,000 recovered; transmission slowing in some areas but new outbreaks elsewhere prevent declaring control. Border cases reported in Uganda, Kenya and Ni.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ共和国のエボラ流行、1万1000人超の感染と5300人超の死亡で同国史上最悪の流行に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、8州に拡大し国境を越えた症例も報告されているため、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるIHR基準複数該当のシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境症例が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。治安悪化（医療従事者への攻撃、施設襲撃）が対応の大きな障害となっている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : renforcement des capacités de plus de 60 leaders communautaires à Rwampara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Capacity-building for more than 60 community leaders in Rwampara.
article.articleSummary: On 10 November, more than 60 community leaders and influential actors from the Rwampara health zone participated in a training on risk communication and community engagement (CREC) and on community-based surveillance to bolster prevention and early detection of Ebola in Ituri. Organized by DPS/Ituri in collaboration with Mercy Corps, the session supports the IERDC Jamii Imara Kwa Ajili ya Afya project, implemented by Mercy Corps, CORACON, VIAMO, Alert International, and Concern in Bunia (Ituri) and in Beni and Oïcha (North Kivu). The goal is to empower leaders to promote transmission interruption through CBS and risk communication while addressing community concerns about Ebola vaccination and treatment at Ebola Treatment Centers. Officials emphasized feeding back field concerns to health services to remove engagement barriers, including ambulance delays or shortages, and to intensify surveillance and community engagement efforts.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州のエボラ対策：ルワンパラで60人以上の地域リーダーの能力強化
triage.triage_reason: 新規症例や発生状況の報告はなく、コミュニティ向け研修・能力強化活動に関する運営上の記事であり、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事は研修・能力強化活動の実施報告であり、新規感染者や発生拡大の情報は含まれていない。「Rwampara」はルワンダ国ではなくイツリ州内の保健ゾーン名であるため、Rwandaは対象国リストに該当せず除外した。

article.articleHeadline: بكتيريا تسبب حمى "تسوتسوجاموشي" في عدة دول
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bacteria causing scrub typhus in several countries.
article.articleSummary: Scrub typhus, caused by Orientia tsutsugamushi, is reported spreading across northern Japan, Southeast Asia, northern Australia, China, and the Indian subcontinent, according to Germany's travel medicine center. Natural reservoirs are rodents; chigger larvae transmit the bacterium to humans, typically when travelers are outdoors near riverside shrubs. After a bite, symptoms usually appear 1–2 weeks later. About half of patients develop a dark crust at the bite site; lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, limb pain, and cough may accompany. A rash with papules and itching often appears a few days after onset. Rare complications can involve brain or meninges, heart, or lungs. Early antibiotic treatment is crucial; penicillins are ineffective, doxycycline is preferred. No vaccine exists. Prevention focuses on protective clothing treated with insect repellent, DEET-containing products, avoiding animal contact, and not sitting on ground or grass; travelers in remote areas may carry a standby antibiotic after medical consultation.

triage.headline_ja: 複数の国で「ツツガムシ病」を引き起こす細菌について
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、ツツガムシ病に関するドイツ旅行医学センターからの一般的な予防啓発情報であるため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定のアウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、ツツガムシ病（Orientia tsutsugamushi）の流行地域・症状・予防法に関する一般的な旅行医学情報。日本、東南アジア、オーストラリア北部、中国、インド亜大陸が流行地域として言及されているが、これは既知の地域病としての説明であり、新規の異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Bengal's dengue control measures receive Centre's praise as cases drop nearly 14%
article.articleSummary: West Bengal's dengue-control measures received central praise as cumulative dengue cases by Oct 31, 2026 declined about 14% from the same period in 2025. The state reported 14,634 dengue cases up to Oct 31, 2026, versus 17,032 in 2025 (44th epidemiological week). A national review by the NCVBDC Dengue Division on Nov 6 described Bengal's performance as 'extraordinary' and credited key initiatives: a dedicated dengue reporting portal, cascade training of healthcare workers, mortality analyses linking epidemiological and entomological data, and a special anti-dengue month. The Centre also commended regular monitoring at the highest administrative levels—by the Chief Minister, Health and Family Welfare Minister, Chief Secretary, and district magistrates—and noted active participation of the Health Minister, Dr Sharadwat Mukherjee. Dr Tanu Jain (Director) and Dr A.K. Pasi (Joint Director) chaired the review.

triage.headline_ja: ベンガル州のデング熱対策、症例数約14%減少で中央政府から称賛を受ける
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数は前年比で減少しており、対策の成功を報じる内容で、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱対策の成功事例を称賛する内容であり、症例数は減少傾向。政府レベルでの関心は高いが、公衆衛生上の脅威としてのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Escabiose confirmada em cinco escolas de Varginha
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scabies confirmed in five schools in Varginha.
article.articleSummary: 24 scabies cases across five schools in Varginha, Brazil, as of November 10, triggering intensified surveillance, prevention, and control. Cases were confirmed via Epidemiological Surveillance; measures began in late October with an advisory to municipal schools. In early November, health and education departments held technical meetings and coordinated with public and private school directors to standardize care pathways and isolation of suspected cases. Scabies is caused by the mite Sarcoptes scabiei and spreads mainly through prolonged direct skin contact, with transmission possible via sharing towels, clothing, or bedding. Key symptoms include intense nocturnal itching and skin lesions. Prevention emphasizes avoiding sharing personal items, proper hygiene, and seeking medical care on symptom onset. Treatments must be followed, including guidance for close contacts. Daily monitoring continues; epidemiological bulletin updates will be weekly on semus.varginha.mg.gov.br and other channels.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァルジーニャの5校で疥癬が確認
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は軽症で管理可能な皮膚疾患であり、国際的拡大リスクや重篤性は低く、既に地域保健当局により監視・対応がなされている。
triage.notes: 疥癬は接触感染するが重症度は低く、地元当局が既に監視体制を強化し対応している。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Un virus mortal, descoperit de cercetători în pergamentele unor manuscrise vechi de 1.000 de ani
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deadly virus, discovered by researchers in the parchments of thousand-year-old manuscripts
article.articleSummary: DNA of the sheep pox virus (Capripoxvirus) was detected in parchment hides from medieval manuscripts and in Bronze Age sheep teeth, showing the virus affected Eurasian flocks for at least 3,700 years. The international study, led by University College Dublin, analyzed biological material in York Gospels (~1,000 years old) and other British and continental European documents, including the Corpus Glossary at Cambridge. Viral DNA was also found in calf and goat skins, suggesting past cross-species infection or contamination during parchment production. Phylogenetic analysis places major Capripoxvirus lineages—sheep pox, goatpox, and lumpy skin disease—diverging roughly 11,500–3,700 years ago, coinciding with domestication and sheep migrations from the Eurasian steppe to Europe. The work highlights parchment as a reservoir for ancient epidemiological data and opens new avenues to study historical animal diseases.

triage.headline_ja: 千年前の写本の羊皮紙から致死性ウイルスが発見される
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は歴史的・考古学的研究に関するものであり、現代における感染症発生事例ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急対応は不要。
triage.notes: 本記事は古代DNA研究（医学史・考古学）であり、現代のアウトブレイクではない。発生地域として挙げられたタイ(Bangkok)等は記事本文と無関係で、Bluedotの誤タグ付けと判断。対象国での現在進行形の発生事例なし。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Padang temukan 2.800 kasus tuberkolosis hingga November 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Padang City Health Office Finds 2,800 Tuberculosis Cases as of November 2026
article.articleSummary: Padang City Health Office in West Sumatra reports 2,800 tuberculosis (TB) cases identified through contact tracing across 104 kelurahan (urban villages) in Padang City as of November 2026. The tracing of close contacts of TB patients forms part of efforts to strengthen early detection and management of this infectious disease. The report emphasizes ongoing surveillance and case-finding within the city, but provides no details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or specific transmission sources. These findings reflect local public health activity to map TB burden and identify additional cases through routine TB control measures in Padang, Sumatra's West Sumatra region. No information on case severity or treatment outcomes is provided.
