triage.headline_ja: パダン市保健局、2026年11月までに結核2,800例を発見
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の流行病であり、通常の接触者追跡・サーベイランス活動の一環として報告されたもので、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は地方保健局による定例的な症例発見活動の一環であり、重症度・治療結果等の詳細情報はないが、通常のTB対策活動と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia entlässt letzten Ebola-Patienten nach Hause
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya discharges the last Ebola patients home.
article.articleSummary: On 11 November 2026, Kenya discharged the last Ebola patient to recover and released eleven contacts after 21 days in quarantine, initiating a 42-day period under WHO rules to confirm Ebola-free status if no new cases arise. Kenya’s first Ebola case was reported on 6 October: a Kenyan citizen who had entered from the Democratic Republic of Congo. In total, Kenya recorded nine Ebola cases, all linked to the initial infection, with two deaths. The current outbreak in Africa began mid‑May in the Democratic Republic of Congo and is regarded as the worst in the country’s history. The National Health Institute reported more than 11,000 infections and over 5,300 deaths. Nigeria and Uganda have also reported cases in this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最後のエボラ患者を退院させる
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラアウトブレイクは同国史上最悪規模（感染1万1千人超、死者5300人超）であり、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアへも拡大しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事自体はケニアでの収束（最後の患者退院）を報じているが、背景となるDRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（過去最悪、感染1万1千人超・死者5300人超）が主要情報として含まれるためDRCを対象国として記載。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll climbs to 11,000 in Congo, as health officials warn of worsening outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 11,042 cases and 5,387 deaths, with the Bundibugyo strain driving the outbreak that began in May. Eight of the 26 provinces are affected, with Ituri accounting for nearly 70% of infections and North Kivu the main center of new transmissions. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. Ongoing containment challenges include armed conflict, damaged health infrastructure, poor roads, and public mistrust, compounded by attacks on medical workers and facilities. Schools have been affected as well, with teachers contracting the virus and staff reporting trauma. Authorities urge an end to fighting in affected areas to enable access for medical teams. This outbreak ranks as the second-largest Ebola epidemic on record, after the 2014–2016 West Africa crisis.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ死者数が1万1000人に達し、保健当局が流行悪化を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ株エボラ流行が死者5,387人・症例11,042人に達し、ワクチン・治療法未承認、武力紛争による対応困難も重なる深刻な公衆衛生事態であり、IHR基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 史上2番目に大規模なエボラ流行とされ、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認のブンディブギョ株による流行。武力紛争や医療従事者への攻撃により封じ込めが困難化している。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya discharges its last Ebola patient and starts a 42-day countdown to being declared free of the virus
article.articleSummary: Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient on November 11, 2026, starting a 42‑day countdown to an outbreak end under WHO rules. Seven patients have recovered, including four health workers; five were discharged on November 3 and a sixth on November 6. All 135 identified contacts completed 21 days of monitoring, and Kenya has had no new case since October 20. The infections traced to a businessman who traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda and died in Nairobi after arriving in early October; his mother also died. No evidence of wider community spread. WHO requires 42 days after the last negative test or discharge before declaring an outbreak over; surveillance and border screening will continue, with 21‑day quarantines for travelers from affected areas. The Congo outbreak since May has killed more than 5,000 (Bundibugyo virus) with no vaccine or treatment; Uganda declared it over on Aug 27.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最後のエボラ患者を退院させ、ウイルス終息宣言に向けた42日間のカウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で5月以降5000人以上が死亡したエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）の越境感染事例であり、ケニアでの発症・隔離対応が行われた。国際的拡大実績と渡航制限措置が確認され、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの発生終息（対象国リスト外）だが、感染源であるコンゴ民主共和国での大規模流行（5月以降5000人超死亡、ワクチン・治療法なし）が実質的な記事内容として詳述されているため、DRCを検証済み地域として含めた。ケニア国内では新規感染なく、コミュニティ内拡散の証拠もないため終息に向かっている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia ha dado el alta a su último paciente de ébola: se inicia una espera de 42 días para erradicar el brote de 2026 en la región
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya has discharged its last Ebola patient: a 42-day waiting period begins to eradicate the 2026 outbreak in the region.
article.articleSummary: Kenya has contained its Ebola outbreak, reporting nine confirmed cases and two deaths associated with the Bundibugyo strain. The first case appeared on Oct 6 in a man who had traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo; he died soon after, prompting emergency measures. Eight additional infections followed—four relatives of the index patient and four healthcare workers—bringing total cases to nine and leaving seven recovered. The last patient was discharged on Nov 11, 2026, after completing treatment and testing negative, and 11 contacts completed surveillance and returned home. No new infections have been detected since Oct 19. No community transmission outside the initial chain has been observed. A 42-day waiting period—double the maximum 21-day incubation—now begins to declare the outbreak over; if no new cases emerge, Kenya could be Ebola-free on Dec 23, 2026. Public health teams and border controls remain active during the observation window.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアが最後のエボラ患者を退院させる：2026年の地域アウトブレイク撲滅に向け42日間の待機期間が開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクはケニアで既に制御下にあり新規感染なしで終息に向かっているが、発生国ケニアは対象国リストに含まれず、起源とされるDRCも記事の主題ではないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでのエボラアウトブレイク終息に関する続報であり、感染は既にコントロールされ新規症例なし。発生地域にDRCが含まれるが、これは指標患者の渡航元として言及されたのみでDRC国内での発生拡大は記述されていないため除外。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde libera R$ 524 mil contra o sarampo no Amazonas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health allocates R$ 524 thousand to combat measles in Amazonas.
article.articleSummary: 65 imported measles cases were confirmed in Brazil in 2026, with 21 in Amazonas near the Peru and Colombia border. To curb spread, the Ministry of Health allocated R$524,000 for vaccination, surveillance, and blocking transmission in Atalaia do Norte, Benjamin Constant, and Tabatinga, Amazonas. Tabatinga receives R$322,135.03; Benjamin Constant R$124,376.94; Atalaia do Norte R$77,517.70. A portaria published on November 9, 2026, transfers the funds from the National Health Fund to municipal coffers, each city to report usage. The Day D vaccination drive on November 7 intensified efforts, targeting health units, ports, fairs, schools, and communities, with special attention to Indigenous and riverine populations. Vaccination is free via SUS for children from 6 months old. Amazonas reported 23 measles cases from September 1 to November 3, 2026, involving Peruvians and Brazilians, underscoring cross-border transmission risk and the need to prevent endemic re-establishment.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、アマゾナス州の麻疹対策に52万4千レアルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アマゾナス州で輸入麻疹症例の集積と越境伝播リスクがあり対策費が投入されているが、公衆衛生上の深刻度や国際的拡大の程度は不明な点が多い。
triage.notes: ペルー・コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジルのアマゾナス州での越境感染（ペルー人・ブラジル人双方の症例）が主題であり、記事はブラジル国内の対策費拠出が中心。

article.articleHeadline: Mato Grosso registra 94 mortes por síndrome respiratória no ano e apresenta crescimento associado à covid-19 - Só Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mato Grosso records 94 deaths from respiratory syndrome this year and shows growth associated with COVID-19 - Só Notícias.
article.articleSummary: Through January 31, 2026, Mato Grosso registered 2,165 Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases and 94 SRAG-related deaths, with surveillance noting a long-term growth trend driven mainly by COVID-19. The state ended 2025 with 368 SRAG deaths. Year-to-date, COVID-19–related SRAG accounted for 49 cases and 4 deaths; influenza 427 cases and 24 deaths; respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) 389 cases and 6 deaths; rhinovirus 231 cases and 8 deaths; other respiratory viruses 237 cases and 3 deaths; other etiologies 46 cases and 1 death; SRAG with unspecified cause 990 cases and 50 deaths; 198 cases under investigation. COVID-19–related SRAG shows >95% probability of six-week growth, though overall activity remains low risk. Nationally 7,204 deaths; MT ranks 16th; leaders São Paulo 1,526; Minas Gerais 1,063; Rio Grande do Sul 652. Fiocruz cites MT SRAG activity at alert/risk level, linked mainly to COVID-19.

triage.headline_ja: マットグロッソ州、今年の呼吸器症候群による死者94人を記録、COVID-19関連の増加傾向を示す
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マットグロッソ州の定期的な重症急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）サーベイランス報告であり、COVID-19・インフルエンザ・RSVなど複数病原体による通常の季節性動向を示すもので、異常な公衆衛生事象とは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事は定例の呼吸器症候群サーベイランスレポートであり、COVID-19関連SRAGの6週間成長確率は高いとされるが全体活動度は低リスクとされている。国内の通常の公衆衛生監視活動の範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: El peor brote de ébola de la historia de Congo supera los 11.000 casos confirmados y 5.300 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The worst Ebola outbreak in Congo's history has surpassed 11,000 confirmed cases and 5,300 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths, with about 2,990 recoveries, per the National Public Health Institute. Originating in Ituri in the northeast, the 17th Ebola outbreak was declared May 15 and has spread to seven provinces, mainly Ituri and North Kivu. WHO data through November 3 show Ituri with 7,485 cases and 3,532 deaths; North Kivu 2,593 cases and 1,422 deaths (province fatality 54.8%). In the last 21 days there were 1,463 new confirmed cases. Cases have appeared in Uganda, Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths), and Nigeria (1 imported); Uganda and France had outbreaks controlled by August. Bundibugyo, unlike Zaire, has no approved vaccines or treatments; Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus) will be tested in Congo in the Tumaini trial starting Oct 23 in Bunia with ring vaccination. Security issues, including attacks on a Lolwa health center and Fataki clashes, hinder the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ史上最悪のエボラ出血熱流行、確定症例11,000人・死者5,300人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最悪規模（11,042症例、5,387死亡、致死率54.8%）のエボラ流行で、複数国への拡大、承認済みワクチン・治療薬の不在、治安問題による対応の阻害が重なっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスへの症例拡大が報告されているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。Bundibugyo株には承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、Ervebo（Zaireエボラ用）のリングワクチン接種試験（Tumaini試験）がBuniaで10月23日より開始。治安悪化（Lolwa保健センター襲撃、Fataki衝突）が対応を妨げている点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en la RDC supera los 11 mil casos y los 5.300 muertos - La Prensa de Monagas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC surpasses 11,000 cases and 5,300 deaths - La Prensa de Monagas.
article.articleSummary: 11,042 confirmed Ebola infections and 5,387 deaths (case fatality rate 48.8%) were reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of November 9, with 2,990 recoveries and 651 patients hospitalized or in isolation. The outbreak, declared May 15 in the DRC, remains centered in the eastern Ituri province (epicenter) which accounts for 57.7% of new cases, followed by North Kivu at 32.7% on Nov 9. It spans 67 health zones across eight provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, South Kivu, Ubangui du Sud, and Ubangui du Nord. Contact tracing is 79.7% complete. Cases have emerged across East, Central, and Western Africa, representing the largest geographic extent of any Ebola outbreak in Africa to date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、感染者1万1千人・死者5,300人を超える - La Prensa de Monagas
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、11,000例超・死者5,300人超の大規模流行で8州67保健地区に拡大し、アフリカ史上最大の地理的拡がりを示しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）における既知の大規模エボラ流行の最新集計を報じたもの。モザンビークや中央アフリカ地域はBluedotの発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文で言及されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Idoso de 73 anos morre com suspeita de febre maculosa em Mimoso do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 73-year-old man dies with suspected Brazilian spotted fever in Mimoso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: 73-year-old man from the Ponte do Itabapoana district in Mimoso do Sul, southern Espírito Santo, Brazil, died on Monday (Nov 9) with suspected Brazilian spotted fever (febre maculosa). He reported a tick bite and presented with high fever, headache, dizziness, diarrhea, and vomiting. Initial diagnoses included dengue and acute sinusitis; blood samples were collected and sent for laboratory testing, with results expected in about seven days. Mimoso do Sul has recorded three Brazilian spotted fever cases this year, including two deaths: a 12-year-old girl in July and a 24-year-old woman in April. As of the last epidemiological bulletin (Saturday, Nov 7), 69 cases had been notified with 24 still under investigation. The star tick is the vector; reservoirs include capybaras and horses. Authorities intensified health information, training of professionals, and tick collection; state health department (Sesa) was contacted for comment.

triage.headline_ja: ミモゾ・ド・スル市で73歳の男性がブラジル紅斑熱疑いで死亡
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部エスピリトサント州の一地域で紅斑熱（ロッキー山紅斑熱）による死亡例が続いているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクはなく、現時点では地域的な風土病の流行として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ブラジル紅斑熱（febre maculosa）はマダニ媒介性のリケッチア感染症で、ブラジル国内では既知の風土病。今年同地域で3例（うち死亡2例）が確認されており、今回が疑い例として4例目。地域当局が情報提供や専門家訓練、マダニ採取などの対策を強化している。デング熱は初期誤診断として言及されているのみで、主題はブラジル紅斑熱。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Balangan Gencar Deteksi Dini TBC, Kali Ini Sasar Warga Desa Muara Jaya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Balangan Health Office Intensifies TB Early Detection, This Time Targets Muara Jaya Village Residents
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, Balangan Regency in South Kalimantan intensifies tuberculosis (TB) early detection through field tracing integrated with the Free Health Check (CKG) program, focusing on Muara Jaya village in Awayan district. The initiative seeks to identify TB cases at the outset to curb transmission and expedite medical care. Prioritized groups include household contacts of TB patients, individuals with diabetes mellitus, children with growth or developmental issues, and the elderly. In addition to TB screening, the activities provide education on infectious diseases and offer free health services such as blood glucose and cholesterol checks. Those meeting medical indicators are offered chest X-ray, except children under 10. Local officials welcome the door-to-door approach, hoping it reduces pediatric TB and raises awareness of regular health monitoring in Muara Jaya.

triage.headline_ja: バランガン保健局、結核早期発見を強化 今回はムアラ・ジャヤ村住民を対象
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核早期発見プログラムの一環であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 地元保健局による日常的なTB早期発見・啓発活動の報道であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため対象国リストへの該当なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: Strengthen India's preparedness against emerging viral threats: ICAR scientist
article.articleSummary: ICAR Deputy Director General (Education) Yashpal Singh Malik in New Delhi urged stronger preparedness against emerging viral threats through diagnostics, forecasting, indigenous vaccines and surveillance. Speaking at VIROCON 2026, organized by the Indian Virological Society in collaboration with ICAR-CTCRI in Thiruvananthapuram, Malik called for greater convergence among virology institutions to boost innovation and self-reliance in line with Viksit Bharat and Atmanirbhar Bharat. He stressed reliable, validated data before publication and prioritized human-resource development via interdisciplinary training. Referencing avian influenza outbreaks and the COVID-19 pandemic, he highlighted India's capabilities in pathogen identification and disease modelling, including work from the ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases. ICAR-CTCRI director G. Byju urged collaboration; Kerala Agricultural University Vice-Chancellor T. Sajitha Rani was guest of honour. The three-day conference concludes on Friday, with participants from across India, organized with ICAR-National Research Centre for Banana, Institute of Advanced Virology and Indian Society for Root Crops.

triage.headline_ja: 新興ウイルス脅威に対するインドの備えを強化せよ：ICAR科学者
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な感染症の発生事例ではなく、学術会議における研究者の提言・啓発的発言であり、公衆衛生上の緊急対応を要する事象ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は学術会議（VIROCON 2026）での講演内容に関するもので、鳥インフルエンザやCOVID-19は過去の事例として言及されているのみ。実際の新規感染症発生イベントではないため対象国なし。

article.articleHeadline: Varian Covid-19 PJ.2.1 Mulai Menyebar, Ini Cara Mencegah Penularannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 Variant PJ.2.1 Has Begun to Spread; Here's How to Prevent Its Transmission.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 variant PJ.2.1 has begun spreading beyond its origin, first detected in Canada in May 2026 and subsequently found in the United States, Australia, Singapore, and Spain; the WHO is monitoring its geographic expansion as of November 11, 2026. There is no evidence PJ.2.1 causes more severe disease, but symptoms can resemble a cold or influenza, risking undetected transmission. Diagnostic testing remains the most reliable method to confirm SARS-CoV-2 infection and guide isolation. Vaccination remains protective; a study published in the Journal of Infection in October 2026 found no substantial antibody escape from vaccines updated for prior variants. PJ.2.1 is descended from lineage JN.1 with spike mutations linked to higher ACE2 interaction and higher cell-entry efficiency in some lab tests, though not proven to worsen disease. Public health guidance: maintain vaccination per age/condition, avoid close contact when ill, limit outdoor activities when symptomatic, and follow official health updates. Dr. Amit Saraf, Jupiter Hospital, Thane, India, emphasizes that faster spread does not imply higher severity.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19変異株PJ.2.1が拡大開始、その予防法とは
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1が複数国に拡大しWHOが監視しているが、重症度増加のエビデンスはなく、現時点では緊急対応を要する兆候に乏しいため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はカナダ・米国・豪州・シンガポール・スペインでの拡大を主題としており、インドは医師コメントの引用元に過ぎず発生国ではないため対象国として含めない。重症化の証拠なしとされているため緊急度は低いが、変異株の国際拡大状況は今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Circa două mii de cazuri noi de Ebola, raportate în Congo de la mijlocul lunii octombrie - ipn.md
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Approximately two thousand new Ebola cases reported in Congo since mid-October
article.articleSummary: New Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reaches about 11,000 total cases, with nearly 2,000 new infections reported since mid-October 2026. The Ministry of Health deems it the country's most severe Ebola outbreak. Ituri Province accounts for roughly 70% of cases, while North Kivu has become the main site of new infections. Escalating violence in these regions impedes healthcare access, and authorities urge an end to clashes. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo strain); there is currently no vaccine or specific treatment for this variant. Schools in Ituri, notably Bunia, report disruptions as teachers and students fall ill, triggering calls for psychological support. Declared mid-May, the epidemic continues to expand; internationally, nearly half of infected individuals have died. Cases have appeared in Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria, highlighting cross-border transmission. Globally, this is the second-largest outbreak after West Africa 2014-2016 (approximately 28,000 cases, over 11,000 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで10月中旬以降、約2000件のエボラ新規症例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が継続し、致死率約50%、国境を越えた伝播（ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア）も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境症例も言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株による流行であり、紛争地域での医療アクセス困難も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: The Plague Still Lives in the West and the CDC Says Keep Pets off Your Bed
article.articleSummary: Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, persists globally and is mainly transmitted by fleas (Xenopsylla cheopis) that infest wild rodents. Humans contract via infected fleas, direct contact with infected animals or their tissues, or inhalation of droplets; pets can bring infected fleas indoors. The 'blocked flea' mechanism—biofilm buildup in a flea gut causes starvation and repeated biting—drives transmission. Globally, plague exists on all continents except Australia and Antarctica; WHO reports about 551 suspected and 378 confirmed cases annually, mostly from Africa (DR Congo, Madagascar). The last large outbreak was Madagascar in 2017 with 2,348 cases. In the U.S., about five human cases per year, all in the West: states west of the 100th meridian (e.g., MT, WY, CO, NM, AZ, CA, OR, WA, NV, ID, UT, TX, ND, SD, NE, KS, OK). No vaccine in the U.S.; early antibiotics are effective. Prevention: avoid handling wildlife, fleas, and keep pets from beds.

triage.headline_ja: ペストは今も米国西部に存在、CDCはペットをベッドに入れないよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 特定の新規アウトブレイクではなく、米国西部における既知の風土病的ペストに関する一般的な啓発記事であり、トリアージ基準に該当する特異な公衆衛生事象は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事は米国西部におけるペストの季節性・地理的背景とCDCの予防啓発に関する一般情報であり、DRCやマダガスカルは世界的統計の引用として言及されているのみで、具体的な新規アウトブレイクの主題ではないため対象国として含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Response in the DRC: Contact Tracing Gaps and the Role of Community Trust | Infection Control Today
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the largest ever there, with more than 10,000 cases in the DRC and 10,699 confirmed globally (as of Nov 4), 5,202 deaths, 2,905 recoveries, and a 48.6% case fatality rate across 5 countries (DRC, Kenya, Nigeria, Uganda, France). In the DRC, 8 provinces have reported cases, with South Ubangi and North Ubangi adding new activity since September; North Ubangi has 8 cases and 1 death, while South Ubangi reported 2 isolated cases (112 contacts identified). Transmission is widespread: North Kivu recent 7‑day total (232) nearly matches Ituri (207). A critical gap is contact tracing: only ~11% of confirmed cases are among known contacts over 25 weeks; 85% occur outside contact lists. DRC targets 95% daily follow-up, but rates hovered around 84% or less since Oct 24 (83.9% on Nov 3). Ituri maintains near 90% follow-up; North Kivu and Tshopo show weaker performance. Travel-related cases have emerged in Kenya and Nigeria, underscoring cross-border risk.

triage.headline_ja: DRCにおけるエボラ対応：接触者追跡のギャップとコミュニティの信頼の役割
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が継続しており、致死率約49%、複数国への越境拡大、接触者追跡率の低下など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスでの症例は渡航関連の二次拡大であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRC国内8州で症例報告、接触者追跡率の低下（約84%未満）が継続的な感染拡大リスクを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Meu exame deu positivo para mpox. E agora? | Letra de Médico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: My test came back positive for mpox. Now what? | Doctor's Letter
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox remains circulating in Brazil, with 832 cases and one death in 2026; Rio de Janeiro reports 196 cases through November. The Ministry of Health authorized up to 25,000 vaccine doses for SUS stocks. Most mpox infections are mild to moderate and resolve in 2–4 weeks. Transmission is mainly by direct contact with lesions and crusts, contaminated objects, or close exposure. Isolation ends only after all crusts have fallen and a new skin layer forms; fever relief or crust drying does not end isolation. Home isolation is feasible: use separate room and bathroom if possible, clean surfaces with soap and diluted bleach or 70% alcohol, cover lesions, avoid shared items, and ventilate. Contacts should be informed early; observe 21 days, and post-exposure vaccination (18–49, medium/high risk) within 4 days, up to 14 days, two-dose schedule 28 days apart. Vaccine access is limited to the public system; private supply is unavailable.

triage.headline_ja: 私の検査結果がmpox陽性でした。これからどうすればいい？｜医師の手紙
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでmpoxの継続流行があり（2026年832例、死亡1例）、保健省がワクチン25,000回分を承認するなど政府の対応が継続していることから、WPRO基準（持続曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当し、政府の関心も確認できるためPICKUPと判定した。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルにおけるmpox流行の継続状況と患者向け隔離指導を解説する医師コラムであり、新規の異常事態というより既知の流行継続報告に近い内容。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya : le dernier patient atteint d'Ebola rentré chez lui, 42 jours de vigilance dès le 12 novembre - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya: the last patient infected with Ebola has returned home, 42 days of vigilance starting November 12 - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: Kenya's last Bundibugyo virus disease patient was discharged on November 11, 2026, ending active infection in the country and triggering a 42-day vigilance countdown from November 12 to December 23, 2026 to determine if the outbreak is over. By November 11, the World Health Organization Africa reported no patients in treatment and no contacts in quarantine. The first Kenyan case was confirmed October 6 in a returnee from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda; Nairobi later identified an eighth case on October 18, and the last positive case was confirmed October 19, with two deaths in total. The WHO cautioned that vigilance must continue. Separately, the Democratic Republic of Congo remains in an active Ebola transmission phase, with about 11,000 confirmed cases and over 5,000 deaths as of November 11, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア：エボラ最後の患者が退院、11月12日から42日間の警戒期間へ - Mali Actu
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでの輸入エボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）症例が終息に向かう一方、感染源であるDRCでは約11,000人の確定症例と5,000人超の死者を伴う大規模な活動性アウトブレイクが継続しており、国際的拡大と重篤性の観点からフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入エボラ症例の終息だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは活動性アウトブレイクの具体的データ（約11,000症例、5,000超の死者）が明記されており、主題の一部として含めた。ウガンダも感染経路として言及されるが対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Lages intensifica prevenção à dengue após chuvas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lages intensifies dengue prevention after rains
article.articleSummary: Intense dengue prevention underway in Lages after severe rains, focusing on the Ferrovia, Habitação and Várzea neighborhoods hit by flooding. A municipal health task force conducts morning house-to-house inspections to identify and eradicate Aedes aegypti breeding sites, aiming to curb mosquito proliferation before the next reproductive cycle. The effort coincides with the National Dengue Fight Day on November 19, under directives from Mayor Carmen Zanotto and Health Secretary Rose Cristina Possato, emphasizing community participation. Residents are advised to eliminate standing water, manage post-flood debris, remove old tires and containers, check yards, gutters, and water tanks, and properly dispose of waste. The municipal health network also offers dengue vaccination for youths aged 10 to 14 years (11 years 11 months 29 days) with ID and immunization booklet. If symptoms—high fever, headache, muscle/joint pain, red rash—appear, seek care at the local Basic Health Unit for evaluation and hydration.

triage.headline_ja: ラージェス市、大雨後にデング熱予防を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防啓発・ワクチン接種案内に関する内容であり、異常な流行や重症例の報告はなく、IHR・WPRO基準への該当も確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事は洪水後のデング熱予防活動とワクチン接種案内が主題で、具体的な症例数や流行拡大の情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Mpox : 261 cas et deux décès enregistrés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Mpox: 261 cases and two deaths recorded.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in the Republic of the Congo: 261 cases, 2 deaths (case fatality rate 0.76%). More than 59% of infections involve men over 15. Eleven departments and thirteen health districts are affected, with Congo-Oubangui, Brazzaville, and Pointe-Noire among the hardest-hit; the Lumumba district of Brazzaville accounts for a substantial share of cases. Re-emerging since 2024 and again in 2026, Mpox remains a public health concern. Authorities intensified prevention, surveillance, and early case detection during a November 10 Brazzaville meeting with district health delegates and community volunteers. Challenges include lack of vaccines and medicines. Two laboratories are mobilized to analyze specimens from suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ共和国：Mpox（サル痘）261例、死亡2例を記録
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxの継続的な再興流行で複数県・地区に拡大し死亡例も発生、ワクチン・医薬品不足により国際支援が必要とされるためWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ共和国（Republic of the Congo、ブラザビル・ポワントノワール等）であり、対象国リストのDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）とは別国のため、verified_locationsは空とした。Bluedotの発生地域データにDRCが含まれるが記事本文では言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Andrographolide from Andrographis paniculata as a potential inhibitor of the novel malarial drug target PF11_0189: a comprehensive in silico approach
article.articleSummary: Global malaria deaths exceed 600,000 annually, with partial artemisinin resistance spreading across South and Southeast Asia, creating urgency for antimalarials with new mechanisms. PF11_0189, an essential Plasmodium falciparum M16 insulinase-family metallopeptidase lacking significant human homologs, is a pharmacologically underexploited target. Using ethnopharmacology from Northeast India—where Andrographis paniculata (Kalmegh) is repeatedly documented as antimalarial—the study deployed a multi-layered in silico pipeline to identify PF11_0189 inhibitors. Docking ten phytochemicals against decoys yielded andrographolide as the top hit (ROC-AUC 0.81; EF@1% 12.4; docking energy -8.4 kcal/mol, better than chloroquine at -6.9). Andrographolide shows a clean drug-likeness profile (zero Lipinski violations; non-HERG; non-P-gp substrate; PAINS/Brenk-negative) and, in three 100-ns MD runs, forms a stable complex (backbone RMSD < 2.5 Å) with binding energy -42.3 kJ/mol, anchored by five hotspot residues: Glu-203, Thr-89, Phe-116, Trp-214, Ser-112. This purely computational work, using an AlphaFold2 receptor, designates andrographolide as a prioritized, testable PF11_0189 inhibitor; wet-lab validation is still required.

triage.headline_ja: アンドログラフィス・パニキュラータ由来のアンドログラフォリドは新規マラリア創薬標的PF11_0189の潜在的阻害剤である：包括的インシリコアプローチ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は創薬を目的とした純粋な計算機（インシリコ）研究であり、実際の感染症発生事例の報告ではないため、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は創薬標的分子のドッキングシミュレーション研究であり、実際のマラリア発生・流行状況の報告ではない。インドの伝統医学（ネアンドログラフィス）に関する言及はあるが、実際の感染症イベントの発生地域情報ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: กรมควบคุมโรคเฝ้าระวัง คอตีบ ทั่วปท. หลังพบผู้ป่วยประปรายหลายพื้นที่
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Disease Control monitors diphtheria nationwide after sporadic cases detected in multiple areas.
article.articleSummary: Thailand's Department of Disease Control monitors diphtheria nationwide after sporadic cases; as of 9 November 2026 there are 61 suspected cases, male-to-female 1.14:1, ages 8 months to 82 years (median 18). The majority are children under 4. Eight deaths have occurred (case fatality 13%). Cases are reported across many provinces but are clustered in the southern border provinces and in Songkhla and Narathiwat; Narathiwat reports 10 cases, Songkhla 21 cases with 5 deaths (3 lab-confirmed). There is no evidence of a nationwide outbreak yet, but additional cases may appear, especially in communities with incomplete vaccination. Control measures include intensified surveillance, contact tracing, case finding, and stockpiling diphtheria antitoxin, plus vaccination campaigns in the south. Vaccination: 5-dose DTaP (2,4,6 months; boosters at 18 months and 4 years) and adult dT boosters. Seek medical care for sore throat or white-gray throat pseudomembranes; hotline 1422.

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健省疾病管理局、複数地域で散発的なジフテリア症例確認後、全国的に監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: ジフテリア疑い61例・死亡8例（致死率13%）が複数県で確認され、特に南部国境県（ソンクラー、ナラティワート）に集積。ワクチン未接種地域での拡大懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 南部国境県（ソンクラー・ナラティワート）でクラスター化。致死率13%は高く、ワクチン未接種率の高い地域での感染拡大リスクに注意。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は現時点で報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient, awaits disease-free status
article.articleSummary: Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient and began a 42-day countdown to be declared disease-free by December 23, with prevention measures to continue. Nine confirmed cases were traced to the first patient’s contacts; the last case was Oct 19, and there was no community transmission. The initial patient traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) through Uganda, infecting four family members and four healthcare workers; the patient and his mother died, while seven others recovered, and 135 contacts were identified. Regionally, the DRC remains the outbreak’s epicenter with 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths; Uganda and Nigeria were also affected. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain. Travel restrictions included Saudi Arabia’s visa suspension; Kenya tightened border controls and will require a 21-day quarantine for arrivals from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最後のエボラ患者を退院させ、感染症撲滅宣言を待つ
triage.triage_reason: DRCを震源とするエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダ・ケニアへ越境拡大し、サウジアラビアのビザ停止やケニアの検疫措置など渡航制限が発生しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの退院・経過観察に焦点を当てているが、ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・サウジアラビアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。震源地であるDRCのみverified_locationsに計上。DRC国内の感染者数(11,042人)・死者数(5,387人)は地域全体の大規模流行を示しており、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : en RDC, les violences et les déplacements entravent la lutte contre l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: in the DRC, violence and displacement hinder the fight against the epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) totals about 11,000 confirmed cases and more than 5,300 deaths as of November 11, 2026, in eight provinces. Violence against health workers and population displacement hinder the response. In Cantine-Aloya, North Kivu, attacks killed 66 people, including three clinicians, and three facilities were looted or burned. Over 1,000 contacts are no longer followed, and three infected patients remain untraceable. In Tshopo, a nurse was killed and another wounded near Ebola alerts, with gunfire near treatment centers. The virus travels along routes used by displaced people and traders; IOM reports 71 confirmed cases and 258 corpses intercepted on informal routes, amid a funding gap of about $60 million of the $110 million regional plan. In Kenya, the last patient has left hospital; nine cases, two deaths since a traveler from DRC; 135 contacts and eight secondary infections in quarantined individuals; 42-day surveillance could declare Ebola-free on Dec 23 if no new cases. Two experimental vaccines could join the trial; vaccines supplement but do not replace testing and health-worker protection. OMS urged lifting travel restrictions and sustaining funding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で、暴力と住民移動が感染拡大防止の取り組みを妨げている
triage.triage_reason: DRCで約11,000例・5,300人以上の死亡という大規模流行が継続し、医療従事者への暴力や住民の強制移動により対応が妨げられ、ケニアへの国際的拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニアへの越境事例も報告されているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。資金不足（1億1000万ドルの地域計画に対し約6000万ドル不足）が懸念事項として明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : deux nouveaux patients guéris quittent le CTE, les soignants appelés à la vigilance
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: two newly recovered patients leave the CTE, health workers urged to stay vigilant.
article.articleSummary: On 11 November 2026, two more Ebola patients were declared cured and discharged from the Ebola Treatment Center at Beni General Reference Hospital in Nord-Kivu. This lifts the three-day total recoveries to 22, following seven on 10 November and thirteen on 9 November. Dr. Jérémie Muhindo, head of the care pillar, attributed progress to intensified care and the addition of another drug to the treatment regimen. He urged health workers, especially frontline staff, to vaccinate, stay vigilant, and strictly observe prevention measures, noting that doctors, hygienists, and other health personnel are among those exposed; more than 100 have been infected to date. The recovered patients thanked medical teams and urged the public, particularly skeptics, to acknowledge Ebola’s reality, adhere to preventive measures, and seek medical care promptly if contaminated.

triage.headline_ja: ベニのエボラ流行：新たに回復した2名の患者がCTEを退所、医療従事者に警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州ベニで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する継続報道。感染者100名超、医療従事者への感染も確認されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を満たすためフルリスク評価が適切。
triage.notes: 進行中のエボラアウトブレイクの経過報告記事。感染者数（100名超、医療従事者含む）や回復者数の推移が示されており、既存の危機対応の継続状況を示す。国際的拡大や渡航制限への言及は記事中になし。

article.articleHeadline: Segunda escola de Vespasiano suspende aulas após casos de sarna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second school in Vespasiano suspends classes after cases of scabies.
article.articleSummary: In Vespasiano, in the Belo Horizonte metropolitan area, Escola Estadual Maria da Piedade Fonseca in Morro Alto suspended classes on November 11 after confirmed scabies cases, including a teacher. It is the second city school to pause activities that week; on November 9, Escola Municipal de Ensino Especial Vovó Mariquita suspended after one case. Three scabies cases have been confirmed in the municipality, with the third identified over the weekend in a student at Escola Municipal Josefina Alves Vieira; that school underwent cleaning and did not suspend. SEE-MG said the Maria da Piedade Fonseca suspension aims to allow cleaning and disinfection. The number of infected at that unit was not disclosed; staff, students and families were advised on prevention with the municipal Health Surveillance. Classes will resume after disinfection, and the paused days will be made up. Vovó Mariquita was expected to resume on November 12.

triage.headline_ja: ヴェスパシアーノ市内2校目、疥癬症例により授業を休止
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は軽症で局地的な学校内発生に留まり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当せず、国際的拡大や社会的関心の高まりも確認されない。
triage.notes: 疥癬はブラジルの一地方都市の学校施設内での限定的な感染事例であり、対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、発生国がBlueDotの対象国リストにある国（Brazil）であっても、本イベントは小規模・低リスクの学校内感染でありpickup対象外と判断。なお、ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、重大性が低いためDISMISSとした。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Covid sobem no país; conheça sintomas da cepa XFG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID cases rise nationwide; learn the symptoms of the XFG strain.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reported 118,851 COVID-19 cases in 2026 through Oct 31, with 3,479 severe cases and 437 deaths (provisional). Cases remain well below 2025 levels. COVID-19 is still low risk; vaccination remains the best protection against complications. The majority of sequenced samples are XFG, a subvariant of Omicron identified in 2025, with no evidence of greater severity. Common symptoms include sore throat, nasal congestion, hoarseness, and low fever; loss of smell/taste may occur but is less characteristic. Genomic surveillance shows XFG and lineages account for about 90% of sequences this year. A rising trend is noted across multiple states, including Alagoas, Bahia, Ceará, Distrito Federal, Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo. Paxlovid is available via SUS for mild/moderate at-risk cases with confirmed infection, to be started by day 5. Routine vaccination: 6 months–<5 years three-dose; 60+ semiannual; pregnant each gestation; immunocompromised semiannual; comorbidities annual.

triage.headline_ja: 国内でCOVID感染者数が増加；XFG株の症状を知る
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知の病原体で季節的増加に留まり、2025年水準を下回り、重症度増加の証拠もないため、通常のサーベイランス範囲内と判断。
triage.notes: 既知の変異株XFGによる季節的な感染者数増加で、重症度増加の証拠はなく、2025年水準を下回っているため低リスクと評価。

article.articleHeadline: أكثر من 11 ألف إصابة بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 11,000 Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, AFP citing the Democratic Republic of the Congo National Institute of Public Health reports 11,042 Ebola virus disease cases in the DRC, with 5,387 deaths and about 2,990 recoveries. The outbreak, officially declared on 15 May, is described as the worst in the country’s history, with a case-fatality rate of 48.8%. The virus has crossed borders, with infections in Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. Globally, this outbreak ranks as the second largest on record, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic that affected Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone, totaling more than 28,600 cases and over 11,000 deaths. The report underscores ongoing transmission and cross-border spillover risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱患者が11,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、1万人超の症例と国境を越えた感染拡大（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としており、2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行（ギニア、リベリア、シエラレオネ）は比較対象として言及されているのみで現時点の発生国ではない。ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへの越境感染が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: CHDC Congo ghi nhận hơn 11.000 ca mắc Ebola, gần một nửa tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC records more than 11,000 Ebola cases, nearly half have died.
article.articleSummary: DRC reports 11,042 Ebola cases and 5,387 deaths as of 11 November 2026, the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country's history, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The outbreak began in May and has spread fastest in Ituri and North Kivu, where renewed armed conflict and assaults on healthcare facilities hinder access to patients. Transportation and health-system crises, wage arrears, and strikes have paralysed several health facilities, with screening points along roads, at river ports and airports suspended. Misinformation fuels distrust, with people reluctant to undergo screening and comply with safe burial practices; violence against health workers has led to closures, including in Ituri. The WHO supports testing two vaccines—Oxford University/Serum Institute of India and Moderna—with trials led by the National Institute for Biomedical Research in collaboration with WHO. Early care, isolation, and contact tracing remain critical.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者1万1000人超、約半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%・1万人超の症例という歴史的規模のエボラ流行であり、武力紛争による医療アクセス阻害や医療従事者への暴力など公衆衛生・国際的拡大リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: WHOがワクチン試験（Oxford/SII、Moderna）を支援中。武力紛争・医療従事者への暴力・誤情報による検疫忌避が流行拡大の主要因。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hochansteckende Krankheit: Letzter Ebolapatient in Kenia aus Klinik entlassen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Highly Contagious Disease: Last Ebola Patient in Kenya Discharged from Hospital
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s last Ebola patient has been discharged, leaving nine total cases in the country with seven survivors; no secondary infections among contacts have been reported. Kenya could be declared Ebola-free after 42 days (two incubation cycles) without a new case, which would be December 23, 2026. The index case was registered on October 6; the man infected in the Democratic Republic of Congo traveled via Uganda to Kenya, where he died in hospital, and a family member who developed symptoms in mid-October died while under quarantine. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the outbreak across eight provinces remains uncontrolled, with more than 11,000 cases and about 5,400 deaths. A clinic there has admitted no new patients since May. No approved treatments or vaccines exist for the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain. The UN has appealed for international assistance.

triage.headline_ja: 高度感染症：ケニアの最後のエボラ患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で8州にまたがり11,000例以上・死亡約5,400人という大規模かつ制御不能なエボラ流行が継続しており、国連が国際支援を要請している。公衆衛生上重大な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニアおよびウガンダは越境・輸入症例の経路として言及されているが、両国とも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主要な流行地はコンゴ民主共和国であり、同国での制御不能な流行継続が主な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Covid cresce em 17 estados e no DF, e infectologista alerta: 'Nunca foi uma doença leve'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases rise in 17 states and in the Federal District, and an infectious disease specialist warns: "It has never been a mild disease."
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Brazil is rising for at least six weeks across 17 states and the Federal District, per the latest Ministry of Health epidemiological bulletin. Infectologist Luana Araújo notes that COVID-19, like other respiratory viruses, has a fluctuating incidence, and the current uptick is concerning even though there is no clear rise in severity compared with earlier waves. She cautions that COVID-19 has never been a mild disease and even seemingly mild cases can lead to significant sequelae. Emphasizing vaccination, she urges keeping shots up to date, especially for children, older adults, pregnant women, people with multiple comorbidities, and immunodeficiencies. Individuals in these groups should visit a basic health unit to verify missing vaccines on their record. The article underscores ongoing surveillance and public health messaging on vaccination and protection.

triage.headline_ja: コロナが17州と連邦区で増加、感染症専門医が警告：『これまで軽い病気だったことはない』
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19のブラジル国内での季節的な増加を報じるもので、重症度の明確な上昇は認められず、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも示されていないため、継続的な経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性の流行拡大に関する国内保健省報告に基づく記事であり、重症度上昇や新規変異株等の異常性は明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Brazilian Zika Virus Strain Selectively Suppresses Ndel1 Enzyme in Neonatal
article.articleSummary: Brazilian Zika virus strain (ZIKVBR) selectively suppresses Ndel1 (nudE neurodevelopment protein 1 like 1) oligopeptidase activity in the neonatal brain, in contrast to an African Zika lineage (ZIKVAF) and dengue virus (DENV), in a neonatal Swiss mouse intracerebroventricular infection model. Early post-infection (postnatal day 3 and 7) shows significant Ndel1 activity reduction only in ZIKVBR-infected brains; Ndel1 mRNA remains unchanged at day 3 and only declines by day 7, indicating post-transcriptional regulation before transcriptional downregulation. Neuroinflammation occurs with both ZIKVBR and ZIKVAF, yet enzyme suppression is exclusive to ZIKVBR, demonstrating that inflammatory signaling alone does not trigger Ndel1 loss. The strain-specific Ndel1 impairment parallels ZIKVBR’s microcephaly capacity, identifying a mechanistic, early molecular event of viral neurodevelopmental injury in the neonatal brain.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル株ジカウイルスが新生児マウスのNdel1酵素を選択的に抑制
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究論文であり、実際の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事は実験動物モデルを用いた分子生物学的研究報告であり、実際のジカウイルスやデング熱の流行・発生事例を扱ったものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya, guariti tutti i pazienti affetti dal virus ebola - Medicina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya, all patients infected with the Ebola virus have recovered - Medicine
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms all Ebola patients recovered after nine cases (two deaths) with no evidence of community transmission. The last patient was discharged today, initiating a 42-day countdown required to officially declare the outbreak over. Seven survivors have recovered; the 11 contacts quarantined have completed monitoring. Health Minister Aden Duale announced the update. The outbreak originated from an imported case—a Kenyan citizen returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda—after which all subsequent infections were traced to the original transmission chain. No further community spread was detected. The final case was confirmed on 19 October, and Kenya expects to end the epidemic after the 42-day monitoring period concludes.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラウイルス感染患者全員が回復
triage.triage_reason: エボラという重大疾患の案件だが、本記事はケニアでの限定的アウトブレイク（輸入症例由来、二次感染なし）の収束報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。疾患の特性上、続報として経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのエボラアウトブレイク収束であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれない。DRC・ウガンダは感染源・経由地として言及されているのみで、当該国でのアウトブレイク発生ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemie - Letzter Ebola-Patient in Kenia als geheilt aus Krankenhaus entlassen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemic - Last Ebola patient in Kenya discharged from hospital as cured.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports the last Ebola patient cured; the seven remaining survivors were discharged in Nairobi, with no secondary infections among their contacts and quarantine lifted. Kenya's outbreak total stood at nine Ebola cases, with two deaths, leaving seven survivors. The Ebola outbreak in Kenya is now closed domestically, following the discharge of the final patient. Separately, the ongoing Ebola outbreak in Africa began with mid-May official identification in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and the World Health Organization calls it the worst Ebola epidemic in the DRC’s history, with more than 11,000 infections and over 5,300 deaths. This update was broadcast on 11 November 2026 by Deutschlandfunk.

triage.headline_ja: エピデミック - ケニアで最後のエボラ患者が治癒し退院
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主眼はケニアでの流行終息という既に収束した事案だが、同時に言及されているDRCでのエボラ流行は依然として進行中で深刻（11,000例超・5,300人超死亡）であり、継続した経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ケニアでのエボラ流行は9症例・2死亡で終息済み（ケニアは対象国リスト外のため除外）。一方でDRCの流行はWHOが史上最悪と評価する規模で継続中であり、この部分は対象国として記録。本記事自体に新規の進展情報はなく、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak crosses 11,000 cases: Should India worry as the deadly virus spreads beyond Congo? What we need to know
article.articleSummary: DRC Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak has reached 11,021 confirmed cases and 5,358 deaths as of November 8, 2026, the second-largest on record and the DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak. It crossed 1,000 cases within 40 days of the response, much faster than the 2018 outbreak. Strained health services, scarce diagnostic labs and protective gear, and ongoing conflict hinder contact tracing; healthcare workers have been infected, and distrust hampers community engagement. There have been small cross-border exports: Kenya reports nine cases traced to a traveler via Uganda (with other cases among relatives and quarantined health workers; no community spread); Nigeria one case; France one case. Uganda and France now show no active cases. India currently has no reported cases, though cross-border movement keeps risk alive; the US restricts entry for recent DRC travelers and screens others. Transmission is by direct contact with blood or bodily fluids; not airborne. Symptoms include fever, weakness, muscle pain, headache, and bleeding; seek prompt medical care after travel.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生が11,000例を超える：コンゴ以外に感染が拡大する中、インドは懸念すべきか？知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がアフリカ史上2番目の規模（11,021例、死亡5,358例）に達し、ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスへの越境感染も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスへの越境症例が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インドは記事見出しで言及されるが、本文で『現時点で症例なし』と明記されているため発生国として含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya's last Ebola patient leaves hospital
article.articleSummary: Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient in Nairobi, leaving nine confirmed cases in a single transmission cluster with no community transmission. Eleven contacts are under supervision, and 135 contacts linked to the index case were traced and monitored, with a 21-day quarantine for the final patient’s contacts. Kenya could be declared Ebola-free on 23 December if no symptoms appear by then. The first case, reported on 6 October, involved a Kenyan man who had recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo; seven patients recovered and two died. DR Congo’s ongoing outbreak, which began in May, has reached about 11,000 cases and 5,387 deaths, making it the country’s deadliest Ebola outbreak. Nigeria reported one imported case from a traveler from Uganda, forming a small cluster.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアの最後のエボラ患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: 記事はケニアの回復状況を中心に報じているが、DRCで進行中のエボラ流行が約11,000症例・5,387人死亡に達し同国史上最も致死的な流行となっていることが述べられており、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生影響が認められるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアの退院患者だが、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは本文で詳細に言及される進行中の大規模流行（史上最悪）であり、対象国として記録すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Rio teve aumento de casos de Mpox na primeira semana de novembro | Band
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro saw an increase in Mpox cases in the first week of November | Band
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) cases rise in Rio de Janeiro in the first week of November, with 282 confirmed infections reported by the morning of November 11. The Municipal Epidemiological Panel notes a 196% increase over all 2025 cases. October saw the year's peak with 136 records; one death occurred in Cosmos, in the West Zone. About 23% of cases are in Zona Sul, with Copacabana, Botafogo, and Flamengo streets among the most affected areas; officials cite higher tourist flow as a possible driver. Mpox is a viral infection transmitted by contact, causing fever, headache, and skin lesions; severe cases occur in immunocompromised individuals. Despite the surge, the City Health Department says current numbers remain below levels seen four years ago during the emergency. Vaccination resumed Friday November 6, after more than 2,000 doses from the Ministry of Health, targeted at people living with HIV.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ、11月第1週にMpox症例が増加 | Band
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロで2025年通年比196%増という異常な増加率が報告され、死亡例・免疫不全者の重症化も確認されており、ワクチン再開など公的対応も行われているためフルRRAでの確認が妥当。
triage.notes: 観光客流入が感染拡大の一因とされており、国際的な人の移動との関連が示唆されるが、国境を越えた拡大の直接的証拠は記事内に無い。保健省からのワクチン提供はあるが国際支援の必要性は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient, begins 42-day countdown
article.articleSummary: Kenya discharges its last Ebola patient, triggering a 42-day monitoring countdown ending December 23, 2026, to declare the country Ebola-free if no new infections arise. Health Minister Aden Duale said the final patient recovered after a nine-case outbreak that began with an index case who arrived from the Democratic Republic of Congo through Uganda in October. Of the nine infections, the first patient and his mother died; seven infected persons recovered, including four healthcare workers. A total of 135 contacts were traced and completed the mandatory monitoring without developing the disease. The countdown, twice the longest Ebola incubation period, will run unless new cases are reported, with ongoing surveillance and preventive measures to prevent further transmission. Regionally, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports over 11,000 infections and more than 5,000 deaths, underscoring the outbreak context.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最後のエボラ患者を退院させ、42日間のカウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCを起源としウガンダ経由でケニアに越境伝播したエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、DRCでは11,000人超の感染・5,000人超の死亡という大規模な地域流行が継続している深刻な事例。
triage.notes: ケニアとウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは地域的な大規模アウトブレイク（11,000人超感染、5,000人超死亡）の文脈として記事内で明示的に言及されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola cobra miles de vidas en RD del Congo y alcanza una letalidad del 48,8 % | TN8
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola claims thousands of lives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and reaches a case fatality rate of 48.8% | TN8.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, with 11,042 cases and 5,387 deaths as of November 9, a case-fatality rate of 48.8%. About 2,990 have recovered, and 651 are hospitalized or in isolation; contact tracing stands at 79.7%. Ituri and North Kivu provinces bear the heaviest burden, with 57.7% and 32.7% of new infections on November 9. Declared May 15, the outbreak has spread to 67 health zones across eight of the 26 provinces, the widest geographic spread in Africa to date. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC and the second-deadliest globally after 2014–2016 West Africa. Challenges include late detection, conflict, and overwhelmed health services; many deaths occur outside treatment centers. The Bundibugyo strain has no specific treatment; WHO supports vaccines, and DRC began August vaccination with Ervebo for Zaire ebolavirus. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever and hemorrhagic manifestations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で数千人の命を奪い、致死率48.8％に達する | TN8
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行は致死率48.8%、11,042症例、5,387死亡に達し、8州67保健地域に拡大するアフリカ史上最大級の地理的広がりを見せており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 本流行は2014-2016年西アフリカ流行に次ぐ世界第2位の致死規模であり、紛争・医療体制逼迫・検知遅延が課題。WHOとDRC当局によるErvebo（ザイールエボラウイルス用）ワクチン接種が8月より開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: У Кенії виписали останнього пацієнта з Еболою -- Deutsche Welle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kenya, the last patient with Ebola was discharged — Deutsche Welle.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, Kenya discharged the last Ebola patient from a Nairobi hospital, leaving 11 contacts under 21-day quarantine. The health ministry reported 135 contacts traced; all nine confirmed infections belong to a single transmission chain with no documented spread to the wider population. If no new symptomatic cases emerge by 23 December, Kenya will be declared Ebola-free. The initial Kenyan case was registered 6 October in a man who had recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo; seven of the nine patients recovered and two died. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the current Ebola outbreak, which began in May, has surpassed 11,000 cases and 5,387 deaths, a figure described as the deadliest on record. One imported case was also reported in Nigeria in a traveler from Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラの最後の患者が退院 ― ドイチェ・ヴェレ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ流行は11,000例超・死者5,387人と史上最悪規模に達しており、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境伝播も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのエボラ患者退院だが、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCの流行は史上最悪規模（11,000例超、死者5,387人）であり対象国として該当するためverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Blood tests for a deadly infection have a lingering blind spot
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis in northeast Thailand: 142 hospitalized patients confirmed with Burkholderia pseudomallei; 9 deaths; median age 54; 99 men; 98 with diabetes. Blood antibody tests show long-lasting responses after illness: IgA against Hcp1 and OPS markers persist 597–710 days; IgG markers persist 902–1080 days. Among 52 retested after about one year, 30–34 remained positive, illustrating that positive antibody results can reflect past exposure rather than active infection. Culture confirmation from blood or samples takes at least two days and may miss cases; safety steps can complicate diagnosis. Hospitals in Mukdahan, Roi-Et, and Surin studied 656 samples with 76 healthy controls. Globally, melioidosis is linked to soil and water; B. pseudomallei persists in the environment. Mississippi investigations found three patients from the same county and the same strain in local soil and water, signaling continental US presence. Rapid, accurate diagnosis remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: 致死的感染症の血液検査に残る死角
triage.triage_reason: タイ東北部のメリオイドーシス（類鼻疽）に関する診断検査の研究記事であり、新規の集団発生や異常事態を報告するものではなく、既知の風土病に関する学術的知見の紹介に留まる。
triage.notes: 本記事は血清学的診断法の限界（抗体陽性が既往感染を反映し得る点）を論じる研究報告であり、タイのムクダハン・ロイエット・スリン県の既存入院患者データ（142例、9死亡）を後ろ向きに分析したもの。類鼻疽はタイ東北部で風土病として知られており、新規アウトブレイクの兆候ではない。米国ミシシッピ州の事例も既存の土壌・水系定着確認であり、対象国リストに該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: കോംഗോയിൽ എബോള ബാധിതർ 11,000 കടന്നു; മരണം 5,387
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo exceed 11,000; deaths 5,387.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to surge: 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths, with about half of those infected dying. It is the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DR Congo’s history. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is responsible, spreading across eight of the country’s 26 provinces, with Ituri and North Kivu being the epicenters. Approximately 70% of cases are in Ituri, though new infections are higher in North Kivu. No approved vaccine or treatment is available; experimental vaccines and therapies are under trial. Ongoing conflict, weak health systems, misinformation, and attacks on health facilities impede detection, isolation, and care. The outbreak’s reach extends to Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. By comparison, the 2014–16 West Africa outbreak affected about 28,000 people and killed over 11,000; Congo’s early months show infection and death counts more than three times those levels.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者が11,000人を突破、死者5,387人
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続しており、致死率約50%、ワクチン未承認、複数国への拡大リスクがあるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Ituri州・北キブ州が流行の中心であり、いずれもDRC国内のためDRCとして集約。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの波及は言及されているが、具体的な症例確認かは記事からは不明。対象国リストに該当しないアンゴラ・ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアは除外。

article.articleHeadline: Piauí registra queda de 95,4% nos casos de Covid-19 em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piauí records a 95.4% drop in COVID-19 cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Piauí, Brazil, fell 95.4% in 2026 with 154 confirmed cases (2025: 3,362) and deaths down 89.3% to 3 (two in Teresina, one in Parnaíba). The number of municipalities with cases dropped from 143 in 2025 to 40 in 2026. In Teresina, cases declined 93.2% to 60; Parnaíba 11 (from 135); Piripiri 15 (from 53). Six municipalities reported increased notifications, including Monsenhor Gil (14→15) and Pavussu (1→3). Vaccination is cited as a protective factor, with Teresina vaccination contributing to reductions; authorities urge continued vaccination, vaccination status checks, and health-unit access. While COVID-19 cases decreased, rhinovirus rose 173% (63→172) and influenza rose ~51% (112→170) in Teresina, likely linked to viral mutations. Seasonal flu vaccination is available; COVID-19 vaccines remain targeted to recommended groups, and updates are advised for those with prior doses.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州、2026年のCOVID-19症例が95.4%減少
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19症例・死亡数とも大幅減少という内容であり、インフルエンザ・ライノウイルスの増加も季節性の範囲内で深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はCOVID-19症例・死亡の減少傾向を報告する統計的な内容であり、インフルエンザ・ライノウイルスの増加も地域内の季節性変動として言及されているのみでアラートの必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Tem mosquito aí? Fumacê percorre a região do Parati
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Are there mosquitoes there? Fogging sweeps through the Parati region.
article.articleSummary: Fogging (fumacê) using ultra-low-volume insecticide is set to operate in the Parati neighborhood of Campo Grande on Wednesday, 2026-11-11, from 16:00 to 22:00, to curb transmission of Aedes aegypti, the mosquito that carries dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Conducted by the Municipal Health Secretariat (Sesau) with the Vector Endemics Control Coordination (CCEV), the campaign targets adult mosquitoes, including females—the primary transmitters of these diseases. Households should keep doors and windows open to maximize coverage. The spray may affect non-target species and is contingent on favorable weather; rain, wind, or fog can lead to delays or cancellation. The effort reflects ongoing vector-control measures in Campo Grande to reduce dengue, Zika, and chikungunya outbreaks, with emphasis on local community participation and adherence to timing guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊はいるか？パラチ地区で消毒用煙霧（フマセ）が実施される
triage.triage_reason: 通常の蚊媒介感染症予防のための定期的な防除活動の告知であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・カンポグランデ市での定例的な蚊防除（フォギング）活動の案内記事であり、具体的な感染者数や症例急増の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Health dept asks residents to be cautious of spread of mosquito-borne diseases in Kochi
article.articleSummary: Intermittent rains in Kochi prompt the district health department to warn residents about an increased risk of dengue. The Aedes mosquito, which transmits dengue, breeds in clean water that stagnates in plastic containers, bottles, tyres, coconut shells, flowerpots and other water-collecting vessels around homes and institutions. After rain, water stagnation is more likely, raising mosquito density; authorities urge weekly inspections to locate and destroy breeding sources. Preventive actions include keeping water storage vessels tightly closed and draining and cleaning them weekly. To reduce bites, residents should use mosquito nets, apply repellents, and wear clothing that fully covers the body. If fever, severe body pain, headache, or pain behind the eyes occurs, seek care promptly at a health center or hospital rather than self-medicating, as dengue could be a concern.

triage.headline_ja: コーチの保健部門、蚊媒介感染症の拡大に注意するよう住民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の予防啓発に関する定例的な注意喚起記事であり、具体的な症例数や異常な流行の報告はないため、現時点でピックアップ基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: デング熱の季節的な予防啓発記事であり、具体的な感染者数や異常な流行拡大の記述はない。地方自治体レベルの通常の公衆衛生対応として扱われる。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde de Guarulhos fará ações educativas e de conscientização durante semana de prevenção à dengue - Click Guarulhos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guarulhos Health Department will carry out educational and awareness-raising actions during Dengue Prevention Week - Click Guarulhos
article.articleSummary: Guarulhos Health Department will run a Dengue Prevention Week from 14 to 19 November 2026 to educate residents on eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites that transmit dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Activities include the puppet show 'Teatro da Belinha contra a Dengue' for children at CEUs, information tents, life-cycle displays, and larval samples at local fairs, plus pamphlets and outreach by health agents. The kick-off is 14 November at GRU Cidadania—CIC Guarulhos (Estrada do Capão Bonito, 53). The program then moves to CEU Pimentas on 16 November and continues 17–19 November at CEUs Bonsucesso and Continental, with corresponding free-market activities at Avenida Mem de Sá, Praça dos Aviadores, and Rua Juarez Távora. Residents are urged to remove water-collecting objects to prevent mosquito breeding and reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: グアルリョス保健局、デング熱予防週間中に啓発・教育活動を実施へ
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染拡大や症例増加の報告ではなく、通常の予防啓発キャンペーンに関する行政広報であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱予防週間の教育活動に関する地方自治体広報であり、具体的な症例数・流行状況の報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO aktivovala nejvyšší krizový stupeň kvůli super El Niñu. Hrozí vedra, potravinová krize a infekční nemoci
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO has activated the highest emergency level due to the Super El Niño. Heatwaves, a food crisis and infectious diseases threaten.
article.articleSummary: WHO has activated its highest internal crisis level (Grade 3) to address health risks linked to Super El Niño, enabling broad resource mobilization without declaring a PHEIC. The WMO expects Niño 3.4 sea-surface temperature anomalies up to 3.8°C above normal from November 2026 to January 2027, peaking late November through December. Extreme heat is the primary threat, with a Climate Impact Lab estimate of up to 451,000 excess deaths June 2026–February 2027, most in Nigeria, Indonesia and Sudan. Acute hunger could threaten 274 million people by 2027, up from 225 million. El Niño shifts disease dynamics: drought-prone regions include Central America, southern Caribbean, the Amazon and southern Africa; heavy rains threaten East Africa, the southern United States, Ecuador, Peru and southern Brazil. Floods and poor sanitation raise cholera risk; malaria, dengue and Zika transmission are affected; coastal Bangladesh faces rising salinity promoting pathogens. Initial funding needs ~$35 million; CERF has released >$50 million for 11 countries.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、スーパーエルニーニョによる最高レベルの危機対応を発動。熱波・食料危機・感染症の脅威
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクの実際の発生報告ではなく、エルニーニョに伴う将来的な感染症リスク（コレラ・マラリア・デング・ジカ等）の予測・懸念を扱う気候関連記事であるため、継続的な情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はWHOによるエルニーニョ関連の気候危機対応発表であり、特定疾患の現在発生中のアウトブレイク報告ではない。Brazil・Indonesiaは将来リスク予測の文脈で言及されているのみで、実際の感染症発生事例の記述ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Više od 11.000 slučajeva ebole u Demokratskoj Republici Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 11,000 Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports Ebola outbreak surpassing 11,000 cases. As of 11 November 2026, confirmed infections total 11,042 with 5,387 deaths. The outbreak is linked to a rare Ebola virus strain and was declared in mid-May. Kinshasa cites government data and Reuters confirmation. The numbers indicate sustained transmission and ongoing public health challenge in the DRC. No further details on transmission routes, geographic spread within the country, or laboratory confirmation are provided beyond the counts and the designation of a rare strain. The situation remains under surveillance with continued monitoring of cases and fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱患者が11,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、11,000人超の感染者が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 5月中旬の宣言以降、死者5,387人・致死率約49%と非常に高く、希少株とされる点も懸念材料。感染経路や地理的拡大の詳細は記事内で不明。

article.articleHeadline: ŠIRI SE ZARAZA U KONGU: Više od 11.000 slučajeva ebole, preminulo preko 5.000 ljudi!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading in Congo: More than 11,000 Ebola cases, over 5,000 people have died!
article.articleSummary: As of November 11, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 11,042 confirmed infections and 5,387 deaths. The outbreak, declared in mid-May 2026, is caused by a rare Ebola virus strain for which no vaccines are approved. Delayed detection, ongoing conflict, and an overburdened health system have allowed the virus to spread more rapidly than in previous epidemics. The disease is now reported across Eastern, Central, and Western Africa, marking the largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded on the African continent. The absence of a vaccine for this strain complicates response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、感染拡大：感染者1万1000人超、死者5000人超！
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ大陸史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、致死率約49%、ワクチン未承認、紛争下で医療体制崩壊という複合的な深刻事態であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事では東部・中部・西部アフリカに拡大と記載されているが、具体的な国名はDRCのみ明示されており、対象国リスト内の他国への拡大は確認できない。ワクチン未承認の希少株であることが対応を一層困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Varginha e São Thomé das Letras monitoram casos de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Varginha and São Thomé das Letras monitor cases of human scabies.
article.articleSummary: By 10 November, 40 scabies cases were reported in the Southern Minas region: Varginha 24 cases across five schools and São Thomé das Letras 16 cases. In Varginha, the municipal health secretariat imposed five days of absence for diagnosed children and three days for adults to interrupt transmission, with no school closures required. Transmission is via direct prolonged skin-to-skin contact and sharing of personal items such as clothing, towels, and bed linens; intense itching, especially at night, is the characteristic symptom. Basic Health Units are stocked and prepared to assess cases and provide prescribed treatment. Outreach and training for schools have been ongoing since late October. Authorities urge individuals with symptoms to seek the nearest health unit, avoid self-medication, and households with diagnosed members to be evaluated and maintain frequent hygiene of personal items.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァルジーニャとサントメ・ダス・レトラスで人疥癬の症例を監視
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は国際的に懸念される重篤な感染症ではなく、地域の学校での局地的な発生に留まり、自治体レベルで管理可能であるため。
triage.notes: 地域の保健当局が対応しており、学校閉鎖も不要な軽微な事案。国際的な公衆衛生上のリスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Discharges Last Ebola Patient, Begins 42-Day Countdown
article.articleSummary: Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient and launched a 42-day countdown to be declared disease-free, with prevention measures maintained through December 23. The nine confirmed Ebola cases linked to the first patient, who travelled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo via Uganda, infected four family members and four healthcare workers; the patient and his mother died, while seven others recovered. Authorities identified 135 contacts and found no community transmission, as all cases were traceable to the initial contact list. Regionally, the Bundibugyo-strain outbreak in the DRC has infected 11,042 and killed 5,387, with spillover to Uganda and Nigeria, described as among the worst outbreaks on record. Saudi Arabia imposed an indefinite visa suspension for Kenyan workers on Oct 30; Kenya tightened border controls, implemented a dedicated airport gate, thermal screening, health declarations, and a 21-day quarantine for arrivals from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最後のエボラ患者を退院させ42日間のカウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,042人感染・5,387人死亡という記録的規模のエボラアウトブレイクがあり、ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡散、サウジアラビアによる渡航制限（ビザ停止）も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生したBundibugyo株エボラの大規模アウトブレイクとケニアへの波及事例。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・サウジアラビアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのアウトブレイクは既知のため続報・既存RRAとの統合が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ZARAZA U KONGU: Više od 11.000 slučajeva ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo: More than 11,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 11,000 confirmed cases, with 11,042 infections and 5,387 fatalities reported as of November 11, 2026, according to government data released today. The outbreak, caused by a rare Ebola virus strain, was declared in mid-May. There are no approved vaccines for this strain. Late detection, ongoing armed conflict, and an overburdened health system have accelerated transmission compared with prior outbreaks. The disease is now reported across eastern, central, and western Africa, representing the widest geographic spread of Ebola to date. This marks the largest Ebola epidemic ever recorded on the African continent.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの感染拡大：エボラ感染者数が11,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、1万人超の感染、承認されたワクチンがない稀な株、武力紛争下での医療崩壊、アフリカ大陸史上最大規模のエボラ流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事はセルビア語メディアによる二次報道であり、一次情報源（DRC政府・WHO発表）での裏付け確認が必要。承認ワクチンがない稀なエボラ株という記述は特に重要で、フルRRAで詳細確認すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Adadin mutaen da suka harbu da cutar Ebola ya haura 11,000 a Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people who have contracted Ebola has risen above 11,000 in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 11,000 infections and 5,387 deaths, according to authorities. The outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved therapy or vaccine exists. It began in mid-May 2026 and has spread to eight of the country’s 26 provinces. It is the second-largest and most deadly Ebola outbreak on record, behind the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak that infected over 28,600 people and killed more than 11,000. Delayed detection, ongoing conflict, and health-system challenges are driving transmission. Reports confirm spread across East Africa, Central Africa, and West Africa, making this the most widespread Ebola event on the continent to date. As of 11 November 2026, the situation remains ongoing with rising case numbers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者数が11,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で感染者11,000人超・死者5,387人の大規模アウトブレイクが発生し、複数州・複数地域へ拡大しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の複数該当、国際的関心の高さが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事ではモザンビーク・アンゴラへの拡大は言及されておらず、Bluedotの発生地域付与に含まれるがverified_locationsからは除外。東アフリカ・中央アフリカ・西アフリカへの拡散が報告されているが具体的な対象国リスト内の国名は明記されていないためDRCのみを採用。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола хара Африком: Више од 5.300 преминулих
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages Africa: More than 5,300 dead.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa reports that confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpassed 11,000, with 11,042 confirmed infections and 5,387 deaths, according to government data cited by Reuters on 2026-11-11. The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by a rare strain of Ebola virus, was declared in mid-May and currently has no approved vaccines for this strain. Late detection, ongoing conflicts, and strained health systems have accelerated spread relative to prior outbreaks. The disease is now reported across eastern, central, and western Africa, representing the largest Ebola outbreak on the African continent to date. This crisis continues to evolve.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがアフリカを席巻：死者5,300人超
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認感染者11,042人・死者5,387人に達し、アフリカ大陸史上最大規模のエボラ流行となっており、ワクチン未承認・医療体制逼迫・紛争の影響で拡大が続いているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事では東部・中部・西部アフリカにも拡大していると記載されているが、具体的な対象国名の記載がないため、DRC以外は特定できず除外した。承認ワクチンがない稀な株による流行である点は重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Last Ebola patient in Kenya leaves hospital
article.articleSummary: Last Ebola patient in Kenya discharged, leaving seven survivors among nine total cases; no further infections among contacts. Kenya enters a 42-day (two incubation cycles) countdown to be declared Ebola-free, with potential declaration on December 23 if no new cases arise. The index patient fell ill on October 6 and had travelled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo through Uganda to Kenya, where he died in hospital. A family member who showed symptoms in mid-October also died while in quarantine. The development in Kenya comes as the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues an uncontrolled outbreak across eight provinces, reporting more than 11,000 cases and about 5,400 deaths. This underscores cross-border transmission risk from DRC to neighboring countries during the ongoing outbreak, and the importance of surveillance during peak travel season.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで最後のエボラ患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,000例超・5,400人死亡の制御不能な流行が継続しており、ケニアへの越境感染事例も発生。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの越境感染例終息とDRCでの進行中の大規模流行について述べている。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外し、DRCのみ記載した。

article.articleHeadline: حالات الإصابة بإيبولا في الكونغو تتجاوز 11 ألفاً
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infection cases in Congo surpass 11,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 11,042 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,387 deaths from a Bundibugyo strain outbreak that began in mid-May. This rare strain has no approved treatment or vaccine, and the outbreak is the continent’s widest to date, affecting eight of the DRC’s 26 provinces with many deaths occurring outside treatment centers. Delays in detection, ongoing conflict, and strained health services have accelerated spread. The outbreak has now expanded into East, Central, and West Africa, making it the most geographically widespread Ebola outbreak in Africa so far. It is the second-largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak on the continent, surpassed only by the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which infected more than 28,600 and killed over 11,000. Ongoing surveillance, public health responses, and containment efforts are critical to curb further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ感染者数が11,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で希少株（ブンディブギョ株）による大規模エボラ流行が発生し、感染者11,042人・死者5,387人に達し、複数州・複数地域に拡大しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事ではDRCでの大規模流行（ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・治療薬未承認）が中心的に報告されている。モザンビーク・アンゴラはBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが、記事本文で具体的な感染確認は言及されておらず、除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Sarna humana contagia crianças e servidores em creches públicas de MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human scabies spreads to children and staff in public daycares in Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreak in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, affecting Ceim Recanto Raízes (Jardim Água Boa) with 24 children and 16 staff; classes suspended indefinitely from 11 November 2026 to interrupt transmission and allow environmental decontamination. Additional cases at Ceim Beatriz de Barros Bumlai (BNH 4º Plano): four staff and two children diagnosed. Overall, 40 confirmed cases among children and workers, with 18 recovered; 6 reinfestations and 5 new cases reported recently. Control measures emphasize simultaneous actions: decontamination of facilities, cleaning of environments, health monitoring, and treatment of contacts, coordinated by Epidemiological Surveillance, Sanitary Vigilance, UBS, and intersectoral partners (Social Assistance, Guardians Council). Reopening will depend on health authorities’ assessment; scabies is a highly transmissible skin infestation not related to hygiene, requiring sustained coordinated response and household treatment to break transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 疥癬がブラジル・マトグロッソ・ド・スル州の公立保育園で子供や職員に感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は局地的な集団発生であり、重症度・国際的拡大リスクともに低く、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 疥癬は軽症の皮膚感染症で、保育施設内での集団発生に留まり、地方当局（衛生監視部門等）により対応されている。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Више од 11.000 случајева еболе у Конгу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 11,000 Ebola cases in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 11,000 confirmed infections, with 11,042 cases and 5,387 deaths. The epidemic is driven by a rare Ebola virus strain for which no approved vaccine exists. Declared mid-May, the outbreak has spread faster due to late detection, ongoing conflict, and an overwhelmed health system. Authorities indicate cases have now been reported across eastern, central, and western Africa, marking the largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded on the African continent. The data cited are government figures corroborated by Reuters. No vaccine is available for this strain; public health measures face challenges from security issues and health-system capacity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで1万1000件以上のエボラ症例
