triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが1万人以上の感染者・5000人以上の死者を記録し、アフリカ大陸史上最大規模に達している。承認ワクチンが存在しない希少株であり、紛争・医療体制崩壊により拡大が継続している。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）での大規模エボラアウトブレイクを主題としている。『東部・中部・西部アフリカ全域で症例報告』とあるが、具体的な対象国名の言及はDRCのみであるため、Africa（大陸）は対象国リストに該当せず除外。ワクチン未承認株であること、紛争による医療アクセス制限、過去最大規模という点から緊急性が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola could be raging in DRC for another year, expert warns
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo could last at least another year, according to a leading UK epidemiologist. The current outbreak is described as raging in the DRC, with experts warning that containment will be hard. Containment is significantly hampered by conflict and widespread mistrust of authorities in affected areas, making response efforts difficult. The warning underscores a protracted crisis in which transmission remains challenging to interrupt under unstable conditions. As of 11 November 2026, the outbreak continues to pose a serious public health threat in the region, demanding sustained attention from health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、DRCでさらに1年続く恐れ、専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のDRCでの長期化・制御困難な状況はIHR基準複数該当し、国際的関心・支援の必要性も高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 紛争や住民の不信感により封じ込めが困難であるとの専門家警告。継続的な監視と国際支援の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC Praises Kenya's Successful Containment of Bundibugyo Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Kenya has contained the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, with the last confirmed patient discharged and all contacts released. On 11 November 2026, the final patient was discharged and the eleven contacts completed monitoring. On 12 November 2026, day one of a 42-day observation period began; if no new cases emerge, Kenya will be declared Ebola‑free on 23 December 2026. Africa CDC praised the response, citing early detection, contact tracing, clinical care and community engagement. Kenya recorded its first Bundibugyo case on 6 October 2026 in a traveller returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo via Uganda; 135 close contacts were traced, eight secondary infections among quarantined individuals (four family members, four health workers). Seven patients recovered and two deaths occurred. WHO congratulated Kenya and urged vigilance until the 42‑day period ends, noting cross-border risk with ongoing Ebola in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、ケニアによるブンディブギョ・エボラ・アウトブレイクの封じ込め成功を称賛
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでのエボラ・アウトブレイクは封じ込めに成功し終息に向かっているが、感染源であるDRCでは流行が継続中であり、42日間の観察期間終了まで新規感染のリスクが残るため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのアウトブレイク封じ込め成功報告であり、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは感染源・継続中の流行地として言及されているが、記事の主題ではなく背景情報として扱われているため verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Ebola di RD Kongo Tembus 11.042, Korban Jiwa Capai 5.387 Orang : Okezone News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in DR Congo surpass 11,042, death toll reaches 5,387: Okezone News
article.articleSummary: Lab-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo have reached 11,042 with 5,387 deaths, per government data released on 10 November 2026. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain and represents the largest and deadliest Ebola event in DR Congo’s history. It ranks as the second-largest and second-deadliest Ebola outbreak globally, behind the 2014-2016 West Africa crisis (over 28,600 infections and more than 11,000 deaths). Eight of DR Congo’s 26 provinces have been affected, with many fatalities occurring outside treatment centers. The report highlights ongoing transmission challenges amid stretched public health response. The article does not specify infection sources or any imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱症例数が11,042人を突破、死者数5,387人に達する：Okezone News
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行（症例11,042、死者5,387）が継続しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内の症例・死者数を主題としており、Angolaへの拡大や越境感染については言及がないため対象国リストから除外。Bundibugyo株による過去最大規模のアウトブレイクであり、治療施設外での死亡が多い点から医療対応能力の逼迫が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en Congo supera los 5.000 fallecidos. | HSB Noticias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo surpasses 5,000 deaths. | HSB Noticias.
article.articleSummary: 11,042 Ebola virus disease cases and 5,387 deaths reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of November 11, 2026, in an outbreak declared mid-May 2026. Ituri province accounts for about 70% of cases; North Kivu is a major transmission hotspot. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant causes this outbreak; no vaccine or approved specific treatment is available. Eight of 26 provinces affected, with spread to neighboring Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria raising regional risk. Health workers face attacks and community distrust, hindering surveillance and access to care in conflict-affected areas, including Ituri schools. The outbreak has surpassed early West Africa 2014–2016 totals, challenging surveillance, medical center access, and protection of frontline staff.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、死者5,000人を超える | HSB Noticias
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）流行が継続し、死者5,000人超、周辺国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）への拡大懸念もあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するため。

article.articleHeadline: Around 20 People Fall Ill After Eating At Karimnagar Hotel
article.articleSummary: Around 20 people fell ill after dining at a mandi hotel in Karimnagar town on Friday night; the incident came to light on Wednesday, Nov 11, 2026. Affected diners reported dysentery and vomiting the next morning, with one patient admitted to a hospital. Doctors attributed the illness to food poisoning. The cluster involves diners who ate at the same hotel on Friday, with no laboratory confirmation or specific causative agent mentioned in the report. No details on the exact infection source beyond the hotel meal are provided, and no further cases or public health actions are described.

triage.headline_ja: カリムナガルのホテルで食事をした約20人が体調不良
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設での食中毒疑いの小規模クラスターであり、病原体不明・国際拡大や渡航貿易制限の懸念もなく、IHR・WPRO基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 食中毒疑いの単一事例。病原体不明、検査確認なし、重症者も1名入院のみで、続報は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemie in Afrika: Letzter Ebola-Patient aus Klinik in Kenia entlassen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemic in Africa: Last Ebola patient discharged from hospital in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient on 2026-11-11, but the country is not yet Ebola-free. All seven surviving patients are healthy, with no secondary infections among contacts, bringing Kenya’s total Ebola cases to nine. To be declared Ebola-free, 42 days (two incubation cycles) must pass without any new case, expected by 2026-12-23. The first Kenyan case was registered on 6 October; the patient contracted in the Democratic Republic of Congo, traveled via land to Uganda, then flew to Kenya where he died in hospital, and a family member who developed symptoms in mid-October and was quarantined also died. In Congo, the outbreak remains uncontrolled across eight provinces, with more than 11,000 cases and about 5,400 deaths after nearly six months since its official announcement.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでの流行:ケニアの病院から最後のエボラ患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で8州にまたがる制御不能なエボラ流行が継続し、11,000人超の症例・5,400人の死亡が報告されており、既にウガンダ・ケニアへ国境を越えて拡大している。IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準も多数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国での大規模エボラ流行とその越境拡大（ウガンダ経由でケニアへ）。ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCの流行規模（11,000例超、死亡5,400人、8州にわたる）が特に重大。

article.articleHeadline: Little-Known Protein May Be Target for Chagas Disease Treatment
article.articleSummary: In Brazil, USP researchers identify IP6K as a promising target to treat Chagas disease by disrupting Trypanosoma cruzi’s infection cycle. In lab tests, lowering IP6K production impaired the parasite’s differentiation into infectious forms within human cardiac cells, reducing blood-stage parasites across intracellular cycles. Parasites lacking both IP6K gene copies were non-viable, so assays used strains with one copy, underscoring IP6K’s essential role and its ~25% similarity to the human counterpart, a factor favoring potential drug specificity. T. cruzi cycles between kissing bugs and mammals; in humans, amastigotes multiply and become bloodstream trypomastigotes, contributing to cardiac tissue damage and chronic disease. The study, published in August in Communications Biology, suggests targeted drugs against IP6K could be effective, pending identification of druggable sites. Brazil reported about 400 Chagas disease cases in 2025 per the Ministry of Health.

triage.headline_ja: シャーガス病治療の標的となりうる、あまり知られていないタンパク質
triage.triage_reason: 研究レベルの基礎研究報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な流行拡大を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は創薬研究（IP6Kタンパク質の標的化）に関する内容で、ブラジルでの2025年のシャーガス病症例数（約400件）は参考情報として言及されているのみで、アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de covid aumentam em 17 estados e DF; veja sintomas e onde testar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases rise in 17 states and the Federal District; see symptoms and where to test.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising in 17 Brazilian states and the Federal District, but overall activity remains low risk. The Health Ministry reports six weeks of elevated notifications nationwide. ITpS shows 17% of tests positive in the week ending 7 November 2026, up from 3% in August, the highest for this time of year since 2023. Severe cases and deaths in 2026 are about two-thirds below 2025. Higher positivity is seen in Alagoas, Bahia, Ceará, Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Mato Grosso, Paraíba, Pernambuco, Piauí, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Rondônia, Roraima, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina, São Paulo, and DF. Fiocruz InfoGripe notes increases in DF, SP, RJ, SC but low incidence; Mato Grosso shows COVID driving respiratory hospitalizations. The XFG variant accounts for ~90% of 2026 sequences; vaccination totals 20.3M doses distributed, 7.4M administered. Nirmatrelvir/ritonavir is advised for 65+ or immunocompromised within five days of symptoms. Free testing at UBS; pharmacy rapid tests and autotests available with ANVISA registration.

triage.headline_ja: 17州および連邦直轄区でCOVID-19症例増加、症状と検査方法について
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル保健省は季節的な陽性率上昇を報告しているが、重症例・死亡数は前年より大幅減少しており「低リスク」と明記されているため、特段のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 既知のXFG変異株による季節性の感染者数増加であり、保健省自身が低リスクと評価。重症化率・死亡率は前年比約3分の1に減少しており、COVID-19は既にエンデミック化した状況下での通常の疫学報告に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Starts Countdown to End of Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Kenya started a countdown on 2026-11-11 to declare the end of its Ebola outbreak, after the final patient tested positive for Ebola was discharged. Cabinet Secretary for Health Aden Duale said the last 11 people under monitoring for Ebola symptoms had completed a 21-day quarantine and were discharged. For the first time since the outbreak began, Kenya has no patients under treatment and no contacts in quarantine. The outbreak involved a small number of imported cases that came in from Congo. Laboratory confirmation and strict isolation helped limit community transmission, with Kenya nearing formal end of activity as monitoring concludes.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ流行終息へのカウントダウン開始
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでのエボラ流行は収束に向かっているが、感染源であるコンゴ(DRC)での流行状況について記事に詳細情報がなく、背景情報が不足しているため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの輸入症例によるエボラ流行の終息を報じるポジティブな内容。感染源であるDRCでの流行の現状については直接的な記述がなく不明。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: В ДРК число случаев Эболы превысило 11 тысяч
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, the number of Ebola cases has surpassed 11,000.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, confirmed Ebola virus disease cases have risen to 11,042, with 5,387 deaths, authorities said. The current outbreak is the second-largest by cases and deaths in the country’s records and the largest in DRC history; only the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak exceeded it (over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths). The virus has affected eight of DRC's 26 provinces, with many deaths occurring outside health facilities. Analysts attribute the rapid spread to delayed case detection, ongoing armed conflict in the eastern region, and an overstretched health system. The outbreak has spread across East, Central and West Africa, marking the widest geographic reach of any Ebola outbreak on the continent.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ症例数が1万1000人を超える

article.articleHeadline: La OMS confirma nuevos focos de contagio de ébola y advierte de que el brote sigue expandiéndose en otras áreas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO confirms new Ebola transmission hotspots and warns that the outbreak continues to spread in other areas.
article.articleSummary: WHO confirms new Ebola transmission hotspots in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as the outbreak continues to spread across eight provinces, with nearly 11,000 confirmed cases and over 5,300 deaths; about 3,000 people have recovered. While transmission is slowing in some areas, new foci emerge and insecurity hampers response. Last week a Cantine-Aloya attack killed 66 civilians, including three health workers, and involved looting and burning of three health centers, resulting in more than 1,000 contacts lost to follow-up and three confirmed cases with unknown whereabouts. A vaccine trial for Ervebo has begun, but vaccines are not a substitute for rapid care, contact tracing, isolation, safe burials, and infection prevention. WHO urges international support to strengthen political, logistical, and financial backing, leadership, and community engagement to end the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱の新たな感染拠点を確認、アウトブレイクは他地域にも拡大し続けていると警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が8州に拡大し約11,000例・5,300人超の死亡と重大な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、治安悪化による対応困難・国際支援の必要性も明確なためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 武装勢力による攻撃で医療従事者死亡・接触者1,000人以上が追跡不能となり、感染拡大・対応困難性が増大している。ワクチン治験(Ervebo)開始も報告。

article.articleHeadline: MSD lança vacina contra Newcastle e outras quatro doenças em aves
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSD launches a vaccine against Newcastle disease and four other avian diseases.
article.articleSummary: MSD Health Animal launched Nobilis Multriva, a pentavalent poultry vaccine protecting against Newcastle disease and four other diseases: avian rhinotracheitis, infectious bronchitis, infectious bursal disease (Gumboro), and reovirus. The 0.3 mL formulation bundles five antigens in a single dose, reducing administration volume by up to 70% versus conventional vaccination programs. Compared with standard multivalent inactivated vaccines, volume decreases by about 40%, and can reach 70% when two 0.5 mL doses are given intramuscularly. The reduced volume lowers tissue reactions, speeds farm vaccination, and cuts labor costs and plastic waste. The prime-boost strategy combines live priming with an inactivated booster, aiming for cross-protection against circulating variants and improved transfer of maternal immunity. Field studies in Brazil with large integrators report strong, durable immune responses. Intramuscular administration in birds from eight weeks, with up to three weeks before onset of lay; announced November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: MSD、ニューカッスル病など5疾患に対する鶏用ワクチンを発売
triage.triage_reason: 疾病発生報告ではなく、動物用ワクチン新製品の発売に関する商業ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の懸念や感染拡大の報告は含まれない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン製品発売に関する業界ニュースであり、実際の疾病発生事例の報告ではないため、発生地域としてのBrazilは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Bicho-de-pé é pulga? Veja o que é mito e verdade sobre o parasita que ameaça cães e humanos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is tungiasis a flea? See what's myth and what's true about the parasite that threatens dogs and humans.
article.articleSummary: Tungiasis, caused by Tunga penetrans (bicho-de-pé), is classified by WHO as a neglected tropical disease. The parasite affects millions of animals and people across the Americas and Sub-Saharan Africa, with Brazilian endemic areas showing prevalences that can exceed 50%. The female flea embeds in the host’s skin, where eggs develop and are released into the environment, triggering inflammation, pain, swelling, and discomfort in dogs and humans. It is a zoonosis; exposure occurs via the same sandy soils, especially around children. DIY removal can cause pain and secondary bacterial infections (Staphylococcus, Streptococcus) and may allow tetanus entry; veterinary treatment is required. Most antiparasitics lack proven efficacy against T. penetrans; Defenza (MSD, veterinary chew) is currently the only product with explicit labeling against this parasite and provides up to 37 days of protection. Prevention includes pre-trip veterinary checks, daily paw inspections, avoiding contaminated environments, and maintaining a strict medication schedule.

triage.headline_ja: ツツガムシ病はノミか？犬と人間を脅かす寄生虫についての神話と真実
triage.triage_reason: 教育的・啓発的な一般記事であり、特定の発生事例や急性の公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではないため。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola supera 11 mil casos no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola surpasses 11,000 cases in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeds 11,000 cases with 5,387 deaths, making it the country’s worst on record as of 11 November 2026. Declared in mid-May, the current outbreak is concentrated in eastern DRC amid armed conflict and weak state presence, hindering containment. Health authorities report 11,042 cases and 5,387 deaths to date, with the Bundibugyo variant identified as the origin and no vaccine specific to this strain available. Cases have also been detected in Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. The World Health Organization began a clinical trial in October to assess the Ervebo vaccine (approved for the Zaire strain) in the region, while Médecins Sans Frontières urged urgent expanded vaccine access to protect at-risk populations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が1万1000人超に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、1万人超の症例と周辺国への拡大、ワクチン未整備という状況はIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアでも症例が検出されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。武力紛争下での対応困難、特異株（Bundibugyo）に対する専用ワクチン未承認という点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Læger uden Grænser: "Det er det voldsomste og mest dødelige udbrud til dato i landets historie"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders: "It is the most severe and deadliest outbreak to date in the country's history."
article.articleSummary: As of November 11, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo are described by Doctors Without Borders as the most severe and deadliest in the country’s history. More than 11,000 people have been infected and 5,387 have died since the outbreak began in mid-May. The virus has spread beyond the DRC to Kenya and Nigeria, indicating cross-border transmission. There is no sign of a slowdown; case counts are rising rapidly, according to MSF spokesperson Gitte Rønde, with government figures corroborating the 11,000+ infections and 5,387 deaths, though MSF cautions that the true toll may be higher than official tallies. The excerpt attributes the difficulty in controlling the outbreak to challenging conditions, but provides no details on laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or specific vaccination data within the snippet.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団：「これは同国史上最も激しく、最も致死率の高い流行だ」

triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアへの拡大が報じられているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCのみが対象国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 volta a subir em Alagoas, aponta Ministério da Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 rises again in Alagoas, according to the Ministry of Health.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 is again rising in Alagoas, with the state among 19 Brazilian states showing an increasing trend per the Ministry of Health. The signal comes from six weeks of notifications ending Oct 25–31. While nationwide activity remains low, Alagoas faces renewed circulation and is urged to sustain precautions and vaccination updates. Infectologist Fernando Maia notes this period tends to see higher coronavirus activity as influenza wanes, with alternating circulation of respiratory viruses observed in recent years. Seven Northeast states show rising trends: Alagoas, Bahia, Ceará, Maranhão, Paraíba, Pernambuco and Piauí, with some growth signals in the North, Center-West, Southeast and South. The analysis uses statistical models that adjust for reporting delays; a rising trend does not mean every week increased. Common symptoms include sore throat, runny nose, low fever, and sometimes temporary loss of smell or taste. Vaccinated individuals generally have mild disease; unvaccinated face higher risks of pneumonia, respiratory failure, hospitalization, and death. COVID-19 vaccination is free via SUS, and authorities advise checking vaccination status and receiving the recommended dose. Vaccines require periodic updates due to mutations, similar to influenza.)

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19がアラゴアス州で再び増加、保健省が発表
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の季節性COVID-19増加傾向に関する通常の疫学モニタリング報告であり、全国的な活動は低水準、異常性や重篤性の増加、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo, superati gli 11mila contagi: oltre 5mila morti per il virus Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo, over 11,000 cases: more than 5,000 deaths due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has surpassed 11,000 cases with 5,387 deaths, the deadliest in the country’s history. As of 2026-11-11, 11,042 laboratory-confirmed infections have been recorded across eight of the 26 provinces. The surge comes amid no vaccine or approved specific therapy for this variant, complicating containment and patient management. The World Health Organization had raised the epidemic risk to very high in May, citing rapid transmission and accelerating case counts. Health authorities continue surveillance and containment efforts, but the rising caseload underscores the need for intensified infection control, surveillance, and monitoring for potential imported or exported cases across provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱、感染者1万1000人超：ブンディブギョ型ウイルスにより5000人超が死亡

article.articleHeadline: تسجيل نحو 11 ألف إصابة بـ "إيبولا" في الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly 11,000 Ebola cases recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 11,042 Ebola infections and 5,387 deaths are reported, with around 2,990 recoveries; the case fatality rate stands at 48.8% (National Institute of Public Health). The outbreak, officially declared on May 15, 2026, represents the worst in the country’s history, aided by ongoing armed conflict that hampers health responses. The virus has crossed borders previously, with past cases recorded in Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. As of 11 November 2026, Kenya declared itself Ebola-free after the last patient recovered and was discharged; authorities reported all 135 identified contacts completed a 21-day monitoring period, with no onward community transmission. The Democratic Republic of the Congo, home to over 100 million people, continues to face a substantial and challenging containment effort amid regional spillover risks.

article.articleHeadline: Une cinquantaine d'élèves touchés par Ebola dans 44 écoles du
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: About fifty students affected by Ebola in 44 schools of the.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo: at least 50 students across 44 schools in Beni and Butembo have tested positive for Ebola; 31 of them have died, reported at a November 10 briefing in Beni on the province's epidemiological situation. UNICEF will strengthen school-based prevention, early warning, and barrier measures to make schools safer and more resilient to transmission. UNICEF notes every child case is a critical signal and is collaborating with PROVED and other child-protection partners in North Kivu. In response, 300 schools have already received sanitation and hygiene kits. A new partnership with Save Communities for Children will enable rapid sensitization and protection efforts, including training 900 teachers in prevention measures. Parents, teachers, and school authorities are urged to cooperate; emphasis on handwashing, rapid reporting of suspected cases, and strict adherence to preventive measures in schools. Funding availability will shape continuation.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州の44校で約50人の生徒がエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が学校を通じて児童に拡大し致死率も高く（50人中31人死亡）、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき事案。
triage.notes: 致死率約62%（50人中31人死亡）と非常に高く、学校を介した子どもへの感染拡大が懸念される。UNICEFや地域パートナーが介入中だが、資金継続性に依存するとの記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de SRAG e covid-19 aumentam no Brasil segundo a Fiocruz | JC Rio Claro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SARI and COVID-19 cases rise in Brazil according to Fiocruz | JC Rio Claro
article.articleSummary: Brazilian Fiocruz's InfoGripe bulletin shows rising SARI (severe acute respiratory infection) and COVID-19 activity in September–October. Severe COVID-19 signals are present in at least five states: Mato Grosso, the Federal District, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Santa Catarina. SARI incidence at alert/risk/high risk without long-term growth is reported in Roraima, Sergipe, and Santa Catarina. Aracaju (Sergipe) and João Pessoa (Paraíba), capitals, show SARI activity at alert/risk/high risk with long-term growth. In the four most recent epidemiological weeks, among SARI positives, detection rates were: influenza A 4.2%, influenza B 4.7%, RSV 10.1%, rhinovirus 50.1%, COVID-19 8.5%; deaths among positives: influenza A 1.3%, influenza B 12.7%, RSV 3.8%, rhinovirus 43%, COVID-19 24.1%. Through 2026, 171,369 SARI cases were notified, with 91,420 (53.3%) lab-positive for a respiratory virus, 62,823 (36.7%) lab-negative, and 7,457 (4.4%) awaiting results.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルスによると、ブラジルでSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）とCOVID-19の症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルFiocruzによる定期的な呼吸器感染症サーベイランス速報であり、季節性の変動を報告する通常のモニタリング情報。新規性・異常性は認められず、特段の社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 本記事はFiocruz InfoGripeによる定期的な疫学速報であり、COVID-19、インフルエンザA/B、RSV、ライノウイルスなど複数の呼吸器病原体の季節的動向をまとめたもの。既知の病原体による季節性サーベイランスデータであり、新規性・緊急性のあるシグナルとは判断されない。

article.articleHeadline: وكالة سرايا : تسجيل أكثر من 11 ألف إصابة بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saraya Agency: More than 11,000 Ebola cases recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 11,000 cases as of 2026-11-11, with 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths, and about 2,990 recoveries, yielding a case-fatality rate of 48.8%. The current outbreak is the worst in the country’s history, ongoing amid armed conflict that hampers surveillance, access, and response. Officially declared on 15 May, transmission continues across multiple regions, with prior cross-border spillovers to Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. Kenya reports its territory is Ebola-free after the last patient was discharged, with 21-day monitoring of 135 contacts completed and no community transmission detected. The DRC remains in a protracted, difficult response, emphasizing border vigilance and cross-border surveillance to prevent further spread.

triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境感染が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ケニアはエボラフリー宣言済みとの記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: Monophasic Salmonella Typhimurium Surged Among Diarrheal Patients in
article.articleSummary: Monophasic Salmonella Typhimurium became the leading serotype in Zhejiang Province, China, in 2025, accounting for 24.75% of Salmonella isolates from diarrheal patients, after a period of dominance by Typhimurium, Enteritidis, and London (2019–2024). In a 2019–2025 longitudinal study, 8,778 Salmonella isolates from 11 prefecture-level cities were serotyped and subjected to antimicrobial susceptibility testing, revealing an overall multidrug resistance (MDR) rate of 65.8% with a significant upward trend (P = 4.89×10^-24; r = 0.1181). In 2025, ampicillin and tetracycline resistance stood at 68.1% and 60.2%, respectively, with rising resistance to chloramphenicol and co-trimoxazole over time. Serotype-specific profiles showed Typhimurium co-resistant to aminoglycosides and sulfonamides; Enteritidis to beta-lactams and cephalosporins; London and Thompson to macrolides; Kentucky to fluoroquinolones. Hangzhou had the strongest monophasic Typhimurium clustering (observed/expected 4.62); Zhoushan, Newport; Quzhou, Give. The study underscores integrated serotype and resistance tracking and One Health antimicrobial stewardship.

triage.headline_ja: 浙江省の下痢患者における単相性サルモネラ・ティフィムリウムの増加
triage.triage_reason: 浙江省における2019-2025年のサルモネラ血清型・薬剤耐性サーベイランス研究であり、急性のアウトブレイクではないが、多剤耐性率の上昇傾向は公衆衛生上注視すべき情報であるため。
triage.notes: 本記事は急性アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、長期的な血清型・薬剤耐性サーベイランス研究（2019-2025年）であり、多剤耐性率上昇（65.8%、有意な上昇傾向）が注目点。疾患タグ（Paratyphoid/Typhoid）は実際の記事内容（非チフス性サルモネラ、Monophasic Typhimurium等）と一致しておらず、Bluedotのタグ付けに誤りがある可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ébola já matou mais de mais de cinco mil pessoas na RDC - ANGONOTÍCIAS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak has already killed more than five thousand people in the DRC - ANGONOTÍCIAS.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has infected 11,042 people and caused 5,387 deaths, with 2,990 recoveries, according to the DRC Ministry of Health. Declared in May this year, the outbreak remains hard to control. The eastern provinces of Ituri and North Kivu continue to register the highest numbers of new cases. Authorities cite armed conflict, health system fragilities, access difficulties to affected areas, and community misinformation as key factors complicating the response. The latest figures reflect the ongoing public health challenge in the region, emphasizing the need for continued containment and mitigation efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、DRCで既に5000人以上死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ出血熱流行が継続しており、多数の死者・感染者が発生。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 武力紛争や医療体制の脆弱性、アクセス困難、誤情報拡散が対応を困難にしていると報告されている。既に5000人超の死者が出ており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Com 70 infecções, surto de sarna humana se espalha por MS e duas cidades fecham creches
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 70 infections, a human scabies outbreak spreads through Mato Grosso do Sul, and two cities shut down daycares.
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreak in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, centers on two neighboring towns, Dourados and Itaporã, with 70 infections among students and school staff. Itaporã’s Milton Melani Center for Early Childhood Education closed eight days after 24 of about 300 children were infected; reopening is planned if the outbreak ends. A second Itaporã daycare with 115 enrollments registered only one case; workers received preventive ivermectin. In Dourados, Recanto Raízes Center reports 24 children and 16 staff infected; classes suspended indefinitely from November 11. Across Recanto Raízes, 40 cases have been reported, with 18 cured and 22 under treatment, including six reinfections and five new cases. Additional units, such as Beatriz de Barros Bumlai, reported two children and four staff infected. Scabies, caused by Sarcoptes scabiei and highly contagious via skin-to-skin contact or contaminated objects, lacks mandatory reporting; decontamination includes washing fabrics at >55°C and ironing.

triage.headline_ja: 感染者70人、疥癬の流行がマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州に拡大、2都市が保育施設を閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度・国際拡大リスクが低く、局地的な保育施設での集団感染にとどまっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当は乏しい。
triage.notes: 疥癬はブラジルのみで発生しており、対象国リストに該当なし。地域の学校・保育施設内のアウトブレイクで、重症度は低く、死亡例の報告もない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya discharges last patient, begins 42-day countdown to Ebola-Free status
article.articleSummary: Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient, starting a 42-day countdown to Ebola-Free status with the countdown ending December 23. The first case was recorded October 6; the last case October 19. Nine confirmed cases were linked to the initial patient’s contacts, with no evidence of community transmission. The index patient traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo via Uganda, infecting four family members and four healthcare workers; he and his mother died, seven others recovered. A total of 135 contacts were traced. In the DRC epicenter, 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths were reported. The outbreak spread to Uganda and Nigeria via travellers from the DRC, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. Kenya tightened border controls, with 21-day quarantine for arrivals from the DRC; ten countries have dedicated screening. Saudi Arabia suspended visas on Oct 30; Kenya urged reconsideration.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最後の患者を退院させエボラ終息に向け42日間のカウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCを震源とするエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行（感染11,042例、死亡5,387例）が複数国（ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリア）に拡大し、渡航制限（サウジアラビアのビザ停止等）も発生しているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの終息を主題としているが、震源地であるDRCの被害規模（感染11,042例、死亡5,387例）が極めて大きく、国際的拡大（ウガンダ、ナイジェリア）と渡航制限（サウジアラビア等）を伴う重大イベント。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・サウジアラビアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: COP31, sequía en Centroamérica, Gaza, ébola... las noticias del miércoles
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COP31, drought in Central America, Gaza, Ebola... Wednesday's news
article.articleSummary: At COP31, UN Secretary-General António Guterres calls for a climate-justice pact making polluters pay, warning the planet could warm beyond 2.5°C this century. The four priorities are a just transition with worker protections, early-warning systems for vulnerable populations, affordable climate finance, and stronger international cooperation. He notes US$95 billion earned by the nine largest oil producers in a single quarter versus US$600 million for the fund for vulnerable countries—about 14 hours of those profits. In Central America, the podcast Sin la ONU covers the Dry Corridor’s drought, profiling Honduran Anastacio and Guatemalan Marta with WFP help to curb migration. In Gaza, Tom Fletcher denounces delays and closures harming winter relief, urging open crossings and NGO work. In the DRC, safe, dignified burials are central to stopping Ebola transmission through community involvement.

triage.headline_ja: COP31、中米の干ばつ、ガザ、エボラ…水曜日のニュース
triage.triage_reason: エボラに関する言及はDRCでの安全な埋葬慣行についての一般的な解説に留まり、具体的な発生状況や新規感染拡大の情報がないため、現時点でのピックアップ対象とはしない。
triage.notes: 記事は複数のニュースをまとめたダイジェストであり、エボラに関する部分は「DRCでは安全で尊厳のある埋葬が感染拡大防止の鍵」という一般的な言及のみで、具体的な感染者数・発生規模等の情報は含まれていない。続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：刚果（金）埃博拉疫情应对面临安全局势动荡等多重障碍
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces multiple obstacles, including a volatile security situation.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo faces major obstacles from volatile security. In Kantine-Aloya, 66 civilians were killed, including 3 health workers, and three facilities looted or burned. More than 1,000 contacts are untraceable, and 3 confirmed cases are missing. In Tshopo Province, a nurse responding to alerts was killed and another health worker injured; attacks near facilities threaten response. Displacement, rugged terrain and the rainy season complicate access; frontline pay arrears risk strikes. WHO, with the DRC government and Africa CDC, is expanding surveillance, testing, clinical care, IPC and community engagement. Vaccination is ongoing, including Ervebo trials and potential Bundibugyo virus candidates. Kenya reports 9 imported cases (2 deaths); Nigeria reports 1 imported case. Five requests to member states: sustained political engagement, safe access, expanded response, timely frontline pay, and community-centered health system strengthening.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱対応、治安情勢の不安定化など複数の障害に直面
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大（ケニア・ナイジェリアへの輸入症例）と治安悪化による対応困難が確認され、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ケニア（9例・2死亡）とナイジェリア（1例）への輸入症例が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCの治安悪化が感染者追跡・ワクチン接種活動を著しく阻害している点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Le Kenya libère le dernier patient atteint d'Ebola, commence le compte à rebours de 42 jours.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya releases the last Ebola-infected patient, starts the 42-day countdown.
article.articleSummary: Kenya released its last Ebola patient on November 11, 2026, and began a 42-day countdown to declare the outbreak over on December 23 if no new cases emerge. Nine people tested positive and two died in Kenya. Eleven contacts completed a 21-day quarantine. The index case arrived from Congo on October 6, tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain, and died in a Nairobi private hospital. Kenya has not reported a confirmed case since October 20, with no evidence of wider transmission. Congo reported 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths as of November 11; Uganda ended its outbreak August 27. Saudi Arabia suspended visas on October 30, affecting Kenyan workers, with Duale urging reconsideration of travel restrictions. Returnees from Ebola zones must complete electronic health declarations, be screened on arrival, and observe a 21-day quarantine.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最後のエボラ感染患者を退院させ、42日間のカウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（11,042感染・5,387死亡）を背景に、ケニアへの越境伝播と国際的な渡航制限（サウジアラビアのビザ停止）が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの越境エボラ症例の終息だが、感染源かつ大規模流行継続中のDRCが対象国リストに該当するため含めた。ケニア・ウガンダ・サウジアラビアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: La República Democrática del Congo supera los 11,000 casos de ébola y suma 5,387 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 11,000 Ebola cases and totals 5,387 deaths.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has surpassed 11,000 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths as of November 9, 2026 (INSP). Infections reach 11,042; case fatality 48.8%; recoveries 2,990; 651 hospitalized or in isolation; contact tracing 79.7%. Ituri (epicenter) accounts for 57.7% of new cases and North Kivu 32.7% on Nov 9; 67 health zones across eight provinces are affected: Ituri, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, South Kivu, Ubangi North and South. The outbreak is DRC's 17th Ebola event and the second deadliest globally after 2014-2016 West Africa (approx. 11,000 deaths, 28,000 cases). Bundibugyo has no specific treatment; WHO is testing two vaccines in Phase 1, and Ervebo has been used since August. The outbreak spread to Uganda (20 cases, 2 deaths; Aug 26 end), Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths), Nigeria (1); France-linked case; evacuees to Netherlands, Germany, and UK. Transmission: direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever and hemorrhagic signs.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者が11,000人を超え、死者数は5,387人に達する
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、11,000人超の感染者、8州67保健区に拡大し、複数国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）への国際的拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランス、オランダ、ドイツ、英国への感染拡大・避難例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。DRCの第17次エボラ流行であり、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行に次ぐ世界2番目の死亡者数規模。WHOがワクチン治験、Ervebo使用中。

article.articleHeadline: Vespasiano registra novo caso de sarna humana e segue com duas escolas fechadas na Grande BH
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vespasiano records a new case of human scabies and two schools remain closed in the Greater Belo Horizonte area
article.articleSummary: Vespasiano, in the Greater Belo Horizonte area, records a new human scabies case, triggering suspension of classes in two state schools. In Lagoa Santa, also in the Metropolitana region, 25 schools have halted classes due to scabies, affecting about 250 people. Minas Gerais state has reported 11 human scabies outbreaks this year, according to the Secretaria de Estado de Saúde. A schoolteacher in the state education network was diagnosed, highlighting ongoing transmission through direct skin-to-skin contact or contaminated surfaces. Scabies is not a notifiable disease, complicating precise outbreak tracing across municipalities. Health authorities emphasize vigilance and hygiene measures to limit spread.

triage.headline_ja: ヴェスパシアーノで新たなヒト疥癬症例を確認、グレーター・ベロオリゾンテ地域で学校2校が休校継続
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は軽症・管理可能な皮膚感染症であり、国際的拡大リスクや渡航貿易制限の懸念は低い。対象国（ブラジル）内の局地的な学校閉鎖事例であり、フルRRAに進める基準は満たさない。
triage.notes: 疥癬は届出義務のない疾患であり、正確な追跡が困難と記事内で言及されているが、重症度・国際的懸念は低い。地域の公衆衛生当局による衛生管理対応で十分とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia entlässt letzten Ebola-Patienten, beginnt 42-tägigen Countdown.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya discharges the last Ebola patient, begins a 42-day countdown.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient and began a 42-day countdown to declare the outbreak over on 23 December, provided no new cases are reported. Nine individuals tested positive, including four family members and four health workers; the first patient and his mother died, seven others recovered. The index case was a man who arrived from the Congo via Uganda and tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain, dying in a Nairobi private hospital. Authorities identified 135 contacts. Since 20 October, no new confirmed cases and no signs of wider community transmission have been reported. For the first time since the outbreak began, Kenya reported no patients in treatment and no quarantined contacts. Travel/entry measures: Kenyan travelers from Ebola-affected areas require electronic health declarations and 21-day quarantine; Saudi Arabia suspended visas for Kenyan workers.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最後のエボラ患者を退院させ、42日間のカウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクにおいて死亡例・医療従事者感染・国際的な渡航制限措置（サウジアラビアのビザ停止等）が発生しており、IHR基準に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおけるエボラアウトブレイクの収束報告（42日カウントダウン開始）。感染源はコンゴ経由ウガンダからの渡航者とされるが、DRC・ウガンダ自体で発生が報告されているわけではなく記事の主題でもないため、対象国リストに該当する発生国なしと判断。ケニア・ウガンダ・サウジアラビアは対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia da de alta al último paciente de ébola, comienza cuenta regresiva de 42 días.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya discharges the last Ebola patient, a 42-day countdown begins.
article.articleSummary: Kenya declared its Ebola outbreak largely controlled on November 11, with the last patient discharged and a 42-day countdown to an end on December 23 if no new cases arise. Nine cases and two deaths were recorded. The final discharge came after 21 days of monitoring; for the first time there are no patients under treatment or contacts in quarantine. The first Kenyan case was detected October 6 in a man who arrived from the Democratic Republic of Congo, having lived there seven years; he carried the Bundibugyo strain and died in a Nairobi hospital. No confirmed new cases since October 20, and authorities saw no wider community transmission. Congo reports 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths; Uganda’s outbreak was declared over August 27. Saudi Arabia suspended visas October 30 affecting Kenyan workers; returnees must complete electronic health declarations, arrival screenings, and observe a 21-day quarantine.

article.articleHeadline: Novos casos de mpox exigem atenção aos sintomas e cuidados necessários
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New mpox cases require attention to symptoms and the necessary care.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Brazil reached 665 cases in 2026, per the Ministry of Health, a figure 94% lower than 2022’s surge of 10,821. Transmission is mainly via direct contact with skin lesions, mucous membranes, or secretions from infected individuals; intimate contact (including sex) carries higher risk, with additional spread possible through contaminated objects and, in prolonged close contact, respiratory secretions. Symptoms typically include fever, headache, myalgias, lymphadenopathy, and skin or mucosal lesions, which can be genital/anal and sometimes subtle. Diagnosis is laboratory-confirmed by PCR on lesion material. There is no specific approved antiviral; management is supportive, with most cases mild to moderate and resolving in 2–4 weeks. Isolation is advised from symptom onset until all lesions heal and crusts shed. SUS vaccination targets priority groups after surveillance: people with HIV/AIDS immunosuppression, exposed lab workers, and those with medium/high risk exposure. Seek care early and follow prevention measures.

triage.headline_ja: 新たな新たなmpox症例が増加、症状と必要なケアへの注意が求められる
triage.triage_reason: 2026年の症例数は2022年の大流行時より94%減少しており、公衆衛生学的教育記事の性格が強く、異常性や拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は啓発・教育目的の一般向け記事であり、症例数は前年より大幅減少していることから、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 avança em 18 estados brasileiros com alta na positividade
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 spreads to 18 Brazilian states with rising positivity rate.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 is rising in Brazil, with 18 states showing increases as of 4 November 2026. Through that date, 118,851 SARS-CoV-2–related respiratory syndrome cases were recorded in 2026, and test positivity reached 16.66% last week—the highest since March 2025, with the rise starting in August. Despite the uptick, the Ministry classifies current infections as low risk. SRAG signals are growing in Mato Grosso, Distrito Federal, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Santa Catarina; hospitalizations remain very low overall, though Mato Grosso shows notable SRAG activity. The XFG (Stratus) variant dominates, about 90% of samples; 2,199 genomes across 127 lineages were identified. JN.1, a subvariant of Omicron, was detected; OMS classifies XFG as a Variant Under Monitoring. Vaccination guidance: children 6 months to under 5 years (Moderna two doses, Pfizer three), adults 60+ or immunocompromised boosters every six months, otherwise annual doses; one dose per pregnancy for pregnant individuals.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19がブラジル18州に拡大、陽性率が上昇
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでCOVID-19の陽性率上昇と州数拡大が見られるが、保健省は低リスクと分類し入院も低水準であるため、継続監視が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 新変異株XFG（Stratus）がWHOによりVariant Under Monitoringに分類されているが、重症度や国際的拡大への影響は現時点で不明。入院数は低水準で、当局は低リスクと評価している。

article.articleHeadline: New Covid variant cases spreading, but 'no cause for alarm' - Juta MedicalBrief
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1 is a new Covid-19 variant first identified in Ontario, Canada in May, with detections in New York (US) by late June and later in Australia, Singapore and Spain. As of 2026-11-11, global Covid-19 infections total about 780 million with around 7 million deaths. The variant has many spike-protein mutations but is not believed to evade the immune system more effectively; it accounts for a growing share of cases and may cause more throat infections and prolonged fatigue, per UAE officials. Studies by Chinese scientists (September) suggest rapid intercontinental spread linked to enhanced ACE2 binding. There is no evidence of increased severity or higher hospitalization or mortality; health systems remain under less strain than during the pandemic. Ongoing vigilance is advised but no panic. Imported/exported cases: Ontario May; New York end-June; also Australia, Singapore and Spain. Quotes from Dr. Asher Jamal and Prof. Paul Hunter.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新変異株、感染拡大も『警戒の必要なし』—Juta MedicalBrief
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1は複数国に拡大しているが、重症化・死亡率の増加は確認されておらず、対象国での発生も明記されていないため、現時点では続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は中国の科学者による研究への言及があるが、中国国内での発生事例は明記されていないため対象国として含めていない。発生報告国（カナダ、米国、豪州、シンガポール、スペイン）はいずれも対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Konge - didžiausias Ebolos protrūkis istorijoje: kodėl vis dar nėra vakcinos?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Konge - The Largest Ebola Outbreak in History: Why Is There Still No Vaccine?
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports the largest Ebola outbreak in history, caused by Bundibugyo virus, with confirmed cases exceeding 11,000. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country, officially announced in May, though evidence suggests the virus circulated weeks or months earlier. Bundibugyo, first identified in 2007 in Uganda and in 2012 in DRC, remains without an approved vaccine or specific therapy. The Ervebo vaccine protects against Zaire Ebola virus, but no licensed vaccine exists for Bundibugyo. German researchers, including Leonie Mayer, show Ervebo can elicit a cross-reactive T cell response to Bundibugyo (and perhaps Sudan virus), but it is unclear whether this offers protection. The article notes the paradox that Ebola is a viable vaccine target, yet vaccine development for Bundibugyo has lagged, partly due to funding priorities. Bundibugyo may be less aggressive but longer infectious, complicating control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ ― 史上最大のエボラ流行：なぜ今もワクチンがないのか？
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模（1万1000例超）のエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）流行が継続しており、有効なワクチンもなく公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるブンディブギョ型エボラの史上最大流行とワクチン開発の遅れに焦点を当てている。ウガンダ・ドイツは研究者・歴史的発見地としての言及であり、現在の発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Mpox confirmados no Ceará sobem para 68; saiba como se proteger da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox confirmed cases in Ceará rise to 68; learn how to protect yourself from the disease.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Ceará, Brazil, reached 68 confirmed cases as of November 11, 2026, per Sesa via IntegraSUS, with 9 new confirmations on Saturday, November 7. Most cases occurred in October–November (18 in October; 45 in November); 5 were confirmed February–July 2026. All confirmed cases are male, ages 24–51; 57 reside in Fortaleza. Across Ceará, 174 cases have been notified, 79 discarded, and one probable; no suspected cases were under investigation on November 11. Prevention emphasizes avoiding direct skin contact and unsafe sex, immediate isolation for suspected/confirmed cases, not sharing personal items, hand hygiene, laundering contaminated items, and surface disinfection; ill individuals should wear masks, and gloves are advised when handling lesions. Avoid unprotected animal contact and ensure meat is well cooked. Fiocruz notes smallpox vaccination may confer protection against mpox, though younger people are unlikely to have been vaccinated; global vaccination ceased in 1980; MSD Manual cites up to 85% effectiveness in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州のMpox確定症例が68例に増加；感染予防法について
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・セアラ州でMpox症例が増加傾向（10月18件→11月45件）にあるが、死亡・重症例報告はなく、既知の流行パターン内であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 全症例が男性(24-51歳)、主に性的接触を含む直接接触による感染とみられる。地域内（フォルタレザ市に57例集中）の継続的増加傾向に注意が必要だが、現時点で国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Devetoro dece zaraženo opasnom bakterijom, popularna plaža hitno zatvorena: Sumnja se na vodu, zdravstvene službe pokrenule istragu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nine children infected with a dangerous bacterium, a popular beach has been urgently closed: Water suspected; health authorities have launched an investigation.
article.articleSummary: Nine children in Santa Cruz County, California, infected with a dangerous Escherichia coli O157 strain prompted Capitola Beach to close on November 10 as health authorities investigate a potential waterborne outbreak. Four cases are from Santa Cruz residents and five from other Bay Area communities; all nine are linked, indicating a common source or shared exposure. Officials suspect contaminated water at Capitola Beach or nearby waterways, with four-site water sampling including upstream areas, the pier area, Soquel Lagoon, and the water’s discharge into Monterey Bay; results are pending and further testing planned. E. coli O157 can cause severe gastrointestinal illness, including cramps, abdominal pain, diarrhea (often with blood), and vomiting, with young children at risk of hemolytic uremic syndrome. Public advisories urge avoiding water at the closed beach, not drinking untreated water, and seeking care for dehydration or bloody stools. California Department of Public Health and CDC are assisting; the beach remains closed until conditions are deemed safe.

triage.headline_ja: 9人の子供が危険な細菌に感染、人気のビーチを緊急閉鎖：水が疑われ、保健当局が調査を開始
triage.triage_reason: 米国カリフォルニア州で発生したE. coli集団感染であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 発生地域にPhilippines(Calabarzon/Santa Cruz)が含まれているが、これは地名の同名一致（Santa Cruz County, CAとSanta Cruz, Philippines）によるBluedotの誤判定と考えられる。記事内容は米国カリフォルニア州サンタクルーズ郡での発生のみを扱っており、フィリピンでの発生を示す記述はない。対象国リストに該当する発生国はないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya, aproape de eliminarea Ebola. Ultimul pacient infectat a fost externat din spital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya, close to eradicating Ebola. The last infected patient has been discharged from hospital.
article.articleSummary: Kenya discharged the last Ebola patient, leaving seven survivors among nine total cases with two fatalities. Nairobi Health Minister Aden Duale reported no new infections among contacts. The discharge advances Kenya toward an Ebola-free status, but a 42-day window without new cases (two incubation periods) must pass; if no new cases occur, Kenya could be declared Ebola-free on December 23. The outbreak began on October 6 with a man infected in the Democratic Republic of Congo who traveled to Uganda and then Kenya, dying in hospital. A family member who developed symptoms mid-October also died, while in quarantine. Meanwhile, in the Democratic Republic of Congo eight provinces remain affected, with over 11,000 infections and about 5,400 deaths after nearly six months.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ根絶に近づく。感染した最後の患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでのエボラ症例は収束傾向だが、発生源であるDRCでは8州に拡大し1万1千人以上感染・約5400人死亡という大規模な進行中のアウトブレイクがあり、国境を越えた伝播（DRC→ウガンダ→ケニア）も実際に発生しているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのエボラ終息だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、アウトブレイクの発生源かつ現在も大規模流行が継続中のDRC（8州、11,000人以上感染、約5,400人死亡）は対象国リストに含まれ、記事内で実質的な内容として言及されているためverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Chagas: entenda como um vinho de patauá contaminado causou uma morte e 7 infecções no Pará
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chagas disease: understand how a contaminated patauá wine caused one death and seven infections in Pará.
article.articleSummary: Chagas disease outbreak linked to contaminated patauá wine in Óbidos, Pará, Brazil. One death and seven infections confirmed by the local Health Surveillance bulletin; at least 33 people were exposed. Two hospitalized, four under home monitoring, one under observation, and 26 remaining under surveillance. Wine consumption occurred Sept 21–Oct 2; first symptoms appeared 2–3 days after ingestion. The fruit was harvested in Breu, processed in Vila Liberdade, and distributed to Vila Liberdade and Fuzil communities. Chagas disease is caused by Trypanosoma cruzi and can be transmitted via triatomine bugs (Panstrongylus noireaui); contaminated food can transmit the parasite even if insects are dead. Acute infection lasts 3–8 weeks; chronic disease may involve the heart, esophagus, or intestine. Diagnosis relies on blood tests, with imaging used in chronic cases to assess complications.

triage.headline_ja: シャーガス病：汚染されたパタウア酒がパラ州で1人の死亡と7人の感染を引き起こした経緯
triage.triage_reason: 経口感染（汚染ワイン）によるシャーガス病クラスターで1名死亡・7名感染と非典型的な感染経路であり、地元保健当局が監視体制を敷いていることから、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 汚染されたパタウアヤシの果実から作られたワインの摂取による食品媒介性シャーガス病アウトブレイク。ヒト-ヒト感染ではなく、感染源（特定のワインバッチ）は既に特定・隔離されているため、地理的拡大リスクは低いとみられる。地元保健監視当局が33名の暴露者を追跡中。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola supera los 11,000 casos y más de 5,000 muertes en el Congo: no seamos indiferentes y volteemos la cara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola surpasses 11,000 cases and more than 5,000 deaths in the Congo: let's not be indifferent and turn a blind eye.
article.articleSummary: By November 9, 2026, the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths (roughly 49% fatality), with about 1,000 new infections in the past two weeks. Declared May 15 in Ituri, this outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment; vaccines and antibodies against the Zaire strain do not work here. WHO is backing an in-country vaccine trial. The epidemic has reached eight of 26 provinces, centered in Ituri and North Kivu, and has crossed into Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria, marking the widest geographic spread of Ebola in Africa. Between 60% and 80% of new cases occur outside monitored contact tracing, and about one-third of deaths happen outside treatment centers; early on, a quarter of deaths were children. Ongoing conflict and distrust impede response; calls include ceasefire, urgent funding, equitable vaccine access, and sustained public attention, including evacuations to Europe.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が11,000症例、5,000人以上の死者を超える：無関心にならず、目を向けよう
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、11,000例超・5,387人死亡という大規模流行で複数国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）への越境拡大が確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス（ザイール株用ワクチン無効）によるDRC東部（イトゥリ、北キブ中心）の大規模流行を扱っている。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。接触追跡外での感染が60-80%、治療施設外死亡が約1/3など監視体制の限界も示唆され、致死率・地理的拡大ともに極めて深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Vacina para covid-19: quem deve se vacinar ou tomar reforço diante de aumento de casos da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 Vaccine: Who Should Get Vaccinated or Receive a Booster Amid Rising Cases of the Disease.
article.articleSummary: Rising COVID-19 activity is reported across 18 Brazilian states, including São Paulo, Bahia, Minas Gerais, Distrito Federal and Rio Grande do Sul. The National Immunization Program prioritizes high-risk groups, and anyone who has never been vaccinated may receive a dose at any health unit. Routine vaccination targets: children 6 months–5 years (three doses at 6, 7, and 9 months); pregnant people per pregnancy; adults 60+ (one dose every six months); immunosuppressed (biannual); and those with comorbidities (annual), including obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cardiovascular disease, COPD, vascular disease, dementia or mental disorders. Annual doses are advised for residents/workers in long-term care facilities, healthcare workers, Indigenous, riverine, quilombola communities, incarcerated individuals and staff, adolescents in socio-educational programs, the homeless, and postal workers. Under-60s without comorbidities who are up to date need not vaccinate again; those never vaccinated may receive a dose. XFG/Stratus now dominates ~90% of samples; no evidence of increased severity; vaccines retain protection against severe disease; XFG shows partial immune escape but modest. WHO classifies XFG as Variant Under Monitoring; surveillance identifies 2,199 sequences and 127 lineages in 2026, including JN.1 as a VOI.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19ワクチン：感染増加の中、誰が接種または追加接種を受けるべきか
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の季節的な感染増加とワクチン接種ガイダンスに関する一般的な公衆衛生情報であり、重症度増加の証拠もなく、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 新変異株XFG/Stratusが優勢だが、重症度増加の証拠なし、ワクチンの有効性も維持されているとの報告。通常のワクチン接種キャンペーンの案内記事。

article.articleHeadline: Centre lauds Bengal's steps against dengue
article.articleSummary: Centre lauds Bengal's dengue prevention and control after NCVBDC's Nov 6 review of high-burden states. Kolkata, West Bengal has implemented a dengue reporting portal, healthcare worker training programmes, and a regular monitoring and observation system, which the union health ministry commended. In Oct–Nov this year, Bengal reported about 14,634 dengue cases, compared with 17,032 cases in the same period last year, indicating improvement. Centre's appreciation highlights strengthened surveillance and rapid response in dengue management. State health minister Sharadwat Mukherjee noted the acknowledgment will motivate health workers. The remarks came at the NCVBDC meeting, underscoring ongoing efforts to curb dengue in Bengal.

triage.headline_ja: 中央政府、デング熱対策でベンガル州を称賛
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はインド西ベンガル州の風土病であり、今年は前年より症例数が減少し、対策が評価されている内容で、異常性・緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は中央政府による州の防疫対策への称賛が主題で、症例数も前年比減少しており、通常の季節性デング熱報告の範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: 肯尼亚本轮埃博拉疫情最后一名患者出院
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The last patient in this round of the Ebola outbreak in Kenya has been discharged.
article.articleSummary: Kenya's Ministry of Health announced the last patient of the current Ebola outbreak has recovered, and the final 11 close contacts completed a 21-day monitoring period. Kenya reported 9 Ebola cases with 2 deaths, and traced 135 contacts, all within a single transmission chain with no community transmission. A 42-day monitoring period begins on November 12; if no new cases are detected, the outbreak is expected to be declared over on December 23, reflecting the period double Ebola’s longest incubation. The ministry will maintain high vigilance with border screening, community outreach, and rapid-response teams on standby, given ongoing risk from the Congo (Kinshasa) outbreak. The DRC’s Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak began May 15; there is no approved vaccine or targeted therapy for this strain, and the WHO called it among the largest Ebola outbreaks on record.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアにおける今回のエボラ出血熱流行、最後の患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: ケニアの流行は単一の感染連鎖に限定され地域内感染なく終息に向かっているが、背景にあるDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）のブンディブギョ型エボラ流行は依然継続中でワクチン・治療薬未承認とされ、WHOが史上最大規模の一つと指摘しており、引き続き監視が必要。
triage.notes: ケニアはBluedot付与地域に含まれるが対象国リスト外のため除外。記事はケニアの流行終息を主題としつつ、DRCの進行中の大規模エボラ流行（ワクチン・治療薬未承認、WHOが史上最大級と指摘）を背景リスクとして言及しているためDRCを検証地域に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de sarna atinge 46 pessoas e suspende aulas em centro infantil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scabies outbreak affects 46 people and suspends classes at a daycare center.
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreak in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, has reached at least 46 laboratory-confirmed cases across two municipal early childhood centers. Ceim Recanto Raízes (Jardim Água Boa) reports 40 cases (24 children, 16 staff), with 18 recovered and 22 under treatment; five new cases and six reinfestations prompted an indefinite suspension of in-person classes as of Nov 11, 2026. Ceim Beatriz de Barros Bumlai (BNH 4º Plano) accounts for six cases (four staff, two children). A third unit in Jardim Água Boa shows suspected cases but is not confirmed. Total confirmed cases: ≥46. Control measures include complete environmental cleaning, linen laundering, and decontamination; expanded interdepartmental coordination (Education, Health, Primary Care, Epidemiological Surveillance, Social Assistance, and the Tutelary Council). Transmission occurs via prolonged direct contact with Sarcoptes scabiei and is not necessarily linked to hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 疥癬の集団発生、46人に拡大し保育施設で休園措置
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度・国際的拡大リスクが低く、局地的な保育施設での集団発生に留まるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルでの対応が進んでおり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には該当しない。続報の必要性も低い。

diseases.name: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza A H5N1
Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1
