article.articleHeadline: El brote de gripe aviar H5N1 de Umán sigue en curso, informa la OMSA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Umán's H5N1 avian influenza outbreak is ongoing, reports the OIE.
article.articleSummary: OIE reports an ongoing highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) outbreak in Umán, Yucatán, Mexico—the first poultry outbreaks in the country, with the event not yet resolved. The Umán farm's infection source remains inconclusive. Mexico's 2023–2024 national H5N1 outbreak affected Sonora, Jalisco and Oaxaca, with 145,160 birds lost (15,678 died, 129,482 culled). As of November 2026, H5N1 outbreaks remain active in 18 countries, including Ivory Coast, Italy, Philippines, Indonesia, Peru, Nigeria, Bulgaria, Taiwan, South Africa, Senegal, Germany, Denmark, Canada, the United States, Mexico, the United Kingdom, Norway and the Netherlands; Indonesia is stable. Outbreak began Oct 30, 2026; sequencing confirmed H5N1 on Nov 4–5, 2026. The Umán farm housed 225,860 birds; 862 died and 224,998 were culled; a 40-day containment and quarantine began.

triage.headline_ja: ユカン(メキシコ)のH5N1鳥インフルエンザ流行が継続中、国際獣疫事務局(OMSA)が報告
triage.triage_reason: メキシコ・ユカタン州の養鶏場でH5N1の継続的な発生が報告されているが、ヒト感染例は確認されておらず影響カテゴリも動物のみ。世界18か国で流行が続いている点は注視が必要だが、現時点でヒトへの公衆衛生リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 主たる発生国であるメキシコは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。フィリピンとインドネシアは『現在活動中のH5N1発生国18か国』のリストに具体的に名指しされているため含めたが、記事の主題はメキシコ・ユカタン州の家禽発生である。ヒト感染例の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Up 58% in Costa Rica as Chikungunya Passes 1,000 Cases
article.articleSummary: Costa Rica reports dengue up 58% in 2026, with 6,594 cases as of Nov. 2 and 105 dengue cases with warning signs; three hospitalizations. CDC flagged elevated dengue risk earlier. Chikungunya now exceeds 1,000 cases, at 1,049 through week 42 (mid-October): 916 lab-confirmed and 133 probable. Guanacaste’s Chorotega region accounts for 602 chikungunya cases (57% of the total); La Cruz 389; Carrillo 90; Santa Cruz 64. Outside Guanacaste, Alajuela Province has 2,791 dengue cases, followed by Puntarenas 981 and San José 880; Grecia 727, Alajuela 658, Orotina 591, San José 418, Puntarenas 416 by county. Orotina records 2,323.8 dengue cases per 100,000 (about 18x the national rate). Local transmission for both diseases began in Guanacaste in July and in Alajuela; by September dengue reached Pavas, San José. Prevention focuses on mosquito bite avoidance, repellent, protective clothing, and eliminating standing water; seek care for fever or severe symptoms and avoid ibuprofen/aspirin. The dry season prompts container coverage.

triage.headline_ja: コスタリカでデング熱が58%増加、チクングニア熱は1,000例を突破
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱の症例数増加と地域的な感染継続が確認されるが、重篤な転帰（死亡等）の報告はなく、社会的・国際的関心の高まりも明確でないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコスタリカにおけるデング熱・チクングニア熱の増加であり、対象国リストに含まれる国（フィリピン等）は発生地域データに含まれるが記事本文では言及されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : MSF appel à élargir l'accès au vaccin Ervebo - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: MSF calls to broaden access to the Ervebo vaccine - ACP
article.articleSummary: MSF urges expanded access to Ervebo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid an Ebola outbreak linked to Bundibugyo virus. Although Ervebo was developed against Zaire ebolavirus, animal and immunology data suggest cross-reactivity that could protect exposed populations, according to MSF in Kinshasa. The NGO argues that widening use beyond research protocols would reduce severe disease and deaths among health workers, frontline responders, contacts of confirmed cases, and affected communities. While the DRC Ministry of Health has authorized compassionate use, vaccine stocks remain limited: 500,000 doses requested via the ICG with Africa CDC support, but only 70,000 doses have been made available. MSF calls Merck, global health authorities, and partners to reallocate vaccines to meet public health needs, pending WHO SAGE guidance (meeting November 17). Vaccination should complement surveillance, rapid testing, case management, contact tracing, and infection prevention.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：国境なき医師団（MSF）がErveboワクチンのアクセス拡大を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）アウトブレイクに関する報道であり、重篤性・国際的関心・ワクチン供給不足など複数のIHR/WPRO基準に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン配分に関する提言が主題だが、背景にあるエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）アウトブレイク自体が重大な公衆衛生イベントであるため、既存アウトブレイクの継続監視としてPICKUP判定。ワクチン供給不足（70,000/500,000回分）は管理可能性への懸念を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mongbwalu : reprise du travail des chauffeurs de l'hôpital après des négociations - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mongbwalu: Hospital Drivers Resume Work After Negotiations - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola response drivers in Mongbwalu, Ituri province, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, resumed work after negotiations on 11 November 2026. The drivers had blocked Ebola response vehicles at hospital entrances, hindering ambulance access and delaying some patients seeking care. Dr. Richard Lokudu, medical director of Mongbwalu General Reference Hospital, said the protest began with refusals to work and impeded opening of the hospital portal. Hospital staff intervened to clear the way and restore passage. The drivers' action followed the detention of a colleague for a week after a road traffic accident that resulted in a police officer's death, linking the disruption to the ongoing Ebola response operations in the Mongbwalu health zone.

triage.headline_ja: ムングバルのエボラ出血熱対応：交渉後、病院の運転手が業務再開 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州ムングバルで進行中のエボラ出血熱対応活動が運転手のストライキにより一時妨げられたことを示しており、致死率の高いエボラ対応オペレーションへの支障は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響とIHR通報の対象となる異常事象に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事自体は新規症例の報告ではなく、既存のエボラ対応活動に対する運転手のストライキと交渉による業務再開を伝えるもの。背景に進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応があることから、全体の対応継続性に関するリスクとしてピックアップが妥当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : une trentaine de préoccupations communautaires recueillies lors d'une formation - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Around Thirty Community Concerns Collected During a Training Session - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centers on a training session held on 11 November 2026 in Rwampara for community leaders on community-based surveillance and risk communication. About thirty community concerns were raised regarding Ebola vaccination and the management of patients in Ebola Treatment Centers (ETCs). Mercy Corps led the effort to map perceptions and counter misinformation, aiming to restore trust and boost population engagement in prevention and surveillance. The training seeks to strengthen leaders' capacity for early detection of Ebola virus disease signs, timely alerting, and interruption of transmission chains, with community engagement viewed as a key lever toward the zero Ebola cases objective.

triage.headline_ja: イツリのエボラ出血熱：研修会で約30件の地域住民の懸念が集められる - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州でのエボラ対応に関する地域住民向け研修活動の報告であり、新規症例やアウトブレイクの詳細（規模・重症度）は記載されていないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ治療センターでの患者管理やワクチン接種に関する地域住民の懸念を集める研修活動についての報告であり、新規感染者数や死亡者数などの疫学データは含まれていない。ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文では言及されていないため除外した。ゼロエボラ目標への言及から、イツリ州で既存のエボラ対応が継続中であることが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : l'UNICEF salue les progrès et réaffirme son soutient aux autorités - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: UNICEF welcomes progress and reaffirms its support for the authorities - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, is being tackled with strengthened UNICEF support as of November 11, 2026. UNICEF Associate Director of Public Health Emergencies, Dr. Douglas Noble, after talks with military governor Major General Gaby Kasongo, reported substantial progress since May and positive community impact. The response has expanded to schools and rural areas, implementing hygiene measures, training, and distribution of prevention kits. UNICEF has delivered more than half a billion metric tons of PPE and medical supplies to Bunia and Ituri. Thousands of community health workers have been trained to boost household awareness, active case finding, and access to safe drinking water in schools and health facilities. Essential health services, including prenatal care and routine child vaccination, are being maintained, with continued support to the government and partners until the outbreak ends.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州のエボラ出血熱：UNICEFが進展を歓迎し、当局への支援を再確認 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準における重大性・異常性に該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当（重症度・持続曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）するため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事は5月から続くイツリ州のエボラ流行に対するUNICEFの支援進捗報告であり、新規発生ではなく既存アウトブレイクの継続的対応状況を示す内容。国際的拡大や渡航制限に関する言及はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : un médecin survivant d'Ebola retourne en première ligne - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: a doctor who survived Ebola returns to the front line - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On 11 November 2026, a doctor who survived Ebola has resumed frontline duties with response teams in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, to help care for patients. Dr. Sylvain Radjabu, formerly staff at the Ebola Treatment Center in Elikya, Bunia, rejoined high-risk-zone operations after his own recovery from Ebola. He recalls the fear, pain, and uncertainty faced by patients, and his return is driven by empathy and a commitment to patient support, including psychological care. MSF’s project 'Ebola: Behind the Mask' highlights survivors who continue work in Ituri and North Kivu, focusing on care, infection prevention, and community awareness. Radjabu says, 'I know it is possible to heal because I was healed,' underscoring the role of personal experience in guiding the response.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ:エボラ生存者の医師が最前線に復帰 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ生存者医師の復帰という人道的な話題であり、新規感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報は含まれていないが、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ対応継続中であることから経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は新規アウトブレイクの発生を報じるものではなく、エボラ生存者医師の人道的な活動に焦点を当てた内容であり、現在進行中のエボラ流行の規模や新規感染状況についての具体的情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans la Tshopo : l'hostilité communautaire à Bafwasende entrave la surveillance épidémiologique - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tshopo: Community hostility in Bafwasende hinders epidemiological surveillance - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Bafwasende, Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is hampered by community hostility toward investigation teams, hindering epidemiological surveillance, case detection, field investigations, and contact tracing. In Kisangani, Dr. Stanislas Masulimare highlighted that resistance from some communities complicates exposure assessment and timely response, underscoring the need to rebuild trust between populations and health teams. The response plan emphasizes a participatory approach, involving community leaders and local authorities, with large-scale sensitization missions. Objectives are to restore public confidence, secure cooperation with investigation teams, and facilitate field interventions, thereby reducing resistance, improving acceptance of surveillance activities, and strengthening collaboration to interrupt the Ebola transmission chain.

triage.headline_ja: トショパ州でのエボラ出血熱：バフワセンデでの住民の敵対的態度が疫学サーベイランスを妨げている（ACP）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクであり、コミュニティの抵抗により調査・サーベイランスが妨げられているため、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクを伴う可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ出血熱のサーベイランス活動そのものに焦点を当てており、感染者数・死亡者数など具体的疫学データは記載されていない。コミュニティの抵抗が感染連鎖遮断の障害となっている点が主要な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: MSD lança nova vacina contra doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSD launches new vaccine against Newcastle disease.
article.articleSummary: MSD Animal Health launched Multriva, a new vaccine in São Paulo on 10 November 2026, targeting Newcastle disease and four other poultry diseases: Avian Rhinotracheitis (Pneumovirus), Infectious Bronchitis (IBV), Gumboro disease (Infectious Bursal Disease), and Reovirus (REOm). Multriva is an update of Ibmulti, a bivalent product introduced about 20 years ago and now holding roughly 70% of the Brazilian market for layer breeders; MSD aims to reach 85% market share. The move coincides with ongoing Newcastle disease outbreaks in Brazil. In Brazil, Newcastle vaccination is mandatory for breeders and laying birds, but optional in broiler operations, including farms that reported cases. The article emphasizes market expansion and regulatory context rather than detailing case counts or laboratory confirmations.

triage.headline_ja: MSD、ニューカッスル病に対する新ワクチンを発売
triage.triage_reason: 記事は新ワクチン発売を主題とする商業ニュースであり、感染症アウトブレイクの詳細（症例数、確定検査等）は記載されていないが、ブラジルで継続中のニューカッスル病発生に言及しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽疾病ワクチンの市場参入に関する商業記事であり、ヒトへの感染リスクや公衆衛生への影響は言及されていない。家禽（動物）疾病であり、ニューカッスル病の発生継続という事実のみ確認できる。続報でアウトブレイクの規模・公衆衛生影響を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : le centre de transit pour les cas suspects d'Ebola bientôt opérationnel à Kasindi (Bourgmestre de la commune) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: the transit center for suspected Ebola cases will soon be operational in Kasindi (the mayor of the municipality) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) transit center for suspected cases will soon be operational at Kasindi-Lubiriha health center in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, near the Uganda border. Kasindi mayor Gilbert Bwambale announced progress on the transit center to receive suspected EVD cases, enabling cross-border activities to resume. The municipality has 45 confirmed cases, reflecting strong community engagement and epidemiological surveillance by response teams. Authorities and partners are deploying ambulances and constructing transit and Ebola treatment centers to ensure rapid response. Kasindi-Lubiriha authorities barred admission of suspects into facilities that do not meet housing standards, directing them to transit or treatment centers. Mutwanga health zone, which includes Kasindi, reports 68 confirmed cases, 45 of them in Kasindi.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州:カシンディでエボラ疑い例のための通過センターが近く稼働へ(同市長)-ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州カシンディでエボラ出血熱の確定症例が45例(ムトワンガ保健地区全体で68例)報告されており、ウガンダ国境近接地域での継続的なアウトブレイクとして重大な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダ国境付近での越境活動再開の記述があり国際的拡大リスクが示唆されるが、ウガンダ側での症例発生は記事中に明記されていないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ébola en República Democrática del Congo supera los 11 mil contagios con casi 5,400 decesos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 11,000 infections with nearly 5,400 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000 confirmed infections, with 5,387 deaths as of 9 November 2026. National Institute of Public Health data show 11,042 cases, a case fatality rate of 48.8%, and 2,990 recoveries; 651 patients remain under medical surveillance or in isolation. The outbreak began on 15 May. Authorities continue control measures, including disinfection and contact tracing in the most affected areas to curb spread. This underscores the ongoing, high-fatality Ebola outbreak in the DRC with substantial active cases under care or observation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、感染者1万1千人超、死者はほぼ5,400人に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%の大規模エボラ流行が継続し、1万人超の感染と拡大リスクがあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 5月15日に始まった流行が継続中で、致死率48.8%と非常に高く、651名が隔離・経過観察中であり、さらなる拡大とヒト-ヒト感染のリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola hara Afrikom: Više od 5.300 preminulih
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages Africa: More than 5,300 have died.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa — Ebola confirmed infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo reached 11,042 with 5,387 deaths, government data cited by Reuters show. Declared mid-May, the outbreak is caused by a rare Ebola strain for which no vaccines are approved. Late detection, ongoing conflict, and an overwhelmed health system have allowed faster spread than in previous epidemics. The disease is now reported across eastern, central, and western Africa, representing the largest Ebola epidemic ever recorded on the African continent. The absence of a vaccine for this strain compounds response challenges amid widespread instability and resource constraints.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、アフリカを席巻：死者5,300人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が発生し、致死率が高く国際的拡大も報告されており、IHR基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は稀なエボラ株による過去最大規模の流行を報じており、ワクチン未承認・紛争下での医療崩壊が拡大要因とされる。アフリカ大陸全域への波及が述べられているが、具体的な対象国としてはDRCが主題。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans la Tshopo : 98 cas confirmés et 40 décès enregistrés au 10 novembre - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tshopo: 98 confirmed cases and 40 deaths recorded as of November 10 - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Kisangani, Tshopo province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, shows 98 confirmed cases and 40 deaths as of 10 November, per the provincial health division’s updated epidemiological report. The case fatality rate is 41%. Among the infected are 25 frontline health workers, including five deaths. Contact tracing identified 30 contacts, of which 28 are known and under follow-up, a 93.3% follow-up rate. The data indicate ongoing transmission in this northeastern province, underscoring the critical role of close contact monitoring and surveillance to curb spread and protect frontline staff. The report highlights sustained transmission within the province and the need for continued public health measures to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州でのエボラ出血熱：11月10日時点で98例確認、40人死亡 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 致死率41%のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクがDRCで継続しており、医療従事者への感染・死亡も発生していることから深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR Annex2で即時通報対象疾患であり、致死率41%・医療従事者感染25名を含む継続伝播が確認されているため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Riposte contre Ebola: trois nouveaux cas enregistrés dans la province du Haut-Uele - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola response: three new cases recorded in Haut-Uele Province - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in Haut-Uele Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, progresses with three new confirmed cases reported on 10–11 November 2026—one in the Rungu health zone and two in the Pawa health zone—raising the province’s total to 502 confirmed cases and 230 deaths (case fatality rate 45.8%). The update was delivered by the surveillance pillar lead during a planning meeting of the provincial coordination in Isiro, with participation from the provincial health division and the WHO. Currently, 24 patients are receiving care in Ebola Treatment Centers across Haut-Uele. The report emphasizes ongoing surveillance and response activities as the outbreak persists, underscoring the need for sustained treatment capacity and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応：オートウエレ州で新たに3例を確認 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の進行中のアウトブレイクで、致死率45.8%と高く、累計502例・死亡230例に達しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大のリスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 既知の進行中アウトブレイクの継続報告であり、新規発生ではないが、死亡率の高さと症例増加により継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: près de 11.000 cas d'Ebola notifiés à la 42ème semaine - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Nearly 11,000 Ebola cases reported in Week 42 - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains concerning as of Week 42, 2026, with 10,920 cumulative cases, a 48% case fatality rate, and 69% of contacts followed up. The high lethality is notably observed among children in North Kivu province, prompting a methodological review to identify drivers of this mortality and to define targeted interventions to protect children and the elderly. The briefing also covered cross-border collaboration with Uganda, with final bilateral conclusions pending to translate recommendations into concrete actions, including strengthened surveillance at entry points. These data indicate ongoing transmission in the DRC and underscore the need for enhanced public health measures and cross-border coordination to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：第42週にエボラ出血熱の症例が約1万1000件報告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48%の大規模エボラ流行がDRCで継続しており、ウガンダとの国境を越えた拡大リスクも指摘されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たしフルRRAが必要と判断される。
triage.notes: ウガンダは国境監視強化の文脈で言及されているが、感染事例の発生国としては明記されていないため対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみを検証対象とした。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Aumento de casos de Covid-19: o que fazer diante da suspeita da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in COVID-19 cases: what to do when you suspect the disease.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports a rise in COVID-19 cases, with Fiocruz’s InfoGripe showing more severe illnesses in Mato Grosso, the Federal District, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Santa Catarina. In Espírito Santo, 2,073 new COVID-19–related influenza-like syndrome cases and 15 deaths were recorded through epidemiological week 43 (ending Oct 31), with adults 18–59 most affected, followed by seniors; cases also occur in children, indicating broad circulation. Symptoms overlap with influenza—sore throat, cough, runny nose, congestion, headache, fever—and cannot be distinguished reliably without lab tests. Confirmation requires rapid antigen tests or RT-PCR. There is no universal vaccination; the National Immunization Program targets children up to five, adults over 60, immunocompromised individuals, and health workers, with annual boosters for high-risk groups. Vaccination aims to reduce severity, hospitalizations, and deaths, complemented by hygiene, masking when symptomatic, testing, and early antivirals like Paxlovid (nirmatrelvir-ritonavir) for high-risk patients.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19症例の増加:疑わしい症状がある場合の対処法
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでの季節性のCOVID-19症例増加に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性のCOVID-19/インフルエンザ様疾患の増加を報告する健康啓発的内容であり、ワクチン接種プログラムや検査・治療法の案内が中心。既存の国家保健システムで対応可能な通常の季節変動と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Com possível surto em Corguinho, Campo Grande mantém alerta para leishmaniose com 30 casos em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With a possible outbreak in Corguinho, Campo Grande remains vigilant for leishmaniasis with 30 cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Possible leishmaniasis outbreak in Corguinho, inland Mato Grosso do Sul, prompts vigilance in Campo Grande, 99 km away. Visceral leishmaniasis is not transmitted person-to-person; infection requires a bite from an infected sandfly. Campo Grande remains a vector-endemic area, with high indices in Anhanduizinho, Segredo and Lagoa. By October 2026, 30 human cases have been confirmed in the capital; 2025 saw 39 cases and four deaths. Sesau emphasizes ongoing prevention and surveillance via the Centro de Controle de Zoonoses, including annual serological surveys in all neighborhoods, environmental management, vector monitoring, and veterinary preventive diagnostics. Residents should keep yards clean, remove organic waste, use dog collars, and install screens on doors and windows. Suspected human lesions should be evaluated at a UBS; tegumentary leishmaniasis has free SUS treatment, with therapy chosen by clinical manifestation; avoid self-treatment. Sandfly activity is higher in late afternoon and at night.

triage.headline_ja: コルギーニョでの発生可能性を受け、カンポ・グランデはリーシュマニア症への警戒を継続、2026年は30例
triage.triage_reason: 地域流行地での既知の媒介生物媒介疾患であり、2025年と同程度の発生数で特段の異常性や急拡大は見られないが、継続的なサーベイランスの対象として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ヒト-ヒト感染なしの媒介生物媒介疾患で、既存の流行地における定期的なサーベイランス活動の一環として報じられている。2025年は39例・4死亡、2026年は10月時点で30例と大きな増加は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: Αντίστροφη μέτρηση για την Κένυα: Σε 42 ημέρες θα κηρυχθεί απαλλαγμένη από τον Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Countdown for Kenya: In 42 days it will be declared Ebola-free.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, Kenya began a 42-day countdown to declare Ebola-free after the last patient was discharged, ending a outbreak that began in October. Nine Ebola cases have been recorded in Kenya; the index patient traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), where May's large outbreak was declared. All subsequent cases were contacts of the initial case. One more patient died and seven recovered. No new cases have been reported since 19 October, and the final 11 contacts completed quarantine on Wednesday. Kenya will require arrivals from the DRC to quarantine for 21 days. Ebola has been detected in four African countries—the largest geographic spread on the continent—with the DRC outbreak the second largest ever, exceeding 11,000 confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアの逆算カウントダウン開始：42日後にエボラ終息宣言へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行（1万1千例超）が継続中であり、ケニアを含む4カ国への国際的拡大と渡航制限措置（21日間の検疫）が確認されているため、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアのエボラ終息カウントダウンだが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方でDRCの大規模流行（史上2番目、1万1千例超）が背景として言及されており、国際的拡大の重要な文脈となるためDRCを含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient
article.articleSummary: Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient on 2026-11-11, with the patient completing treatment in Nairobi and the country expected to be declared free on December 23 if no new cases emerge. The Ministry of Health said 135 contacts linked to the index case had been traced and monitored; the final patient had 11 contacts who would undergo a 21-day quarantine. Of the nine confirmed cases, seven recovered and two died, all linked to a single transmission cluster with no community transmission. The first case was reported on October 6 in a Kenyan man who had recently returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the outbreak continues with 11,000 cases and 5,387 deaths since May, its deadliest episode. Nigeria has recorded one Ebola case involving a traveler from Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最後のエボラ患者を退院させる
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでの小規模クラスターは終息に向かっているが、DRCで11,000例・5,387死亡という大規模かつ深刻なエボラ流行が継続中であり、ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの越境感染も報告されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ケニアの事例は終息に向かっているが、DRCの大規模流行（2026年5月以降最悪の流行）が主題であり継続的な国際的懸念事項。Kenya・Nigeria・Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Idoso de 73 anos morre com suspeita de febre maculosa em Mimoso do Sul - Folha Vitória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 73-year-old man dies with suspected Rocky Mountain spotted fever in Mimoso do Sul - Folha Vitória
article.articleSummary: In Mimoso do Sul, southern Espírito Santo, a 73-year-old man died Monday with suspected Rocky Mountain spotted fever. He presented with fever, headache and body aches after visiting Apiacá hospital Friday and was discharged after treatment for possible sinusitis. Over the weekend his condition worsened; he returned Sunday with severe symptoms and died the following Monday. Family reported he worked on a farm across the Itabapoana River, near Rio de Janeiro; tick exposure was only disclosed to clinicians on Sunday, triggering a febrile syndrome investigation. A blood sample was taken at Apiacá hospital and sent to LACEN-ES; results are pending. The municipality had 69 RMSF notifications, with 3 confirmations and 24 under investigation as of Nov 7. Among confirmed cases, two deaths: a 12-year-old girl in July and a woman in April. No further details from Sesa at publication.

triage.headline_ja: ミモーゾ・ド・スル市で73歳男性がロッキー山紅斑熱疑いで死亡 - Folha Vitória
triage.triage_reason: ロッキー山紅斑熱（紅斑熱群リケッチア症）はブラジル南東部で地域的流行が見られる疾患で、単発の疑い死亡例であり、現時点で異常な拡大や人-人感染のリスクは確認されていないが、自治体内での感染報告数が継続しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・エスピリトサント州ミモーゾ・ド・スル市での単発の疑い死亡例を報告。同市では年間69件の発熱症候群通知があり、3件確定、24件調査中（11/7時点）。ダニ媒介性で人-人感染なし。地域の風土病としての継続的サーベイランス対象。

article.articleHeadline: Military Clashes Undermine Ebola Case Tracking in DRC - WHO
article.articleSummary: On 11 November 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said military clashes and insecurity in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are undermining Ebola case tracking. Speaking at a briefing for WHO member states, he acknowledged progress in the outbreak response, noting that some areas have reported no new Ebola cases. However, he warned that new hotspots continue to emerge, complicating surveillance and containment efforts. The remarks underscore how conflict disrupts data collection and timely response, potentially delaying outbreak control. The update highlights the ongoing Ebola situation in affected DRC regions and the need to ensure safe access for health workers to monitor cases and report accurately. No further figures are provided in the excerpt.

triage.headline_ja: 軍事衝突がコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ症例追跡を妨げる - WHO
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という高重症度疾患の継続的アウトブレイクに加え、紛争による監視・対応能力の低下という異常事態が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が加盟国向けブリーフィングで言及した内容であり、国際的関心の高さが示唆される。新規ホットスポットの出現と紛争による追跡困難が強調されており、続報の確認が必要。具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Past Avian Flu Outbreaks Had Limited Impact on Bird Populations
article.articleSummary: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) outbreaks prior to 2020 are characterized for their longer-term impacts on wild bird populations. The international study involves authors from the United Kingdom, Iran, Slovenia, Romania, Uganda, Bulgaria, Germany, Algeria, Japan, the Republic of Korea, the Netherlands, South Africa, China, France, and Namibia, underscoring a global research perspective. It aims to characterize the sustained effects of HPAI outbreaks on wild birds over time, with no specific outbreak counts or effects detailed in the summary provided. Funding was granted to WP by the Royal Society for the Protection of Birds through its Avian Flu Appeal, with funders not involved in study design, data collection and analysis, decision to publish, or manuscript preparation. The material is presented as a public release, focusing on pre-2020 avian influenza events and their longer-term implications for wild bird populations.

triage.headline_ja: 過去の鳥インフルエンザ流行は野鳥個体群への影響が限定的だった
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2020年以前のHPAI流行が野鳥個体群に与えた長期的影響に関する学術研究の紹介であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の脅威やアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は研究論文の著者所属国を列挙しているだけで、特定の国での新規アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。対象国（中国など）も著者所属として言及されているのみで、発生国としての記載ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: തിരുവല്ലയിൽ 750 തെരുവുനായ്ക്കൾക്ക് പേവിഷ പ്രതിരോധ കുത്തിവെപ്പ്‌ നൽകി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies vaccination given to 750 street dogs in Thiruvalla
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination drive in Thiruvalla: 750 street dogs vaccinated out of a target of 1,000, as part of an ongoing municipal program. The vaccination began on October 14 and runs daily, except holidays. Trained government-authorized dog catchers are participating, with the Thiruvalla Municipality Veterinary Polyclinic leading the effort. Senior Veterinary Surgeon Dr. Ritesh Babu said the remaining dogs could be vaccinated within a week. The campaign aims to lower the threat of bite-related rabies and move toward a rabies-free Thiruvalla. The Animal Birth Control (ABC) center and related schemes are nearing completion, expected to enhance the efficiency of street-dog control and vaccination once fully operational.

triage.headline_ja: ティルヴァッラで野良犬750匹に狂犬病予防接種を実施
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病フリーを目指す通常の野良犬ワクチン接種事業の進捗報告であり、ヒトの症例や異常事態の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による予防的な動物ワクチン接種プログラムの定期進捗報告記事であり、感染拡大や異常事態を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Spike in attacks on DRC journalists fueled in part by Ebola reporting
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has surged to the second-worst outbreak on record since its May detection, fueling fear and a backlash against reporters covering its spread. CPJ reports attacks on two radio stations in the past week and multiple journalists harassed or detained. Nov 4 in North Kivu’s Oïcha, Radio du Peuple Oïcha editor-in-chief Jackson Mbusa Vagheni was beaten by six unidentified assailants and hospitalized after being accused of spreading Ebola information. Nov 5 in Bafwasende, Tshopo, RTBD journalist Finance Sianga Bilanga was punched amid Ebola-awareness work. Oct 24 Sianga was attacked after a report on clinic closures amid Ebola fear. Jul 27 Kamole FM presenter Guillaume Munguakonkwa was detained for reporting on Ebola. Nov 3 Zahabu Celemami survived a home invasion; Nov 7 Radio Terra FM staff were assaulted in Ituri. Nov 6 threats targeted a journalist collective in Kasaï-Central over illegal mining investigations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のジャーナリストへの攻撃増加、一因はエボラ報道
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5月以来「史上2番目に深刻なエボラ流行」とされる事態が継続しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たすため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事本体はジャーナリストへの暴力・弾圧を主題としているが、背景にあるエボラ流行自体がDRC北東部（北キブ、ツホポ、イトゥリ、カサイ・セントラル）で深刻化しており、5月の検出以来「史上2番目に深刻」とされる点が重要なシグナル。続報で感染者数・死亡者数・WHO対応状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DOH reports 17% increase in flu-like cases
article.articleSummary: Influenza-like illness (ILI) in the Philippines rose 17% from Oct 4–17 to 15,122 cases, up from 12,929 registered Sept 20–Oct 3, per the DOH’s Ulat ng Ahensya. Cumulative Jan 4–Oct 31 reached 142,246, 18% lower than 173,364 in the same period in 2025. The case fatality rate is 0.06%. Regional increases were highest in Western Visayas, Mimaropa and Central Visayas; 13 provinces and highly urbanized cities across 10 regions showed localized upticks, most in the National Capital Region. DOH urged preventive measures: cover coughs/sneezes, stay home when symptomatic and ensure proper indoor ventilation, plus vaccination for vulnerable groups. The WHO defines ILI as fever ≥38°C with cough within 10 days; other respiratory viruses can produce similar symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: DOH、インフルエンザ様疾患の症例が17%増加と報告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ様疾患の通常のサーベイランス報告であり、致死率も低く（0.06%）、年間累計は前年より減少しているため異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: DOHによる定期的な疾病動向報告（Ulat ng Ahensya）であり、季節的な地域増加（Western Visayas、Mimaropaなど）が報告されているが、累計症例数は前年同期比で18%減少しており、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola na República Democrática do Congo chega a 11.042 casos e 5.387 mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 11,042 cases and 5,387 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 11,042 cases and 5,387 deaths, the worst outbreak on record in the country. As of November 11, 2026, transmission remains focused in eastern DRC, with spillover reported to Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. The outbreak was declared in mid-May, with the official notice coming months later. Ebola spreads through contact with bodily fluids and causes severe fever with hemorrhagic symptoms. Counts come from the Congolese National Institute of Public Health, as clashes between armed groups and security forces complicate containment. In October, the World Health Organization began a clinical trial to assess the Ervebo vaccine, approved only for the Zaire ebolavirus strain. MSF has urged expanding vaccine access to those at risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、感染者11,042人・死者5,387人に達する
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大が報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへのスピルオーバーが報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。武装勢力との衝突が封じ込めを困難にしており、WHOによるErvebo臨床試験開始、MSFによるワクチンアクセス拡大要求あり。

article.articleHeadline: Number of Ebola Cases in Congo Surpasses 11,000
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in Congo has surpassed 11,000 confirmed cases (11,042) and 5,387 deaths (case fatality rate 48.8%). Eight provinces—Haut-Uélé, Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Sud Ubangi, Nord Ubangi—are affected, with 67 of 178 health zones reporting cases. The WHO Africa Region says transmission remains high and sustained, with no sign of decline as of Nov 7. Factors driving spread include delayed detection, conflict, and strained health services; many deaths occur outside treatment centers. Strikes and security incidents have strained responses in Nord-Kivu, Tshopo, and Bas-Uélé, with response suspension in Bafwasende after October violence. On import/export, Kenya and Nigeria remain contained; no new Kenyan cases since Oct 19, no Nigerian secondary cases, monitoring ending Nov 13. The last Kenyan Ebola patient was discharged on Nov 11, starting a 42-day countdown to Ebola-free status. Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids; not airborne.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ症例数が1万1000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、1万1000例超の大規模アウトブレイクが8州に拡大し、紛争や治安問題で対応が困難化しており、国際的拡大（ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境例）も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアは二次感染例なく封じ込め成功、両国とも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが主たる発生国。

article.articleHeadline: Interpretable Random Forest Model Predicts Severe Influenza Risk in
article.articleSummary: A retrospective cohort at Nanjing Children’s Hospital analyzed 436 hospitalized pediatric influenza patients (322 mild, 114 severe) admitted between Jan 1, 2022 and May 31, 2023 to predict progression to severe disease within the first 24 hours of admission. Using an interpretable SHAP-based random forest framework with LASSO feature selection, eight biomarkers were identified as core predictors: neutrophil percentage, serum procalcitonin, aspartate aminotransferase, blood glucose, blood urea nitrogen, complement C3, B cell percentage, and CD4+ T lymphocyte count. Missing values were imputed; 46 candidate variables were reduced to eight. The dataset was split 70/30 into training (n=305) and testing (n=131) cohorts with balanced baseline characteristics. Secondary bacterial coinfections, especially Haemophilus influenzae, Staphylococcus aureus, and Streptococcus pneumoniae, were more common in severe cases. The model offers transparent risk drivers for early triage and targeted interventions. Keywords: influenza, pediatric, Nanjing, machine learning, SHAP, biomarkers, coinfection.

triage.headline_ja: 解釈可能なランダムフォレストモデルが入院小児における重症インフルエンザリスクを予測
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は過去の後ろ向きコホートデータを用いた予測モデル研究であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な感染症発生を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 研究対象は2022年1月〜2023年5月の過去データであり、現在進行形の発生イベントではないため地域検証でも除外。

article.articleHeadline: Carbapenem-Resistant Bloodstream Infections Drive High Mortality in
article.articleSummary: Retrospective cohort at the Department of Hematology, Affiliated Hospital of Southwest Medical University, Luzhou, China, analyzed 210 patients with hematological diseases and culture-confirmed Gram-negative bacteremia (May 2023–May 2025). Thirty-day all-cause mortality was 19.05% (40 deaths). Carbapenem-resistant Gram-negative infections showed 30-day mortality 45.7%, vs 11.6% for carbapenem-susceptible cases. Serum interleukin-6 was markedly elevated in non-survivors and in patients with carbapenem-resistant strains, supporting IL-6 as a prognostic marker. E. coli was the most common pathogen (94 isolates, 44.8%), followed by Klebsiella pneumoniae (50, 23.8%); carbapenem-resistant isolates totaled 46 (21.9%), with E. coli and K. pneumoniae predominating among resistant strains. MDR and ESBL phenotypes were 44.8% and 31.4%, respectively. Patients were largely neutropenic (78.6%), with acute leukemia most common (63.3%), high rates of pulmonary coinfection (84.8%) and septic shock (31.9%); median pre-infection hospitalization was 18 days.

triage.headline_ja: カルバペネム耐性血流感染症が血液疾患患者の高い死亡率をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設における後ろ向きコホート研究の学術報告であり、新規の感染症発生・アウトブレイクイベントではないため、シグナルとしての対応は不要。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国・瀘州市の一病院における血液疾患患者を対象とした薬剤耐性菌血症の後ろ向き研究論文であり、公衆衛生上の発生事象（アウトブレイク）ではない。院内感染・AMRに関する学術的知見の報告であるため、トリアージ対象外（地域特定の発生国としても除外）。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola no Congo supera 11 mil casos e 5 mil mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo surpasses 11,000 cases and 5,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 11,042 confirmed infections and 5,387 deaths, across eight of the country’s 26 provinces. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, for which no licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists. It constitutes the deadliest outbreak in the DRC’s history and the second-largest by case count globally, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. The WHO notes Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine) has no proven protection against bundibugyo. On 4 November, the WHO recommended two vaccine candidates—ChAdOx1 (Oxford/SII) and mRNA-1469 (Moderna)—for inclusion in the Tumaini adaptive Phase 2/3 trial conducted in the DRC to evaluate safety and efficacy against bundibugyo. Enrollment depends on national approvals; results are expected early 2027. The trial uses ring vaccination targeting contacts and other high-risk individuals.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、感染者1万1000人、死者5000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪規模のエボラ流行で、承認済みワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株によるものであり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態であるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRC国内の状況のみを記述しており、Angolaでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية ..حالات الإصابة بفيروس إيبولا تتجاوز 11 ألفا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola virus infections surpass 11,000
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 11,042 confirmed Ebola virus infections and 5,387 deaths from the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. The outbreak, identified in mid‑May, is the second‑largest and deadliest on record, after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. Eight of the 26 provinces have been affected, with many fatalities occurring outside treatment centers. Delays in detection and strained health services have accelerated spread compared with previous outbreaks. Health authorities call for sustained vigilance, enhanced surveillance, and intensified investigations of suspected cases. The Ministry of Health also emphasizes rigorous contact tracing in areas with gaps to cut transmission chains and prevent new infections in communities. There are no approved treatments or vaccines for this Bundibugyo strain according to the report.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラウイルス感染者数が11,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際的拡大リスク）に加え、史上2番目の規模・致死率の高いアウトブレイクであり、治療薬・ワクチンが存在しないため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC国内の流行のみが言及されており、Angolaへの拡大は確認されていないため除外した。ブンディブギョ株には承認された治療法・ワクチンがなく、致死率が極めて高い点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 中共隱瞞疫情 年輕人疏於防範猝死增多 | 中國新冠疫情 | 新冠變異株 | 心梗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CCP Conceals the Outbreak; Youth Lax in Precautions, Rise in Sudden Deaths | China's COVID-19 Pandemic | SARS-CoV-2 Variants | Myocardial Infarction.
article.articleSummary: China faces a COVID-19 surge driven by a new SARS-CoV-2 variant, with authorities allegedly concealing the outbreak, leading to lax precautions among youths and a spike in sudden deaths from myocardial infarction in people roughly 20–30 years old (including reports of 16- and 14-year-olds). Provincial CDC health risk advisories in November urge vigilance against COVID-19, influenza, measles, and monkeypox, yet CCP media highlights only influenza. Anecdotal posts describe more than ten cremations of young adults, and a 23-year-old dying of a stroke; Wuhan parents report multiple fever-related absences in middle school students; a triple-infection case shows simultaneous COVID-19, Influenza A and Influenza B. Medical commentators warn that SARS-CoV-2 damages blood vessels and promotes thrombosis; northern China is at medium transmission, the south approaching high; a 15% rise may trigger higher stroke risk.

triage.headline_ja: 中共が疫病を隠蔽、若者の予防意識低下で突然死増加｜中国新型コロナウイルス感染症｜新型コロナ変異株｜心筋梗塞
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株による若年層の突然死急増という主張は反体制系メディア（NTD）による未確認の逸話的情報が中心だが、各省CDCが新型コロナ・インフルエンザ・麻疹・サル痘への注意喚起を発出している点は公式情報として注視に値する。
triage.notes: 情報源は反中共系メディア（新唐人電視台）であり、突然死・心筋梗塞の事例はSNS上の逸話的情報で検証困難。ただし地方CDCによる感染症注意喚起（公式発表）の存在は事実として言及されており、続報・公式統計の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Կոնգոյում Էբոլայի վարակակիրների թիվը գերազանցել է 11 հազարը
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the number of Ebola cases has exceeded 11,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 11,042 cases and 5,387 deaths, per government health ministry data (AP cites it as the country’s heaviest outbreak). Declared in mid-May, the outbreak has spread to eight of 26 provinces, including Ituri and North Kivu. The causative Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no known vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission-control efforts are hampered by armed conflict, a health-system crisis, poor road infrastructure, and misinformation; renewed fighting in Ituri and North Kivu further restricts access for clinicians. The virus has also crossed borders to Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. This outbreak is the world’s second-deadliest Ebola event; the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak remains the largest, with roughly 28,000 cases and over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルス感染者数が1万1000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は1万人以上の症例・5000人超の死者を伴う深刻な公衆衛生事象であり、複数国への越境拡大も確認されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）が主題。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・アンゴラへの越境拡大が言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in DRC: Confirmed cases top 11,000
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) saw 52 new confirmed cases on Nov 9, 2026, across Ituri (30), North Kivu (17), and Haut-Uélé (5) — a 25.7% drop from the previous day. Thirty-nine patients (Ituri 22, North Kivu 15, Haut-Uélé 2) recovered after two negative tests. Community deaths reached 19 (Ituri 10, North Kivu 8, Haut-Uélé 1); 14 additional deaths occurred in Ebola Treatment Centers (ETCs) (Ituri 5, North Kivu 9), totaling 33 deaths during this period. Since outbreak start, 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths (case fatality rate 48.8%). Ituri remains the epicenter (69.6% of cumulative cases; 57.7% of new cases); North Kivu accounts for 32.7% of new cases with CFR 55.0%. No new health zones were affected in the last 24 hours; 67 of 178 zones (37.6%) across eight provinces have been affected.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：確定症例数が11,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で累計11,042例・致死率48.8%の大規模エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続しており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性）を2つ以上満たすためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率48.8%、178保健地域中67地域（8州）が影響を受けている大規模かつ継続中のアウトブレイク。国際的拡大や渡航制限については記事内に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Cacique Raoni é internado em Peixoto após alterações na pressão e diagnóstico de infecção pulmonar - Só Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chief Raoni is hospitalized in Peixoto after changes in blood pressure and a diagnosis of pulmonary infection - Só Notícias.
article.articleSummary: Indigenous leader Chief Raoni Metuktire, 93, is hospitalized for three days at Hospital Regional de Peixoto de Azevedo (197 km from Sinop) after blood pressure fluctuations and a diagnosed pulmonary infection treated with intravenous antibiotics. The latest bulletin notes a stable clinical course, though he remains on antihypertensive treatment with vasoactive medications to maintain hemodynamic stability. He is taking meals orally and breathing ambient air without supplemental oxygen, under continuous medical supervision. The care plan emphasizes palliative principles, prioritizing comfort, symptom control, and dignity. The infection is being addressed alongside general supportive measures. Raoni had previously been hospitalized in Sinop and was transferred to a hospital in São Paulo, where he was discharged in July this year.

triage.headline_ja: ラオニ酋長、血圧変動と肺感染症の診断を受けてペイショット病院に入院 - Só Notícias
triage.triage_reason: 個人の高齢者（93歳）の個別医療事例であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生や感染拡大の兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: 著名な先住民指導者個人の健康状態に関する報道であり、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Morte de idoso é investigada suspeita de febre maculosa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of an elderly person under investigation for suspected spotted fever.
article.articleSummary: An elderly resident, 73, from the Ponte Itabapoana district of Mimoso do Sul in southern Espírito Santo, Brazil, is under investigation for suspected spotted fever (febre maculosa) after dying on November 10, 2026. He sought care on November 6 with fever, intense headache, and body pains; initial assessment suggested sinusitis and he was discharged, but symptoms worsened and he died two days later. He did not report tick exposure at first; the family later said he worked on a farm in a high-risk tick area. Lacen-ES is analyzing samples. Espírito Santo has 31 confirmed spotted fever cases in 2026, with 17 deaths; Mimoso do Sul records 3 cases and 2 deaths, Baixo Guandu 2/2, Linhares 1/1. A concurrent dengue investigation is underway; results are pending. Health authorities urge reporting tick exposure and starting treatment promptly upon suspicion, ideally within five days of symptom onset.

triage.headline_ja: 高齢者の死亡、紅斑熱（斑点熱）の疑いで調査中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・エスピリトサント州で致死率の高い紅斑熱（リケッチア症）の集団発生が継続しているが、ヒト-ヒト感染がなく国際的拡大リスクは低いため、フルRRAには至らないが経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 紅斑熱（febre maculosa、ダニ媒介性リケッチア症）は致死率が高く、エスピリトサント州で2026年に31例確定・17死亡と高い致死率を示している。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、国際的な拡大リスクは低い。デング熱の並行調査中だが結果待ち。ベクター（ダニ）媒介性疾患であり、国内の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: UFBA emite alerta sobre Covid-19 e gripe e orienta isolamento de cinco dias em casos leves
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UFBA issues an alert about COVID-19 and influenza and advises five-day isolation for mild cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, Universidade Federal da Bahia (UFBA) in Bahia, Brazil, reinforces guidance for COVID-19, influenza and other respiratory illnesses. The Medical University Service (SMURB) urges masks, vaccination and isolation for those with respiratory symptoms. Symptoms such as cough, runny nose, sore throat, nasal congestion or fever warrant wearing a mask (surgical or PFF2/N95), avoiding in-person activities and seeking medical evaluation. Five-day isolation from symptom onset is advised for mild influenza-like illness in non-immunocompromised people, per Ministry of Health Technical Note 5/2026. After five days, isolation may end if fever is resolved for at least 24 hours without antipyretics and symptoms improve. Asymptomatic positives should isolate for five days from the test date; immunocompromised or severe cases follow specific guidelines. On return, continue wearing a well-fitted mask through day 10 and avoid contact with vulnerable individuals. Vaccination against COVID-19 and influenza, ventilation, hand hygiene and cough etiquette are encouraged; staff should report positives and follow leave procedures; students should avoid on-site activities during isolation and inform coordinators.

triage.headline_ja: UFBA、新型コロナとインフルエンザに関する注意喚起を発表、軽症例は5日間の隔離を推奨
triage.triage_reason: 大学による通常の公衆衛生ガイダンス・予防啓発であり、異常な発生や重症化、国際的拡大の兆候は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は大学による季節性呼吸器疾患（COVID-19・インフルエンザ）への標準的な予防・隔離ガイダンスであり、具体的な症例数・流行状況の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola supera los 11.000 casos, el más mortífero en la historia de Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak surpasses 11,000 cases, the deadliest outbreak in Congo's history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) has reached 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths, the deadliest outbreak in the country’s history. Declared mid-May, the outbreak spans eight of 26 provinces, with Ituri accounting for about 70% of cases and North Kivu the main site of new transmission. There is no vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo virus. Ongoing violence, a weak health system, poor roads, and distrust hinder response, leaving over 1,000 contacts untraced and three suspected cases unlocated. Attacks on health workers have drawn WHO concern; Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus condemns the violence. The outbreak has spread to Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. It ranks as the second-largest Ebola outbreak ever, with roughly triple the pace of the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo übersteigt 11.000 Fälle, 5.387 Todesfälle gemeldet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo surpasses 11,000 cases, 5,387 deaths reported.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000 cases, with 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths reported as of November 11. Ituri Province accounts for about 70% of cases, while North Kivu is the main site of new transmissions. The Bundibugyo virus behind the outbreak has no known vaccine or treatment. The health ministry notes the outbreak began in mid-May and has spread to eight of 26 provinces. triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、感染者11,000人を超え、死者5,387人と報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が11,000例・死者5,387人に達し、複数国へ拡大、武力紛争により対応が困難な深刻な公衆衛生事案であるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngola, Kenya, Uganda, Nigeriaが含まれるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ブンディブギョウイルス株によるもので既知のワクチン・治療法がなく、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行に次ぐ規模。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 continua circulando em Cuiabá e vacinação é reforçada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 continues to circulate in Cuiabá and vaccination is being reinforced.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 continues to circulate in Cuiabá, Brazil, with reinforced vaccination and free vaccines at 72 Family Health Units (USFs). Priority groups include people 60+, pregnant individuals, puerperae, those with obesity, diabetes, chronic diseases, disabilities, and immunocompromised status; health workers, Indigenous, quilombolas, riverine communities, and people experiencing homelessness, plus other groups defined by the Ministry of Health. Booster doses are advised every six months for the elderly and immunocompromised; one dose per pregnancy for pregnant individuals; other groups follow an annual schedule per guidance. From weeks 01 to 42, Cuiabá saw a substantial reduction in COVID-19 cases vs 2025, which had 1,412 notifications; 2026 data show an 85.33% decline for the same period. Symptoms include fever or chills, cough, shortness of breath, fatigue, sore throat, runny nose, and sometimes loss of smell or taste; seek care if symptoms worsen.

triage.headline_ja: クイアバでCOVID-19の感染が継続、ワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の日常的な流行状況報告であり、2026年は前年比85.33%減少しているなど通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内で、異常性や緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり、本記事は定例のワクチン接種キャンペーンと症例数減少を報告する内容。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、イベントとしての異常性がなくシグナルには該当しないため地域検証上も特記事項なし。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en el Congo supera los 11,000 casos, se reportan 5,387 muertes.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000 cases, with 5,387 deaths reported.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak has surpassed 11,000 cases as of November 11, 2026, with 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths reported by the health ministry. Ituri Province accounts for ~70% of cases, while North Kivu is the primary site of new transmission; eight of 26 provinces are affected. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus behind this outbreak has no vaccine or approved treatment. Response efforts are hindered by ongoing violence, a strained health system, poor roads, and community mistrust and misinformation. Attacks on health workers have killed at least four and delayed contact tracing, with more than 1,000 contacts lost to follow-up. Declared mid-May, the outbreak has also spread to Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. The 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak remains the largest on record, with about 28,000 infections and over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが11,000症例を超え、5,387人の死亡が報告される
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,000例超・死亡5,387人という大規模なエボラアウトブレイクであり、周辺国への越境拡大やワクチン・治療薬の欠如など深刻な公衆衛生上のリスクが認められるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへの拡大が言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。アンゴラも発生地域に含まれるが記事本文では言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, oltre 11mila casi in Congo: il virus corre dove le cure non arrivano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, over 11,000 cases in the Congo: the virus is spreading where treatment does not reach.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo virus spans eight provinces, including Ituri and Nord Kivu. As of Nov 9, 2026, 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths have been reported, with 335 deaths outside treatment centers between Oct 21 and Nov 3. Declared May 15, the epidemic is worsened by conflict, insecurity, and transportation barriers that hinder response, diagnostics, and community trust. Diagnostic capacity in Bunia and Mongbwalu has risen from 30 to 80 tests per day, enabling faster case identification, though reaching patients remains challenging. Transmission requires direct contact with blood or infected fluids; early symptoms are fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headache, followed by vomiting and diarrhea, not necessarily hemorrhage. Treatments focus on rehydration and supportive care. Ervebo protects against Ebola Zaire; new Bundibugyo vaccines—ChAdOx1 and mRNA-1469—are in the Tumaini trial, with PARTNERS evaluating MBP134, remdesivir, and potential maftivimab.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴで1万1000人超の症例：治療が届かない地域でウイルスが拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによる大規模流行が継続しており、8州にまたがり1万人超の症例・致死率約49%と深刻。紛争・治安悪化により対応が困難で国際支援が必要なためPICKUP。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に宣言された流行で、Bundibugyoウイルスによるもの。紛争・治安悪化・交通障害が対応を妨げており、治療施設外での死亡例も多数報告されている。新規ワクチン（ChAdOx1、mRNA-1469）の臨床試験（Tumaini trial）が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola au Congo dépasse 11 000 cas, 5 387 décès signalés.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo surpasses 11,000 cases, 5,387 deaths reported.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 11,000 cases; as of November 11, 2026, the Ministry of Health tallies 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths. Ituri Province accounts for about 70% of cases, while North Kivu is the main site of recent transmission; the outbreak has spread to eight of the country’s 26 provinces. Violence complicates response, and health workers have been attacked, delaying contact tracing with over 1,000 contacts lost and three suspected cases not counted. The Bundibugyo strain drives the outbreak, for which no vaccine or treatment is known. The epidemic began mid-May and has extended to Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. Health authorities urge a halt to fighting to enable access; this outbreak ranks second to the 2014-2016 West Africa Ebola epidemic (28,000 infections, >11,000 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、感染者数1万1000人超、死者5387人を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ大規模流行（1万人超の感染、致死率約49%）がウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへ拡大し、ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株が原因で、紛争による対応阻害も深刻であるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（特にIturi州、North Kivu州）での流行を主題としている。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの拡大が言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。アンゴラも発生地域に含まれていたが記事本文では言及なく除外。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Chagas deixa um morto e sete infectados no Pará
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chagas disease leaves one dead and seven infected in Pará.
article.articleSummary: Seven people diagnosed with acute Chagas disease in the rural Óbidos area of Pará, Brazil, including one death; six are under home monitoring and one is hospitalized at Hospital Regional Menino Jesus in Oriximiná. As of 11 November 2026, 27 others await test results. The outbreak began after a patient who drank artisanal wine from patauá palm reported symptoms; wine was consumed between 21 September and 2 October. Health authorities interdicted the production site and seized the depulping device; Fiocruz collected a sample of the beverage kept in a freezer for analysis, along with other vectors. Patauá does not carry the parasite; contamination can occur during processing if fruits and equipment are not protected. Symptoms include diarrhea, abdominal pain, headache, and intermittent fever; early treatment in the acute phase is crucial. Óbidos had not notified severe Chagas cases in over 20 years, though underreporting exists.

triage.headline_ja: パラ州でシャーガス病アウトブレイク、死者1名・感染者7名
triage.triage_reason: 過去20年以上重症シャーガス病の報告がなかった地域での急性感染アウトブレイク（死亡1例、感染7例、27名検査待ち）であり、WPRO基準（異常性・重症度）に該当し、保健当局による生産施設の閉鎖等の対応も見られるため、フルリスク評価への移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 経口感染（パタウア椰子の自家製ワイン）によるアウトブレイクであり、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクは低い。汚染源は特定・処理済みだが、27名の検査結果待ちがあり追加症例の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 天津一学校停课两周！这种病进入高发期，传染性极强
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A school in Tianjin suspends classes for two weeks! This disease has entered a high-incidence period and is highly contagious.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) is in a high-incidence period in Tianjin, China, with schools suspending classes for two weeks after a surge among children aged five and under. HFMD is caused by multiple enteroviruses; peak seasons are spring–summer (April–July) and autumn (September–November). Typical symptoms include fever and rashes on hands, mouth, and feet, often with cough, runny nose, or poor appetite; some cases lack prominent rash. Transmission occurs via fecal–oral contamination, direct contact with vesicle fluid, saliva, or feces, contaminated objects, and respiratory droplets, with crowded, poorly ventilated settings accelerating spread. Prevention centers on hand hygiene, ventilation, disinfection of toys and dinnerware, and EV-A71 vaccination, which reduces severe disease and death but only covers EV-A71. Vaccination is advised for 6 months to 5 years. Seek immediate care for persistent high fever, lethargy, tremors, vomiting, cold extremities, or rapid breathing.

triage.headline_ja: 天津の学校が2週間の休校措置！この病気が流行期に入り、感染力が非常に強い
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病（HFMD）流行により天津で学校が2週間休校するなど社会的関心が高く、子ども集団での流行しやすさ・曝露継続が確認されるためWPRO基準を満たす。
triage.notes: HFMDは中国で季節性流行が通常見られる疾患であり、本記事も「高発期」と明記しているため異常性は低いが、学校休校という社会的インパクトと子ども集団での感染拡大リスクからPICKUPと判定。重症例・死亡例の報告は本文中になし。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ заявила о регистрации тысяч случаев чумы по всему миру и сотнях погибших
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reports thousands of plague cases worldwide and hundreds of deaths
article.articleSummary: Between 2019 and 2025, WHO recorded nearly 4,000 suspected plague cases (bubonic and pneumonic) across 10 countries, with 423 deaths. Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis and transmitted by wild rodents and fleas, incubates from several hours to 3–6 days and presents in bubonic, pneumonic, or septicemic forms with high fever and severe toxemia. Africa remains the traditional hotspot in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar; Asia includes Mongolia and China; the Americas include Peru and the United States. Lab-confirmed cases are concentrated in DRC (1,893), Madagascar (693), Kenya (22), China (19), Mongolia (17), and Uganda (2). Suspected but unconfirmed cases include Brazil (8, all fatal, not lab-confirmed), Qatar (2), Saudi Arabia (2), and Ecuador (1). The United States reportedly averages about 7 cases per year but is not included in WHO tallies. Modern antibiotics render plague highly treatable and not a global pandemic threat.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが世界各地でペスト症例数千件、死者数百人を報告
triage.triage_reason: 2019〜2025年の累積データに基づくWHOの世界的ペスト動向レビューであり、新規発生や急激な変化を示す情報ではないため、継続監視が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOによる2019〜2025年の累積統計レビューであり、特定の新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。DRC・マダガスカルは既知の流行地であり、中国・ブラジルは確定/疑い症例が少数報告されているのみ。抗生物質による治療可能性が高く、パンデミックリスクは低いとされる。

article.articleHeadline: Trem2 Receptor Shapes Immune Defense and Pathogen Survival in Infectious
article.articleSummary: Trem2 is a myeloid-restricted immunoglobulin receptor acting as a context-dependent immune sensor that shapes host defense and pathogen survival across bacterial, viral, and parasitic infections. A Frontiers review from China summarizes Trem2’s role in alveolar and placental macrophages, as well as CNS microglia and recruited tissue macrophages, showing a nonuniform influence on infection. Structurally, Trem2 has a transmembrane domain and an extracellular IgV-like domain stabilized by disulfides C36-C110 and C51-C60, with a short intracellular tail; mutations Y38C, T66M, and V126G disrupt folding. It is shed by ADAM10/ADAM17 to soluble Trem2. Signaling requires DAP12 and DAP10, with Src-family phosphorylation and SYK recruitment. Ligands include Gram-positive/negative bacteria, mycobacterial mycolic acid and trehalose dimycolate, and apoptotic eat-me signals (phosphatidylserine/phosphatidylethanolamine, cardiolipin) and damaged lipids. Toxoplasma gondii antigens suppress Trem2 transcription via ATF3. Trem2’s net effect varies with pathogen, cell type, and disease stage, modulating inflammation and survival rather than eradication, with lipid-rich lung environments promoting macrophage survival.

triage.headline_ja: Trem2受容体が感染症における免疫防御と病原体生存を左右する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はTrem2受容体の免疫学的メカニズムに関する基礎研究レビューであり、具体的な感染症の発生・流行事例を報告するものではないため、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は基礎免疫学研究のレビューであり、中国での実際の感染症アウトブレイクを報告するものではないため、発生地域としての中国は除外した。
