article.articleHeadline: Projeto da UFBA realiza testagem de tuberculose em adolescentes de escolas de Salvador
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UFBA project conducts tuberculosis screening among adolescents in Salvador's schools.
article.articleSummary: Salvador, Brazil—The UFBA-led WellModTB project will screen 15-19-year-olds in four Salvador schools for latent tuberculosis infection using IGRA blood tests. Data collection begins in November 2026 after student engagement. Conducted by UFBA's PECS/ISC, the study aims to generate data on Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection prevalence among Brazilian youth to inform public health policy. A positive IGRA signals exposure, not active disease; those individuals will be referred to a SUS primary health unit for further testing and care. Participants will also complete a 15-30 minute questionnaire on attitudes toward potential new TB vaccines; results will be anonymized. WellModTB, funded by the Wellcome Trust and coordinated by the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine (UK), seeks evidence to guide national/global TB prevention and potential vaccine adoption in adolescents and adults. TB is airborne; BCG offers limited lifelong protection; vaccine research continues.

triage.headline_ja: UFBAのプロジェクトがサルバドールの学校で青少年の結核検査を実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の研究・スクリーニングプロジェクトであり、アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は研究プロジェクト（潜在性結核感染のスクリーニング研究）の紹介であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態の報告ではない。エルサルバドルと英国は資金提供・研究機関所在地として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Epitaciolândia faz Dia D de vacinação após casos de sarampo no município
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epitaciolândia holds D-Day vaccination drive after measles cases in the municipality.
article.articleSummary: Two imported measles cases prompted intensified prevention and a D-Day vaccination drive in Epitaciolândia, Acre, Brazil. On Saturday, November 14, 2026, from 8:00 AM, the Municipal Health Secretariat will host Dia D - Epitaciolândia Imunizada at Praça Edmundo Pinto to update immunization records and expand health services. The multivaccination event will include pentavalent and measles-containing vaccines (triple viral) and other vaccines listed in the National Vaccination Calendar, for children, adolescents and adults. The campaign also provides access to the Mobile Dental Unit and general medical consultations. Residents are urged to bring identification, the SUS card, and their vaccination card if available. Aim: raise vaccination coverage and reinforce immunization as essential protection, with heightened surveillance following the imported measles cases.

triage.headline_ja: エピタシオランジアで麻疹症例確認後、ワクチン接種の「D-Day」を実施
triage.triage_reason: 輸入麻疹症例2例に対する予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンであり、現時点で大規模な拡大や重症化の情報はないが、麻疹の伝播性を踏まえ続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 症例数2件の輸入症例で、現地当局がワクチン接種強化で対応中。重症度や拡大の兆候に関する情報は記事内になし。

article.articleHeadline: Índice de infestação do mosquito da dengue em Limeira fica em 0,3, abaixo do limite de 1%; cuidados devem ser mantidos - Portal Veloz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue mosquito infestation index in Limeira remains at 0.3%, below the 1% limit; precautions must be maintained - Portal Veloz.
article.articleSummary: October 2026 surveillance in Limeira, Brazil, shows Aedes aegypti–driven dengue risk remains controlled but vigilance required. The health department’s Larval Density Assessment (ADL) found a built-environment infestation index of 0.3% across 4,952 urban properties, well below Brazil’s 1% threshold; eight urban areas all stayed under 1% (0 to 0.5%). The survey identified 26 containers with larvae, 22 (85%) testing positive for Aedes aegypti. Of 570 containers observed, 441 contained water (77.4%), predominantly cans and bottles, reusable bottles, and plant-pot dishes. About 48.6% of containers were movable and 35% were removable or alterable. Authorities emphasize year-round prevention: eliminate unused items that collect water and keep containers dry and covered; perform weekly property checks in yards and gardens to reduce breeding sites. Resident participation is crucial to prevent dengue spread.

triage.headline_ja: リメイラ市のデング熱媒介蚊幼虫指数は0.3%で基準値1%を下回るも、注意継続が必要
triage.triage_reason: 蚊の幼虫指数調査結果であり、基準値を下回り管理下にあることが報告されているのみで、実際の症例急増や異常事態は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・リメイラ市における蚊の幼虫密度調査（予防的サーベイランス）に関する内容であり、デング熱症例の増加や異常事態の報告はない。対象国リストにBrazilは含まれるが、本記事の内容は通常の予防活動報告でありシグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: All Ten Sampled Urban Bats in Soppeng Harbor Ectoparasites
article.articleSummary: Ten bats from an urban roost at Taman Kalong in Watansoppeng, Soppeng Regency, South Sulawesi, were examined; ectoparasites detected on all individuals (infestation prevalence 100%, 95% CI 69.2–100%). Recovered 34 ectoparasites, 2–6 per bat; mean abundance and mean intensity 3.4 parasites per bat. Morphology aligned with Nycteribiidae bat flies; provisional identification of Eucampsipoda cf. sundaica. Specimens preserved in 70% ethanol and examined microscopically. Contextual environmental-health indicators from the Indonesian Health Survey 2023 suggest high basic drinking-water access but gaps in safely managed sanitation, wastewater, and waste management. Authors describe findings as a preliminary baseline, not generalizable beyond this urban roost, and call for One Health surveillance: host-resolved sampling, ongoing ectoparasite monitoring, molecular ID, and targeted pathogen screening at human-wildlife interfaces, integrating local environmental indicators.

triage.headline_ja: ソッペンの都市部コウモリ全10匹に外部寄生虫が確認される
triage.triage_reason: コウモリの外部寄生虫に関する基礎的な生態学的調査であり、ヒトへの感染事例や健康被害の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は疾患名としてCoccidioidomycosisがタグ付けされているが、内容はコウモリの外部寄生虫（ハエ科Nycteribiidae）調査であり、実際の疾患発生報告ではない。One Health監視の必要性を提言する学術的な予備調査。

article.articleHeadline: Município de Iracemápolis chega a 100% do território urbano mapeado por drone no combate à dengue - Portal Veloz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Iracemápolis Municipality Reaches 100% of Its Urban Territory Mapped by Drone in the Fight Against Dengue - Portal Veloz
article.articleSummary: Iracemápolis, Brazil, completes 100% drone-based mapping of its urban area to identify dengue fever mosquito breeding sites, covering two city regions. The mapping program, which began in 2024, has identified over 1,000 potential foci and relayed them to endemic-illness agents for follow-up inspections. In 2026, the municipality reports 6 dengue fever cases, among the lowest in recent years, attributed to preventive work. Health Secretary Ralf Silva notes that drone surveillance reveals hidden sites such as open water tanks, rooftops, and backyards that are hard to access; he attributes the drop from more than 1,000 dengue cases in 2024 to six in 2026 to the concerted efforts of agents, the Zoonosis Surveillance Department, and community collaboration. As summer approaches and rainfall rises, the risk of breeding sites increases, and residents are urged to eliminate standing water and stay vigilant in mosquito control.

triage.headline_ja: イラセマポリス市、ドローンによるデング熱対策で市街地100%のマッピングを達成
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例は2026年にわずか6件と大幅減少しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められず、予防活動の成功事例を報じる内容である。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・イラセマポリス市におけるデング熱対策（ドローンによる発生源マッピング）の成功を報じるものであり、症例数は2024年の1000件超から2026年は6件に減少。感染症危機シグナルとしての該当性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Um óbito e sete casos de doença de Chagas são confirmados no Pará
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One death and seven cases of Chagas disease have been confirmed in Pará.
article.articleSummary: One death and seven confirmed cases of Chagas disease have been recorded in Óbidos, a municipality in western Pará, Brazil, after a beverage containing pulp from the patauá fruit was consumed. Four patients are in home treatment and three are under hospital observation; those who drank the drink are urged to seek urgent care if fever, diarrhea, or abdominal pain appear. The Pará State Health Secretariat is assisting Óbidos and monitoring epidemiological surveillance. Chagas disease is caused by Trypanosoma cruzi and can be transmitted vectorially, orally, congenitally, by transfusion or transplantation, or accidentally. Incubation periods: vector 4–15 days; oral 3–22 days; accidental up to 20 days; transfusion/transplant 30–40+ days; vertical any time during pregnancy or birth. Benznidazole is the primary treatment, with nifurtimox as an alternative; early treatment is favored in acute cases. Prevention focuses on reducing triatomine exposure and safe food handling, including washing produce with potable water.

triage.headline_ja: パラ州オビドスでシャーガス病の死亡1例と感染7例が確認
triage.triage_reason: 果実ジュースを介した経口感染によるシャーガス病クラスターで死亡例・入院例が確認されており、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響・異常性）が2つ該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 経口感染（パタウア果実ジュース摂取）によるシャーガス病の集団発生。州保健局が疫学調査を実施中で、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性は低く点源曝露の可能性が高い。続報で感染源特定・追加症例の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Covid-19 aumentam 117% em Campinas; veja números
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases rise 117% in Campinas; see numbers.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases in Campinas, São Paulo, Brazil rose 117.8% from September to October 2026, reaching 98 in October (vs 45 in September). Year-to-date total: 1,054 confirmed cases and 16 deaths, with the latest fatalities in the week of October 4–10. Of the 2026 cases, 635 were female and 419 male; the highest diagnostic counts were ages 0–9 (188), 20–29 (167), 30–39 (123), and 40–49 (120). About 8.25% of diagnosed patients required hospitalization. Among the 16 deaths, eight were aged 80+, four were 60–69, and three were 70–79. A circulating new Covid-19 variant shows no evidence of greater severity; vaccination and updated boosters remain essential. Isolation after a positive test is five days, with masking through day 10. Fiocruz’s InfoGripe notes signals of Covid-19–related SRAG growth in several states, though incidence remains low in some areas.

triage.headline_ja: カンピナスでCOVID-19症例が117%増加、数字を見る
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19症例の増加が報告されているが、既知の病原体で重症度の増加もなく、季節的変動の範囲内の可能性があるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 新変異株は重症度増加のエビデンスなしと記載されており、既存の対策（ワクチン、隔離）で管理可能と判断される地域限定的な事例。

article.articleHeadline: देहरा गांव में डेंगू से दो मौतों के बाद जागा स्वास्थ्य विभाग, 110 लोगों की जांच
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Dehra village, after two dengue deaths, the health department woke up; 110 people were screened.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fatalities in Dehra village, Dhaulana, Uttar Pradesh, prompted a health response after two deaths. Gulfam alias Gullu, 32, developed fever about 15 days earlier and died during treatment at a Ghaziabad hospital; about a month earlier, neighbor Zulfiqar alias Aladin also died of dengue after lab-confirmed diagnosis and admission to Pilkhhuwa Medical College. On Wednesday, a district health team set up a fever clinic and screened 110 fever patients for dengue and malaria; tests returned negative for both diseases. Post-screening, authorities conducted door-to-door checks, anti-larvae spraying in drains and ponds, and night fogging. Villagers allege long-standing sanitation neglect and have complained to the gram panchayat without action. Dr. Kishor Kumar Ahuja, Chief Medical Officer, urged cleanliness and removal of standing water from pots, tires, and other containers to curb mosquito breeding.

triage.headline_ja: デヘラ村でデング熱による2人の死亡を受け、保健局が対応開始—110人を検査
triage.triage_reason: 単一村落での散発的なデング熱死亡例で、地元保健当局が既に対応（防疫措置・スクリーニング）を実施済み。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクはなく、インドでは地域的流行がよく見られる疾患であり特段異常ではない。
triage.notes: 地元住民は衛生環境の長年の放置を訴えているが、地元当局で対応可能な規模であり外部支援の必要性は示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ébola: brote histórico en el Congo superó los 11.000 casos y más de 5.300 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic: historic outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpassed 11,000 cases and more than 5,300 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 11,000 confirmed infections and 5,387 deaths, a case fatality rate of 48.8% from 11,042 infections, as of 11 November 2026. Declared May 15, 2026, the outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola, with no approved vaccines or treatments for this strain, hindering containment in conflict-affected eastern DRC. Eight of 26 provinces are affected, led by Ituri (7,485 cases, 3,532 deaths) and North Kivu (2,593 cases, 1,422 deaths). Cross-border spread includes Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. Armed conflict and attacks on health workers, including arson of a treatment center in Lolwa, disrupt response. MSF warns of care delays due to misinformation. The WHO launched the Tumaini emergency trial on Oct 23 in Bunia to test Ervebo for cross-protection against Bundibugyo, with plans to add Oxford and Moderna vaccine candidates pending approvals.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：コンゴ(DRC)での歴史的なアウトブレイクが1万1000症例、死者5300人超に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）が確認され、承認されたワクチン・治療法がない新規株（Bundibugyo Ebola）による大規模・高致死率の流行であり、国境を越えた拡大（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）も報告されているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの大規模流行が主題。ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへの越境拡大が言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。致死率48.8%、承認ワクチン・治療薬なし、紛争地域での対応困難、医療従事者への攻撃など極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: XFG: o que se sabe sobre a variante do coronavírus que predomina no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: XFG: What is known about the coronavirus variant that predominates in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s COVID-19 activity is linked to the Omicron subvariant XFG and descendants, which together accounted for about 90% of 2,199 sequenced samples in 2026 (weeks 1–42), per the Ministry of Health; XFG remains under World Health Organization monitoring. XFG appears to be more transmissible, but there is no evidence it causes more severe disease than other circulating variants. Symptoms align with typical COVID-19, such as runny nose and cough, with possible progression to pneumonia or severe illness. The rise in cases cannot yet be attributed to XFG. Increases in severe COVID-19 are reported in Mato Grosso, the Federal District, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, and Santa Catarina, though overall incidence is low. Vaccination remains crucial to prevent severe outcomes; high-risk groups include elderly, very young children, and the immunocompromised. Masking and medical evaluation are advised for respiratory symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: XFG：ブラジルで優勢となっている新型コロナウイルス変異株について分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: WHO監視下の変異株XFGがブラジルで優勢となり重症例増加の報告があるが、重症度増加のエビデンスはなく全体の発生率は低いため、フルRRAには至らないが経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: XFGはWHOが監視中の既知のオミクロン系統であり、感染性増加の可能性はあるが重症度増加のエビデンスはない。複数州で重症例増加が報告されているが全体の発生率は低いとされる。続報での重症度・流行状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño will cause 'pandemic-scale mortality'
article.articleSummary: El Niño 2026-27, predicted to be the most intense on record, is expected to cause pandemic-scale mortality worldwide. Epidemiologists urged classifying the event as a global health emergency of international concern, arguing it could kill hundreds of thousands. An early analysis cited by Dr. Colin Carlson and Prof. Christopher Callahan projects nearly 500,000 deaths from extreme heat alone, with epidemics of dengue fever, cholera, and other infectious diseases likely to occur in tandem. The researchers call for the WHO to elevate the situation to a level akin to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and the circulation of polio. El Niño is a natural climate phenomenon intensified by warming oceans; its health impact could be amplified by climate change and affect countries worldwide, with dengue, cholera, and heat-related mortality central to the risks.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョが『パンデミック規模の死亡』を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: 2026-27年エルニーニョによる世界的な健康被害を予測する科学者の見解記事であり、具体的な感染症アウトブレイクの確定情報はない。DRCのエボラや世界的なポリオは比較対象として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地としての主題ではない。続報や実際の症例報告を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はエルニーニョによる将来的な世界的健康危機を予測する研究者の意見記事であり、DRCのエボラやポリオは比較の引用として言及されているに過ぎず、実際の発生国としての確定情報はない。具体的な疾病発生データが不足しているため、WATCHとして継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Neutralizing Antibodies Differ Between Historical Vaccine and
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus-neutralizing antibody titers differ between China's historical vaccine strains and circulating epidemic strains in hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS). In a study of 48 convalescent HFRS patients (HTNV 23, SEOV 13, untypable 12) and vaccinees, neutralizing antibodies were measured via MN-ELISA against HTNV vaccine strain 84FLi, SEOV vaccine strain L99, and epidemic strains SX26 (HTNV), LN03 and FJ-17 (SEOV). HTNV titers were higher against the vaccine strain 84FLi than SX26 in both patients (1:386.08 vs 1:223.04, P<0.001) and vaccinees (1:137.94 vs 1:110.37, P<0.05). SEOV titers showed the opposite pattern, with higher neutralization for epidemic strains LN03 and FJ-17 than against L99 (patients 1:177.02 vs 1:297.71, P<0.01; vaccinees 1:97.52 vs 1:243.71, P<0.001), and heterogeneity between LN03 and FJ-17. Authors highlight geographicly structured viral diversity affecting immunogenicity, noting the vaccine induces broad cross-neutralization but efficacy varies across circulating strains; hence ongoing regional genomic surveillance and vaccine-strain matching are essential for sustained HFRS control in China.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス中和抗体、既存ワクチン株と中国国内流行株で異なる反応
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は研究論文の内容であり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は研究報告（免疫学的な抗体中和能の比較研究）であり、具体的なアウトブレイク事例や患者数の急増等は報告されていない。HFRSの地域サーベイランスに関する学術的知見であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: DRC: nearly 11,000 cases of Ebola reported in the 42nd week - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: as of the 42nd epidemiological week, 10,920 cumulative Ebola cases were reported with a case-fatality rate of 48% and 69% contact tracing. The most concerning finding is a higher mortality among children in Nord-Kivu province, prompting a thorough methodological review to identify factors driving deaths and to define targeted interventions to protect children and the elderly. The coordination team recommends strengthening child and elder protection and analyzing mortality determinants. Cross-border collaboration with Uganda was discussed, with plans to translate bilateral meeting conclusions into concrete actions, notably by enhancing health surveillance at points of entry. Final conclusions of the bilateral meeting are awaited to guide these actions.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:第42週までにエボラ症例が約11,000件報告 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ累計症例が約11,000件、致死率48%と深刻であり、小児の死亡率上昇という異常所見とウガンダとの越境協力の必要性からIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ウガンダは国境協力の文脈で言及されているが、記事の主題である発生国はDRCのみであり、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: ZNAČAJ KORAK KA SUZBIJANJU EPIDEMIJE Kenija otpustila poslednjeg pacijenta obolelog od ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Importance of a Step Toward Containing the Epidemic: Kenya Discharged the Last Patient Infected With Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient in Nairobi, marking a step toward containment. The seventh recovered patient was released; 11 of his contacts are under 21-day quarantine. Health Minister Aden Duale said all 135 identified contacts were monitored, and all confirmed cases belonged to a single transmission chain, with no evidence of community spread. Kenya has reported nine confirmed cases overall, with seven recoveries and two deaths; the most recent case was recorded on October 20, and there have been no new infections since. If no new cases by December 23, Kenya could be declared Ebola-free. Africa CDC called the development a regional success but urged continued epidemiological surveillance until the outbreak is finished. Uganda, neighboring DR Congo, declared its outbreak over on August 27. In DR Congo, since May, 5,387 deaths and about 11,000 cases; Bundibugyo Ebola virus, no approved vaccine or specific therapy, though trials are ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: 重要な前進：ケニアがエボラ出血熱患者の最後の一人を退院させる－流行抑制への一歩
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続く大規模なエボラ流行（死者5,387人、症例約11,000人）があり、国際的拡大とヒト-ヒト感染の懸念から、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの流行終息（ケニアは対象国リスト外のため除外）だが、DRCにおける大規模かつ継続中のエボラ流行（5,387人死亡、約11,000症例、2026年5月以降）が背景情報として言及されており、これがPICKUP判定の主因となる。Uganda（対象国外）は既に流行終息を宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: "إيبولا" يفتك بـ5387 شخصاً في الكونغو.. والإصابات تتجاوز 11 ألفاً
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has claimed 5,387 lives in the Congo, and cases have surpassed 11,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 11,042 confirmed infections and 5,387 deaths since the mid-May start of this outbreak, the worst on record for the country. Eight of 26 provinces are affected, with Ituri reporting 7,684 cases and 3,628 deaths, and North Kivu 2,737 cases and 1,505 deaths, accounting for the majority of cases; the remaining provinces total 621 infections and 254 deaths. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Ongoing violence hampers containment, with health teams attacked, four killed across two incidents, and contact tracing disrupted, leading to over 1,000 potential contacts lost. Infections linked to the outbreak have been reported in Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria, heightening cross-border concerns. International efforts include vaccine trials and other preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラ」がコンゴで5,387人の命を奪う。感染者数は11,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模のエボラ出血熱流行（感染者11,042人、死者5,387人）が発生し、国境を越えた感染拡大懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへの感染関連報告があるとされるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。暴力による封じ込め困難、ワクチン・治療法未承認（Bundibugyo株）など深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC condemns deadly attack on health facilities amid DRC Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Attack on health facilities in Cantine-Aloya, Beni territory, North Kivu, eastern DRC, occurred overnight Thursday–Friday, targeting civilians and Ebola patients amid the ongoing outbreak. Hundreds with confirmed or suspected Ebola fled facilities, heightening public-health risk. Africa CDC condemns the assault and calls for a 'corridor of peace' to protect civilians, patients, health workers and facilities, and to maintain access for outbreak response; it urges respect for international humanitarian law protections for healthcare. Interruptions to patient care, contact tracing or disease surveillance worsen outcomes. The outbreak, first declared on 15 May, has spread from 3 to 67 health zones across eight provinces, with 10,668 confirmed cases and 5,198 deaths recorded by Africa CDC. Africa CDC reiterates collaboration with DRC authorities and partners to support Ebola response and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、DRCエボラ流行の最中に医療施設への死者を伴う攻撃を非難
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（10,668症例、5,198死亡、67保健地区に拡大）の最中に医療施設が攻撃され、患者が逃走し感染拡大・対応阻害のリスクが高まっているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 医療施設への攻撃により、感染者の逃走・接触者追跡の中断・サーベイランスの弱体化が懸念され、アウトブレイク対応の継続性に重大なリスクをもたらしている。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết, cúm A cùng gia tăng: Nhiều ca nặng nhập viện cấp cứu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever and Influenza A on the rise: Many severe cases admitted to the emergency department.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, Hanoi hospitals report a rise in dengue fever and Influenza A with severe cases. The National Hospital for Tropical Diseases is treating two women with severe dengue: a 53-year-old from Hai Phong and a 23-year-old from Hanoi, with marked thrombocytopenia (platelets 38→21 G/L), extremely high liver enzymes (near 2000 U/L), coagulopathy and organ injury; one shows ascites and pleural effusions consistent with plasma leakage, with a total of 16 dengue patients under care at the center. At Thanh Nhan Hospital, about 60 patients are hospitalized for influenza, roughly 50 with Influenza A, predominantly elderly with comorbidities; one patient (born 1951 in Hanoi) remains on oxygen after six days with pneumonia and respiratory failure. Hospitals have expanded beds and staff; clinicians urge rapid care for warning signs and caution against self-medication with antipyretics/NSAIDs. Seasonal weather changes may facilitate spread.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱とA型インフルエンザが同時増加：重症化し救急入院する例が多数
triage.triage_reason: ハノイでデング熱とインフルエンザA型の重症例が増加しているが、季節性の流行拡大であり国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は見られないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: デング熱・インフルエンザA型ともにハノイを中心とした季節性の増加であり、病院は病床・人員を拡充して対応中。重症例（血小板減少、肝酵素上昇、呼吸不全等）が報告されているが、現時点では地域内の医療対応の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas registra 17 casos de mpox em 2026; saiba identificar a doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas records 17 mpox cases in 2026; learn how to identify the disease.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil, reports 17 mpox cases in 2026 through November 11; all patients are men aged 20–49 (20–29, 30–39, 40–49) with no deaths. The 2022–2026 series: 2022, 96; 2023, 1; 2024, 22; 2025, 20; 2026, 17 (as of 11/11). Health specialist Valéria Almeida notes a modest uptick in recent weeks, aligning with trends in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. Mpox is caused by Monkeypox virus (MPXV), an Orthopoxvirus, zoonotic. Transmission occurs via direct contact with lesions or bodily secretions, contaminated objects, and close respiratory contact. Diagnosis is by molecular laboratory testing. Incubation is 3–16 days (up to 21). Symptoms include skin lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, myalgias, and fatigue; lesions may appear on face, hands, genitals, or anus. Seek medical care for lesions with fever or swollen nodes, recent exposure, or high-risk status; avoid close contact until evaluated.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナスで2026年にmpox症例17件を記録；疾患の識別方法について
triage.triage_reason: 死亡例なく散発的な報告だが、サンパウロ・リオデジャネイロでも同様の増加傾向が見られるため、地域的な拡大動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 2022年のピーク(96例)以降、年々減少傾向にあり、2026年の17例は過去と比べ特段の急増ではない。死亡例なし、年齢層は20-49歳男性に限定。サンパウロ・リオデジャネイロでも同様の緩やかな増加が報告されているが、詳細な数値や公衆衛生上の対応は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Indian Hepatitis Summit 2025 Examines National Pathways Toward Viral
article.articleSummary: Chennai Liver Foundation hosted the Indian Hepatitis Summit 2025 in Chennai on Jan 17‑18, with 54 program faculty and 275 delegates, and published as a meeting report in BMC Proceedings. It outlines strategies to eliminate viral hepatitis in India by 2030, aligning with WHO Global Health Sector Strategies 2022–2030 and SDG 3.3. The gathering evaluated epidemiology, programmatic frameworks, barriers, and international and regional models, noting that India’s National Viral Hepatitis Control Program (2018) faces urgent operational hurdles with only five years remaining to targets. India accounts for 11.6% of global HBV/HCV burden (≈29.8 million HBV, ≈5.5 million HCV). In SEA, 61.4 million HBV and 9.1 million HCV, representing 24% of global cases, 10% of HIV, and 16% of STIs. Egypt and Pakistan examples informed potential strategies. India’s program now includes 978 treatment sites across 711 districts, ~4,900 master trainers, and ~300,000 treated patients, with focus on vulnerable groups and stigma reduction.

triage.headline_ja: インド肝炎サミット2025、ウイルス性肝炎撲滅への国家的道筋を検討
triage.triage_reason: 学会・政策会議に関する報告であり、急性の公衆衛生緊急事態や異常な流行を示すものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はウイルス性肝炎（HBV/HCV）の国家戦略・政策会議の報告であり、急性アウトブレイクの報告ではない。エジプト・パキスタンは参考事例として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生事象ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Covid: quais grupos devem se preocupar com a nova escalada do vírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: Which Groups Should Be Concerned About the Virus's New Surge.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising across 18 Brazilian states, with SARS-CoV-2 at low overall risk but posing greater danger to vulnerable groups: the elderly, infants (6 months–5 years), pregnant people, immunocompromised individuals, and those with chronic diseases. From the year's start through November 4, 118,851 influenza-like illness cases linked to the virus were reported. About 15% of infections may be severe and 5% critical; MIS-C and MIS-A inflammatory syndromes can affect children, adolescents, and adults. A vaccination strategy targets these groups: infants 6 months–5 years who have never been vaccinated receive three doses (second after 4 weeks; third after 8 weeks); pregnant individuals receive one dose per pregnancy; adults over 60 and the immunocompromised a dose every six months; people with comorbidities one dose per year. Contacts should avoid symptomatic exposure and wear masks. Stratus (XFG) dominates, ~90% of samples; no evidence of higher severity; vaccines protect against severe disease. Genomic surveillance identified 2,199 sequences and 127 lineages, including JN.1, with regional distribution similar. Over 7.4 million doses administered this year via SUS.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ：ウイルスの新たな拡大で懸念すべきグループとは
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで新型コロナ感染者が増加しているが、全体的なリスクは低く、既知の変異株（Stratus/XFG、JN.1系統）であり、ワクチン接種体制も確立された平常時のサーベイランス報告である。
triage.notes: 季節性の新型コロナ感染拡大に関する通常のサーベイランス情報であり、既存の変異株（JN.1系統、XFG）で重症度の増加は確認されていない。SUSによるワクチン接種プログラムも継続中。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief Tedros commends Kenya for containing Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Kenya discharged its final Ebola patient, initiating a 42-day countdown to being Ebola-free; declaration possible on December 23, 2026 if no new infections occur. Kenya has nine Ebola cases linked to an imported infection from the DRC, including two deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus praised Kenya's health workers, responders and government for preparedness, surveillance and swift intervention, urging vigilance during the monitoring period. In the DRC, insecurity threatens the Ebola response: a Cantine-Aloya attack killed 66 civilians, including three health workers; three health facilities were looted or burned. More than 1,000 contacts are lost to follow-up, and three confirmed Ebola cases are unaccounted for; a nurse was killed and another health worker seriously injured in Tshopo Province two weeks earlier. The outbreak in the DRC remains a PHEIC with almost 11,000 confirmed cases and over 5,300 deaths across eight provinces as of Nov 11, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長テドロス氏、ケニアのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク封じ込めを称賛
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱のPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）が継続中で、約11,000症例・5,300人超の死亡、治安悪化により接触者追跡が困難になっている。ケニアへの国境を越えた拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ケニアはBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リスト（GeoNames ID指定）には含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCの治安悪化（攻撃による医療従事者死亡、施設破壊、1,000人超の接触者フォローアップ喪失）が response の重大な障害となっており、PHEIC継続中である点に特に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Preocupación por el aumento de casos de viruela símica en Brasil y Argentina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern over the rise in monkeypox cases in Brazil and Argentina.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (mpox) cases are rising in Brazil and Argentina as of 2026-11-11. Brazil reports 832 total cases, with concentrations in São Paulo (64 new infections in one month) and Rio de Janeiro (74 cases in the last two months, seven times the 2025 figure); Ceará and Brasília are focal. In Argentina, 23 cases have been recorded this year, with at least four clade Ib infections detected in Córdoba, San Juan, and Buenos Aires province. Clade Ib, originally described in the Democratic Republic of Congo, is the most transmissible among person-to-person spread. Transmission occurs via respiratory droplets in close contact, contact with lesions, fluids, and contaminated objects. Incubation is 6–20 days, starting with flu-like symptoms, fever, muscle pains, and swollen lymph nodes, followed by skin lesions. Brazil has secured 25,000 additional vaccine doses for at-risk groups. Authorities urge vigilance; the situation is not at the scale of the 2022 emergency.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルとアルゼンチンで増加するサル痘（Mpox）症例への懸念
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで832例、アルゼンチンでクレードIb感染を含む症例が確認され、人-人感染しやすいクレードIbの検出は異常事象であり、国際的拡大リスクも認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・アルゼンチンでのMpox（Clade Ib含む）症例増加が主題。DRCはクレードIbの起源地として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため除外。アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Paraíba registra aumento de casos leves de covid-19, aponta Ministério da Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraíba records an increase in mild COVID-19 cases, according to the Ministry of Health.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Health Ministry reports Paraíba, among 18 states, with a rise in mild COVID-19 cases, per the Influenza-like Syndromes surveillance bulletin through Oct 31. Despite the uptick, the situation is low risk. Other states with rising mild cases include Alagoas, Bahia, Ceará, DF, Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Mato Grosso, Pernambuco, Piauí, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina and São Paulo. For severe cases, a rising trend of COVID-19–associated SRAG is seen in Mato Grosso, DF, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo and Santa Catarina, though levels remain low. In 2026, 118,851 COVID-19–related ILI cases were reported, down 68.8% from 2025; SRAG cases total about 3,400 (−63%), with 437 deaths (−69%). Vaccination remains prevention; since 2024 it is in the National Vaccination Schedule for children 6 months–<5 years, pregnant people, and adults 60+, with guidance for at-risk groups to update at UBS or vaccination posts.

triage.headline_ja: パライバ州、新型コロナウイルスの軽症例が増加と保健省が発表
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル保健省の定期サーベイランス報告であり、低リスクと明記され、症例数・死亡数も前年より大幅減少しているため、通常の季節性動向の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。記事は既存の季節性サーベイランス報告であり、低リスクと明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 volta a crescer em SP; entenda alerta sobre novas variantes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 is rising again in São Paulo; understand the alert about new variants.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 resurgence in São Paulo as of late 2026; hospitals report more SARS-CoV-2 infections, but severe illness remains low. In October, Beneficência Portuguesa registered 28 infections; Santa Catarina-Paulista 98; Nove de Julho saw higher demand in early November. Fiocruz InfoGripe (5 Nov) detects increases in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome associated with COVID-19 across five states—São Paulo, Mato Grosso, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina, and the Federal District, with Mato Grosso most affected. Genomic surveillance (Jan–Oct 2026) identified 127 SARS-CoV-2 lineages in 2,199 sequences, reflecting ongoing viral evolution; no single lineage identified as driving the surge. São Paulo totals for 2026: 1,375 cases, 440 ICU admissions, 195 deaths; capital: 356 cases, 104 ICU, 46 deaths, versus higher 2025 figures. Nationwide, 19 states show rising notifications over six weeks, but national risk remains low; continued monitoring recommended, especially for the elderly and immunocompromised.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロで新型コロナ感染者が再び増加；新変異株に関する警戒について理解する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でCOVID-19感染者数が季節的に増加しているが、重症化率は低く、国としてのリスクは低いと評価されており、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候も見られない。
triage.notes: COVID-19の季節的な増加であり、Fiocruz InfoGripeや州保健当局による通常のサーベイランス報告。重症患者数・死亡数は低水準で推移しており、新たな懸念すべき変異株の特定もない。国内監視の継続が推奨されているのみで、フルリスク評価の必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ébola en El Congo, la segunda más mortífera de la historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Congo, the second deadliest in history.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak, declared May 15, is the second deadliest in history, with 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths as of November 9, a 48.8% fatality rate. About 2,990 people have recovered; 651 remain hospitalized or in isolation. Contact tracing covers 79.7% of cases, but health authorities say this is insufficient to curb transmission. The epicenters are Ituri and North Kivu, accounting for 57.7% and 32.7% of new cases on November 9, respectively. The outbreak spans 67 health zones across eight provinces, fueled by armed conflict and mass displacement that hinder access to care. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved targeted therapies exist. WHO notes the absence of specific cures, focusing on supportive care and prevention. Two vaccine candidates have entered Phase 1 trials with acceptable safety; full development could take months. Frontline workers lack a drug that directly reduces mortality.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、史上2番目に死者数が多い
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.8%、感染者1万人超・死者5000人超の大規模流行で、紛争・大量避難民により接触者追跡が不十分かつ8州67保健地域に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 史上2番目に致死的なエボラ流行とされ、武力紛争により対応が困難化。特異的治療薬はなく、ワクチン候補はフェーズ1段階。継続的なフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Covid sobem no país: saiba diferenciar os sintomas da gripe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases are rising in the country: learn to differentiate flu symptoms.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising in Brazil, with Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin showing increases in severe cases in Mato Grosso, the Federal District, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Santa Catarina. In São Paulo, 1,375 severe cases and 440 ICU admissions occurred from January through Monday 9th. Vaccination is the main preventive measure, available free at health posts. Priority groups include elderly, immunocompromised, pregnant people, health workers, those with comorbidities, Indigenous communities, residents of long-term care facilities, and prisoners and children aged 6 months to 4 years. COVID-19 commonly presents with fever, dry cough, fatigue, sore throat, nasal congestion, headache, myalgias, loss of smell or taste, GI symptoms, and in moderate/severe cases dyspnea and hypoxemia; influenza tends to have fever often. The main flu symptoms, per Butantan, are sudden fever, dry cough, headache, myalgias, sore throat, and runny nose. For mild to moderate cases, rest, hydration, and balanced nutrition are key.

triage.headline_ja: 国内でCOVID-19症例が増加:インフルエンザとの症状の見分け方
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の季節的な増加に関する一般的な健康情報記事であり、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内で、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 既知の疾患(COVID-19/インフルエンザ)の季節性増加に関する一般向け医療情報記事。重症例・ICU入院数の報告はあるが、既存の医療体制内で対応されており、ワクチン接種呼びかけ等通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲。

article.articleHeadline: UAE Ends Visa Ban for Ugandan Nationals After Ebola Outbreak Review
article.articleSummary: As of 11 November 2026, the United Arab Emirates has lifted its June 2026 visa suspension for Ugandan nationals, resuming new visa issuance with a 21‑day travel restriction. The ban aimed to limit importing Ebola cases from Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and South Sudan, with Uganda first among the three to have restrictions eased after reassessment by UAE health and emergency agencies. Ugandans already in the UAE may return if they were students enrolled before June 2026 and their families, subject to health procedures. Diplomatic passport holders, embassy staff, humanitarian workers, and patients seeking medical treatment are exempt, though medical applicants must provide documentation of condition and treatment plans. The ban remains for DR Congo and South Sudan. Authorities involved include the National Emergency Crisis and Disaster Management Authority, the Ministry of Health and Prevention, and the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security. Officials expect visa resumption to boost travel for work, education, and family visits, with the 21‑day rule persisting.

triage.headline_ja: UAE、エボラ流行審査後にウガンダ国籍者へのビザ禁止を解除
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤な感染症であり、複数国（ウガンダ、DRC、南スーダン）にまたがる流行に伴い渡航制限が継続・調整されている点でIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はUAEのビザ政策変更が主題だが、エボラ流行国としてDRCが依然渡航制限対象である旨言及されており、進行中のアウトブレイク文脈として含めた。ウガンダ・南スーダン・UAEは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Belford Roxo realiza ação de combate a roedores e prevenção à dengue - Prefeitura de Belford Roxo - Belford Roxo 24h
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belford Roxo carries out an action to combat rodents and dengue prevention - Belford Roxo City Hall - Belford Roxo 24h.
article.articleSummary: On 11 November 2026, Belford Roxo City Hall's Health Secretariat, via the Vector and Zoonoses Coordination, carried out a rodent-control and dengue-prevention action at Park Belo Campo in central Belford Roxo. The operation integrated the Rodent Control Program (PCR), fumacê fogging, domiciliary visits, and health-education outreach to curb urban pests and prevent dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and leptospirosis. The activities targeted the Park Belo Campo condominium, home to more than 4,000 residents, with inspections and outreach within a 150-meter radius. Marcelo Guimarães, Coordinator of Vector and Zoonoses, emphasized the municipality's commitment to public health and noted the effort as another joint initiative by the Belford Roxo municipal government to protect residents' health.

triage.headline_ja: ベルフォード・ロショ市、ネズミ対策とデング熱予防活動を実施 - ベルフォード・ロショ市役所
triage.triage_reason: 通常の公衆衛生予防活動の報告であり、実際の症例発生や異常な流行状況を示す情報がないため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ベルフォード・ロショ市における定例的な防虫・デング熱予防活動の広報であり、具体的な症例数や流行の急増を示す情報は含まれていない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、記事内容が予防活動の報告に留まるためverified_locationsには含めない（イベント性が低いため）。

article.articleHeadline: Ferritin Ratios Fail to Outperform Routine Blood Tests in Adult Dengue
article.articleSummary: In a prospective study at SMIMER Hospital, Surat, India (June 2020–November 2021), 100 adults with WHO 2009‑confirmed dengue were evaluated to test ferritin kinetics and composite ferritin-derived ratios against routine tests for predicting severe outcomes. Of the cohort, 68 had non‑severe disease and 32 severe; endpoints included dengue shock syndrome in 22, severe thrombocytopenia (<20,000/µL) in 28, and severe hepatitis (AST/ALT ≥1000 U/L) in 18. Ferritin rose to a Day 3 peak of 955±177 ng/mL before falling, with Day 1 ferritin discriminating shock (AUC 0.789) and severe thrombocytopenia (AUC 0.727). Ferritin-to-Platelet Day 1 AUC 0.801 versus platelet alone 0.784 (p=0.41); Ferritin/ALT Day 1 AUC 0.995 versus ALT alone 1.000 (p=0.23). Overall, ferritin ratios did not provide incremental diagnostic benefit over routine tests, suggesting no added value for predicting severe dengue outcomes; multicenter validation is needed.

triage.headline_ja: フェリチン比は成人デング熱において通常の血液検査を上回る性能を示さず
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は臨床診断研究であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 2020-2021年に実施された後ろ向き研究の結果報告であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクに関する情報ではない。デング熱の発生そのものを報じる記事ではないため対象国の該当なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果伊波拉疫情创历来最严重 累计确诊破1万1000起
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo Ebola outbreak the deadliest on record; cumulative confirmed cases exceed 11,000.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak is the deadliest on record, with cumulative confirmed cases exceeding 11,000 and over 10,000 infections, and 5,387 deaths (case fatality near 50%). The surge has spread to seven additional provinces and to neighboring Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. In Kenya, the last Ebola patient has recovered and a 42-day surveillance window has begun; if no new cases are reported, Kenya will declare the outbreak over on December 23, 2026. Kenya’s nine confirmed cases (two deaths) are all linked to the index patient—a Kenyan man who had traveled to Congo—first diagnosed on October 6, 2026. The situation highlights ongoing international spread from the Congo outbreak into East Africa and adjacent regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が史上最悪に、累計確定症例が1万1000件を突破
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%、史上最悪規模の流行で複数国への国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき案件。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ流行を主題とし、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの波及に言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ケニアでの症例は収束傾向（42日間サーベイランス中）との記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: حصيلة إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000 cases, with 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths, according to the latest Ministry of Health data as of 2026-11-11. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus and remains ongoing since mid-May, spanning eight of the country’s 26 provinces. The death toll is roughly half of reported cases, in one of the deadliest outbreaks in the country. Security and health-system challenges hinder containment, with violence in Ituri and North Kivu raising risks to health workers and complicating access to affected areas. Attacks on health facilities have been reported, hindering vaccination and patient care efforts. Health authorities urge safe passage for responders and continued containment measures. Cross-border concerns are rising as cases appear in Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria, underscoring regional transmission risks amid ongoing eastern Congo conflicts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の死者数
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1万件超の感染・致死率約50%の大規模エボラ流行が継続し、治安悪化により封じ込めが困難化、周辺国への越境拡大懸念もあるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの感染拡大懸念が言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。主発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州・北キブ州を含む8州）。

article.articleHeadline: 喜剧演员何以扁桃体切除术后死亡 手术感染引发悲剧
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How did a comedian die after a tonsillectomy? A postoperative infection triggered the tragedy.
article.articleSummary: On November 7, A Yan, a signed actor with Dalian Hui Xiao Comedy and a Tencent ‘Single-rank Comedy Contest’ participant, died after a tonsillectomy due to a postoperative infection. He was hospitalized for infection and, during a second operation, suffered a cardiac arrest and could not be resuscitated. The obituary released November 8 confirmed his death, with funeral arrangements to be held in Dalian. Prior to surgery, he had posted anxiety about anesthesia and had undergone weight loss, reported from 330 lb down to 260 lb; his mother is undergoing cancer treatment this year. ENT physician Peng Wei of Union Hospital, Tongji Medical College (Huazhong University of Science and Technology) noted that post-tonsillectomy mortality is very low and most deaths result from major bleeding, with age as a key predictor of postoperative hemorrhage—riskier in adults and very young children.

triage.headline_ja: 喜劇俳優、扁桃摘出術後に死亡 手術感染が悲劇を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: 個別の医療事故（扁桃摘出術後の感染による死亡）であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生や感染症アウトブレイクには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本件は著名人の個人的な医療事故（術後感染による死亡）であり、感染症の集団発生やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。公衆的関心はあるが公衆衛生上のリスク事象ではないため対象国に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Raoni segue internado em MT com infecção pulmonar e quadro estável
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Raoni remains hospitalized in Mato Grosso with a pulmonary infection and his condition is stable.
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary infection in Raoni Metuktire, the renowned Indigenous leader, requires hospitalization in the Regional Hospital of Peixoto de Azevedo, Mato Grosso, Brazil. Three days after presenting with blood pressure fluctuations, he was admitted from the UPA to the regional hospital. Medical team diagnosed a pulmonary infection and started intravenous antibiotics. To stabilize hemodynamics, vasoactive medications were used. He is clinically stable but remains on drug therapy to maintain blood pressure. He eats orally and breathes ambient air without supplemental oxygen. Care is guided by palliative principles, emphasizing comfort and symptom control, with respect for his dignity. The Instituto Raoni and family request privacy; updates will be shared through official channels. Raoni's leadership is highlighted as a reference for Indigenous peoples and Amazon defense.

triage.headline_ja: ラオニ氏、肺感染症でマット・グロッソ州に入院、容体は安定
triage.triage_reason: 著名な個人1名の肺感染症による入院に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の脅威やアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 著名な先住民指導者ラオニ氏個人の健康状態に関する記事であり、感染症のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の懸念事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Creche suspende aulas após surto de sarna em MS; 40 foram infectados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Daycare center suspends classes after scabies outbreak in Mato Grosso do Sul; 40 were infected.
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreak at Recanto Raízes Municipal Education Center in Jardim Água Boa, Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with 40 confirmed cases (24 children, 16 staff). Indefinite class suspension began 11 November 2026 to interrupt transmission and allow full decontamination. Of the 40 cases, 18 have recovered and others remain under treatment; six reinfestations and five new cases have been reported recently. A second unit, Ceim Beatriz de Barros Bumlai, reports four staff and two children diagnosed; authorities implemented decontamination and staff exclusions there as well. Scabies spreads mainly by direct skin contact, with a 2–6 week incubation, so multiple cases in a school cluster indicate active transmission. Emphasis on household decontamination: wash recent clothes, linens, and towels in boiling water and iron; nonwashables should be sealed for at least 72 hours, ideally seven days, since mites survive 3–4 days off a human host.

triage.headline_ja: 保育施設で疥癬の集団感染、40人感染によりMS州で授業停止
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威や渡航制限につながるものではなく、ローカルな施設内集団感染に留まり、国家的・国際的関心も低い。
triage.notes: 疥癬は直接皮膚接触で感染し重症度は低いが、学校施設内での集団感染（再感染含む）が続いており、地域の衛生対策として続報の可能性はあるが全国的・国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Molecular Survey Detects Widespread Zoonotic Parasites in Hubei Goat Herds
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-12, across five goat-farming regions in Hubei Province, China, a cross-sectional molecular survey of 500 fecal samples (April 2024–April 2025) found widespread circulation of Giardia duodenalis (29.4%), Enterocytozoon bieneusi (16.2%), and Cryptosporidium spp. (3.2%). This provides the province’s first molecular baseline for these pathogens. Cryptosporidium positives (n=16) were mainly C. bovis (8) and C. xiaoi (6); zoonotic lineages included C. parvum IIdA19G1 and C. ubiquitum XIIa (one each, 6.3% of positives). Giardia and E. bieneusi harbored human-infective lineages as well, indicating cross-species transmission potential. Regionally, prevalence varied (e.g., Xiangyang 6.9%). Molecular work used nested PCR targeting multi-locus loci for Giardia, ITS for E. bieneusi, SSU rRNA and gp60 for Cryptosporidium, with BLAST and phylogenetic validation. Goats thus represent reservoirs with public-health implications.

triage.headline_ja: 分子疫学調査により湖北省のヤギ群で広範な人獣共通寄生虫を検出
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はヤギの糞便サンプルを対象とした学術的な分子疫学調査報告であり、実際のヒトでの感染事例や公衆衛生上の緊急事態は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は湖北省のヤギ農場における寄生虫（Giardia、Cryptosporidium、Enterocytozoon bieneusi）の分子疫学的基礎調査であり、人獣共通感染の可能性は指摘されているが、実際のヒト感染事例やアウトブレイクの報告はない。研究論文としての情報提供にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、感染者1万1000人超 武力衝突が対策阻む
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola hemorrhagic fever in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: more than 11,000 people infected; armed conflict hampers countermeasures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola hemorrhagic fever outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 11,042 laboratory-confirmed infections and 5,387 deaths as of November 11, 2026, according to INSP. Originating in Ituri Province in the northeast, the outbreak has spread to seven other provinces, with most cases in Ituri and North Kivu; infections have been reported in Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. Ongoing insecurity hampers countermeasures, with Ituri experiencing armed clashes and violence against health workers. On November 8, a healthcare facility treating Ebola patients in Rolwa was set ablaze by youths. UN reports that local militia clashes around Fataki disrupted the Ebola response. The IS-linked Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) have conducted deadly attacks across Ituri, Haut-Uele, and North Kivu in recent days, further complicating outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、感染者1万1000人超 武力衝突が対策阻む
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が1万人超感染・5千人超死亡と深刻化し、複数国への感染拡大、武力衝突による対応阻害があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの感染報告があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。武力紛争により対応が困難な点が国際的リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab Sumba Timur Bertekad Eliminasi AIDS, TBC dan Malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Sumba Regency Government Determined to Eliminate AIDS, TB, and Malaria
article.articleSummary: East Sumba Regency aims to eliminate HIV/AIDS, TB, and Malaria (ATM) through the Resilient and Sustainable Systems for Health (RSSH) ATM program. A November 11, 2026 cross-sector partnership forum at Padadita Hotel, Waingapu, discussed financing from village/kelurahan budgets and district CSR partners, plus regional support via Adinkes and The Global Fund, to form a local action plan. Attendees included Regent Umbu Lili Pekuwali (represented by Yulius Ngenju) and RSSH ATM coordinator Dr. Hyronimus A. Fernandez, with Bappeda, Health Office, camats, lurahs, and puskesmas staff. HIV/AIDS: 5,010 tested out of a 8,409 target (59.6%); people living with HIV on ART 63.9%. TB: suspects identified 3,187 of 3,558 (89.6%); new case detection 41.3%; treatment success 81.8%. Malaria API 0.84 per 1,000 population (below target <1). TB screening ongoing, but a wide gap remains between suspects examined and confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: 東スンバ県政府、HIV/AIDS・結核・マラリアの排除に取り組む姿勢を表明
triage.triage_reason: 通常の行政プログラム・会議に関する報道であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の兆候はなく、既存の公衆衛生対策活動の進捗報告にとどまる。
triage.notes: 記事はHIV/AIDS・結核・マラリアの既存対策プログラムの地域会議報告であり、新規発生や異常な公衆衛生事象ではないため対象国locationsも計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Dr. Gonzalo Vecina Neto: 'Pandemia acabou, mas Covid-19 continua em circulação'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Gonzalo Vecina Neto: "The pandemic is over, but COVID-19 continues to circulate."
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces a renewed rise in Covid-19 and other severe acute respiratory illnesses, Dr. Gonzalo Vecina Neto, a public health expert. Cold drives people indoors, increasing transmission of airborne viruses such as SARS-CoV-2, Influenza, and Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV). The expert emphasizes that the COVID-19 pandemic is over, but the virus continues circulating and contributing to hospitalizations, especially among the elderly 60+, young children under 5, and those with comorbidities. Vaccination remains crucial: annual COVID-19 and Influenza shots for these groups. Early care focuses on hydration, fever control, and rest, with urgent care if respiratory symptoms worsen. Brazil’s primary health network includes more than 50,000 vaccination posts, with federal vaccine stocks secured. SUS spending averages R$3,000 per capita for over 160 million dependents; private care has resources but serves 25% of the population. High-complexity procedures, including 95% of transplants and hemodialysis, and all hemophilia treatment, are fully funded by SUS.

triage.headline_ja: ゴンサロ・ヴェシナ・ネト博士:「パンデミックは終わったが、COVID-19は依然として流行している」
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器感染症（COVID-19、インフルエンザ、RSV）に関する一般的な公衆衛生専門家の解説記事であり、新規・異常な発生事象ではなく、ワクチン接種や医療体制の案内が主旨であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 季節性呼吸器疾患の流行状況と医療体制に関する専門家インタビュー記事であり、新規の異常事象の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dua Anak Sapi di Jembrana Bali Mati Terinfeksi Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two calves in Jembrana, Bali die of rabies.
article.articleSummary: Two calves in Pangyangan village, Pekutatan District, Jembrana, Bali died from rabies, suspected to have been transmitted by stray dogs roaming the area. Reports were received on 27 and 31 October 2026 from farmers. Veterinary officials examined the livestock; one calf displayed classic rabies signs—hypersalivation and aggression—and fled into a river near the farm before dying. Samples were collected and sent to Balai Besar Veteriner (BBVet) for laboratory testing, which confirmed rabies. The infected animals were located within 50–100 meters of each other on the farm. Officials believe transmission likely originated from stray dogs, which could bite multiple animals, enabling spread within the farm. In response, the Bali Agriculture Department initiated surveillance, dog vaccination, community education, and control of stray dog populations to prevent further cases.

triage.headline_ja: バリ州ジェンブラナで子牛2頭が狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 動物（牛）の狂犬病感染事例であり、ヒト感染の報告はないが、野犬を介した感染拡大の可能性があり地域の公衆衛生当局が対応を開始しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本事例は家畜（子牛）における狂犬病で、ヒトへの感染報告はない。野犬の存在が感染源として疑われており、当局はワクチン接種・野犬対策・啓発活動を実施中。人獣共通感染症としてヒト感染の可能性があるため継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: USP desenvolve embalagem biodegradável com prata que combate bactérias em laboratório, enquanto testes com nanopartículas registram redução de até 90,7% de E. coli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: USP develops biodegradable packaging with silver that combats bacteria in the laboratory, while tests with nanoparticles record up to 90.7% reduction in E. coli.
article.articleSummary: Researchers at the University of São Paulo (USP) and Peruvian scientists developed a biodegradable film from chitosan, vanillin, and silver nanoparticles with antibacterial activity. In antimicrobial assays, silver nanoparticles reduced Escherichia coli viability by 88.4%–90.7% after three hours; Staphylococcus aureus reductions reached 71.5% after 24 hours. Direct contact with the films demonstrated effects varying by organism and exposure time. Vanillin increased tensile strength from 38 to 48 MPa, while silver nanoparticles slowed moisture transmission by up to 17.4 hours. Antioxidant activity rose four- to sevenfold, and UV blocking occurred with silver. Human cell viability stayed above 70% at nanoparticle concentrations up to 12 µg/mL. In soil, pure chitosan degraded in ~20 days; chitosan-vanillin reached 87.7% degradation by day 30, whereas silver-containing films degraded more slowly, challenging industrial deployment. Not yet approved for foods; studies on silver migration, real-fruit/vegetable performance, and scalability are ongoing. Published in ACS Food Science & Technology.

triage.headline_ja: USPが銀を使った生分解性包装材を開発、ナノ粒子を用いた実験でE.coliを最大90.7%減少させることに成功
triage.triage_reason: これは感染症のアウトブレイク事例ではなく、抗菌性包装材料に関する研究開発記事であり、公衆衛生上の脅威やシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は食品包装材の抗菌性研究に関する内容であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。発生地域にBrazil/Peruが含まれるが、Peruは対象国リストに無く、Brazilも疾病発生国としてではなく研究機関所在地として記載されているため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Memakzulkan Stunting dan TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Impeach Stunting and TB
article.articleSummary: Stunting and tuberculosis (TB) in Indonesia remain major public health burdens. National stunting prevalence is 19.8%, with a 2026 target of 17.5%; almost one in five children is at risk, linked to maternal iron-deficiency anemia (27%). About half of stunted children live in six provinces with low economic growth. TB affects roughly 1.08 million people and causes about 126,000 deaths, accounting for about 10% of global TB and ranking second after India. Health authorities warn TB kills every five minutes in Indonesia. Notified TB cases rose from 7% of global cases in 2010 to 10% in 2024; in 2025 Indonesia detected ~80% of estimated cases, with 41% notified by July 27, 2026. The two diseases form a cycle, where malnutrition weakens immunity and sustains TB, harming productivity. The article advocates ‘impeachment’ of both conditions, citing World Bank evidence of high returns on nutrition investments.

triage.headline_ja: スタンティングと結核を弾劾する
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるTBと栄養不良の慢性的な公衆衛生課題を論じる政策論説記事であり、急性のアウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: インドは結核罹患数の国際比較（世界第1位）として言及されているのみで、記事の主題はインドネシア国内の既知の慢性的な公衆衛生課題（TBとスタンティング）に関する政策論説であるため、インドはverified_locationsから除外した。
